Ish-ba’ar lo yeda, uch’sil lo-yavin et-zot. Bifroach r’sha’im k’mo-esev, vayatzitzu kol-po’alei aven,

blocks.he: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיְיָ, וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן. לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ, וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת. עֲלֵי־עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־נָבֶל, עֲלֵי הִגָּיוֹן בְּכִנּוֹר.
blocks.tr: Tov l’hodot la’Adonai, ulzamer l’shimcha elyon. L’hagid baboker chasdecha, ve’emunatcha baleilot. Alei-asor va’alei-navel, alei higayon b’chinor.

blocks.he: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְיָ בְּפׇעֳלֶךָ, בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן. מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְיָ, מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ.
blocks.tr: Ki simachtani Adonai b’fo’olecha, b’ma’asei yadecha aranen. Mah gadlu ma’asecha Adonai, m’od amku machsh’votecha.

blocks.he: אִישׁ־בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע, וּכְסִיל לֹא־יָבִין אֶת־זֹאת. בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ־עֵשֶׂב וַיָּצִיצוּ כׇּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן, לְהִשָּׁמְדָם עֲדֵי־עַד. וְאַתָּה מָרוֹם לְעֹלָם יְיָ. כִּי הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יְיָ כִּי־הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ, יִתְפָּרְדוּ כׇּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן. וַתָּרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי, בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָן. וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים תִּשְׁמַעְנָה אׇזְנָי.
blocks.tr: Ish-ba’ar lo yeda, uch’sil lo-yavin et-zot. Bifroach r’sha’im k’mo-esev, vayatzitzu kol-po’alei aven, l’hishamdam adei-ad. V’ata marom l’olam Adonai. Ki hineh oyvecha Adonai, ki-hineh oyvecha yovedu, yitpardu kol-po’alei aven. Vatarem kir’em karni, baloti b’shemen ra’anan. Vatabet eini b’shurai, bakamim alai m’re’im tishma’na oznai.

blocks.he: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח, כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה. שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְיָ, בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִיחוּ.
blocks.tr: Tzadik katamar yifrach, k’erez balvanon yisge. Sh’tulim b’veit Adonai, b’chatzrot Eloheinu yafrichu.

blocks.he: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה, דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ. לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְיָ, צוּרִי וְלֹא־עַוְלָתָה בּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Od y’nuvun b’seiva, d’shenim v’ra’ananim yihyu. L’hagid ki-yashar Adonai, tzuri v’lo-avlata bo.

blocks.en: A psalm, a song for the day of Shabbat. It is good to give thanks to You, to sing to Your name, Most High — to tell of Your love in the morning and Your faithfulness through the nights, on the ten-stringed harp and the lyre, to the murmuring of the harp.
You have gladdened me by what You have made; at the work of Your hands I sing for joy. How great are Your works — how deep beyond us are Your thoughts.

A brutish person cannot know this, a fool cannot grasp it: though the wicked spring up like grass and all who do harm blossom, it is only to be destroyed forever — while You are exalted for all time. For look: those who set themselves against You, the ones who do harm, scatter and are undone.
You have lifted my strength high; I am anointed with fresh oil. My eyes have seen the fall of those who watched for me; my ears take in the fate of those who would rise against me.

The just flourish like the date palm and grow tall like a cedar of Lebanon — planted in Your house, they blossom in the courtyards of our God. Even in old age they still bear fruit, staying full of sap and green — to declare that You are upright, my Rock, in whom there is no wrong.

sources.name: Psalm 93
aliases: The psalm of Friday itself — we close the week by singing the very crown creation sang when it was new.

Mikolot mayim rabim, adirim mishb’rei-yam, adir bamarom Adonai.

blocks.en: The Eternal reigns, robed in majesty; robed and girded in strength. The world stands firm; it will not be shaken.
Your throne stands firm from of old; from all eternity, You are. The rivers lift up — the rivers lift up their voice; the rivers lift up their roaring.

Mightier than the thunder of great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea, You are mighty on high. Your teachings are utterly trustworthy; holiness graces Your house for all the length of days.

blocks.tr: El chai v’kayam tamid yimloch aleinu l’olam va’ed. Baruch ata Adonai, hama’ariv aravim.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who brings on evening with a word. Wisdom opens the gates of the sky; understanding turns the seasons, setting the stars in their courses across the dome of the heavens.
Day becomes night, light rolling away before darkness and darkness before light, as day passes and night comes on — a line drawn between them. Source of all being is that Name.
Living and enduring God, unchanging through all time — may that Oneness hold over us, now and forever. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who brings on the evening.

blocks.en: With everlasting love You have loved the house of Israel, Your people — teaching us Torah and mitzvot, the obligations and just ways that bind us to one another.

And so, Eternal our God, lying down and rising up, we will speak of what You ask of us and delight in the words of Your Torah — bound to those who came before us, to those beside us, and most of all to those still to come.
For they are our life and the length of our days; on them we will meditate day and night. May Your love never leave us. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who loves Your people Israel.

blocks.he: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְיָ֤ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ וּלְעׇבְד֔וֹ בְּכׇל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃ וְנָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר־אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִירֹֽשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃ וְנָתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃
blocks.tr: V’haya im shamoa tishm’u el mitzvotai asher anochi m’tzaveh etchem hayom, l’ahava et Adonai Eloheichem ul’ovdo b’chol l’vavchem uvchol nafsh’chem. V’natati m’tar artz’chem b’ito, yoreh umalkosh, v’asafta d’ganecha v’tirosh’cha v’yitzharecha. V’natati esev b’sad’cha liv’hemtecha, v’achalta v’sava’ta.

blocks.en: The first paragraph, above, we read aloud together. The tradition continues here; many read it quietly, and we gather again at the gold line.

blocks.he: הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃ וְחָרָ֨ה אַף־יְיָ֜ בָּכֶ֗ם וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֑הּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְיָ֖ נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
blocks.tr: Hisham’ru lachem pen yifteh l’vavchem, v’sartem va’avadtem elohim acherim v’hishtachavitem lahem. V’chara af Adonai bachem, v’atzar et hashamayim v’lo yihyeh matar, v’ha’adama lo titen et y’vulah, va’avadtem m’hera me’al ha’aretz hatova asher Adonai noten lachem.

blocks.he: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרַ֣י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַֽל־נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל־יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶֽם׃ וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשׇׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃ לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵיכֶם֙ וִימֵ֣י בְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְיָ֛ לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם כִּימֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
blocks.tr: V’samtem et d’varai eleh al l’vavchem v’al nafsh’chem, uk’shartem otam l’ot al yedchem, v’hayu l’totafot bein eineichem. V’limadtem otam et b’neichem l’daber bam, b’shivt’cha b’veitecha uvlecht’cha vaderech, uvshochb’cha uvkumecha. Uch’tavtam al m’zuzot beitecha uvish’arecha. L’ma’an yirbu y’meichem vimei v’neichem al ha’adama asher nishba Adonai la’avoteichem latet lahem, kimei hashamayim al ha’aretz.

blocks.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְנָ֥תְנ֛וּ עַל־צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
blocks.tr: Daber el b’nei Yisra’el v’amarta alehem, v’asu lahem tzitzit al kanfei vig’deihem l’dorotam, v’natnu al tzitzit hakanaf p’til t’chelet.

blocks.he: וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺ֣ת יְיָ֔ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תָת֜וּרוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
blocks.tr: V’haya lachem l’tzitzit, ur’item oto uz’chartem et kol mitzvot Adonai, va’asitem otam, v’lo taturu acharei l’vavchem v’acharei eineichem asher atem zonim achareihem.

blocks.he: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵאלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃ אֲנִ֞י יְיָ֣ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְיָ֥ אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
blocks.tr: L’ma’an tizk’ru va’asitem et kol mitzvotai, vih’yitem k’doshim leloheichem. Ani Adonai Eloheichem, asher hotzeti etchem me’eretz Mitzrayim lihyot lachem lelohim, ani Adonai Eloheichem.

blocks.en: And you shall love HaShem your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might. Let these words that I command you today rest upon your heart. Teach them again and again to your children; speak them when you sit in your home and when you walk on the way, when you lie down and when you rise.
Bind them as a sign upon your hand, let them be a symbol before your eyes, and write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.

If you truly listen — and keep on listening — to the mitzvot I give you this day, loving HaShem your God and serving with all your heart and all your soul, then the rains will fall on your land in their season, the early rain and the late; you will gather your grain and your wine and your oil, and there will be grass in your fields for your animals — you will eat, and be satisfied.

But take care, for a heart is easily led astray: when you turn away, serving other gods and bowing down to them, the bond frays — the skies seem to close, the rain holds back, the ground withholds its yield, and you are soon adrift, lost from the good land. So set these words upon your heart and soul; bind them as a sign on your hand and let them rest between your eyes; teach them to your children, speaking them at home and on the way, when you lie down and when you rise; and write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates — that your days, and your children’s days, may be many on the land, as many as the days of the heavens over the earth.

HaShem said to Moses: tell the people of Yisrael to make themselves fringes on the corners of their garments, in every generation, and to set on each corner a thread of blue. Look at it and remember all the mitzvot of HaShem, and do them — and do not go chasing after the cravings of your own heart and eyes.
So that you will remember and do all My mitzvot, and be holy to your God. I am HaShem your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am HaShem your God.

sources.name: Emet v’Emunah
aliases: The blessing turns from declaring the One to begging for freedom — belief voiced from a place of powerlessness.
openingWords: אֱמֶת וֶאֱמוּנָה כָּל־זֹאת וְקַיָּם עָלֵינוּ כִּי הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאֵין זוּלָתוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ
Emet ve’emuna kol zot v’kayam aleinu, ki hu Adonai Eloheinu v’ein zulato,
הַשָּׂם נַפְשֵׁנוּ בַּחַיִּים וְלֹא־נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֵנוּ.
Hasam nafsheinu bachayim, v’lo natan lamot ragleinu.
הָעֹשֶׂה לָּנוּ נִסִּים וַיּוֹצֵא אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם לְחֵרוּת עוֹלָם.
Ha’oseh lanu nisim, vayotze et amo Yisra’el mitocham l’cherut olam.
הַמַּעֲבִיר בָּנָיו בֵּין גִּזְרֵי יַם סוּף. וְרָאוּ בָנָיו גְּבוּרָתוֹ שִׁבְּחוּ וְהוֹדוּ לִשְׁמוֹ.
Hama’avir banav bein gizrei yam suf. V’ra’u vanav g’vurato, shib’chu v’hodu lishmo.

blocks.he: אֱמֶת וֶאֱמוּנָה כָּל־זֹאת וְקַיָּם עָלֵינוּ כִּי הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאֵין זוּלָתוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ. הַפּוֹדֵנוּ מִיַּד מְלָכִים מַלְכֵּנוּ הַגּוֹאֲלֵנוּ מִכַּף כָּל־הֶעָרִיצִים.

blocks.tr: Hama’avir banav bein gizrei yam suf. V’ra’u vanav g’vurato, shib’chu v’hodu lishmo. L’cha anu shira b’simcha raba, v’amru chulam:

sources.name: Mi Chamocha
aliases: The song at the shore, sung again tonight — the moment slavery broke open and a people first sang free.
openingWords: מִֽי־כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְיָ֔ מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃
Mi chamocha ba’elim Adonai, mi kamocha nedar bakodesh, nora t’hilot oseh fele.
מַלְכוּתְךָ רָאוּ בָנֶיךָ, בּוֹקֵעַ יָם לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וּמִרְיָם, זֶה אֵלִי עָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ:
Malchut’cha ra’u vanecha, bokea yam lifnei Moshe uMiryam, zeh Eli anu v’amru:
וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי־פָדָה יְיָ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וּגְאָלוֹ מִיַּד חָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ
V’ne’emar: ki fada Adonai et Ya’akov, ug’alo miyad chazak mimenu. Baruch ata

blocks.tr: Mi chamocha ba’elim Adonai, mi kamocha nedar bakodesh, nora t’hilot oseh fele.

blocks.he: מַלְכוּתְךָ רָאוּ בָנֶיךָ, בּוֹקֵעַ יָם לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וּמִרְיָם, זֶה אֵלִי עָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ:
blocks.tr: Malchut’cha ra’u vanecha, bokea yam lifnei Moshe uMiryam, zeh Eli anu v’amru:

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי־פָדָה יְיָ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וּגְאָלוֹ מִיַּד חָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ גָּאַל יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: V’ne’emar: ki fada Adonai et Ya’akov, ug’alo miyad chazak mimenu. Baruch ata Adonai, ga’al Yisra’el.

blocks.en: All this we hold true and faithful, binding upon us: there are no other gods other than HaShem above us, and we are Your people. May we be redeemed from the hand of kings; may we be freed from the grasp of every tyrant.
Keep our souls amongst the living, and do not let our feet give way.
May there be wonders for us, and may we all be brought out from amongst our oppressors into lasting freedom.
You led us through the parted seas. Beholding that power, we praised and gave thanks, and with great joy we all sang out:
Who is like You among the mighty, O Source of freedom? Who is like You — glorious in holiness, awesome in praises, working wonders!
Your children beheld Your majesty as You split the sea before Moses and Miriam; “This is my God!” they answered, and said:
The Eternal will reign forever and ever.
And it is said: the Eternal has redeemed us and freed us from a hand stronger than our own. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who redeemed Israel.

sources.name: Hashkivenu
aliases: A prayer for when the dark feels total — trust that there is light, even when we cannot see it yet.
openingWords: הַשְׁכִּיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְשָׁלוֹם וְהַעֲמִידֵנוּ שׁוֹמְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ וְתַקְּנֵנוּ
Hashkiveinu Adonai Eloheinu l’shalom, v’ha’amideinu shomreinu l’chayim, ufros aleinu sukat sh’lomecha, v’takneinu
וְהָגֵן בַּעֲדֵנוּ וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ אוֹיֵב דֶּבֶר וְחֶרֶב וְרָעָב וְיָגוֹן וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנוּ
V’hagen ba’adeinu, v’haser me’aleinu oyev, dever v’cherev, v’ra’av v’yagon, uvtzel k’nafecha tastireinu,
וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵנוּ וּבוֹאֵנוּ לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם. וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ.
Ushmor tzeteinu uvo’einu l’chayim ulshalom me’ata v’ad olam. Ufros aleinu sukat sh’lomecha.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַפּוֹרֵשׂ סֻכַּת שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל
Baruch ata Adonai, hapores sukat shalom aleinu v’al kol amo Yisra’el v’al

blocks.he: הַשְׁכִּיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְשָׁלוֹם וְהַעֲמִידֵנוּ שׁוֹמְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ וְתַקְּנֵנוּ בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Hashkiveinu Adonai Eloheinu l’shalom, v’ha’amideinu shomreinu l’chayim, ufros aleinu sukat sh’lomecha, v’takneinu b’etza tova mil’fanecha, v’hoshi’einu l’ma’an sh’mecha.

blocks.he: וְהָגֵן בַּעֲדֵנוּ וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ אוֹיֵב דֶּבֶר וְחֶרֶב וְרָעָב וְיָגוֹן וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנוּ כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמְרֵנוּ וּמַצִּילֵנוּ אָתָּה כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה.
blocks.tr: V’hagen ba’adeinu, v’haser me’aleinu oyev, dever v’cherev, v’ra’av v’yagon, uvtzel k’nafecha tastireinu, ki El shomreinu umatzileinu ata, ki El melech chanun v’rachum ata.

blocks.he: וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵנוּ וּבוֹאֵנוּ לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם. וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Ushmor tzeteinu uvo’einu l’chayim ulshalom me’ata v’ad olam. Ufros aleinu sukat sh’lomecha.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַפּוֹרֵשׂ סֻכַּת שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלָיִם.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, hapores sukat shalom aleinu v’al kol amo Yisra’el v’al Yerushalayim.

blocks.en: Allow us to lie down in peace, Eternal our God, and to rise in peace, protected to life. Spread over us a shelter of peace; set us right with good counsel, and help us for the sake of Your name.
Shield us: turn away from us the enemy, plague and sword, famine and grief. Hide us in the shadow of Your wings, for You are the One who guards and rescues us — God, gracious and compassionate.

Watch over our going out and our coming in, for life and for peace, now and forever. Spread over us Your shelter of peace. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who spreads a shelter of peace over us, over all Your people Israel, and over Jerusalem.

sources.name: V’shamru
aliases: Two verses from Sinai, sung: Shabbat as the sign of an unbreakable promise, kept in every generation.
openingWords: וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
V’shamru v’nei Yisra’el et haShabbat, la’asot et haShabbat l’dorotam b’rit olam.
בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי־שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְיָ֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם
Beini uvein b’nei Yisra’el ot hi l’olam, ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai
The people of Israel shall keep Shabbat, observing Shabbat in every generation
It is a sign forever between Me and the people of Israel,

blocks.he: וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
blocks.tr: V’shamru v’nei Yisra’el et haShabbat, la’asot et haShabbat l’dorotam b’rit olam.

blocks.he: בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי־שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְיָ֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שָׁבַ֖ת וַיִּנָּפַֽשׁ׃
blocks.tr: Beini uvein b’nei Yisra’el ot hi l’olam, ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashamayim v’et ha’aretz, uvayom hash’vi’i shavat vayinafash.

blocks.en: The people of Israel shall keep Shabbat, observing Shabbat in every generation as a covenant for all time.
It is a sign forever between Me and the people of Israel, for in six days the Eternal made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day rested and drew breath.

sources.name: Chatzi Kaddish
aliases: A hinge in the service — this short Kaddish closes the Sh’ma and its blessings and turns us toward the Amidah.
openingWords: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן
Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.
יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu,
May the great name be made great and holy in the world
May the great name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon uvyomeichon uvchayei d’chol beit Yisra’el, ba’agala uvizman kariv, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵלָּא מִן־כָּל־בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’ela min kol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Israel, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the name of the Holy One of blessing — far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

sources.name: The Amidah
aliases: Three steps forward, as if entering a small room.
openingWords: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
Adonai, s’fatai tiftach, ufi yagid t’hilatecha.

blocks.he: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Adonai, s’fatai tiftach, ufi yagid t’hilatecha.

sources.name: Avot v’Imahot
aliases: We stand in a court we inherited — connected to the past, and obligated to the present because of it.
openingWords: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ,
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu,
אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב;
Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, ve’lohei Ya’akov;
אֱלֹהֵי שָׂרָה, אֱלֹהֵי רִבְקָה, אֱלֹהֵי לֵאָה, אֱלֹהֵי רָחֵל, אֱלֹהֵי בִּלְהָה, וֵאלֹהֵי זִלְפָּה.
Elohei Sara, Elohei Rivka, Elohei Le’a, Elohei Rachel, Elohei Bilha, ve’lohei Zilpa.
הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל, וְזוֹכֵר
Ha’El hagadol hagibor v’hanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, v’koneh hakol, v’zocher

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ,
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu,

blocks.tr: Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, ve’lohei Ya’akov;

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵי שָׂרָה, אֱלֹהֵי רִבְקָה, אֱלֹהֵי לֵאָה, אֱלֹהֵי רָחֵל, אֱלֹהֵי בִּלְהָה, וֵאלֹהֵי זִלְפָּה.
blocks.tr: Elohei Sara, Elohei Rivka, Elohei Le’a, Elohei Rachel, Elohei Bilha, ve’lohei Zilpa.

blocks.he: הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל, וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת, וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה.
blocks.tr: Ha’El hagadol hagibor v’hanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, v’koneh hakol, v’zocher chasdei avot v’imahot, umevi go’el livnei v’neihem l’ma’an sh’mo b’ahava.

blocks.he: מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם וְעֶזְרַת שָׂרָה.
blocks.tr: Melech ozer umoshi’a umagen. Baruch ata Adonai, magen Avraham v’ezrat Sara.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, God of our ancestors — God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; God of Sarah, God of Rebecca, God of Leah, God of Rachel, God of Bilhah, and God of Zilpah.

Great, mighty, and awesome God, God most high, who acts with love, who creates all, who remembers the faithfulness of our ancestors, and who lovingly brings redemption to their children’s children for the sake of Your name.
You are our help, our rescue, our shield. Blessed are You, Eternal One, shield of Abraham and help of Sarah.

sources.name: G’vurot
aliases: We are obligated to a future beyond our own lifetime — the same power that revives holds every debt we owe forward.
openingWords: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ.
Ata gibor l’olam Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/meitim ata, rav l’hoshi’a.
מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים, סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר
M’chalkel chayim b’chesed, m’chayeh hakol/meitim b’rachamim rabim, somech nof’lim, v’rofe cholim, umatir

blocks.he: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ.
blocks.tr: Ata gibor l’olam Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/meitim ata, rav l’hoshi’a.

blocks.en: You cause the wind to blow and the rain to fall.
You cause the dew to fall.

blocks.he: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים, סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים, וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת, וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה.
blocks.tr: M’chalkel chayim b’chesed, m’chayeh hakol/meitim b’rachamim rabim, somech nof’lim, v’rofe cholim, umatir asurim, umkayem emunato lishenei afar. Mi chamocha ba’al g’vurot, umi domeh lach, melech memit umchayeh umatzmi’ach y’shu’a.

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת הַכֹּל/מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/הַמֵּתִים.
blocks.tr: V’ne’eman ata l’hachayot hakol/meitim. Baruch ata Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/hameitim.

blocks.en: You are forever mighty; You give life to all / revive the dead, and Your saving power is great. You sustain the living with love, giving life to all / reviving the dead with great compassion; You hold up the falling, heal the sick, free the captive, and keep faith with those who sleep in the dust.

Who is like You, Source of all power? Who can compare — You who bring death and life, and make rescue blossom? You are faithful to give life to all / to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who gives life to all / who revives the dead.

sources.name: K’dushat HaShem
aliases: Alone and silent, the holiness prayer stays in its oldest, plainest form — three sentences holding one word to the light.
openingWords: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ, וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל יוֹם יְהַלְלוּךָ, סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ,
Ata kadosh v’shimcha kadosh, ukdoshim b’chol yom y’hal’lucha, selah. Baruch ata Adonai,
You are holy, and Your name is holy, and those who seek

blocks.he: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ, וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל יוֹם יְהַלְלוּךָ, סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ.
blocks.tr: Ata kadosh v’shimcha kadosh, ukdoshim b’chol yom y’hal’lucha, selah. Baruch ata Adonai, ha’El hakadosh.

blocks.en: You are holy, and Your name is holy, and those who seek holiness praise You every day. Blessed are You, Eternal One, the holy God.

sources.name: K’dushat HaYom
aliases: The blessing that changes with the day: tonight it claims rest as something everyone is owed, not earned.

blocks.he: אַתָּה קִדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לִשְׁמֶךָ, תַּכְלִית מַעֲשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ, וּבֵרַכְתּוֹ מִכָּל הַיָּמִים, וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ מִכָּל הַזְּמַנִּים, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ:
blocks.tr: Ata kidashta et yom hash’vi’i lishmecha, tachlit ma’aseh shamayim va’aretz, uverachto mikol hayamim, v’kidashto mikol hazmanim, v’chen katuv b’toratecha:

blocks.he: וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ וְכׇל־צְבָאָם. וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה, וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה. וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ, כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת.
blocks.tr: Vay’chulu hashamayim v’ha’aretz v’chol tz’va’am. Vay’chal Elohim bayom hash’vi’i m’lachto asher asa, vayishbot bayom hash’vi’i mikol m’lachto asher asa. Vay’varech Elohim et yom hash’vi’i vay’kadesh oto, ki vo shavat mikol m’lachto asher bara Elohim la’asot.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ, קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ, וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת. וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְיָנוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת.
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, r’tzeh vimnuchatenu, kad’shenu b’mitzvotecha, v’ten chelkenu b’toratecha, sab’enu mituvecha, v’samchenu bishu’atecha, v’taher libenu l’ovd’cha be’emet. V’hanchilenu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava uvratzon Shabbat kodshecha, v’yanuchu vah Yisra’el m’kad’shei sh’mecha. Baruch ata Adonai, m’kadesh haShabbat.

blocks.en: You made the seventh day holy to Your name, the crown of the making of heaven and earth. You blessed it above all days and made it holy above all seasons — as it is written in Your Torah:

The heavens and the earth were finished, and all their vast array. On the seventh day God completed the work that had been made, and rested on the seventh day from all the work. And God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it God rested from all the work of creation.

Our God and God of our ancestors — take pleasure in our rest. Make us holy through Your mitzvot and give us our portion in Your Torah; fill us with Your goodness, gladden us with Your saving help, and make our hearts pure to serve You in truth. In love and favor, Eternal our God, grant us Your holy Shabbat as our inheritance, and let Israel, who make Your name holy, find rest in her. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who makes Shabbat holy.

blocks.tr: V’techezena eineinu b’shuvcha l’Tziyon b’rachamim. Baruch ata Adonai, hamachazir sh’chinato l’Tziyon.

blocks.en: Take pleasure, Eternal our God, in Your people Israel and in their prayer; in love receive that prayer with favor, and may the service of Your people Israel always be, in truth, for the good.
May our eyes behold Your loving return to Zion. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who returns Your presence to Zion.

blocks.he: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. צוּר חַיֵּינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר. נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם.
blocks.tr: Modim anachnu lach, sha’ata hu Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu l’olam va’ed. Tzur chayeinu, magen yish’einu ata hu l’dor vador. Nodeh l’cha unsaper t’hilatecha, al chayeinu ham’surim b’yadecha, v’al nishmoteinu hap’kudot lach, v’al nisecha sheb’chol yom imanu, v’al nifl’otecha v’tovotecha sheb’chol et, erev vavoker v’tzohorayim.

blocks.he: הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ, מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ.
blocks.tr: Hatov ki lo chalu rachamecha, v’hamrachem ki lo tamu chasadecha, me’olam kivinu lach.

blocks.he: וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת.
blocks.tr: V’al kulam yitbarech v’yitromam shimcha tamid l’olam va’ed. V’chol hachayim yoducha selah, vihal’lu et shimcha be’emet, ha’El y’shu’atenu v’ezratenu selah. Baruch ata Adonai, hatov shimcha ulcha na’eh l’hodot.

blocks.en: We thank You, for You are the One, our God and the God of our ancestors, forever. Rock of our life, shield of our rescue — so You are, in every generation. We give thanks and tell Your praise: for our lives, held in Your hand; for our souls, entrusted to You; for Your miracles that are with us every day; and for Your wonders and Your gifts at every moment — evening, morning, and noon.
You are the Good, whose mercies never end; the Compassionate, whose kindnesses never fail — always we have placed our hope in You.

For all these things may Your name be blessed and raised up, always and forever. Let all that lives give thanks to You, and praise Your name in truth, God of our rescue and our help. Blessed are You, Eternal One, whose name is Goodness, and to whom thanks are due.

sources.name: Shalom Rav

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, hamvarech et amo Yisra’el bashalom.

blocks.en: Grant abundant peace to Your people Israel forever, for You are the Source of all peace. May it be good in Your eyes to bless Your people Israel, in every season and at every hour, with Your peace.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, who blesses Your people Israel with peace.

blocks.tr: Elohai, n’tzor l’shoni mera, usfatai midaber mirma, v’limkal’lai nafshi tidom, v’nafshi ke’afar lakol tihyeh. P’tach libi b’toratecha, uvmitzvotecha tirdof nafshi.

blocks.he: וְכֹל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ, הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי.
blocks.tr: V’chol hachosh’vim alai ra’a, m’hera hafer atzatam v’kalkel machashavtam. Aseh l’ma’an sh’mecha, aseh l’ma’an y’minecha, aseh l’ma’an k’dushatecha, aseh l’ma’an toratecha. L’ma’an yechal’tzun y’didecha, hoshi’a y’min’cha va’aneni.

blocks.he: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי.
blocks.tr: Yihyu l’ratzon imrei fi v’hegyon libi l’fanecha, Adonai tzuri v’go’ali.

blocks.he: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh shalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit. To those who curse me, let my soul stay silent; let my soul be humble as the dust before all. Open my heart to Your Torah, that my soul may pursue Your mitzvot.

And all who plan evil against me — quickly undo their designs and unravel their schemes. Act for the sake of Your name; act for the sake of Your right hand; act for the sake of Your holiness; act for the sake of Your Torah. That those You love may be freed, let Your right hand save — answer me.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Eternal One, my Rock and my Redeemer.
May the One who makes peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Israel, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Vayechulu
aliases: After the long hush of the silent prayer, sound comes back into the room — the very words Genesis uses for the first evening finished.
openingWords: וַיְכֻלּ֛וּ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ וְכׇל־צְבָאָֽם׃ וַיְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת֙
Vay’chulu hashamayim v’ha’aretz v’chol tz’va’am. Vay’chal Elohim bayom hash’vi’i m’lachto asher asa,
The heavens and the earth were finished, and all their vast array.

blocks.he: וַיְכֻלּ֛וּ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ וְכׇל־צְבָאָֽם׃ וַיְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃ וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
blocks.tr: Vay’chulu hashamayim v’ha’aretz v’chol tz’va’am. Vay’chal Elohim bayom hash’vi’i m’lachto asher asa, vayishbot bayom hash’vi’i mikol m’lachto asher asa. Vay’varech Elohim et yom hash’vi’i vay’kadesh oto, ki vo shavat mikol m’lachto asher bara Elohim la’asot.

blocks.en: The heavens and the earth were finished, and all their vast array. On the seventh day God completed the work that had been made, and rested on the seventh day from all the work. And God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it God rested from all the work of creation.

sources.name: Me’ein Sheva
aliases: Friday night’s own communal blessing, sung aloud — a kindness born to let latecomers finish and walk home safe.
openingWords: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי
Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu — Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak,
מָגֵן אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת בִּדְבָרוֹ, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים בְּמַאֲמָרוֹ, הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁאֵין כָּמוֹהוּ, הַמֵּנִיחַ
Magen avot v’imahot bidvaro, m’chayeh hakol/meitim b’ma’amaro, ha’El hakadosh she’ein kamohu, hameniach
אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ, קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, שַׂבְּעֵנוּ
Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu r’tzeh vimnuchatenu, kad’shenu b’mitzvotecha v’ten chelkenu b’toratecha, sab’enu

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב, אֱלֹהֵי שָׂרָה אֱלֹהֵי רִבְקָה אֱלֹהֵי לֵאָה אֱלֹהֵי רָחֵל אֱלֹהֵי בִּלְהָה וֵאלֹהֵי זִלְפָּה, הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן קוֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu — Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, ve’lohei Ya’akov; Elohei Sara, Elohei Rivka, Elohei Le’a, Elohei Rachel, Elohei Bilha, ve’lohei Zilpa — ha’El hagadol hagibor v’hanora, El elyon koneh shamayim va’aretz.

blocks.he: מָגֵן אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת בִּדְבָרוֹ, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים בְּמַאֲמָרוֹ, הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁאֵין כָּמוֹהוּ, הַמֵּנִיחַ לְעַמּוֹ בְּיוֹם שַׁבַּת קָדְשׁוֹ, כִּי בָם רָצָה לְהָנִיחַ לָהֶם. לְפָנָיו נַעֲבוֹד בְּיִרְאָה וָפַחַד, וְנוֹדֶה לִשְׁמוֹ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מֵעֵין הַבְּרָכוֹת. אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת, אֲדוֹן הַשָּׁלוֹם, מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת וּמְבָרֵךְ שְׁבִיעִי, וּמֵנִיחַ בִּקְדֻשָּׁה לְעַם מְדֻשְּׁנֵי עֹנֶג, זֵכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית.
blocks.tr: Magen avot v’imahot bidvaro, m’chayeh hakol/meitim b’ma’amaro, ha’El hakadosh she’ein kamohu, hameniach l’amo b’yom Shabbat kodsho, ki vam ratza l’haniach lahem. L’fanav na’avod b’yir’a vafachad, v’nodeh lishmo b’chol yom tamid me’ein hab’rachot. El hahoda’ot, Adon hashalom, m’kadesh haShabbat um’varech shvi’i, umeniach bikdusha l’am m’dushnei oneg, zecher l’ma’asei v’reshit.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ, קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְיָנוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu r’tzeh vimnuchatenu, kad’shenu b’mitzvotecha v’ten chelkenu b’toratecha, sab’enu mituvecha v’samchenu bishu’atecha, v’taher libenu l’ovd’cha be’emet, v’hanchilenu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava uvratzon Shabbat kodshecha, v’yanuchu vah Yisra’el m’kad’shei sh’mecha.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, God of our ancestors — God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; God of Sarah, Rebecca, Leah, Rachel, Bilhah, and Zilpah — the great, the mighty, the awesome; God most high, maker of heaven and earth.

Shield of our ancestors by a word; giving life to all / reviving the dead by a spoken promise. The Holy One beyond compare settles the people into rest on the holy day of Shabbat, for in them God delighted, to give them rest. Before this Presence we serve in awe and trembling, giving thanks to the Name every day, always — an echo of all the blessings. God of all gratitude, Source of peace, who hallows Shabbat and blesses the seventh day, giving rest in holiness to a people brimming with delight — a remembrance of creation.

Our God and God of our ancestors — take pleasure in our rest. Make us holy through Your mitzvot and give us our portion in Your Torah; fill us with Your goodness, gladden us with Your saving help, and make our hearts pure to serve You in truth. In love and favor, Eternal our God, grant us Your holy Shabbat as our inheritance, and let Israel, who make Your name holy, find rest in her. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who makes Shabbat holy.

sources.name: Kaddish Shalem
aliases: The full Kaddish seals the Amidah — asking, beyond every praise, that the prayers just offered be received.
openingWords: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן
Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.
יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu,
May the great name be made great and holy in the world
May the great name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon uvyomeichon uvchayei d’chol beit Yisra’el, ba’agala uvizman kariv, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵלָּא מִן־כָּל־בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’ela min kol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Yisrael, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the name of the Holy One of blessing — far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

blocks.he: תִּתְקַבֵּל צְלוֹתְהוֹן וּבָעוּתְהוֹן דְּכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁמַיָּא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Titkabel tz’lot’hon uva’ut’hon d’chol beit Yisra’el kodam avuhon di vishmaya, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: Receive the prayers and pleas of all the house of Yisrael before the One in heaven — and say: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא, וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’lama raba min sh’maya, v’chayim aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh shalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May great peace from heaven, and life, be upon us and upon all Yisrael — and say: Amen. May the One who makes peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Yisrael, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Mi Shebeirach — Healing
aliases: We speak the names aloud, or hold them in the heart — the community turning to care for its own.
openingWords: מִי שֶׁבֵּרַךְ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, מְקוֹר הַבְּרָכָה לְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ,
Mi shebeirach avoteinu, m’kor habracha l’imoteinu,
We name, aloud or in our hearts, those in need of healing.
May the Source of Strength, who blessed the ones before us, help
מִי שֶׁבֵּרַךְ אִמּוֹתֵינוּ, מְקוֹר הַבְּרָכָה לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ.
Mi shebeirach imoteinu, m’kor habracha la’avoteinu.
Bless those in need of healing with r’fuah sh’leimah — the renewal

blocks.he: מִי שֶׁבֵּרַךְ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, מְקוֹר הַבְּרָכָה לְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ,
blocks.tr: Mi shebeirach avoteinu, m’kor habracha l’imoteinu,

blocks.en: We name, aloud or in our hearts, those in need of healing.
May the Source of Strength, who blessed the ones before us, help us find the courage to make our lives a blessing, and let us say: Amen.

blocks.he: מִי שֶׁבֵּרַךְ אִמּוֹתֵינוּ, מְקוֹר הַבְּרָכָה לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Mi shebeirach imoteinu, m’kor habracha la’avoteinu.

blocks.en: Bless those in need of healing with r’fuah sh’leimah — the renewal of body, the renewal of spirit — and let us say: Amen.

sources.name: Aleinu
aliases: The seal of every service: a vision where everyone is obligated to each other — a fantasy of power spoken from powerlessness.
openingWords: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת
Aleinu l’shabeach la’adon hakol, latet g’dula l’yotzer b’reshit, shelo asanu k’goyei ha’aratzot,
It is upon us to acknowledge the Oneness of Creation, and to
שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי
Shehu noteh shamayim v’yosed aretz, umoshav y’karo bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo b’govhei
The heavens stretched wide, the earth set on its foundations, glory and
עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים
Al ken n’kaveh l’cha Adonai Eloheinu, lir’ot m’hera b’tif’eret uzecha, l’ha’avir gilulim

blocks.he: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם. וַאֲנַחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
blocks.tr: Aleinu l’shabeach la’adon hakol, latet g’dula l’yotzer b’reshit, shelo asanu k’goyei ha’aratzot, v’lo samanu k’mishp’chot ha’adama; shelo sam chelkeinu kahem, v’goraleinu k’chol hamonam. Va’anachnu kor’im umishtachavim umodim, lifnei melech malchei ham’lachim, haKadosh baruch hu.

blocks.en: It is upon us to acknowledge the Oneness of Creation, and to celebrate the majesty of it all — we who were not made like the nations of the lands, nor set like the families of the earth; whose portion is not theirs, whose lot is our own. And so we bend, and bow, and give thanks before what is beyond every power, the Holy One of blessing.

blocks.he: שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים. הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּנוּ אֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ, כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת, אֵין עוֹד.
blocks.tr: Shehu noteh shamayim v’yosed aretz, umoshav y’karo bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo b’govhei m’romim. Hu Eloheinu ein od, emet malkeinu efes zulato, kakatuv b’torato: v’yadata hayom vahashevota el l’vavecha, ki Adonai hu ha’Elohim bashamayim mima’al v’al ha’aretz mitachat, ein od.

blocks.en: The heavens stretched wide, the earth set on its foundations, glory and strength filling the highest heights — this is our God; there is no other, none else at all. As it is written in the Torah: Know this day and take it to heart, that the Eternal is God in the heavens above and on the earth below; there is no other.

blocks.he: עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן, לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי. וְכָל בְּנֵי בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶךָ, לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶיךָ כָּל רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Al ken n’kaveh l’cha Adonai Eloheinu, lir’ot m’hera b’tif’eret uzecha, l’ha’avir gilulim min ha’aretz, v’ha’elilim karot yikaretun, l’taken olam b’malchut Shaddai. V’chol b’nei vasar yikr’u vishmecha, l’hafnot eilecha kol rish’ei aretz.

blocks.he: יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל כִּי לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל בֶּרֶךְ, תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל לָשׁוֹן. לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפֹּלוּ, וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּנוּ, וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם אֶת עֹל מַלְכוּתֶךָ, וְתִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ: יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Yakiru v’yed’u kol yosh’vei tevel, ki l’cha tichra kol berech, tishava kol lashon. L’fanecha Adonai Eloheinu yichr’u v’yipolu, v’lichvod shimcha y’kar yitenu, vikab’lu chulam et ol malchutecha, v’timloch aleihem m’hera l’olam va’ed. Ki hamalchut shel’cha hi, ul’olmei ad timloch b’chavod, kakatuv b’toratecha: Adonai yimloch l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמַר: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד.
blocks.tr: V’ne’emar: v’haya Adonai l’melech al kol ha’aretz, bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad ushmo echad.

blocks.en: And so we hope in You, the Eternal our God: soon to see the splendor of Your strength, when every idol and false god is swept from the earth, and the world is mended whole in the oneness of the Almighty. All who live will call on Your name, and earth’s wrongdoers will turn back to You. Let the world come to know that every knee bends and every tongue swears true before You. Before You, Eternal our God, may all bow low, honor Your name, and take on together the obligation of Oneness, soon and always. All is Yours, and forever You endure in glory, as it is written in Your Torah: The Eternal will reign forever and ever. And it is said: the Eternal shall be sovereign over all the earth; on that day the Eternal shall be One, and the name One.

sources.name: Mourner’s Kaddish
aliases: Mourners rise; the community answers, and no one grieves alone — a prayer for the dead with no word for death.
openingWords: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן
Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon
Mourners rise, in body or in spirit; all who wish may stand
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.
יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא,
Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu,
יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא, וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon uvyomeichon uvchayei d’chol beit Yisra’el, ba’agala uvizman kariv, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: Mourners rise, in body or in spirit; all who wish may stand with them.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא, לְעֵלָּא מִן־כָּל־בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’ela min kol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא, וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’lama raba min sh’maya, v’chayim aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh shalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Yisrael, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the name of the Holy One of blessing — far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

May great peace from heaven, and life, be upon us and upon all Yisrael — and say: Amen. May the One who makes peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Yisrael, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Priestly Blessing
aliases: The oldest words still spoken among us — three lines widening like two hands slowly opening over the room.
openingWords: יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
Yisa Adonai panav eilecha v’yasem l’cha shalom.
May the Eternal bless you and keep you. May the Eternal’s face

blocks.he: יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
blocks.tr: Yisa Adonai panav eilecha v’yasem l’cha shalom.

blocks.en: May the Eternal bless you and keep you. May the Eternal’s face shine upon you and be gracious to you. May the Eternal’s face turn toward you and grant you peace.

sources.name: Adon Olam
aliases: The service ends the way it began: in song. Adon Olam is the melody that carries us out.
openingWords: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא. לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל,
Adon olam asher malach, b’terem kol y’tzir nivra. L’et na’asa v’cheftzo kol,
וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא. וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה
V’acharei kichlot hakol, l’vado yimloch nora. V’hu haya v’hu hoveh, v’hu yihyeh
Eternal One of all, who was before any form was created; when
וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּירָה. בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ
V’hu echad v’ein sheni, l’hamshil lo l’hachbira. B’li reshit b’li tachlit, v’lo
וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה. וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי,

blocks.he: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא. לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא.
blocks.tr: Adon olam asher malach, b’terem kol y’tzir nivra. L’et na’asa v’cheftzo kol, azai melech sh’mo nikra.

blocks.he: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא. וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה.
blocks.tr: V’acharei kichlot hakol, l’vado yimloch nora. V’hu haya v’hu hoveh, v’hu yihyeh b’tif’ara.

blocks.en: Eternal One of all, who was before any form was created; when all was made by Your will, then was Your name made known. And after all has ceased to be, You alone endure, beyond all awe. You were, You are, You will be in glory.

blocks.he: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּירָה. בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה.
blocks.tr: V’hu echad v’ein sheni, l’hamshil lo l’hachbira. B’li reshit b’li tachlit, v’lo ha’oz v’hamisra.

blocks.he: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה. וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא.
blocks.tr: V’hu Eli v’chai go’ali, v’tzur chevli b’et tzara. V’hu nisi umanos li, m’nat kosi b’yom ekra.

blocks.en: You are One; there is no second to compare or set beside You. Without beginning, without end — Yours is the strength, and Yours all that is. You are my God, my living Redeemer, my Rock in time of trouble; my banner, my refuge, the portion of my cup on the day I call.

blocks.he: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִירָה. וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, יְיָ לִי וְלֹא אִירָא.
blocks.tr: B’yado afkid ruchi, b’et ishan v’a’ira. V’im ruchi g’viyati, Adonai li v’lo ira.

blocks.en: Into Your hand I entrust my spirit, when I sleep and when I wake; and with my spirit, my body too — the Eternal is with me, I will not fear.

blocks.tr: Zochreinu Adonai Eloheinu bo l’tova, ufokdeinu vo livracha, v’hoshi’einu vo l’chayim. Uvidvar y’shu’a v’rachamim chus v’chaneinu, v’rachem aleinu v’hoshi’einu, ki eilecha eineinu, ki El melech chanun v’rachum ata.

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors — may the memory of us rise and come and reach You; be seen, accepted, and heard; be counted and remembered — the memory of us and of our ancestors, the memory of Jerusalem Your holy city, and the memory of all Your people the house of Israel — for deliverance and goodness, for grace, kindness, and compassion, for life and for peace, on this day of the New Moon / the Festival of Matzot / the Festival of Sukkot.

Remember us this day, Eternal our God, for goodness; count us on it for blessing; save us on it for life. With a word of rescue and mercy, spare us and be gracious to us; have compassion on us and save us — for our eyes are turned to You — You are God, gracious and compassionate.

blocks.he: עַל הַנִּסִּים וְעַל הַפֻּרְקָן וְעַל הַגְּבוּרוֹת וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּעוֹת וְעַל הַמִּלְחָמוֹת שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם בַּזְּמַן הַזֶּה.
blocks.tr: Al hanisim v’al hapurkan v’al hag’vurot v’al hat’shu’ot v’al hamilchamot she’asita la’avoteinu v’imoteinu bayamim hahem baz’man haze.

blocks.he: בִּימֵי מַתִּתְיָהוּ בֶּן יוֹחָנָן כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל חַשְׁמוֹנָאִי וּבָנָיו, כְּשֶׁעָמְדָה מַלְכוּת יָוָן הָרְשָׁעָה עַל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַשְׁכִּיחָם תּוֹרָתֶךָ, וּלְהַעֲבִירָם מֵחֻקֵּי רְצוֹנֶךָ,

blocks.he: וְאַתָּה בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים עָמַדְתָּ לָהֶם בְּעֵת צָרָתָם, רַבְתָּ אֶת רִיבָם, דַּנְתָּ אֶת דִּינָם, נָקַמְתָּ אֶת נִקְמָתָם, מָסַרְתָּ גִבּוֹרִים בְּיַד חַלָּשִׁים, וְרַבִּים בְּיַד מְעַטִּים, וּטְמֵאִים בְּיַד טְהוֹרִים, וּרְשָׁעִים בְּיַד צַדִּיקִים, וְזֵדִים בְּיַד עוֹסְקֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: v’ata b’rachameicha harabim amadeta lahem b’et tzaratam, raveta et rivam, danta et dinam, nakamta et nikmatam, masarta giborim b’yad chalashim, v’rabim b’yad m’atim, ut’me’im b’yad t’horim, ursha’im b’yad tzadikim, v’zeidim b’yad os’kei toratecha.

blocks.he: וּלְךָ עָשִׂיתָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ בְּעוֹלָמֶךָ, וּלְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשִׂיתָ תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וּפֻרְקָן כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה. וְאַחַר כֵּן בָּאוּ בָנֶיךָ לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶךָ, וּפִנּוּ אֶת הֵיכָלֶךָ, וְטִהֲרוּ אֶת מִקְדָּשֶׁךָ, וְהִדְלִיקוּ נֵרוֹת בְּחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְקָבְעוּ שְׁמוֹנַת יְמֵי חֲנֻכָּה אֵלּוּ, לְהוֹדוֹת וּלְהַלֵּל לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל.
blocks.tr: Ulcha asita shem gadol v’kadosh b’olamecha, ulam’cha Yisra’el asita t’shu’a g’dola ufurkan k’hayom haze. V’achar ken ba’u vanecha lidvir beitecha, ufinu et heichalecha, v’tiharu et mikdashecha, v’hidliku nerot b’chatzrot kodshecha, v’kav’u sh’monat y’mei Chanuka eilu, l’hodot ulhalel l’shimcha hagadol.

blocks.en: For the miracles and the rescue, for the mighty acts, the deliverances, and the wars that You waged for our ancestors in those days, at this season:

In the days of Mattathias son of Yochanan, the High Priest, the Hasmonean, and his sons — when the wicked kingdom of Greece rose against Your people Israel to make them forget Your Torah and turn them from the laws of Your will — You in Your great mercy stood by them in their time of trouble. You took up their cause, judged their claim, and answered their wrong; You gave the strong into the hands of the weak, the many into the hands of the few, the impure into the hands of the pure, the guilty into the hands of the innocent, and the arrogant into the hands of those who kept Your Torah.

For Yourself You made a great and holy name in Your world, and for Your people Israel You worked a great deliverance and rescue, as on this very day. Afterward Your children came into Your sanctuary, cleared Your Temple, purified Your holy place, and kindled lights in Your sacred courts — and they set these eight days of Hanukkah to give thanks and praise to Your great name.

blocks.en: In the days of Mordechai and Esther, in Shushan the capital, when the wicked Haman rose against them and sought to destroy, to kill, and to wipe out all the Jews — young and old, children and women — in a single day, the thirteenth of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, and to plunder their possessions:
You in Your great mercy overturned his plan, spoiled his scheme, and turned his own design back upon his head — and he and his sons were hanged upon the gallows.
From Rosh Hashanah through Yom Kippur, add these four lines to the Amidah, each where it is marked.

blocks.tr: B’sefer chayim, b’racha v’shalom, ufarnasa tova, nizacher v’nikatev l’fanecha, anachnu v’chol am’cha beit Yisra’el, l’chayim tovim ulshalom.

blocks.en: In the Book of Life, blessing, and peace, and of good sustenance, may we be remembered and written before You — we and all Your people the house of Israel — for a good life and for peace.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who creates the fruit of the vine.

Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who chose us from among all peoples, lifted us up among all tongues, and made us holy through Your mitzvot. In love You gave us, Eternal our God, Shabbatot for rest and seasons for gladness, festivals and set times for joy — this Shabbat, and this day of the Festival of Matzot, the season of our freedom / this day of the Festival of Shavuot, the season of the giving of our Torah / this day of the Festival of Sukkot, the season of our rejoicing / this eighth day, the Festival of Atzeret, the season of our rejoicing — in love, a sacred gathering, a remembrance of the going-out from Egypt. For You chose us and made us holy from among all peoples, and gave us Your holy Shabbat and festivals, in love and favor, in gladness and joy, as our inheritance.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, who makes Shabbat, Israel, and the seasons holy.

blocks.en: The heavens and the earth were finished, and all their vast array. On the seventh day God completed the work that had been made, and rested on the seventh day from all the work. And God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it God rested from all the work of creation.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe: You have made us holy with Your mitzvot and taken delight in us. In love and favor You have given us Your holy Shabbat as an inheritance — a remembrance of the work of creation. It is the first of our sacred days, a reminder of our going-out from Egypt. You chose us from among all peoples and made us holy, and in love and favor You have given us Your holy Shabbat. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who makes Shabbat holy.

blocks.he: וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי לְךָ יְיָ עֵת רָצוֹן אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב חַסְדֶּךָ עֲנֵנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Va’ani t’filati l’cha Adonai et ratzon, Elohim b’rov chasdecha, aneni be’emet yish’echa.

blocks.en: How good are your tents, Jacob — your dwelling-places, Yisrael!
As for me: in Your abundant love I enter Your house; I bow toward Your holy sanctuary, in awe of You.
Eternal One, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory rests.
And I — I bow, I bend low, I kneel before the Eternal, my Maker.
As for me — let my prayer come to You, Eternal One, in a time of favor. God, in Your abundant love, answer me with the truth of Your rescue.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ רוֹפֵא כָל בָּשָׂר וּמַפְלִיא לַעֲשׂוֹת.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, rofe chol basar umafli la’asot.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who formed the human being with wisdom and created in the body openings upon openings, hollows upon hollows.
It is revealed and known before You that if one of them were to open, or one of them to close, it would be impossible to endure and to stand before You even a single hour.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, healer of all flesh, who works wonders.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהַי, נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַתָּ בִּי טְהוֹרָה הִיא. אַתָּה בְרָאתָהּ. אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּהּ. אַתָּה נְפַחְתָּהּ בִּי. וְאַתָּה מְשַׁמְּרָהּ בְּקִרְבִּי. וְאַתָּה עָתִיד לִטְּלָהּ מִמֶּנִּי. וּלְהַחֲזִירָהּ בִּי לֶעָתִיד לָבוֹא.
blocks.tr: Elohai, n’shama shenatata bi t’hora hi. Ata v’ratah, ata y’tzartah, ata n’fachtah bi, v’ata m’sham’rah b’kirbi, v’ata atid lit’lah mimeni ulhachazirah bi le’atid lavo.

blocks.he: כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהַנְּשָׁמָה בְּקִרְבִּי מוֹדֶה / מוֹדָה / מוֹדֶת אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי, רִבּוֹן כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲדוֹן כָּל הַנְּשָׁמוֹת.
blocks.tr: Kol z’man shehan’shama b’kirbi, modeh / modah / modet ani l’fanecha, Adonai Elohai ve’lohei avotai, ribon kol hama’asim, adon kol han’shamot.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּחֲזִיר נְשָׁמוֹת לִפְגָרִים מֵתִים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, hamachazir n’shamot lifgarim meitim.

blocks.en: My God — the soul You placed within me is pure. You created it, You formed it, You breathed it into me; You keep it safe within me, and one day You will take it from me and restore it to me in the time to come.
As long as the soul is within me, I am grateful before You, Eternal my God and God of my ancestors, Source of all works, Source of all souls.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, who restores souls to lifeless bodies.

blocks.en: …who frees the bound.

blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, zokef k’fufim.

blocks.en: …who lifts up the bent.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, רוֹקַע הָאָרֶץ עַל הַמָּיִם.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, roka ha’aretz al hamayim.

blocks.en: …who spreads the earth over the waters.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמֵּכִין מִצְעֲדֵי גָבֶר.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, hamechin mitz’adei gaver.

blocks.en: …who steadies a person’s steps.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁעָשָׂה לִּי כָּל צָרְכִּי.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, she’asa li kol tzorki.

blocks.en: …who has provided me all I need.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אוֹזֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּגְבוּרָה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, ozer Yisra’el bigvura.

blocks.en: …who girds Yisrael with strength.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, עוֹטֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִפְאָרָה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, oter Yisra’el b’tif’ara.

blocks.en: …who crowns Yisrael with beauty.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַנּוֹתֵן לַיָּעֵף כֹּחַ.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, hanoten laya’ef koach.

blocks.en: …who gives strength to the weary.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמַּעֲבִיר שֵׁנָה מֵעֵינָי וּתְנוּמָה מֵעַפְעַפָּי.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, hama’avir shena me’einai utnuma me’af’apai.

blocks.en: …who lifts sleep from my eyes and slumber from my eyelids.

blocks.he: וִיהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁתַּרְגִּילֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְדַבְּקֵנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְאַל תְּבִיאֵנוּ לֹא לִידֵי חֵטְא, וְלֹא לִידֵי עֲבֵרָה וְעָוֹן, וְלֹא לִידֵי נִסָּיוֹן, וְלֹא לִידֵי בִזָּיוֹן, וְאַל יִשְׁלֹט בָּנוּ יֵצֶר הָרָע, וְהַרְחִיקֵנוּ מֵאָדָם רָע וּמֵחָבֵר רָע, וְדַבְּקֵנוּ בְּיֵצֶר הַטּוֹב וּבְמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים, וְכוֹף אֶת יִצְרֵנוּ לְהִשְׁתַּעְבֶּד לָךְ, וּתְנֵנוּ הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל יוֹם לְחֵן וּלְחֶסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּבְעֵינֵי כָל רוֹאֵינוּ, וְתִגְמְלֵנוּ חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים.
blocks.tr: Vihi ratzon mil’fanecha Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu, shetargileinu b’Toratecha v’dab’keinu b’mitzvotecha, v’al t’vi’einu lo lidei chet, v’lo lidei avera v’avon, v’lo lidei nisayon, v’lo lidei vizayon, v’al yishlot banu yetzer hara, v’harchikeinu me’adam ra umechaver ra, v’dab’keinu b’yetzer hatov uvma’asim tovim, v’chof et yitzreinu l’hishtabed lach, utneinu hayom uvchol yom l’chein ulchesed ulrachamim b’einecha uv’einei chol ro’einu, v’tigm’leinu chasadim tovim.

blocks.en: May it be Your will, Eternal our God and God of our ancestors, to make us at home in Your Torah and to hold us close to Your mitzvot; keep us from wrongdoing, from transgression and guilt, from trial and from disgrace; let no harmful urge rule over us; keep us far from a bad person and a bad companion, and turn us toward the good — toward good deeds — and bend our own will to serve You. Grant us today and every day grace, kindness, and mercy in Your eyes and in the eyes of all who see us, and deal us kindness upon kindness.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַגּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, hagomel chasadim tovim l’amo Yisra’el.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal One, who deals kindness upon kindness to the people Yisrael.

blocks.he: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי שֶׁתַּצִּילֵנִי הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל יוֹם מֵעַזֵּי פָנִים וּמֵעַזּוּת פָּנִים. מֵאָדָם רָע. מִיֵּצֶר רָע. וּמֵחָבֵר רָע. וּמִשָּׁכֵן רָע. וּמִפֶּגַע רָע. מֵעַיִן הָרָע. מִלָּשׁוֹן הָרָע. מִמַּלְשִׁינוּת. מֵעֵדוּת שֶׁקֶר. מִשִּׂנְאַת הַבְּרִיּוֹת. מֵעֲלִילָה. מִמִּיתָה מְשֻׁנָּה. מֵחֳלָיִם רָעִים. מִמִּקְרִים רָעִים וּמִשָּׂטָן הַמַּשְׁחִית. מִדִּין קָשֶׁה וּמִבַּעַל דִּין קָשֶׁה. בֵּין שֶׁהוּא בֶן בְּרִית וּבֵין שֶׁאֵינוֹ בֶן בְּרִית. וּמִדִּינָהּ שֶׁל גֵּיהִנָּם:
blocks.tr: Y’hi ratzon mil’fanecha Adonai Elohai ve’lohei avotai, shetatzileini hayom uvchol yom me’azei fanim ume’azut panim, me’adam ra, miyetzer ra, umechaver ra, umishachen ra, umipega ra, me’ayin hara, milashon hara, mimalshinut, me’edut sheker, misinat hab’riyot, me’alila, mimita m’shuna, mecholayim ra’im, mimikrim ra’im umisatan hamashchit, midin kasheh umiba’al din kasheh, bein shehu ven b’rit uvein she’eino ven b’rit, umidinah shel geihinam.

blocks.en: May it be Your will, Eternal my God and God of my ancestors, to save me today and every day from the insolent and from insolence; from a bad person, a bad impulse, a bad companion, a bad neighbor, and bad mishap; from the evil eye, an evil tongue, slander, false testimony, the hatred of others, and false accusation; from an unnatural death, from grievous illnesses, from evil happenings, and from the destroying adversary; from a harsh judgment and a harsh opponent-at-law — whether that opponent is a child of the covenant or not — and from the judgment of Gehinnom.

A first word of Torah to study — the priestly blessing:

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ לַעֲסֹק בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, asher kid’shanu b’mitzvotav v’tzivanu la’asok b’divrei Tora.

blocks.he: וְהַעֲרֶב נָא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָתְךָ בְּפִינוּ וּבְפִי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל. וְנִהְיֶה אֲנַחְנוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵינוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלָּנוּ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶךָ וְלוֹמְדֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ [יֵשׁ אוֹמְרִים: תוֹרָתְךָ] לִשְׁמָהּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמְלַמֵּד תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: V’ha’arev na Adonai Eloheinu et divrei Toratcha b’finu uvfi am’cha beit Yisra’el, v’nihyeh anachnu v’tze’etza’einu v’tze’etza’ei am’cha beit Yisra’el kulanu yod’ei sh’mecha v’lom’dei Toratecha lishmah. Baruch ata Adonai, hamlamed Tora l’amo Yisra’el.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר בָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת תּוֹרָתוֹ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ נוֹתֵן הַתּוֹרָה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, asher bachar banu mikol ha’amim v’natan lanu et Torato. Baruch ata Adonai, noten haTora.

blocks.en: A first word of Torah to study — the priestly blessing:

blocks.he: יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
blocks.tr: Yisa Adonai panav eilecha v’yasem l’cha shalom.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who calls us toward holiness as we immerse ourselves in the words of Torah.

Make the words of Your Torah sweet, Eternal our God, in our mouths and in the mouths of Your people, the house of Yisrael — so that we, and our children, and the children of Your people the house of Yisrael, may all come to know Your Name and to study Your Torah for its own sake. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who teaches Torah to the people Yisrael.
Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who chose us from among all the peoples and gave us the Torah. Blessed are You, Eternal One, giver of the Torah.
May the Eternal bless you and keep you. May the Eternal’s face shine upon you and be gracious to you. May the Eternal’s face turn toward you and grant you peace.

sources.name: Eilu D’varim
aliases: Torah as a process that is lived and nurtured and grown.
openingWords: אֵלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם שִׁעוּר. הַפֵּאָה, וְהַבִּכּוּרִים, וְהָרֵאָיוֹן, וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים, וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה.

blocks.he: אֵלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם שִׁעוּר. הַפֵּאָה, וְהַבִּכּוּרִים, וְהָרֵאָיוֹן, וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים, וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה. אֵלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאָדָם אוֹכֵל פֵּרוֹתֵיהֶן בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְהַקֶּרֶן קַיֶּמֶת לוֹ לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא. כִּבּוּד אָב וָאֵם, וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים, וַהֲבָאַת שָׁלוֹם בֵּין אָדָם לַחֲבֵרוֹ, וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה כְּנֶגֶד כֻּלָּם.
blocks.tr: Eilu d’varim she’ein lahem shi’ur: hapea, v’habikurim, v’hare’ayon, ugmilut chasadim, v’talmud Tora. Eilu d’varim she’adam ochel peiroteihen ba’olam hazeh v’hakeren kayemet lo la’olam haba: kibud av va’em, ugmilut chasadim, vahava’at shalom bein adam lachavero, v’talmud Tora k’neged kulam.

blocks.he: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה בַּר שֵׁילָא אָמַר רַבִּי אַסִּי אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: שִׁשָּׁה דְּבָרִים אָדָם אוֹכֵל פֵּירוֹתֵיהֶן בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְהַקֶּרֶן קַיֶּימֶת לוֹ לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, וְאֵלּוּ הֵן: הַכְנָסַת אוֹרְחִין, וּבִיקּוּר חוֹלִים, וְעִיּוּן תְּפִלָּה, וְהַשְׁכָּמַת בֵּית הַמִּדְרָשׁ, וְהַמְגַדֵּל בָּנָיו לְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה, וְהַדָּן אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ לְכַף זְכוּת.
blocks.tr: Amar Rav Y’huda bar Sheila amar Rabi Asi amar Rabi Yochanan: shisha d’varim adam ochel peiroteihen ba’olam hazeh v’hakeren kayemet lo la’olam haba, v’eilu hen: hachnasat or’chin, uvikur cholim, v’iyun t’fila, v’hashkamat beit hamidrash, v’hamgadel banav l’talmud Tora, v’hadan et chavero l’chaf z’chut.

blocks.en: These are the things that have no fixed measure: the corner of the field left for the poor, the first-fruits, the pilgrim’s appearance at the Temple, acts of loving-kindness, and the study of Torah. And these are the things whose fruit a person enjoys in this world while the principal endures for the world to come: honoring father and mother, acts of loving-kindness, and making peace between one person and another — and the study of Torah, which equals them all.

Rav Y'huda bar Sheila taught in the name of Rabbi Assi, in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: There are six things whose fruit a person enjoys in this world while the principal endures for the world to come: welcoming guests, visiting the sick, giving heart to one’s prayer, rising early to the house of study, raising one’s children toward the study of Torah, and judging another person favorably.

blocks.en: Do not take revenge, and do not hold a grudge against the children of your people — love your fellow as yourself: I am HaShem.

Like fine oil on the head, running down over the beard, the beard of Aaron, running down to the collar of his robes;
like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the Eternal commanded the blessing — life, for all time.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ שֶׁאָמַר וְהָיָה הָעוֹלָם. בָּרוּךְ הוּא. בָּרוּךְ עוֹשֶׂה בְרֵאשִׁית. בָּרוּךְ אוֹמֵר וְעוֹשֶׂה. בָּרוּךְ גּוֹזֵר וּמְקַיֵּם. בָּרוּךְ מְרַחֵם עַל הָאָרֶץ. בָּרוּךְ מְרַחֵם עַל הַבְּרִיּוֹת. בָּרוּךְ מְשַׁלֵּם שָׂכָר טוֹב לִירֵאָיו. בָּרוּךְ חַי לָעַד וְקַיָּם לָנֶצַח. בָּרוּךְ פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל. בָּרוּךְ שְׁמוֹ.
blocks.tr: Baruch she’amar v’haya ha’olam. Baruch hu. Baruch oseh v’reishit. Baruch omer v’oseh. Baruch gozer umkayem. Baruch m’rachem al ha’aretz. Baruch m’rachem al hab’riyot. Baruch m’shalem sachar tov lire’av. Baruch chai la’ad v’kayam lanetzach. Baruch podeh umatzil. Baruch sh’mo.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם,. הָאֵל, הָאָב הָרַחֲמָן הַמְהֻלָּל בְּפִי עַמּוֹ. מְשֻׁבָּח וּמְפֹאָר בִּלְשׁוֹן חֲסִידָיו וַעֲבָדָיו. וּבְשִׁירֵי דָוִד עַבְדֶּךָ. נְהַלֶּלְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בִּשְׁבָחוֹת וּבִזְמִרוֹת. וּנְגַדֶּלְךָ וּנְשַׁבֵּחֲךָ וּנְפָאֶרְךָ, וְנַזְכִּיר שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ. יָחִיד חֵי הָעוֹלָמִים. מֶלֶךְ מְשֻׁבָּח וּמְפֹאָר עֲדֵי עַד שְׁמוֹ הַגָּדוֹל.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, ha’El, ha’av harachaman, hamhulal b’fi amo, m’shubach umfo’ar bilshon chasidav va’avadav, uvshirei David avdecha. N’halelcha Adonai Eloheinu bishvachot uvizmirot, ungadelcha unshabechacha unfa’ercha, v’nazkir shimcha malkeinu Eloheinu. Yachid chei ha’olamim. Melech m’shubach umfo’ar adei ad sh’mo hagadol.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ מְהֻלָּל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, melech m’hulal batishbachot.

blocks.en: Blessed is the One who spoke, and the world came to be. Blessed is the One. Blessed is the Maker of beginnings. Blessed is the One who speaks and does. Blessed is the One who decrees and fulfills. Blessed is the One who has mercy on the earth. Blessed is the One who has mercy on all creatures. Blessed is the One who gives good reward to those who stand in awe. Blessed is the One who lives forever and endures for all time. Blessed is the One who redeems and rescues. Blessed is that Name.

Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe — the God, the merciful Source, praised by the mouth of Your people, glorified by the tongue of the faithful and of all who serve You, extolled in the songs of David Your servant. With praises and with songs we praise You, Eternal our God — we make You great, we laud You, we glorify You, and we call Your name to mind, our God: the Only One, life of all the worlds — lauded and glorified, whose great name endures to the very end of time. Blessed are You, Eternal One, sung in praises.

aliases: A psalm of shelter — sung against fear itself, choosing trust over dread.

blocks.he: כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ, אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי.
blocks.tr: Ki vi chashak va’afaltehu, asagvehu ki-yada sh’mi.

blocks.he: יִקְרָאֵנִי וְאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּוֹ־אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה, אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵהוּ.
blocks.tr: Yikra’eni v’e’enehu, imo-anochi v’tzara, achaltzehu va’achabdehu.

blocks.en: "Because you are devoted to Me, I will deliver you; I will lift you high, for you know My name.
When you call to Me, I will answer; I will be with you in trouble; I will rescue you and honor you.
With long life I will satisfy you, and let you see the rescue I bring."

sources.name: Psalm 92
aliases: The song for the day of Shabbat — pointing past the week toward the day that is all rest.

Tov l’hodot la’Adonai, ulzamer l’shimcha elyon. L’hagid baboker chasdecha, ve’emunatcha baleilot. Alei-asor
כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְיָ בְּפׇעֳלֶךָ, בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן. מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְיָ, מְאֹד עָמְקוּ
