Ish-ba’ar lo yeda, uch’sil lo-yavin et-zot. Bifroach r’sha’im k’mo-esev, vayatzitzu kol-po’alei aven,

blocks.he: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיְיָ, וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן. לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ, וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת. עֲלֵי־עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־נָבֶל, עֲלֵי הִגָּיוֹן בְּכִנּוֹר.
blocks.tr: Tov l’hodot la’Adonai, ulzamer l’shimcha elyon. L’hagid baboker chasdecha, ve’emunatcha baleilot. Alei-asor va’alei-navel, alei higayon b’chinor.

blocks.he: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְיָ בְּפׇעֳלֶךָ, בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן. מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְיָ, מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ.
blocks.tr: Ki simachtani Adonai b’fo’olecha, b’ma’asei yadecha aranen. Mah gadlu ma’asecha Adonai, m’od amku machsh’votecha.

blocks.he: אִישׁ־בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע, וּכְסִיל לֹא־יָבִין אֶת־זֹאת. בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ־עֵשֶׂב וַיָּצִיצוּ כׇּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן, לְהִשָּׁמְדָם עֲדֵי־עַד. וְאַתָּה מָרוֹם לְעֹלָם יְיָ. כִּי הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יְיָ כִּי־הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ, יִתְפָּרְדוּ כׇּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן. וַתָּרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי, בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָן. וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים תִּשְׁמַעְנָה אׇזְנָי.
blocks.tr: Ish-ba’ar lo yeda, uch’sil lo-yavin et-zot. Bifroach r’sha’im k’mo-esev, vayatzitzu kol-po’alei aven, l’hishamdam adei-ad. V’ata marom l’olam Adonai. Ki hine oyvecha Adonai, ki-hine oyvecha yovedu, yitpardu kol-po’alei aven. Vatarem kir’em karni, baloti b’shemen ra’anan. Vatabet eini b’shurai, bakamim alai m’re’im tishma’na oznai.

blocks.he: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח, כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה. שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְיָ, בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִיחוּ.
blocks.tr: Tzadik katamar yifrach, k’erez balvanon yisge. Sh’tulim b’veit Adonai, b’chatzrot Eloheinu yafrichu.

blocks.he: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה, דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ. לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְיָ, צוּרִי וְלֹא־עַוְלָתָה בּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Od y’nuvun b’seiva, d’shenim v’ra’ananim yihyu. L’hagid ki-yashar Adonai, tzuri v’lo-avlata bo.

blocks.en: A psalm, a song for the day of Shabbat. It is good to give thanks to You, to sing to Your name, Most High — to tell of Your love in the morning and Your faithfulness through the nights, on the ten-stringed harp and the lyre, to the murmuring of the harp.
You have gladdened me by what You have made; at the work of Your hands I sing for joy. How great are Your works — how deep beyond us are Your thoughts.

A brutish person cannot know this, a fool cannot grasp it: though the wicked spring up like grass and all who do harm blossom, it is only to be destroyed forever — while You are exalted for all time. For look: those who set themselves against You, the ones who do harm, scatter and are undone.
You have lifted my strength high; I am anointed with fresh oil. My eyes have seen the fall of those who watched for me; my ears take in the fate of those who would rise against me.

The just flourish like the date palm and grow tall like a cedar of Lebanon — planted in Your house, they blossom in the courtyards of our God. Even in old age they still bear fruit, staying full of sap and green — to declare that You are upright, my Rock, in whom there is no wrong.

sources.name: Ashrei
aliases: An acrostic of joy — one of the earliest Jewish liturgies.
openingWords: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ, עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה.
Ashrei yoshvei veitecha, od y’hal’lucha sela.
אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ, אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיְיָ אֱלֹהָיו.
Ashrei ha’am shekacha lo, ashrei ha’am she’Adonai Elohav.
Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they never stop praising
Happy the people for whom it is so; happy the people whose

blocks.he: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ, עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה.
blocks.tr: Ashrei yoshvei veitecha, od y’hal’lucha sela.

blocks.he: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ, אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיְיָ אֱלֹהָיו.
blocks.tr: Ashrei ha’am shekacha lo, ashrei ha’am she’Adonai Elohav.

blocks.en: Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they never stop praising You. Selah.
Happy the people for whom it is so; happy the people whose God is the One.

blocks.he: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ, וַאֲבָרְכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Aromimcha Elohai hamelech, va’avarcha shimcha l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: בְּכׇל־יוֹם אֲבָרְכֶךָּ, וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: B’chol yom avarcheka, va’ahalela shimcha l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: גָּדוֹל יְיָ וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד, וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵקֶר.
blocks.tr: Gadol Adonai umhulal m’od, v’ligdulato ein cheker.

blocks.he: דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ.
blocks.tr: Dor l’dor y’shabach ma’asecha, ugvurotecha yagidu.

blocks.he: הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶךָ, וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה.
blocks.tr: Hadar k’vod hodecha, v’divrei niflotecha asicha.
Zecher rav tuvcha yabi’u, v’tzidkatcha y’ranenu.

blocks.he: חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ, אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדׇל־חָסֶד.
blocks.tr: Chanun v’rachum Adonai, erech apayim ugdol-chased.
Tov Adonai lakol, v’rachamav al kol ma’asav.
Yoducha Adonai kol ma’asecha, vachasidecha y’varchucha.

blocks.he: לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו, וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: L’hodia livnei ha’adam g’vurotav, uchvod hadar malchuto.

blocks.he: מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כׇּל־עֹלָמִים, וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכׇל־דּוֹר וָדֹר.
blocks.tr: Malchutcha malchut kol olamim, umemshaltcha b’chol dor vador.
Somech Adonai l’chol hanoflim, v’zokef l’chol hak’fufim.

blocks.he: עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּ, וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אׇכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Einei chol eilecha y’saberu, v’ata noten lahem et ochlam b’ito.
Poteach et yadecha, umasbia l’chol chai ratzon.
Tzadik Adonai b’chol d’rachav, v’chasid b’chol ma’asav.

blocks.he: קָרוֹב יְיָ לְכׇל־קֹרְאָיו, לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת.
blocks.tr: Karov Adonai l’chol kor’av, l’chol asher yikra’uhu ve’emet.
R’tzon y’re’av ya’ase, v’et shav’atam yishma v’yoshi’em.

blocks.he: שׁוֹמֵר יְיָ אֶת־כׇּל־אֹהֲבָיו, וְאֵת כׇּל־הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד.
blocks.tr: Shomer Adonai et kol ohavav, v’et kol har’sha’im yashmid.

blocks.he: תְּהִלַּת יְיָ יְדַבֶּר־פִּי, וִיבָרֵךְ כׇּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קׇדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: T’hilat Adonai y’daber pi, vivarech kol basar shem kodsho l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם, הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
blocks.tr: Va’anachnu n’varech Yah, me’ata v’ad olam, hal’lu-Yah.

blocks.en: A song of praise, of David. I will lift You high, my God, my Sovereign, and bless Your name forever and ever.
Every day I will bless You, and praise Your name forever and ever.
Great is the One, and greatly to be praised; that greatness is beyond all searching out.
One generation praises Your works to the next, and tells of Your mighty acts.
On the glorious splendor of Your majesty, and Your wondrous deeds, I will meditate.
They will speak of the might of Your awesome acts, and I will recount Your greatness.
They will pour out the memory of Your abundant goodness, and sing of Your justice.
Gracious and compassionate is the One, slow to anger and great in love.
The One is good to all, and that mercy rests upon all creation.
All Your works will thank You, and the faithful will bless You.
They will tell the glory of Your reign, and speak of Your power —
to make known to all people those mighty acts, and the glorious splendor of that reign.
Your reign is a reign for all worlds, and Your rule endures through every generation.
The One holds up all who fall, and lifts up all who are bowed down.
The eyes of all look to You in hope, and You give them their food in its season.
You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
The One is just in all those ways, and faithful in all those deeds.
The One is near to all who call — to all who call out in truth.
The One fulfills the longing of those who are in awe, hears their cry, and saves them.
The One watches over all who love, but all the wicked will be destroyed.
My mouth will speak the praise of the One; let all flesh bless that holy name, forever and ever.
And we will bless Yah, from now and forever. Halleluyah.

sources.name: Psalm 150
aliases: The last psalm — every instrument, until the song is handed to everything that breathes.
openingWords: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ. הַלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקׇדְשׁוֹ, הַלְלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ.
Hal’lu-Yah. Hal’lu-El b’kodsho, hal’luhu birkia uzo.
הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר, הַלְלוּהוּ בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר.
Hal’luhu b’teka shofar, hal’luhu b’nevel v’chinor.
הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֹף וּמָחוֹל, הַלְלוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעֻגָב.
Hal’luhu b’tof umachol, hal’luhu b’minim v’ugav.

blocks.he: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ. הַלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקׇדְשׁוֹ, הַלְלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Hal’lu-Yah. Hal’lu-El b’kodsho, hal’luhu birkia uzo.

blocks.he: הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר, הַלְלוּהוּ בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר.
blocks.tr: Hal’luhu b’teka shofar, hal’luhu b’nevel v’chinor.

blocks.he: הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֹף וּמָחוֹל, הַלְלוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעֻגָב.
blocks.tr: Hal’luhu b’tof umachol, hal’luhu b’minim v’ugav.

blocks.en: Halleluyah. Praise God in the holy place; praise the One in the vault of that strength.
Praise for the mighty acts; praise for the greatness beyond all measure.
Praise with the blast of the shofar; praise with harp and lyre.
Praise with hand-drum and dance; praise with strings and pipe.
Praise with clashing cymbals; praise with cymbals that ring out loud.
Let all that breathes praise Yah. Halleluyah.

sources.name: Nishmat Kol Chai
aliases: If our mouths were oceans of song, still not enough — and we praise anyway.

נִשְׁמַת כָּל חַי תְּבָרֵךְ אֶת שִׁמְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וְרוּחַ כָּל בָּשָׂר תְּפָאֵר
Nishmat kol chai t’varech et shimcha Adonai Eloheinu, v’ruach kol basar t’fa’er
אִלּוּ פִינוּ מָלֵא שִׁירָה כַּיָּם, וּלְשׁוֹנֵנוּ רִנָּה כַּהֲמוֹן גַּלָּיו, וְשִׂפְתוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁבַח כְּמֶרְחֲבֵי
Ilu finu male shira kayam, ulshoneinu rina kahamon galav, v’siftoteinu shevach k’merchavei
מִמִּצְרַיִם גְּאַלְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וּמִבֵּית עֲבָדִים פְּדִיתָנוּ, בְּרָעָב זַנְתָּנוּ, וּבְשָׂבָע כִּלְכַּלְתָּנוּ, מֵחֶרֶב
Mimitzrayim g’altanu Adonai Eloheinu, umibeit avadim p’ditanu, b’ra’av zantanu, uvsava kilkaltanu, mecherev
עַל כֵּן אֵבָרִים שֶׁפִּלַּגְתָּ בָּנוּ, וְרוּחַ וּנְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּפַחְתָּ בְּאַפֵּינוּ, וְלָשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתָּ

blocks.en: Nishmat, abridged — the opening, the ocean of song, the redemption remembered, the body’s own praise, and the close; the whole prayer is on p. .

blocks.he: נִשְׁמַת כָּל חַי תְּבָרֵךְ אֶת שִׁמְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וְרוּחַ כָּל בָּשָׂר תְּפָאֵר וּתְרוֹמֵם זִכְרְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד.
blocks.tr: Nishmat kol chai t’varech et shimcha Adonai Eloheinu, v’ruach kol basar t’fa’er utromem zichr’cha malkeinu tamid.

blocks.he: אִלּוּ פִינוּ מָלֵא שִׁירָה כַּיָּם, וּלְשׁוֹנֵנוּ רִנָּה כַּהֲמוֹן גַּלָּיו, וְשִׂפְתוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁבַח כְּמֶרְחֲבֵי רָקִיעַ, וְעֵינֵינוּ מְאִירוֹת כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְכַיָּרֵחַ, וְיָדֵינוּ פְּרוּשׂוֹת כְּנִשְׁרֵי שָׁמָיִם, וְרַגְלֵינוּ קַלּוֹת כָּאַיָּלוֹת, אֵין אֲנַחְנוּ מַסְפִּיקִים לְהוֹדוֹת לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, וּלְבָרֵךְ אֶת שְׁמֶךָ עַל אַחַת מֵאֶלֶף אַלְפֵי אֲלָפִים וְרִבֵּי רְבָבוֹת פְּעָמִים, הַטּוֹבוֹת שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ עִם אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְעִמָּנוּ.
blocks.tr: Ilu finu male shira kayam, ulshoneinu rina kahamon galav, v’siftoteinu shevach k’merchavei rakia, v’eineinu m’irot kashemesh v’chayareach, v’yadeinu f’rusot k’nishrei shamayim, v’ragleinu kalot ka’ayalot — ein anachnu maspikim l’hodot l’cha Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu, ulvarech et sh’mecha al achat me’elef alfei alafim v’ribei r’vavot p’amim, hatovot she’asita im avoteinu v’imanu.

blocks.he: מִמִּצְרַיִם גְּאַלְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וּמִבֵּית עֲבָדִים פְּדִיתָנוּ, בְּרָעָב זַנְתָּנוּ, וּבְשָׂבָע כִּלְכַּלְתָּנוּ, מֵחֶרֶב הִצַּלְתָּנוּ, וּמִדֶּבֶר מִלַּטְתָּנוּ, וּמֵחֳלָיִם רָעִים וְנֶאֱמָנִים דִּלִּיתָנוּ.
blocks.tr: Mimitzrayim g’altanu Adonai Eloheinu, umibeit avadim p’ditanu, b’ra’av zantanu, uvsava kilkaltanu, mecherev hitzaltanu, umidever milatanu, umecholayim ra’im v’ne’emanim dilitanu.

blocks.he: עַל כֵּן אֵבָרִים שֶׁפִּלַּגְתָּ בָּנוּ, וְרוּחַ וּנְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּפַחְתָּ בְּאַפֵּינוּ, וְלָשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתָּ בְּפִינוּ, הֵן הֵם יוֹדוּ וִיבָרְכוּ וִישַׁבְּחוּ וִיפָאֲרוּ וִירוֹמְמוּ וְיַעֲרִיצוּ וְיַקְדִּישׁוּ וְיַמְלִיכוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ.
blocks.tr: Al ken evarim shepilagta banu, v’ruach unshama shenafachta b’apeinu, v’lashon asher samta b’finu — hen hem yodu vivar’chu vishab’chu vifa’aru virom’mu v’ya’aritzu v’yakdishu v’yamlichu et shimcha malkeinu.

blocks.he: נְהַלֶּלְךָ וּנְשַׁבֵּחֲךָ וּנְפָאֶרְךָ וּנְבָרֵךְ אֶת שֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ, כָּאָמוּר, לְדָוִד, בָּרְכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת יְיָ, וְכָל קְרָבַי אֶת שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ.
blocks.tr: N’halelcha unshabechacha unfa’ercha unvarech et shem kod’shecha, ka’amur: l’David, barchi nafshi et Adonai, v’chol k’ravai et shem kodsho.

blocks.en: The breath of all life blesses Your name, Eternal our God; the spirit of all flesh glorifies and lifts up the memory of You, always.

Even if our mouths were as full of song as the sea, our tongues loud with joy as its waves, our lips wide with praise as the open sky, our eyes bright as the sun and the moon, our hands spread like the eagles of the sky, our feet swift as deer — still we could not thank You enough, Eternal our God and God of our ancestors, or bless Your name for even one of the thousand thousand-thousands and myriad myriads of times You did good for our ancestors and for us.

From Egypt You redeemed us, Eternal our God, and from the house of bondage You set us free; in famine You fed us, in plenty You sustained us; from the sword You saved us, from plague You delivered us, and from sickness, harsh and lingering, You drew us up.

And so the limbs You set within us, the breath and soul You breathed into us, the tongue You placed in our mouths — they themselves will thank and bless, praise and glorify, exalt and revere, sanctify and declare the oneness of Your name, our Sovereign.
We will praise You and extol You and glorify You and bless Your holy name, as it is said: "Of David — bless the Eternal, O my soul, and all that is within me, that holy name."

sources.name: Shochein Ad
aliases: Praise rising through the upright, the just, the faithful — into the whole assembly.
openingWords: On Shabbat, Shochein Ad begins here; on the Days of Awe, at
שׁוֹכֵן עַד מָרוֹם וְקָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹ, וְכָתוּב רַנְּנוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיְיָ, לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה.
Shochein ad marom v’kadosh sh’mo, v’chatuv ran’nu tzadikim ba’Adonai, laysharim nava t’hila.
בְּפִי יְשָׁרִים תִּתְהַלָּל, וּבְדִבְרֵי צַדִּיקִים תִּתְבָּרַךְ, וּבִלְשׁוֹן חֲסִידִים תִּתְרוֹמָם, וּבְקֶרֶב קְדוֹשִׁים תִּתְקַדָּשׁ.
B’fi y’sharim tit’halal, uvdivrei tzadikim titbarach, uvilshon chasidim titromam, uvkerev k’doshim titkadash.
וּבְמַקְהֲלוֹת רִבְבוֹת עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בְּרִנָּה יִתְפָּאַר שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר.
Uvmakhalot riv’vot am’cha beit Yisra’el, b’rina yitpa’ar shimcha malkeinu b’chol dor vador.
שֶׁכֵּן חוֹבַת כָּל הַיְצוּרִים, לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, לְהוֹדוֹת לְהַלֵּל לְשַׁבֵּחַ

blocks.en: On Shabbat, Shochein Ad begins here; on the Days of Awe, at HaMelech.

blocks.he: וּבְמַקְהֲלוֹת רִבְבוֹת עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בְּרִנָּה יִתְפָּאַר שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר.

blocks.tr: Sheken chovat kol hay’tzurim, l’fanecha Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu, l’hodot l’halel l’shabeach l’fa’er l’romem l’hader l’varech l’aleh ulkales.

blocks.he: עַל כָּל דִּבְרֵי שִׁירוֹת וְתִשְׁבְּחוֹת דָּוִד בֶּן יִשַׁי עַבְדְּךָ מְשִׁיחֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Al kol divrei shirot v’tishb’chot David ben Yishai avd’cha m’shichecha.

blocks.en: The Eternal dwells forever, exalted and holy is that name. And it is written: sing out, you just ones, to the Eternal — praise is fitting on the lips of the upright.
On the mouth of the upright You are praised; in the words of the just, blessed; on the tongue of the faithful, raised high; among the holy, made holy.
And in the great gatherings of Your people, the house of Yisrael, in song Your name is glorified, in every generation.
For such is the duty of all that is formed, before You, Eternal our God and God of our ancestors: to thank, praise, laud, glorify, exalt, adorn, bless, raise high, and acclaim —
beyond all the words of the songs and praises of David son of Jesse, Your servant, Your anointed.

sources.name: Yishtabach
aliases: The seal of the verses of song — fifteen sh’vachot, closing the full path through P’sukei D’zimra.
openingWords: יִשְׁתַּבַּח שִׁמְךָ לָעַד מַלְכֵּנוּ, הָאֵל הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. כִּי לְךָ
Yishtabach shimcha la’ad malkeinu, ha’El hamelech hagadol v’hakadosh bashamayim uva’aretz. Ki l’cha
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֵל מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת, אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת, אֲדוֹן הַנִּפְלָאוֹת, הַבּוֹחֵר
Baruch ata Adonai, El melech gadol batishbachot, El hahoda’ot, adon haniflaot, habocher
May Your name be praised forever — the God, the great and
blessings and thanksgivings, from now and forever.

blocks.he: יִשְׁתַּבַּח שִׁמְךָ לָעַד מַלְכֵּנוּ, הָאֵל הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. כִּי לְךָ נָאֶה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ: שִׁיר וּשְׁבָחָה, הַלֵּל וְזִמְרָה, עֹז וּמֶמְשָׁלָה, נֶצַח, גְּדֻלָּה וּגְבוּרָה, תְּהִלָּה וְתִפְאֶרֶת, קְדֻשָּׁה וּמַלְכוּת,
blocks.tr: Yishtabach shimcha la’ad malkeinu, ha’El hamelech hagadol v’hakadosh bashamayim uva’aretz. Ki l’cha na’e Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu: shir ushvacha, halel v’zimra, oz umemshala, netzach, g’dula ugvura, t’hila v’tif’eret, k’dusha umalchut,

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֵל מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת, אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת, אֲדוֹן הַנִּפְלָאוֹת, הַבּוֹחֵר בְּשִׁירֵי זִמְרָה, מֶלֶךְ אֵל חֵי הָעוֹלָמִים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, El melech gadol batishbachot, El hahoda’ot, adon haniflaot, habocher b’shirei zimra, melech El chei ha’olamim.

blocks.en: May Your name be praised forever — the God, the great and holy One, in heaven and on earth. For to You, our God and God of our ancestors, all this is fitting: song and praise, chant and melody, strength and reach, endurance, greatness and power, glory and splendor, holiness and majesty —
blessings and thanksgivings, from now and forever.
Blessed are You, Eternal One — great in praises, God of thanksgiving, Source of wonders, who delights in songs of praise, life of all the worlds.

sources.name: Chatzi Kaddish
aliases: A seam in the service — the psalms of praise are sealed, and we turn toward Bar’chu, the call to prayer.
openingWords: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן
Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.
יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu,
May the great name be made great and holy in the world
May the great name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon uvyomeichon uvchayei d’chol beit Yisra’el, ba’agala uvizman kariv, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵלָּא מִן־כָּל־בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’ela min kol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Yisrael, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the name of the Holy One of blessing — far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Bar’chu
aliases: We call one another to bless — turning toward each other like spokes toward one center.
openingWords: Bless the Eternal, Source of blessing.
Blessed is the Eternal, Source of blessing, now and forever.

blocks.en: Bless the Eternal, Source of blessing.
Blessed is the Eternal, Source of blessing, now and forever.

sources.name: Yotzer Or
aliases: The first blessing of the Sh’ma — a moment of smallness, of taking a cosmic perspective.
openingWords: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, יוֹצֵר אוֹר וּבוֹרֵא חֹשֶׁךְ, עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha’olam, yotzer or uvore choshech, oseh shalom
הַכֹּל יוֹדוּךָ וְהַכֹּל יְשַׁבְּחוּךָ וְהַכֹּל יֹאמְרוּ אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּיְיָ. הַכֹּל יְרוֹמְמוּךָ סֶּלָה
Hakol yoducha, v’hakol y’shab’chucha, v’hakol yom’ru ein kadosh k’Adonai. Hakol y’rom’mucha sela,
הַמֵּאִיר לָאָרֶץ וְלַדָּרִים עָלֶיהָ בְּרַחֲמִים, וּבְטוּבוֹ מְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית.
Hame’ir la’aretz v’ladarim aleha b’rachamim, uvtuvo m’chadesh b’chol yom tamid ma’aseh v’reishit.
Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who forms
All things thank You, all things praise You, all things say: nothing

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, יוֹצֵר אוֹר וּבוֹרֵא חֹשֶׁךְ, עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם וּבוֹרֵא אֶת הַכֹּל.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha’olam, yotzer or uvore choshech, oseh shalom uvore et hakol.

blocks.he: הַכֹּל יוֹדוּךָ וְהַכֹּל יְשַׁבְּחוּךָ וְהַכֹּל יֹאמְרוּ אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּיְיָ. הַכֹּל יְרוֹמְמוּךָ סֶּלָה יוֹצֵר הַכֹּל. הָאֵל הַפּוֹתֵחַ בְּכָל יוֹם דַּלְתוֹת שַׁעֲרֵי מִזְרָח, וּבוֹקֵעַ חַלּוֹנֵי רָקִיעַ, מוֹצִיא חַמָּה מִמְּקוֹמָהּ וּלְבָנָה מִמְּכוֹן שִׁבְתָּהּ, וּמֵאִיר לָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ וּלְיוֹשְׁבָיו שֶׁבָּרָא בְּמִדַּת הָרַחֲמִים.
blocks.tr: Hakol yoducha, v’hakol y’shab’chucha, v’hakol yom’ru ein kadosh k’Adonai. Hakol y’rom’mucha sela, yotzer hakol. Ha’El hapoteach b’chol yom daltot sha’arei mizrach, uvokea chalonei rakia, motzi chama mim’komah ulvana mim’chon shivtah, ume’ir la’olam kulo ulyosh’vav shebara b’midat harachamim.

blocks.he: הַמֵּאִיר לָאָרֶץ וְלַדָּרִים עָלֶיהָ בְּרַחֲמִים, וּבְטוּבוֹ מְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית. הַמֶּלֶךְ הַמְרוֹמָם לְבַדּוֹ מֵאָז, הַמְשֻׁבָּח וְהַמְּפֹאָר וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא מִימוֹת עוֹלָם. אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם, בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ, אֲדוֹן עֻזֵּנוּ, צוּר מִשְׂגַּבֵּנוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ, מִשְׂגָּב בַּעֲדֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Hame’ir la’aretz v’ladarim aleha b’rachamim, uvtuvo m’chadesh b’chol yom tamid ma’aseh v’reishit. Hamelech ham’romam l’vado me’az, ham’shubach v’hamfo’ar v’hamitnase mimot olam. Elohei olam, b’rachamecha harabim rachem aleinu, adon uzeinu, tzur misgabeinu, magen yish’einu, misgav ba’adeinu.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who forms light and creates dark, who makes peace and creates all things.

All things thank You, all things praise You, all things say: nothing is holy like the Eternal. All things lift You up, Selah — Maker of it all. Every single day the gates of the east open, the windows of the sky split wide; the sun is drawn from its place and the moon from its resting-station, and light comes to the whole world and all who dwell in it, in mercy.

You light the earth and those who live upon it, in mercy, and in Your goodness renew, each day, always, the work of creation. You alone have been lifted high from of old — praised, glorified, exalted from days beyond memory. Be merciful with us, God of all time, out of Your great mercy — our strength, our sheltering rock, the shield that saves us, the fastness at our side.

blocks.he: אֵל אָדוֹן עַל כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים, בָּרוּךְ וּמְבֹרָךְ בְּפִי כָּל נְשָׁמָה. גָּדְלוֹ וְטוּבוֹ לִפְנֵי עוֹלָם, דַּעַת וּתְבוּנָה סוֹבְבִים אוֹתוֹ.
blocks.tr: El adon al kol hama’asim, baruch umvorach b’fi kol n’shama. Godlo v’tuvo lifnei olam, da’at utvuna sov’vim oto.

blocks.he: הַמִּתְגָּאֶה עַל חַיּוֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ, וְנֶהְדָּר בְּכָבוֹד עַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה. זְכוּת וּמִישׁוֹר לִפְנֵי כִסְאוֹ, חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים מָלֵא כְבוֹדוֹ.
blocks.tr: Hamitga’eh al chayot hakodesh, v’nehdar b’chavod al hamerkava. Z’chut umishor lifnei chis’o, chesed v’rachamim male ch’vodo.

blocks.he: טוֹבִים מְאוֹרוֹת שֶׁבָּרָא אֱלֹהֵינוּ, יְצָרָם בְּדַעַת בְּבִינָה וּבְהַשְׂכֵּל. כֹּחַ וּגְבוּרָה נָתַן בָּהֶם, לִהְיוֹת מוֹשְׁלִים בְּקֶרֶב תֵּבֵל.
blocks.tr: Tovim m’orot shebara Eloheinu, y’tzaram b’da’at b’vina uvhaskel. Koach ugvura natan bahem, lihyot mosh’lim b’kerev tevel.

blocks.he: מְלֵאִים זִיו וּמְפִיקִים נֹגַהּ, נָאֶה זִיוָם בְּכָל הָעוֹלָם. שְׂמֵחִים בְּצֵאתָם וְשָׂשִׂים בְּבוֹאָם, עוֹשִׂים בְּאֵימָה רְצוֹן קוֹנָם.
blocks.tr: M’le’im ziv umfikim nogah, na’eh zivam b’chol ha’olam. S’mechim b’tzeitam v’sasim b’vo’am, osim b’eima r’tzon konam.

blocks.he: פְּאֵר וְכָבוֹד נוֹתְנִים לִשְׁמוֹ, צָהֳלָה וְרִנָּה לְזֵכֶר מַלְכוּתוֹ. קָרָא לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וַיִּזְרַח אוֹר, רָאָה וְהִתְקִין צוּרַת הַלְּבָנָה.
blocks.tr: P’er v’chavod not’nim lishmo, tzohola v’rina l’zecher malchuto. Kara lashemesh vayizrach or, ra’a v’hitkin tzurat hal’vana.

blocks.he: שֶׁבַח נוֹתְנִים לוֹ כָּל צְבָא מָרוֹם, תִּפְאֶרֶת וּגְדֻלָּה שְׂרָפִים וְאוֹפַנִּים וְחַיּוֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ.
blocks.tr: Shevach not’nim lo kol tz’va marom, tif’eret ugdula s’rafim v’ofanim v’chayot hakodesh.

blocks.en: God, over all that is made, blessed and praised by every breathing mouth: greatness and goodness were before the world; knowledge and understanding surround the One.
Exalted above the holy creatures, glorious upon the chariot of splendor; merit and fairness before the throne, love and mercy filling that glory.
Good are the lights our God created — formed with knowledge, wisdom, and care; strength and power set within them, to govern within the heart of the world.
Full of glow and giving off light, their radiance lovely across all the world; glad as they rise, joyful as they set — doing, in awe, the will of the One who made them.
Beauty and honor they give to the Name, gladness and song in memory of that greatness. God called to the sun, and it blazed with light; looked, and shaped the face of the moon.
All the host of the heights gives praise — glory and grandeur, seraphim and ofanim and the holy creatures.

blocks.he: לָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת מִכָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים, בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי הִתְעַלָּה וְיָשַׁב עַל כִּסֵּא כְבוֹדוֹ. תִּפְאֶרֶת עָטָה לְיוֹם הַמְּנוּחָה, עֹנֶג קָרָא לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת. זֶה שֶׁבַח שֶׁל יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי, שֶׁבּוֹ שָׁבַת אֵל מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ.
blocks.tr: La’El asher shavat mikol hama’asim, bayom hash’vi’i hit’ala v’yashav al kise ch’vodo. Tif’eret ata l’yom ham’nucha, oneg kara l’yom haShabbat. Zeh shevach shel yom hash’vi’i, shebo shavat El mikol m’lachto.

blocks.he: וְיוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְשַׁבֵּחַ וְאוֹמֵר: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת, טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת לַיְיָ. לְפִיכָךְ יְפָאֲרוּ וִיבָרְכוּ לָאֵל כָּל יְצוּרָיו, שֶׁבַח יְקָר וּגְדֻלָּה יִתְּנוּ לָאֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹצֵר כֹּל, הַמַּנְחִיל מְנוּחָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ בְּיוֹם שַׁבַּת קֹדֶשׁ.
blocks.tr: V’yom hash’vi’i m’shabeach v’omer: mizmor shir l’yom haShabbat, tov l’hodot la’Adonai. L’fichach y’fa’aru vivar’chu la’El kol y’tzurav, shevach y’kar ugdula yit’nu la’El melech yotzer kol, hamanchil m’nucha l’amo Yisra’el bikdushato b’yom Shabbat kodesh.

blocks.he: שִׁמְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִתְקַדַּשׁ. וְזִכְרְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ יִתְפָּאַר. בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת: תִּתְבָּרַךְ מוֹשִׁיעֶנּוּ עַל שֶׁבַח מַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ. וְעַל מְאוֹרֵי אוֹר שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ יְפָאֲרוּךָ סֶלָה.
blocks.tr: Shimcha Adonai Eloheinu yitkadash, v’zichr’cha malkeinu yitpa’ar, bashamayim mima’al v’al ha’aretz mitachat. Titbarach moshi’einu al shevach ma’asei yadecha, v’al m’orei or she’asita y’fa’arucha sela.

blocks.en: To You, God who rested from all the work of making: on the seventh day You rose above it all and were still. You wrapped the day of rest in beauty and called Shabbat a delight. This is the praise of the seventh day — the day You rested from all the work.

And the seventh day itself gives praise, and says: a song for the day of Shabbat — how good it is to give thanks to the Eternal. And so all Your creatures glorify and bless You, offering praise, honor, and greatness to the God who forms all things and hands rest to the people Yisrael, in holiness, on the holy day of Shabbat.

May Your Name, our God, be hallowed, and the memory of You be glorified — in the heavens above and on the earth below. Be blessed, our Deliverer, for the splendor of the work of Your hands; and for the lights of light that You made — let them glorify You, Selah.

blocks.he: תִּתְבָּרַךְ צוּרֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וְגוֹאֲלֵנוּ בּוֹרֵא קְדוֹשִׁים. יִשְׁתַּבַּח שִׁמְךָ לָעַד מַלְכֵּנוּ, יוֹצֵר מְשָׁרְתִים, וַאֲשֶׁר מְשָׁרְתָיו כֻּלָּם עוֹמְדִים בְּרוּם עוֹלָם וּמַשְׁמִיעִים בְּיִרְאָה יַחַד בְּקוֹל דִּבְרֵי אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים וּמֶלֶךְ עוֹלָם.
blocks.tr: Titbarach tzureinu malkeinu v’go’aleinu borei k’doshim. Yishtabach shimcha la’ad malkeinu, yotzer m’shar’tim, va’asher m’shar’tav kulam om’dim b’rum olam umashmi’im b’yir’a yachad b’kol divrei Elohim chayim umelech olam.

blocks.he: כֻּלָּם אֲהוּבִים, כֻּלָּם בְּרוּרִים, כֻּלָּם גִּבּוֹרִים, וְכֻלָּם עוֹשִׂים בְּאֵימָה וּבְיִרְאָה רְצוֹן קוֹנָם. וְכֻלָּם פּוֹתְחִים אֶת פִּיהֶם בִּקְדֻשָּׁה וּבְטָהֳרָה, בְּשִׁירָה וּבְזִמְרָה, וּמְבָרְכִים וּמְשַׁבְּחִים וּמְפָאֲרִים וּמַעֲרִיצִים וּמַקְדִּישִׁים וּמַמְלִיכִים.
blocks.tr: Kulam ahuvim, kulam b’rurim, kulam giborim, v’chulam osim b’eima uvyir’a r’tzon konam. V’chulam pot’chim et pihem bikdusha uvtahora, b’shira uvzimra, umvar’chim umshab’chim umfa’arim uma’aritzim umakdishim umamlichim.

blocks.he: אֶת שֵׁם הָאֵל, הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, קָדוֹשׁ הוּא. וְכֻלָּם מְקַבְּלִים עֲלֵיהֶם עֹל מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם זֶה מִזֶּה, וְנוֹתְנִים רְשׁוּת זֶה לָזֶה לְהַקְדִּישׁ לְיוֹצְרָם בְּנַחַת רוּחַ, בְּשָׂפָה בְרוּרָה וּבִנְעִימָה, קְדֻשָּׁה כֻּלָּם כְּאֶחָד עוֹנִים וְאוֹמְרִים בְּיִרְאָה:
blocks.tr: Et shem ha’El, hamelech hagadol hagibor v’hanora, kadosh hu. V’chulam m’kab’lim aleihem ol malchut shamayim zeh mizeh, v’not’nim r’shut zeh lazeh l’hakdish l’yotz’ram b’nachat ruach, b’safa v’rura uvin’ima, k’dusha kulam k’echad onim v’om’rim b’yir’a:

blocks.he: קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת, מְלֹא כָל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ.
blocks.tr: Kadosh, kadosh, kadosh Adonai tz’va’ot, m’lo chol ha’aretz k’vodo.

blocks.he: וְהָאוֹפַנִּים וְחַיּוֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּרַעַשׁ גָּדוֹל מִתְנַשְּׂאִים לְעֻמַּת שְׂרָפִים. לְעֻמָּתָם מְשַׁבְּחִים וְאוֹמְרִים:
blocks.tr: V’ha’ofanim v’chayot hakodesh b’ra’ash gadol mitnas’im l’umat s’rafim. L’umatam m’shab’chim v’om’rim:

blocks.en: Be blessed, our rock, our redeemer, maker of holy beings; may Your name be praised forever — You who form the ministering ones, all of whom stand at the height of the world and sound out together, in awe, in one voice, the words of the living God, unchanging through all time.

All of them beloved, all of them clear, all of them mighty — all of them doing, in awe and reverence, the will of the One who made them; opening their mouths in holiness and purity, in song and melody, blessing and praising, glorifying, revering, hallowing, and declaring the oneness of —

the Name of God — the great, the mighty, the awesome — holy is the One. And they take upon themselves, each from the other, the obligation of that Oneness; and they give permission, one to another, to hallow their Maker, calmly, in clear and sweet speech, all as one answering the Kedushah in awe and saying:

Holy, holy, holy is the Source of all being; the fullness of the whole earth is that glory. And the ofanim and the holy creatures, in a great rushing sound, rise toward the seraphim; facing them they give praise and say: Blessed is the glory of the Eternal, from its place.

blocks.he: לְאֵל בָּרוּךְ נְעִימוֹת יִתֵּנוּ, לְמֶלֶךְ אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם זְמִירוֹת יֹאמֵרוּ וְתִשְׁבָּחוֹת יַשְׁמִיעוּ, כִּי הוּא לְבַדּוֹ פּוֹעֵל גְּבוּרוֹת, עֹשֶׂה חֲדָשׁוֹת, בַּעַל מִלְחָמוֹת, זוֹרֵעַ צְדָקוֹת, מַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעוֹת, בּוֹרֵא רְפוּאוֹת, נוֹרָא תְהִלּוֹת, אֲדוֹן הַנִּפְלָאוֹת.
blocks.tr: L’El baruch n’imot yitenu, l’melech El chai v’kayam z’mirot yomeru v’tishbachot yashmi’u, ki hu l’vado po’el g’vurot, oseh chadashot, ba’al milchamot, zorea tz’dakot, matzmiach y’shu’ot, borei r’fu’ot, nora t’hilot, adon hanifla’ot.

blocks.he: הַמְחַדֵּשׁ בְּטוּבוֹ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית, כָּאָמוּר: לְעֹשֵׂה אוֹרִים גְּדֹלִים, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Ham’chadesh b’tuvo b’chol yom tamid ma’aseh v’reishit, ka’amur: l’oseh orim g’dolim, ki l’olam chasdo.

blocks.he: אוֹר חָדָשׁ עַל צִיּוֹן תָּאִיר, וְנִזְכֶּה כֻלָּנוּ מְהֵרָה לְאוֹרוֹ.
blocks.tr: Or chadash al Tziyon ta’ir, v’nizkeh chulanu m’hera l’oro.

blocks.en: To the blessed God they offer sweet music; to the living and enduring One they raise up songs and let their praises be heard — for the One alone does mighty things, makes new things, is master of wars, sows justice, brings rescue into bloom, creates healing, awesome in praises, source of wonders,
who in goodness renews, each day, always, the work of creation — as it is written: to the One who makes great lights, whose love is forever.
May You shine a new light upon Zion, and may we all soon be worthy of its light.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, who forms the lights.

sources.name: Ahavah Rabbah
aliases: The second blessing of the Sh’ma — our connections and obligations to each other.
openingWords: אַהֲבָה רַבָּה אֲהַבְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, חֶמְלָה גְּדוֹלָה וִיתֵרָה חָמַלְתָּ עָלֵינוּ. אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ,

Avinu ha’av harachaman, hamrachem, rachem aleinu, v’ten b’libeinu l’havin ulhaskil, lishmo’a, lilmod

Vahavi’einu l’shalom me’arba kanfot ha’aretz, v’tolicheinu kom’miyut l’artzeinu, ki El po’el y’shu’ot

blocks.he: אַהֲבָה רַבָּה אֲהַבְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, חֶמְלָה גְּדוֹלָה וִיתֵרָה חָמַלְתָּ עָלֵינוּ. אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, בַּעֲבוּר אֲבוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁבָּטְחוּ בְךָ וַתְּלַמְּדֵם חֻקֵּי חַיִּים, כֵּן תְּחָנֵּנוּ וּתְלַמְּדֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Ahava raba ahavtanu Adonai Eloheinu, chemla g’dola vitera chamalta aleinu. Avinu malkeinu, ba’avur avoteinu shebat’chu v’cha vat’lam’dem chukei chayim, ken t’choneinu utlam’deinu.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ הָאָב הָרַחֲמָן, הַמְרַחֵם, רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ, וְתֵן בְּלִבֵּנוּ לְהָבִין וּלְהַשְׂכִּיל, לִשְׁמֹעַ, לִלְמֹד וּלְלַמֵּד, לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת וּלְקַיֵּם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי תַלְמוּד תּוֹרָתֶךָ בְּאַהֲבָה.
blocks.tr: Avinu ha’av harachaman, hamrachem, rachem aleinu, v’ten b’libeinu l’havin ulhaskil, lishmo’a, lilmod ullamed, lishmor v’la’asot ulkayem et kol divrei talmud Toratecha b’ahava.

blocks.he: וְהָאֵר עֵינֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְדַבֵּק לִבֵּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְיַחֵד לְבָבֵנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וּלְיִרְאָה אֶת שְׁמֶךָ, וְלֹא נֵבוֹשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשְׁךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא בָּטָחְנוּ, נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: V’ha’er eineinu b’Toratecha, v’dabek libeinu b’mitzvotecha, v’yached l’vaveinu l’ahava ulyir’a et sh’mecha, v’lo nevosh l’olam va’ed. Ki v’shem kodsh’cha hagadol v’hanora batachnu, nagila v’nism’cha bishu’atecha.

blocks.he: וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ, וְתוֹלִיכֵנוּ קוֹמְמִיּוּת לְאַרְצֵנוּ, כִּי אֵל פּוֹעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת אָתָּה, וּבָנוּ בָחַרְתָּ מִכָּל עַם וְלָשׁוֹן, וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל סֶלָה בֶּאֱמֶת, לְהוֹדוֹת לְךָ וּלְיַחֶדְךָ בְּאַהֲבָה.
blocks.tr: Vahavi’einu l’shalom me’arba kanfot ha’aretz, v’tolicheinu kom’miyut l’artzeinu, ki El po’el y’shu’ot ata, uvanu vacharta mikol am v’lashon, v’kerav’tanu l’shimcha hagadol sela be’emet, l’hodot l’cha ulyachedcha b’ahava.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַבּוֹחֵר בְּעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבָה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, habocher b’amo Yisra’el b’ahava.

blocks.en: With abundant love You have loved us, Eternal our God; with great and overflowing tenderness You have cared for us. Avinu Malkeinu — for the sake of our ancestors who trusted in You, and whom You taught the laws of life, be gracious to us, too, and teach us.

Merciful One, source of mercy, have mercy on us: put into our hearts the will to understand and discern, to listen, to learn and to teach, to keep and to do and to fulfill all the teachings of Your Torah, in love — bound to those who came before us, to those beside us, and most of all to those still to come.

Light up our eyes with Your Torah, hold our hearts close to Your mitzvot, and make our whole heart one — to love and to hold in awe Your Name — so we are never ashamed. For in Your great and awesome holy Name we have trusted; let us celebrate and rejoice in Your saving help.

Bring us home in peace from the four corners of the earth, and lead us upright to our land — for You are the God who brings rescue, and You chose us from every people and tongue, and You have drawn us near to Your great Name, in truth, to give thanks to You and to make You one, in love. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who chooses the people Yisrael, in love.

sources.name: The Sh’ma
aliases: The line we say lying down and rising up, and hope to say last of all — Israel’s whole faith in six words.

sources.name: V’ahavta & Tzitzit
aliases: The first paragraph of the Sh'ma, and the fringes that remember it — we must live our values, not just proclaim them.
openingWords: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְיָ֣ אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכׇל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ׃ וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י
V’ahavta et Adonai Elohecha, b’chol l’vavcha uvchol nafsh’cha uvchol m’odecha. V’hayu had’varim
וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל־יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזֻז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
Uk’shartam l’ot al yadecha, v’hayu l’totafot bein einecha. Uch’tavtam al m’zuzot beitecha
וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְיָ֤ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙
V’haya im shamoa tishm’u el mitzvotai asher anochi m’tzaveh etchem hayom, l’ahava
The first paragraph, above, we read aloud together. The tradition continues here;
הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃ וְחָרָ֨ה

blocks.he: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְיָ֣ אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכׇל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ׃ וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם עַל־לְבָבֶֽךָ׃ וְשִׁנַּנְתָּ֣ם לְבָנֶ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֖ בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשׇׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃
blocks.tr: V’ahavta et Adonai Elohecha, b’chol l’vavcha uvchol nafsh’cha uvchol m’odecha. V’hayu had’varim ha’eleh asher anochi m’tzav’cha hayom al l’vavecha. V’shinantam l’vanecha v’dibarta bam, b’shivt’cha b’veitecha uvlecht’cha vaderech, uvshochb’cha uvkumecha.

blocks.he: וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל־יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזֻז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
blocks.tr: Uk’shartam l’ot al yadecha, v’hayu l’totafot bein einecha. Uch’tavtam al m’zuzot beitecha uvish’arecha.

blocks.he: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְיָ֤ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ וּלְעׇבְד֔וֹ בְּכׇל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃ וְנָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר־אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִירֹֽשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃ וְנָתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃
blocks.tr: V’haya im shamoa tishm’u el mitzvotai asher anochi m’tzaveh etchem hayom, l’ahava et Adonai Eloheichem ul’ovdo b’chol l’vavchem uvchol nafsh’chem. V’natati m’tar artz’chem b’ito, yoreh umalkosh, v’asafta d’ganecha v’tirosh’cha v’yitzharecha. V’natati esev b’sad’cha liv’hemtecha, v’achalta v’sava’ta.

blocks.en: The first paragraph, above, we read aloud together. The tradition continues here; many read it quietly, and we gather again at the gold line.

blocks.he: הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃ וְחָרָ֨ה אַף־יְיָ֜ בָּכֶ֗ם וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֑הּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְיָ֖ נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
blocks.tr: Hisham’ru lachem pen yifteh l’vavchem, v’sartem va’avadtem elohim acherim v’hishtachavitem lahem. V’chara af Adonai bachem, v’atzar et hashamayim v’lo yihyeh matar, v’ha’adama lo titen et y’vulah, va’avadtem m’hera me’al ha’aretz hatova asher Adonai noten lachem.

blocks.he: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרַ֣י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַֽל־נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל־יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶֽם׃ וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשׇׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃ לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵיכֶם֙ וִימֵ֣י בְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְיָ֛ לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם כִּימֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
blocks.tr: V’samtem et d’varai eleh al l’vavchem v’al nafsh’chem, uk’shartem otam l’ot al yedchem, v’hayu l’totafot bein eineichem. V’limadtem otam et b’neichem l’daber bam, b’shivt’cha b’veitecha uvlecht’cha vaderech, uvshochb’cha uvkumecha. Uch’tavtam al m’zuzot beitecha uvish’arecha. L’ma’an yirbu y’meichem vimei v’neichem al ha’adama asher nishba Adonai la’avoteichem latet lahem, kimei hashamayim al ha’aretz.

blocks.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְנָ֥תְנ֛וּ עַל־צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
blocks.tr: Daber el b’nei Yisra’el v’amarta alehem, v’asu lahem tzitzit al kanfei vig’deihem l’dorotam, v’natnu al tzitzit hakanaf p’til t’chelet.

blocks.he: וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺ֣ת יְיָ֔ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תָת֜וּרוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
blocks.tr: V’haya lachem l’tzitzit, ur’item oto uz’chartem et kol mitzvot Adonai, va’asitem otam, v’lo taturu acharei l’vavchem v’acharei eineichem asher atem zonim achareihem.

blocks.he: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵאלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃ אֲנִ֞י יְיָ֣ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְיָ֥ אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
blocks.tr: L’ma’an tizk’ru va’asitem et kol mitzvotai, vih’yitem k’doshim leloheichem. Ani Adonai Eloheichem, asher hotzeti etchem me’eretz Mitzrayim lihyot lachem lelohim, ani Adonai Eloheichem.

blocks.en: And you shall love HaShem your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might. Let these words that I command you today rest upon your heart. Teach them again and again to your children; speak them when you sit in your home and when you walk on the way, when you lie down and when you rise.
Bind them as a sign upon your hand, let them be a symbol before your eyes, and write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.

If you truly listen — and keep on listening — to the mitzvot I give you this day, loving HaShem your God and serving with all your heart and all your soul, then the rains will fall on your land in their season, the early rain and the late; you will gather your grain and your wine and your oil, and there will be grass in your fields for your animals — you will eat, and be satisfied.

But take care, for a heart is easily led astray: when you turn away, serving other gods and bowing down to them, the bond frays — the skies seem to close, the rain holds back, the ground withholds its yield, and you are soon adrift, lost from the good land. So set these words upon your heart and soul; bind them as a sign on your hand and let them rest between your eyes; teach them to your children, speaking them at home and on the way, when you lie down and when you rise; and write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates — that your days, and your children’s days, may be many on the land, as many as the days of the heavens over the earth.

HaShem said to Moses: tell the people of Yisrael to make themselves fringes on the corners of their garments, in every generation, and to set on each corner a thread of blue. Look at it and remember all the mitzvot of HaShem, and do them — and do not go chasing after the cravings of your own heart and eyes.
So that you will remember and do all My mitzvot, and be holy to your God. I am HaShem your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am HaShem your God.

aliases: The Sh’ma’s last word, carried over and answered: what we just said is true — and the blessing of g’ulah begins.

blocks.he: אֱמֶת — וְיַצִּיב וְנָכוֹן וְקַיָּם וְיָשָׁר וְנֶאֱמָן וְאָהוּב וְחָבִיב וְנֶחְמָד וְנָעִים וְנוֹרָא וְאַדִּיר וּמְתֻקָּן וּמְקֻבָּל וְטוֹב וְיָפֶה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָלֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Emet — v’yatziv v’nachon v’kayam v’yashar v’ne’eman v’ahuv v’chaviv v’nechmad v’na’im v’nora v’adir umtukan umkubal v’tov v’yafeh hadavar hazeh aleinu l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: אֱמֶת, אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם מַלְכֵּנוּ, צוּר יַעֲקֹב מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ. לְדֹר וָדֹר הוּא קַיָּם וּשְׁמוֹ קַיָּם, וְכִסְאוֹ נָכוֹן, וּמַלְכוּתוֹ וֶאֱמוּנָתוֹ לָעַד קַיָּמֶת.
blocks.tr: Emet, Elohei olam malkeinu, tzur Ya’akov magen yish’einu. L’dor vador hu kayam ushmo kayam, v’chis’o nachon, umalchuto ve’emunato la’ad kayemet.

blocks.he: וּדְבָרָיו חָיִים וְקַיָּמִים. נֶאֱמָנִים וְנֶחֱמָדִים לָעַד וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עוֹלָמִים. עַל אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְעָלֵינוּ. עַל בָּנֵינוּ וְעַל דּוֹרוֹתֵינוּ. וְעַל כָּל דּוֹרוֹת זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶיךָ: עַל הָרִאשׁוֹנִים וְעַל הָאַחֲרוֹנִים. דָּבָר טוֹב וְקַיָּם לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. אֱמֶת וֶאֱמוּנָה. חֹק וְלֹא יַעֲבֹר.
blocks.tr: Ud’varav chayim v’kayamim, ne’emanim v’nechemadim la’ad ul’olmei olamim. Al avoteinu v’aleinu, al baneinu v’al doroteinu, v’al kol dorot zera Yisra’el avadecha. Al harishonim v’al ha’acharonim, davar tov v’kayam l’olam va’ed. Emet ve’emuna, chok v’lo ya’avor.

blocks.he: אֱמֶת שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, מַלְכֵּנוּ מֶלֶךְ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, גּוֹאֲלֵנוּ גּוֹאֵל אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, יוֹצְרֵנוּ צוּר יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ, פּוֹדֵנוּ וּמַצִּילֵנוּ מֵעוֹלָם שְׁמֶךָ, אֵין אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Emet sha’ata hu Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu, malkeinu melech avoteinu, go’aleinu go’el avoteinu, yotz’reinu tzur y’shu’ateinu, podeinu umatzileinu me’olam sh’mecha, ein Elohim zulatecha.

blocks.en: True — and firm, and settled, and enduring; upright, faithful, beloved and dear, delightful and sweet, awesome and mighty, well-ordered and welcome, good and beautiful is this word for us, forever.

True: the God of all time, the rock of Jacob, the shield that saves us. From generation to generation the Eternal endures, and that Name endures; unchanging, that oneness and that faithfulness stand fast, forever.

And the words of the Eternal are living and enduring, faithful and cherished, forever and to all eternity — for our ancestors and for us, for our children and for our generations, and for every generation of the seed of Yisrael, Your servants; for the first and for the last, a word good and enduring, forever: true and faithful, a law that will not pass away.

True: You are our God and the God of our ancestors, our redeemer and theirs, our Maker, the rock of our rescue; the One who frees us and delivers us — from of old, that is Your name. There is no God but You.

sources.name: Mi Chamocha
aliases: The song at the shore, sung again this morning — the moment slavery broke open and a people first sang free.

Emet, ata hu adon l’amecha umelech gibor lariv rivam. Emet, ata hu
מִמִּצְרַיִם גְּאַלְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וּמִבֵּית עֲבָדִים פְּדִיתָנוּ. כָּל בְּכוֹרֵיהֶם הָרָגְתָּ, וּבְכוֹרְךָ גָּאָלְתָּ,
Mimitzrayim g’altanu Adonai Eloheinu, umibeit avadim p’ditanu. Kol b’choreihem haragta, uvchor’cha ga’alta,

blocks.he: עֶזְרַת אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אַתָּה הוּא מֵעוֹלָם, מָגֵן וּמוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵיהֶם אַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר. בְּרוּם עוֹלָם מוֹשָׁבֶךָ, וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ עַד אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Ezrat avoteinu ata hu me’olam, magen umoshia livneihem achareihem b’chol dor vador. B’rum olam moshavecha, umishpatecha v’tzidkat’cha ad afsei aretz.

blocks.he: אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ שֶׁיִּשְׁמַע לְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתוֹרָתְךָ וּדְבָרְךָ יָשִׂים עַל לִבּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Ashrei ish sheyishma l’mitzvotecha, v’torat’cha ud’var’cha yasim al libo.

blocks.he: אֱמֶת, אַתָּה הוּא אָדוֹן לְעַמֶּךָ וּמֶלֶךְ גִּבּוֹר לָרִיב רִיבָם. אֱמֶת, אַתָּה הוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְאַתָּה הוּא אַחֲרוֹן, וּמִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ גּוֹאֵל וּמוֹשִׁיעַ.
blocks.tr: Emet, ata hu adon l’amecha umelech gibor lariv rivam. Emet, ata hu rishon v’ata hu acharon, umibal’adecha ein lanu melech go’el umoshia.

blocks.he: מִמִּצְרַיִם גְּאַלְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וּמִבֵּית עֲבָדִים פְּדִיתָנוּ. כָּל בְּכוֹרֵיהֶם הָרָגְתָּ, וּבְכוֹרְךָ גָּאָלְתָּ, וְיַם סוּף בָּקַעְתָּ, וְזֵדִים טִבַּעְתָּ, וִידִידִים הֶעֱבַרְתָּ, וַיְכַסּוּ מַיִם צָרֵיהֶם, אֶחָד מֵהֶם לֹא נוֹתָר.
blocks.tr: Mimitzrayim g’altanu Adonai Eloheinu, umibeit avadim p’ditanu. Kol b’choreihem haragta, uvchor’cha ga’alta, v’yam suf bakata, v’zeidim tibata, vididim he’evarta, vaychasu mayim tzareihem, echad mehem lo notar.

blocks.he: עַל זֹאת שִׁבְּחוּ אֲהוּבִים וְרוֹמְמוּ אֵל, וְנָתְנוּ יְדִידִים זְמִירוֹת שִׁירוֹת וְתִשְׁבָּחוֹת, בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְמֶלֶךְ אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם. רָם וְנִשָּׂא, גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא, מַשְׁפִּיל גֵּאִים וּמַגְבִּיהַּ שְׁפָלִים, מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים וּפוֹדֶה עֲנָוִים, וְעוֹזֵר דַּלִּים וְעוֹנֶה לְעַמּוֹ בְּעֵת שַׁוְּעָם אֵלָיו.
blocks.tr: Al zot shib’chu ahuvim v’rom’mu El, v’nat’nu y’didim z’mirot shirot v’tishbachot, b’rachot v’hoda’ot l’melech El chai v’kayam. Ram v’nisa, gadol v’nora, mashpil ge’im umagbiah sh’falim, motzi asirim ufodeh anavim, v’ozer dalim v’oneh l’amo b’et shav’am elav.

blocks.he: תְּהִלּוֹת לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן, בָּרוּךְ הוּא וּמְבֹרָךְ. מֹשֶׁה וּמִרְיָם וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ עָנוּ שִׁירָה בְּשִׂמְחָה רַבָּה, וְאָמְרוּ כֻלָּם:
blocks.tr: T’hilot l’El elyon, baruch hu umvorach. Moshe uMiryam uvnei Yisra’el l’cha anu shira b’simcha raba, v’amru chulam:

blocks.he: מִֽי־כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְיָ֔ מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃
blocks.tr: Mi chamocha ba’elim Adonai, mi kamocha nedar bakodesh, nora t’hilot oseh fele.

blocks.he: שִׁירָה חֲדָשָׁה שִׁבְּחוּ גְאוּלִים לְשִׁמְךָ עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם, יַחַד כֻּלָּם הוֹדוּ וְהִמְלִיכוּ וְאָמְרוּ:
blocks.tr: Shira chadasha shib’chu g’ulim l’shimcha al s’fat hayam, yachad kulam hodu v’himlichu v’amru:

blocks.he: צוּר יִשְׂרָאֵל, קוּמָה בְּעֶזְרַת יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּפְדֵה כִנְאֻמֶךָ יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל. גֹּאֲלֵנוּ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ, קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: Tzur Yisra’el, kuma b’ezrat Yisra’el, ufdeh chin’umecha Y’huda v’Yisra’el. Go’aleinu Adonai tz’va’ot sh’mo, k’dosh Yisra’el.

blocks.en: You were the help of our ancestors from of old — shield and rescue for their children after them, in every generation. Your dwelling is the height of the world, and Your justice and Your fairness reach the ends of the earth.
Happy is the one who listens to Your mitzvot, and takes Your Torah and Your word to heart.
True: You are the guide of Your people, mighty to take up their cause. True: You are the first and You are the last; besides You we have no one who redeems and saves.

From Egypt You redeemed us, HaShem our God, and from the house of bondage You set us free. You brought us through the Sea of Reeds, carrying the beloved across while the waters closed over those who pursued them — and we came out singing.

For this the beloved praised and exalted God, offering songs and praises and thanksgiving to the living and enduring One — high and lifted up, great and awesome, who brings down the proud and lifts up the lowly, frees the captive and redeems the humble, helps the poor and answers the people in the hour of their cry.
Praises to the Most High, blessed and praised. Moses and Miriam and the children of Yisrael sang to You, in great joy, and all of them said:
Who is like You among the mighty, O Source of freedom? Who is like You — glorious in holiness, awesome in praises, working wonders!
A new song the redeemed sang to Your name at the edge of the sea; together they gave thanks, called You One, and said: The Eternal will reign forever and ever.

Rock of Yisrael — rise up to Yisrael’s help; make good on Your promise, and set Judah and Yisrael free. Our redeemer — Source of all being is that name — the Holy One of Yisrael. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who redeemed Yisrael.

sources.name: We Open Our Lips
aliases: Before we ask for anything, we ask only to be able to pray — one borrowed verse as the doorway in.
openingWords: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
Adonai, s’fatai tiftach, ufi yagid t’hilatecha.

blocks.he: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Adonai, s’fatai tiftach, ufi yagid t’hilatecha.

sources.name: Avot v’Imahot
aliases: We stand in a court we inherited — connected to the past, and obligated to the present because of it.
openingWords: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ,
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu,
אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב;
Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, ve’lohei Ya’akov;
אֱלֹהֵי שָׂרָה, אֱלֹהֵי רִבְקָה, אֱלֹהֵי לֵאָה, אֱלֹהֵי רָחֵל, אֱלֹהֵי בִּלְהָה, וֵאלֹהֵי זִלְפָּה.
Elohei Sara, Elohei Rivka, Elohei Le’a, Elohei Rachel, Elohei Bilha, ve’lohei Zilpa.
הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל, וְזוֹכֵר
Ha’El hagadol hagibor v’hanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, v’koneh hakol, v’zocher

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ,
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu,

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב;
blocks.tr: Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, ve’lohei Ya’akov;

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵי שָׂרָה, אֱלֹהֵי רִבְקָה, אֱלֹהֵי לֵאָה, אֱלֹהֵי רָחֵל, אֱלֹהֵי בִּלְהָה, וֵאלֹהֵי זִלְפָּה.
blocks.tr: Elohei Sara, Elohei Rivka, Elohei Le’a, Elohei Rachel, Elohei Bilha, ve’lohei Zilpa.

blocks.he: הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל, וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת, וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה.
blocks.tr: Ha’El hagadol hagibor v’hanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, v’koneh hakol, v’zocher chasdei avot v’imahot, umevi go’el livnei v’neihem l’ma’an sh’mo b’ahava.

blocks.he: מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם וְעֶזְרַת שָׂרָה.
blocks.tr: Melech ozer umoshi’a umagen. Baruch ata Adonai, magen Avraham v’ezrat Sara.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, God of our ancestors — God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; God of Sarah, God of Rebecca, God of Leah, God of Rachel, God of Bilhah, and God of Zilpah.

Great, mighty, and awesome God, God most high, who acts with love, who creates all, who remembers the faithfulness of our ancestors, and who lovingly brings redemption to their children’s children for the sake of Your name.
You are our help, our rescue, our shield. Blessed are You, Eternal One, shield of Abraham and help of Sarah.

sources.name: G’vurot
aliases: We are obligated to a future beyond our own lifetime — the same power that revives holds every debt we owe forward.
openingWords: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ.
Ata gibor l’olam Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/meitim ata, rav l’hoshi’a.
מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים, סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר
M’chalkel chayim b’chesed, m’chayeh hakol/meitim b’rachamim rabim, somech nof’lim, v’rofe cholim, umatir

blocks.he: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ.
blocks.tr: Ata gibor l’olam Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/meitim ata, rav l’hoshi’a.

blocks.en: You cause the wind to blow and the rain to fall.
You cause the dew to fall.

blocks.he: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים, סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים, וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת, וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה.
blocks.tr: M’chalkel chayim b’chesed, m’chayeh hakol/meitim b’rachamim rabim, somech nof’lim, v’rofe cholim, umatir asurim, umkayem emunato lishenei afar. Mi chamocha ba’al g’vurot, umi domeh lach, melech memit umchayeh umatzmi’ach y’shu’a.

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת הַכֹּל/מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/הַמֵּתִים.
blocks.tr: V’ne’eman ata l’hachayot hakol/meitim. Baruch ata Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/hameitim.

blocks.en: You are forever mighty; You give life to all / revive the dead, and Your saving power is great. You sustain the living with love, giving life to all / reviving the dead with great compassion; You hold up the falling, heal the sick, free the captive, and keep faith with those who sleep in the dust.

Who is like You, Source of all power? Who can compare — You who bring death and life, and make rescue blossom? You are faithful to give life to all / to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who gives life to all / who revives the dead.

sources.name: Kedushah
aliases: When the Amidah is sung aloud, the room becomes one voice — reaching for the song the prophets heard the angels sing.
openingWords: נְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בָּעוֹלָם כְּשֵׁם שֶׁמַּקְדִּישִׁים אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁמֵי מָרוֹם. כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד
Nekadesh et shimcha ba’olam, k’shem shemakdishim oto bishmei marom, kakatuv al yad
קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ.
Kadosh, kadosh, kadosh Adonai tz’va’ot, m’lo chol ha’aretz k’vodo.
אָז בְּקוֹל רַֽעַשׁ גָּדוֹל אַדִּיר וְחָזָק מַשְׁמִיעִים קוֹל מִתְנַשְּׂאִים לְעֻמַּת שְׂרָפִים. לְעֻמָּתָם
Az b’kol ra’ash gadol adir v’chazak mashmi’im kol, mitnas’im l’umat s’rafim, l’umatam

blocks.he: נְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בָּעוֹלָם כְּשֵׁם שֶׁמַּקְדִּישִׁים אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁמֵי מָרוֹם. כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ. וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל זֶה וְאָמַר:
blocks.tr: Nekadesh et shimcha ba’olam, k’shem shemakdishim oto bishmei marom, kakatuv al yad n’vi’echa: v’kara zeh el zeh v’amar:

blocks.he: קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ.
blocks.tr: Kadosh, kadosh, kadosh Adonai tz’va’ot, m’lo chol ha’aretz k’vodo.

blocks.he: אָז בְּקוֹל רַֽעַשׁ גָּדוֹל אַדִּיר וְחָזָק מַשְׁמִיעִים קוֹל מִתְנַשְּׂאִים לְעֻמַּת שְׂרָפִים. לְעֻמָּתָם בָּרוּךְ יֹאמֵֽרוּ:
blocks.tr: Az b’kol ra’ash gadol adir v’chazak mashmi’im kol, mitnas’im l’umat s’rafim, l’umatam baruch yomeru:

blocks.he: מִמְּקוֹמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תוֹפִֽיעַ וְתִמְלוֹךְ עָלֵֽינוּ כִּי מְחַכִּים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ מָתַי תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּצִיּוֹן בְּקָרוֹב בְּיָמֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד תִּשְׁכּוֹן. תִּתְגַּדַּל וְתִתְקַדַּשׁ בְּתוֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִירְךָ לְדוֹר וָדוֹר וּלְנֵֽצַח נְצָחִים. וְעֵינֵֽינוּ תִרְאֶֽינָה מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ כַּדָּבָר הָאָמוּר בְּשִׁירֵי עֻזֶּֽךָ עַל יְדֵי דָוִד מְשִֽׁיחַ צִדְקֶֽךָ:
blocks.tr: Mim’komcha malkeinu tofi’a v’timloch aleinu, ki m’chakim anachnu lach. Matai timloch b’Tziyon? B’karov b’yameinu, l’olam va’ed tishkon. Titgadal v’titkadash b’toch Yerushalayim ircha l’dor vador ulnetzach n’tzachim. V’eineinu tir’ena malchutecha, kadavar ha’amur b’shirei uzecha al y’dei David m’shiach tzidkecha:

blocks.he: יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ.
blocks.tr: Yimloch Adonai l’olam, Elohayich Tziyon l’dor vador, hal’luyah.

blocks.he: לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נַגִּיד גָּדְלֶֽךָ וּלְנֵֽצַח נְצָחִים קְדֻשָּׁתְךָ נַקְדִּישׁ וְשִׁבְחֲךָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מִפִּֽינוּ לֹא יָמוּשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ אָֽתָּה.
blocks.tr: L’dor vador nagid godlecha, ulnetzach n’tzachim k’dushatcha nakdish, v’shivchacha Eloheinu mipinu lo yamush l’olam va’ed, ki El melech gadol v’kadosh ata.

blocks.en: We make Your name holy in the world as they make it holy in the heights of heaven, as Your prophet wrote: and they called out, one to another, and said:
Holy, holy, holy is the Source of all being; the fullness of the whole earth is that glory.
Then, with the sound of a great roar, mighty and strong, they raise their voices, lifting toward the seraphim, and facing them say: Blessed —
Blessed is the glory of the Eternal, from its place.

From Your place, shine out and hold over us — for we are waiting for You. When will it take hold in Zion? Soon, in our own days — dwell there forever. Be magnified and made holy within Jerusalem Your city, from generation to generation, for all time. May our own eyes see that oneness, as the word is sung in the songs of Your strength, by the hand of David, Your anointed of justice:
The Eternal will reign forever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.
From generation to generation we will tell Your greatness, and for all time make holy Your holiness; Your praise, our God, will never leave our mouths, for You are God, great and holy.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, the holy God.

blocks.he: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ, וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל יוֹם יְהַלְלוּךָ, סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ.
blocks.tr: Ata kadosh v’shimcha kadosh, ukdoshim b’chol yom y’hal’lucha, selah. Baruch ata Adonai, ha’El hakadosh.

blocks.en: You are holy, and Your name is holy, and those who seek holiness praise You every day. Blessed are You, Eternal One, the holy God.

sources.name: K’dushat HaYom
aliases: The Shabbat blessing: rest not as something earned, but as something everyone is owed.
openingWords: יִשְׂמַח מֹשֶׁה בְּמַתְּנַת חֶלְקוֹ. כִּי עֶבֶד נֶאֱמָן קָרָאתָ לּוֹ. כְּלִיל תִּפְאֶרֶת בְּרֹאשׁוֹ
Yismach Moshe b’matnat chelko, ki eved ne’eman karata lo. K’lil tif’eret b’rosho
Moses rejoiced in the gift of his portion, for You called him
וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
V’shamru v’nei Yisra’el et haShabbat, la’asot et haShabbat l’dorotam b’rit olam.
בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי־שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְיָ֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם
Beini uvein b’nei Yisra’el ot hi l’olam, ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai
The people of Israel shall keep Shabbat, observing Shabbat in every generation

blocks.he: יִשְׂמַח מֹשֶׁה בְּמַתְּנַת חֶלְקוֹ. כִּי עֶבֶד נֶאֱמָן קָרָאתָ לּוֹ. כְּלִיל תִּפְאֶרֶת בְּרֹאשׁוֹ נָתַתָּ. בְּעָמְדוֹ לְפָנֶיךָ עַל הַר סִינַי. וּשְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת אֲבָנִים הוֹרִיד בְּיָדוֹ. וְכָתוּב בָּהֶם שְׁמִירַת שַׁבָּת. וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ:
blocks.tr: Yismach Moshe b’matnat chelko, ki eved ne’eman karata lo. K’lil tif’eret b’rosho natata, b’omdo l’fanecha al har Sinai. Ushnei luchot avanim horid b’yado, v’chatuv bahem sh’mirat Shabbat. V’chen katuv b’toratecha:

blocks.en: Moses rejoiced in the gift of his portion, for You called him a faithful servant. You set a crown of glory on his head as he stood before You on Mount Sinai; and he brought down two tablets of stone in his hand, and written on them was the keeping of Shabbat. And so it is written in Your Torah:

blocks.he: וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
blocks.tr: V’shamru v’nei Yisra’el et haShabbat, la’asot et haShabbat l’dorotam b’rit olam.

blocks.he: בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי־שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְיָ֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שָׁבַ֖ת וַיִּנָּפַֽשׁ׃
blocks.tr: Beini uvein b’nei Yisra’el ot hi l’olam, ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashamayim v’et ha’aretz, uvayom hash’vi’i shavat vayinafash.

blocks.en: The people of Israel shall keep Shabbat, observing Shabbat in every generation as a covenant for all time.
It is a sign forever between Me and the people of Israel, for in six days the Eternal made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day rested and drew breath.

blocks.he: וְלֹא נְתַתּוֹ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת. וְלֹא הִנְחַלְתּוֹ מַלְכֵּנוּ לְעוֹבְדֵי פְסִילִים. וְגַם בִּמְנוּחָתוֹ לֹא יִשְׁכְּנוּ עֲרֵלִים. כִּי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ נְתַתּוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה. לְזֶרַע יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר בָּם בָּחָרְתָּ:
blocks.tr: V’lo n’tato Adonai Eloheinu l’goyei ha’aratzot, v’lo hinchalto malkeinu l’ov’dei f’silim, v’gam bimnuchato lo yishk’nu arelim, ki l’Yisra’el am’cha n’tato b’ahava, l’zera Ya’akov asher bam bachareta.

blocks.he: עַם מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁבִיעִי. כֻּלָּם יִשְׂבְּעוּ וְיִתְעַנְּגוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ. וּבַשְּׁבִיעִי רָצִיתָ בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ. חֶמְדַּת יָמִים אוֹתוֹ קָרָאתָ. זֵכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית:
blocks.tr: Am m’kad’shei sh’vi’i, kulam yisb’u v’yit’an’gu mituvecha, uvashvi’i ratzita bo v’kidashto, chemdat yamim oto karata, zecher l’ma’aseh v’reshit.

blocks.en: You did not give it to the nations of the lands, nor make it the inheritance of those who serve carved images; and in its rest the uncircumcised shall not dwell — for to Israel Your people You gave it, in love, to the seed of Jacob whom You chose.

A people who make the seventh day holy — all of them fill themselves and delight in Your goodness; for in the seventh day You took pleasure and made it holy, calling it the treasure of days, a remembrance of the work of creation.

blocks.he: יִשְׂמְחוּ בְמַלְכוּתְךָ שׁוֹמְרֵי שַׁבָּת וְקוֹרְאֵי עֹנֶג. עַם מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁבִיעִי. כֻּלָּם יִשְׂבְּעוּ וְיִתְעַנְּגוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ. וּבַשְּׁבִיעִי רָצִיתָ בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ חֶמְדַּת יָמִים אוֹתוֹ קָרָאתָ. זֵכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית:
blocks.tr: Yism’chu v’malchutcha shom’rei Shabbat v’kor’ei oneg, am m’kad’shei sh’vi’i, kulam yisb’u v’yit’an’gu mituvecha, uvashvi’i ratzita bo v’kidashto, chemdat yamim oto karata, zecher l’ma’aseh v’reshit.

blocks.en: Those who keep Shabbat and call it a delight will rejoice in a world made whole — a people who make the seventh day holy, all of them filling themselves, delighting in Your goodness; for in the seventh day You took pleasure and made it holy, calling it the treasure of days, a remembrance of the work of creation.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ, קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ, וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת. וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְיָנוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת.
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, r’tzeh vimnuchatenu, kad’shenu b’mitzvotecha, v’ten chelkenu b’toratecha, sab’enu mituvecha, v’samchenu bishu’atecha, v’taher libenu l’ovd’cha be’emet. V’hanchilenu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava uvratzon Shabbat kodshecha, v’yanuchu vah Yisra’el m’kad’shei sh’mecha. Baruch ata Adonai, m’kadesh haShabbat.

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors — take pleasure in our rest. Make us holy through Your mitzvot and give us our portion in Your Torah; fill us with Your goodness, gladden us with Your saving help, and make our hearts pure to serve You in truth. In love and favor, grant us Your holy Shabbat as our inheritance, and let Israel, who make Your name holy, find rest in her — and let rest be the portion of everyone alive. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who makes Shabbat holy.

blocks.he: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן.
blocks.tr: V’techezena eineinu b’shuvcha l’Tziyon b’rachamim. Baruch ata Adonai, hamachazir sh’chinato l’Tziyon.

blocks.en: Take pleasure, Eternal our God, in Your people Israel and in their prayer; in love receive that prayer with favor, and may the service of Your people Israel always be, in truth, for the good.
May our eyes behold Your loving return to Zion. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who returns Your presence to Zion.

sources.name: Modim
aliases: The blessing that stops to count the ordinary — breath, morning, the body’s small mercies — the miracles we forget are miracles.

blocks.he: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. צוּר חַיֵּינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר. נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם.
blocks.tr: Modim anachnu lach, sha’ata hu Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu l’olam va’ed. Tzur chayeinu, magen yish’einu ata hu l’dor vador. Nodeh l’cha unsaper t’hilatecha, al chayeinu ham’surim b’yadecha, v’al nishmoteinu hap’kudot lach, v’al nisecha sheb’chol yom imanu, v’al nifl’otecha v’tovotecha sheb’chol et, erev vavoker v’tzohorayim.

blocks.he: הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ, מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ.
blocks.tr: Hatov ki lo chalu rachamecha, v’hamrachem ki lo tamu chasadecha, me’olam kivinu lach.

blocks.he: וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת.
blocks.tr: V’al kulam yitbarech v’yitromam shimcha tamid l’olam va’ed. V’chol hachayim yoducha selah, vihal’lu et shimcha be’emet, ha’El y’shu’atenu v’ezratenu selah. Baruch ata Adonai, hatov shimcha ulcha na’eh l’hodot.

blocks.en: We thank You, for You are the One, our God and the God of our ancestors, forever. Rock of our life, shield of our rescue — so You are, in every generation. We give thanks and tell Your praise: for our lives, held in Your hand; for our souls, entrusted to You; for Your miracles that are with us every day; and for Your wonders and Your gifts at every moment — evening, morning, and noon.
You are the Good, whose mercies never end; the Compassionate, whose kindnesses never fail — always we have placed our hope in You.

For all these things may Your name be blessed and raised up, always and forever. Let all that lives give thanks to You, and praise Your name in truth, God of our rescue and our help. Blessed are You, Eternal One, whose name is Goodness, and to whom thanks are due.
When said aloud.

blocks.he: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי כָל בָּשָׂר, יוֹצְרֵנוּ יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית. בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ, עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּנוּ. כֵּן תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּתְקַיְּמֵנוּ, וְתֶאֱסוֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶׁךָ, לִשְׁמוֹר חֻקֶּיךָ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ וּלְעָבְדְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם, עַל שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ. בָּרוּךְ אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת.
blocks.tr: Modim anachnu lach, sha’ata hu Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu, Elohei chol basar, yotzreinu yotzer b’reishit. B’rachot v’hoda’ot l’shimcha hagadol v’hakadosh, al shehecheyitanu v’kiyamtanu. Ken t’chayeinu utkaymeinu, v’te’esof galuyoteinu l’chatzrot kodshecha, lishmor chukecha v’la’asot r’tzonecha, ul’ovd’cha b’levav shalem, al she’anachnu modim lach. Baruch El hahoda’ot.

blocks.en: We give thanks to You, for You are the One, our God and the God of our ancestors, the God of all flesh, our Maker, Maker of all creation. Blessings and thanks to Your great and holy name, for giving us life and sustaining us. So give us life and sustain us, and gather our scattered ones to Your holy courts, to keep Your laws and do Your will and serve You with a whole heart — for this we thank You. Blessed is the God of thanksgivings.

sources.name: Birkat Kohanim
aliases: The oldest blessing we have — Aaron’s words, lifted over the whole room.
openingWords: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה
Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, bar’cheinu bab’racha ham’shuleshet baTorah, hak’tuva al y’dei Moshe
יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

blocks.en: When said aloud.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ, הָאֲמוּרָה מִפִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו כֹּהֲנִים עַם קְדוֹשֶׁךָ, כָּאָמוּר:
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, bar’cheinu bab’racha ham’shuleshet baTorah, hak’tuva al y’dei Moshe avdecha, ha’amura mipi Aharon uvanav kohanim am k’doshecha, ka’amur:

blocks.he: יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
blocks.tr: Yisa Adonai panav eilecha v’yasem l’cha shalom.

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors — bless us with the threefold blessing of the Torah, written by the hand of Moses Your servant, spoken by Aaron and his sons, the priests, Your holy people, as it is said:
May the Eternal bless you and keep you. May the Eternal’s face shine upon you and be gracious to you. May the Eternal’s face turn toward you and grant you peace.

sources.name: Sim Shalom
aliases: The Amidah ends where it has been reaching all along — peace, the whole word for wholeness.
openingWords: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ.
Sim shalom tovah uvracha, chein vachesed v’rachamim, aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el amecha.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם.
Baruch ata Adonai, hamvarech et amo Yisra’el bashalom.
Grant peace, goodness, and blessing — grace, kindness, and mercy — to
Blessed are You, Eternal One, who blesses Your people Israel with peace.

blocks.he: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ, כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד, וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת כָּל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל עֵת וּבְכָל שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Sim shalom tovah uvracha, chein vachesed v’rachamim, aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el amecha. Bar’cheinu avinu kulanu k’echad b’or panecha, ki v’or panecha natata lanu Adonai Eloheinu torat chayim v’ahavat chesed, utz’daka uvracha v’rachamim v’chayim v’shalom. V’tov b’einecha l’varech et kol am’cha Yisra’el b’chol et uvchol sha’a bishlomecha.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, hamvarech et amo Yisra’el bashalom.

blocks.en: Grant peace, goodness, and blessing — grace, kindness, and mercy — to us and to all Your people Israel. Bless us, our Source, all of us as one, in the light of Your face; for in the light of Your face You have given us, Eternal our God, a Torah of life and the love of kindness, and justice and blessing and mercy and life and peace. And may it be good in Your eyes to bless Your people Israel, in every season and at every hour, with Your peace.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, who blesses Your people Israel with peace.

sources.name: Elohai N’tzor
aliases: It begins by asking to guard the tongue, then opens a silence — room to pour in whatever we could not say aloud.
openingWords: אֱלֹהַי, נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע, וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר
Elohai, n’tzor l’shoni mera, usfatai midaber mirma, v’limkal’lai nafshi tidom, v’nafshi ke’afar
וְכֹל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ,
V’chol hachosh’vim alai ra’a, m’hera hafer atzatam v’kalkel machashavtam. Aseh l’ma’an sh’mecha,
יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי.
Yihyu l’ratzon imrei fi v’hegyon libi l’fanecha, Adonai tzuri v’go’ali.
