Oseh shalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol

blocks.he: אֱלֹהַי, נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע, וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה. פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדֹּף נַפְשִׁי.
blocks.tr: Elohai, n’tzor l’shoni mera, usfatai midaber mirma, v’limkal’lai nafshi tidom, v’nafshi ke’afar lakol tihyeh. P’tach libi b’toratecha, uvmitzvotecha tirdof nafshi.

blocks.he: וְכֹל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ, הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי.
blocks.tr: V’chol hachosh’vim alai ra’a, m’hera hafer atzatam v’kalkel machashavtam. Aseh l’ma’an sh’mecha, aseh l’ma’an y’minecha, aseh l’ma’an k’dushatecha, aseh l’ma’an toratecha. L’ma’an yechal’tzun y’didecha, hoshi’a y’min’cha va’aneni.

blocks.he: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי.
blocks.tr: Yihyu l’ratzon imrei fi v’hegyon libi l’fanecha, Adonai tzuri v’go’ali.

blocks.he: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh shalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit. To those who curse me, let my soul stay silent; let my soul be humble as the dust before all. Open my heart to Your Torah, that my soul may pursue Your mitzvot.

And all who plan evil against me — quickly undo their designs and unravel their schemes. Act for the sake of Your name; act for the sake of Your right hand; act for the sake of Your holiness; act for the sake of Your Torah. That those You love may be freed, let Your right hand save — answer me.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Eternal One, my Rock and my Redeemer.
May the One who makes peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Israel, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.
On festival mornings and Chanukah, the Hallel is sung here — p. .

sources.name: Ein Kamocha
aliases: We celebrate the pageantry and majesty of text.
openingWords: אֵין כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי, וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ.
Ein kamocha va’elohim Adonai, v’ein k’ma’asecha.
מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל עוֹלָמִים, וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר.
Malchut’cha malchut kol olamim, umemshalt’cha b’chol dor vador.
יְיָ מֶלֶךְ, יְיָ מָלָךְ, יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
Adonai melech, Adonai malach, Adonai yimloch l’olam va’ed.
יְיָ עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן, יְיָ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם.
Adonai oz l’amo yiten, Adonai y’varech et amo vashalom.

blocks.he: אֵין כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי, וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ.
blocks.tr: Ein kamocha va’elohim Adonai, v’ein k’ma’asecha.

blocks.he: מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל עוֹלָמִים, וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר.
blocks.tr: Malchut’cha malchut kol olamim, umemshalt’cha b’chol dor vador.

blocks.he: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ, יְיָ מָלָךְ, יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Adonai melech, Adonai malach, Adonai yimloch l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: יְיָ עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן, יְיָ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם.
blocks.tr: Adonai oz l’amo yiten, Adonai y’varech et amo vashalom.

blocks.he: אַב הָרַחֲמִים, הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת צִיּוֹן, תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלָיִם. כִּי בְךָ לְבַד בָּטָחְנוּ, מֶלֶךְ אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא אֲדוֹן עוֹלָמִים.
blocks.tr: Av harachamim, heitiva virtzon’cha et Tziyon, tivneh chomot Y’rushalayim. Ki v’cha l’vad batachnu, melech El ram v’nisa adon olamim.

blocks.en: There is none like You among all powers, Eternal One — nothing like the things You make.
Your reign is a reign over all worlds; Your rule holds through every generation.
The Eternal rules; the Eternal has ruled; the Eternal will rule forever and ever. May the Holy One give strength to this people; may the Holy One bless this people with peace.
Source of compassion — in Your goodwill, be good to Zion; rebuild the walls of Jerusalem. For in You alone we have trusted — exalted, uplifted, God everlasting.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ.

For Torah goes forth from Zion, and the word of the Eternal from Jerusalem.
Blessed is the One who gave Torah to the people Yisrael, in holiness.

sources.name: Av HaRachamim
aliases: A memorial for communities martyred "for the sanctification of the Name."

blocks.he: אַב הָרַחֲמִים שׁוֹכֵן מְרוֹמִים, בְּרַחֲמָיו הָעֲצוּמִים הוּא יִפְקֹד בְּרַחֲמִים הַחֲסִידִים וְהַיְשָׁרִים וְהַתְּמִימִים, קְהִלּוֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ שֶׁמָּסְרוּ נַפְשָׁם עַל קְדֻשַּׁת הַשֵּׁם, הַנֶּאֱהָבִים וְהַנְּעִימִים בְּחַיֵּיהֶם וּבְמוֹתָם לֹא נִפְרָדוּ.
blocks.tr: Av harachamim shochen m’romim, b’rachamav ha’atzumim hu yifkod b’rachamim hachasidim v’hay’sharim v’hat’mimim, k’hilot hakodesh shemas’ru nafsham al k’dushat haShem, hane’ehavim v’han’imim b’chayeihem uvmotam lo nifradu.

blocks.he: מִנְּשָׁרִים קַלּוּ מֵאֲרָיוֹת גָּבֵרוּ, לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹן קוֹנָם וְחֵפֶץ צוּרָם. יִזְכְּרֵם אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה עִם שְׁאָר צַדִּיקֵי עוֹלָם, וְיִקּוֹם נִקְמַת דַּם עֲבָדָיו הַשָּׁפוּךְ.
blocks.tr: Min’sharim kalu me’arayot gaveru, la’asot r’tzon konam v’chefetz tzuram. Yizk’rem Eloheinu l’tova im sh’ar tzadikei olam, v’yikom nikmat dam avadav hashafuch.

blocks.he: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים: הַרְנִינוּ גוֹיִם עַמּוֹ, כִּי דַם עֲבָדָיו יִקּוֹם, וְנָקָם יָשִׁיב לְצָרָיו, וְכִפֶּר אַדְמָתוֹ עַמּוֹ. וְעַל יְדֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר: וְנִקֵּיתִי דָּמָם לֹא נִקֵּיתִי, וַיְיָ שֹׁכֵן בְּצִיּוֹן.
blocks.tr: Kakatuv b’torat Moshe ish ha’Elohim: harninu goyim amo, ki dam avadav yikom, v’nakam yashiv l’tzarav, v’chiper admato amo. V’al y’dei avadecha han’vi’im katuv lemor: v’nikeiti damam lo nikeiti, v’Adonai shochen b’Tziyon.

blocks.he: וּבְכִתְבֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ נֶאֱמַר: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם, יִוָּדַע בַּגּוֹיִם לְעֵינֵינוּ נִקְמַת דַּם עֲבָדֶיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ. וְאוֹמֵר: כִּי דֹרֵשׁ דָּמִים אוֹתָם זָכָר, לֹא שָׁכַח צַעֲקַת עֲנָוִים.
blocks.tr: Uvchitvei hakodesh ne’emar: lama yom’ru hagoyim ayeh Eloheihem, yivada bagoyim l’eineinu nikmat dam avadecha hashafuch. V’omer: ki doresh damim otam zachar, lo shachach tza’akat anavim.

blocks.he: וְאוֹמֵר: יָדִין בַּגּוֹיִם מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת, מָחַץ רֹאשׁ עַל אֶרֶץ רַבָּה. מִנַּחַל בַּדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּה, עַל כֵּן יָרִים רֹאשׁ.
blocks.tr: V’omer: yadin bagoyim malei g’viyot, machatz rosh al eretz raba. Minachal baderech yishteh, al ken yarim rosh.

blocks.en: Source of compassion who dwells on high — in Your vast mercy, remember with mercy the faithful, the upright, and the whole-hearted: the holy communities who gave their lives for the sanctification of the Name — beloved and cherished in their lives, and in their death not parted.

Swifter than eagles, stronger than lions, they did the will of the One who made them. Remember them, our God, for good, together with all the world’s righteous — and avenge the spilled blood of Your servants.

As it is written in the Torah of Moses, man of God: “Sing out, O nations, for this people — for the blood of God’s servants will be avenged, and vengeance returned upon their foes, and God will wipe clean the land of this people.” And by the hand of Your servant-prophets it is written: “I will hold their blood guiltless — I have not held it guiltless — and the Eternal dwells in Zion.”

And in the holy writings it is said: “Why should the nations say, Where is their God? — let there be known among the nations, before our eyes, the vengeance for the spilled blood of Your servants.” And it says: “For the One who requires blood remembers them, and has not forgotten the cry of the lowly.”
And it says: “God will judge among the nations, heaping high the dead, crushing the head over a vast land — drinking from the brook along the way, and so lifting up the head.”

sources.name: Sh’ma
aliases: The Sh’ma to a raised scroll — call and response — as we repeat these ancient words.
openingWords: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, יְיָ אֶחָד.
Sh’ma Yisra’el, Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai echad.
אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ, גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵינוּ, קָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹ.
Echad Eloheinu, gadol adoneinu, kadosh sh’mo.
גַּדְּלוּ לַיְיָ אִתִּי, וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו.
Gad’lu la’Adonai iti, unrom’ma sh’mo yachdav.
Listen, Yisrael: the Eternal is our God, the Eternal is One.
One is our God; great beyond measure; holy is that Name.

blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, ha’El hane’eman b’chol d’varav.

blocks.he: רַחֵם עַל צִיּוֹן כִּי הִיא בֵּית חַיֵּינוּ, וְלַעֲלוּבַת נֶפֶשׁ תּוֹשִׁיעַ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ.

blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, m’sameach Tziyon b’vaneha.

blocks.he: שַׂמְּחֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא עַבְדֶּךָ, וּבְמַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד מְשִׁיחֶךָ, בִּמְהֵרָה יָבוֹא וְיָגֵל לִבֵּנוּ. עַל כִּסְאוֹ לֹא יֵשֵׁב זָר, וְלֹא יִנְחֲלוּ עוֹד אֲחֵרִים אֶת כְּבוֹדוֹ, כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשְׁךָ נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לּוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יִכְבֶּה נֵרוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Sam’cheinu Adonai Eloheinu b’Eliyahu hanavi avdecha, uvmalchut beit David m’shichecha, bimheira yavo v’yagel libeinu. Al kis’o lo yeishev zar, v’lo yinchalu od acherim et k’vodo, ki v’shem kodsh’cha nishbata lo shelo yichbeh nero l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: עַל הַתּוֹרָה וְעַל הָעֲבוֹדָה וְעַל הַנְּבִיאִים וְעַל יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה שֶׁנָּתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִקְדֻשָּׁה וְלִמְנוּחָה, לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָרֶת. עַל הַכֹּל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ וּמְבָרְכִים אוֹתָךְ, יִתְבָּרַךְ שִׁמְךָ בְּפִי כָּל חַי תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Al haTora v’al ha’avoda v’al han’vi’im v’al yom haShabbat hazeh shenatata lanu Adonai Eloheinu likdusha v’limnucha, l’chavod ultif’aret. Al hakol Adonai Eloheinu anachnu modim lach umvar’chim otach, yitbarach shimcha b’fi kol chai tamid l’olam va’ed.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe — Rock of all worlds, just in every generation, the faithful God who says and does, who speaks and fulfills, whose every word is truth and justice.

You are faithful, Eternal our God, and Your words are faithful; not one of Your words comes back empty — for You are God, faithful and merciful. Blessed are You, Eternal One, the God faithful in every word.
Have compassion on Zion, for it is the home of our life; rescue the crushed spirit, soon, in our own days. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who gladdens Zion in her children.

Gladden us, Eternal our God, with Elijah the prophet, Your servant, and with the reign of the house of David, Your anointed; may it come soon and bring joy to our hearts. Let no stranger sit upon his throne, let no others inherit his glory — for by Your holy name You swore his lamp would never go dark. Blessed are You, Eternal One, shield of David.

For the Torah, and the offering, and the prophets, and for this day of Shabbat that You gave us, Eternal our God, for holiness and for rest, for honor and for beauty — for all of it, Eternal our God, we thank You and bless You. May Your name be blessed in the mouth of all that lives, always, forever. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who makes Shabbat holy.

blocks.tr: Y’chad’sheihu haKadosh baruch hu aleinu v’al kol amo beit Yisra’el b’chol makom shehem, l’tova v’livracha, l’sason ulsimcha, lishua ulnechama, l’farnasa tova ulchalkala, l’chayim ulshalom, lishmuot tovot, v’livsorot tovot, v’lirfua sh’leima, v’ligula k’rova, v’nomar amen.

blocks.en: May it be Your will, Eternal our God and God of our ancestors, to renew this month for us for goodness and blessing. Give us a long life — a life of peace, a life of goodness, a life of blessing, a life of sustenance, a life of vigor in our bones, a life that holds awe of heaven and a wariness of wrongdoing, a life free of shame and disgrace, a life of abundance and honor, a life in which the love of Torah and the awe of heaven live in us, a life in which the longings of our heart are filled toward the good. Amen, selah.

The One who made miracles for our ancestors and redeemed them from slavery to freedom — may that One redeem us soon, and gather our scattered ones from the four corners of the earth. All Israel are one fellowship. And let us say: Amen.
The new moon of [month] falls on [day] — coming to us, and to all Israel, for good.

May the Holy One of blessing renew it for us, and for all the people, the house of Israel, wherever they are — for goodness and blessing, for gladness and joy, for rescue and comfort, for good sustenance and support, for life and for peace, for good reports and good news, for full healing, and for a redemption drawing near. And let us say: Amen.

blocks.en: Let them praise the name of the Eternal — for that name alone is exalted.
Its splendor is over earth and sky. God raised up a horn for this people — a song of praise for all the faithful, for the children of Yisrael, the people close to God. Halleluyah.

sources.name: Psalm 29
aliases: Seven times the voice of HaShem — thunder, then, at the end, peace.
openingWords: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד הָבוּ לַיְיָ בְּנֵי אֵלִים הָבוּ לַיְיָ כָּבוֹד וָעֹז. הָבוּ לַיְיָ
Mizmor l’David. Havu la’Adonai b’nei elim, havu la’Adonai kavod va’oz. Havu la’Adonai
קוֹל יְיָ עַל־הַמָּיִם אֵל־הַכָּבוֹד הִרְעִים יְיָ עַל־מַיִם רַבִּים. קוֹל־יְיָ בַּכֹּחַ קוֹל יְיָ
Kol Adonai al hamayim, El hakavod hir’im, Adonai al mayim rabim. Kol
קוֹל־יְיָ חֹצֵב לַהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ. קוֹל יְיָ יָחִיל מִדְבָּר יָחִיל יְיָ מִדְבַּר קָדֵשׁ.
Kol Adonai chotzev lahavot esh. Kol Adonai yachil midbar, yachil Adonai midbar
יְיָ לַמַּבּוּל יָשָׁב וַיֵּשֶׁב יְיָ מֶלֶךְ לְעוֹלָם. יְיָ עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן יְיָ
Adonai lamabul yashav, vayeshev Adonai melech l’olam. Adonai oz l’amo yiten, Adonai

blocks.he: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד הָבוּ לַיְיָ בְּנֵי אֵלִים הָבוּ לַיְיָ כָּבוֹד וָעֹז. הָבוּ לַיְיָ כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיְיָ בְּהַדְרַת־קֹדֶשׁ.
blocks.tr: Mizmor l’David. Havu la’Adonai b’nei elim, havu la’Adonai kavod va’oz. Havu la’Adonai k’vod sh’mo, hishtachavu la’Adonai b’hadrat kodesh.

blocks.he: קוֹל יְיָ עַל־הַמָּיִם אֵל־הַכָּבוֹד הִרְעִים יְיָ עַל־מַיִם רַבִּים. קוֹל־יְיָ בַּכֹּחַ קוֹל יְיָ בֶּהָדָר. קוֹל יְיָ שֹׁבֵר אֲרָזִים וַיְשַׁבֵּר יְיָ אֶת־אַרְזֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן. וַיַּרְקִידֵם כְּמוֹ־עֵגֶל לְבָנוֹן וְשִׂרְיֹן כְּמוֹ בֶן־רְאֵמִים.
blocks.tr: Kol Adonai al hamayim, El hakavod hir’im, Adonai al mayim rabim. Kol Adonai bako’ach, kol Adonai behadar. Kol Adonai shover arazim, vay’shaber Adonai et arzei haL’vanon. Vayarkidem k’mo egel, L’vanon v’Siryon k’mo ven r’emim.

blocks.he: קוֹל־יְיָ חֹצֵב לַהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ. קוֹל יְיָ יָחִיל מִדְבָּר יָחִיל יְיָ מִדְבַּר קָדֵשׁ. קוֹל יְיָ יְחוֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת וַיֶּחֱשֹׂף יְעָרוֹת וּבְהֵיכָלוֹ כֻּלּוֹ אֹמֵר כָּבוֹד.
blocks.tr: Kol Adonai chotzev lahavot esh. Kol Adonai yachil midbar, yachil Adonai midbar Kadesh. Kol Adonai y’cholel ayalot vayechesof y’arot, uvheichalo kulo omer kavod.

blocks.he: יְיָ לַמַּבּוּל יָשָׁב וַיֵּשֶׁב יְיָ מֶלֶךְ לְעוֹלָם. יְיָ עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן יְיָ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם.
blocks.tr: Adonai lamabul yashav, vayeshev Adonai melech l’olam. Adonai oz l’amo yiten, Adonai y’varech et amo vashalom.

blocks.en: A song of David. Give to the Holy One, you children of the mighty — give glory and strength. Give the glory due to the Name; bow before the One in the beauty of holiness.

The voice of the Holy One over the waters — the God of glory thunders, over the vast waters. The voice, in power; the voice, in splendor. The voice shatters cedars, splinters the cedars of Lebanon, makes the mountains skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.

sources.name: Eitz Chayim
aliases: The scroll goes home — a tree of life — turn us back, make our days new.
openingWords: וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר: שׁוּבָה יְיָ רִבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
Uvnucho yomar: Shuva Adonai riv’vot alfei Yisra’el.
קוּמָה יְיָ לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ, אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּךָ. כֹּהֲנֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ צֶדֶק, וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ. בַּעֲבוּר
Kuma Adonai limnuchatecha, ata va’aron uzecha. Kohanecha yilb’shu tzedek, vachasidecha y’raneinu. Ba’avur
כִּי לֶקַח טוֹב נָתַתִּי לָכֶם, תּוֹרָתִי אַל תַּעֲזֹבוּ.
Ki lekach tov natati lachem, Torati al ta’azovu.
עֵץ־חַיִּים הִיא לַמַּחֲזִיקִים בָּהּ, וְתֹמְכֶיהָ מְאֻשָּׁר. דְּרָכֶיהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹעַם, וְכׇל־נְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ שָׁלוֹם.
Etz chayim hi lamachazikim bah, v’tom’cheha m’ushar. D’racheha darchei noam, v’chol n’tivoteha

blocks.he: וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר: שׁוּבָה יְיָ רִבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: Uvnucho yomar: Shuva Adonai riv’vot alfei Yisra’el.

blocks.he: קוּמָה יְיָ לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ, אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּךָ. כֹּהֲנֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ צֶדֶק, וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ. בַּעֲבוּר דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ אַל תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Kuma Adonai limnuchatecha, ata va’aron uzecha. Kohanecha yilb’shu tzedek, vachasidecha y’raneinu. Ba’avur David avdecha al tashev p’nei m’shichecha.

blocks.he: כִּי לֶקַח טוֹב נָתַתִּי לָכֶם, תּוֹרָתִי אַל תַּעֲזֹבוּ.
blocks.tr: Ki lekach tov natati lachem, Torati al ta’azovu.

blocks.he: עֵץ־חַיִּים הִיא לַמַּחֲזִיקִים בָּהּ, וְתֹמְכֶיהָ מְאֻשָּׁר. דְּרָכֶיהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹעַם, וְכׇל־נְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ שָׁלוֹם.
blocks.tr: Etz chayim hi lamachazikim bah, v’tom’cheha m’ushar. D’racheha darchei noam, v’chol n’tivoteha shalom.

blocks.he: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה, חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם.
blocks.tr: Hashiveinu Adonai eilecha v’nashuva, chadesh yameinu k’kedem.

blocks.en: As it came to rest, Moses would say: Return, Eternal One, to the countless thousands of Yisrael.

Rise, Eternal One, to Your resting place — You and the ark of Your strength. Let Your priests be clothed in righteousness, and Your faithful sing for joy. For the sake of David Your servant, do not turn away the face of Your anointed.
For I have given you a good teaching — do not abandon My Torah.
It is a tree of life to those who hold fast to it, and all who uphold it are happy. Its ways are ways of pleasantness, and all its paths are peace.
Turn us back to You, Eternal One, and we will return — make our days new, as of old.

sources.name: Ein Keloheinu
aliases: A ladder of four names for the One, sung twice over — the letters themselves spelling amen.
openingWords: קַוֵּה אֶל יְיָ. חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ. וְקַוֵּה אֶל יְיָ.
Kaveh el Adonai, chazak v’ya’ametz libecha, v’kaveh el Adonai.
אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּיְיָ. כִּי אֵין בִּלְתֶּךָ. וְאֵין צוּר כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ. כִּי מִי אֱלוֹהַּ
Ein kadosh k’Adonai, ki ein biltecha, v’ein tzur keloheinu. Ki mi eloah
אֵין כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ. אֵין כַּאדוֹנֵינוּ. אֵין כְּמַלְכֵּנוּ. אֵין כְּמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. מִי כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ. מִי כַאדוֹנֵינוּ.
Ein keloheinu, ein kadoneinu, ein k’malkeinu, ein k’moshi’einu. Mi cheloheinu, mi chadoneinu,
נוֹדֶה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ. נוֹדֶה לַאדוֹנֵינוּ. נוֹדֶה לְמַלְכֵּנוּ. נוֹדֶה לְמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ אֲדוֹנֵינוּ.

blocks.en: Psalm 27:14.

blocks.he: קַוֵּה אֶל יְיָ. חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ. וְקַוֵּה אֶל יְיָ.
blocks.tr: Kaveh el Adonai, chazak v’ya’ametz libecha, v’kaveh el Adonai.

blocks.he: אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּיְיָ. כִּי אֵין בִּלְתֶּךָ. וְאֵין צוּר כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ. כִּי מִי אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְיָ. וּמִי צוּר זוּלָתִי אֱלֹהֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Ein kadosh k’Adonai, ki ein biltecha, v’ein tzur keloheinu. Ki mi eloah mibal’adei Adonai, umi tzur zulati Eloheinu.

blocks.he: אֵין כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ. אֵין כַּאדוֹנֵינוּ. אֵין כְּמַלְכֵּנוּ. אֵין כְּמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. מִי כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ. מִי כַאדוֹנֵינוּ. מִי כְמַלְכֵּנוּ. מִי כְמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Ein keloheinu, ein kadoneinu, ein k’malkeinu, ein k’moshi’einu. Mi cheloheinu, mi chadoneinu, mi ch’malkeinu, mi ch’moshi’einu.

blocks.he: נוֹדֶה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ. נוֹדֶה לַאדוֹנֵינוּ. נוֹדֶה לְמַלְכֵּנוּ. נוֹדֶה לְמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ אֲדוֹנֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ מַלְכֵּנוּ. בָּרוּךְ מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Nodeh leloheinu, nodeh ladoneinu, nodeh l’malkeinu, nodeh l’moshi’einu. Baruch Eloheinu, baruch Adoneinu, baruch Malkeinu, baruch Moshi’einu.

blocks.he: אַתָּה הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ. אַתָּה הוּא אֲדוֹנֵינוּ. אַתָּה הוּא מַלְכֵּנוּ. אַתָּה הוּא מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Ata hu Eloheinu, ata hu Adoneinu, ata hu Malkeinu, ata hu Moshi’einu.

blocks.he: אַתָּה הוּא. שֶׁהִקְטִירוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְפָנֶיךָ. אֶת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים.
blocks.tr: Ata hu shehiktiru avoteinu l’fanecha et k’toret hasamim.

blocks.en: Hope in the Eternal; be strong, and let your heart take courage — hope in the Eternal.
There is none holy like the Eternal, none besides You; no rock like our God. For who is God but the Eternal? Who is a rock but our God?
There is none like our God, none like our Source, none like our Shelter, none like the One who saves us. Who is like our God, like our Source, like our Shelter, like the One who saves us?

We give thanks to our God, to our Source, to our Shelter, to the One who saves us. Blessed is our God, our Source, our Shelter, the One who saves us. You are our God, our Source, our Shelter, the One who saves us.
You are the One before whom our ancestors burned the incense of spices.

sources.name: Aleinu
aliases: The seal of every service: a vision where everyone is obligated to each other — a fantasy of power spoken from powerlessness.
openingWords: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת
Aleinu l’shabeach la’adon hakol, latet g’dula l’yotzer b’reshit, shelo asanu k’goyei ha’aratzot,
שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי
Shehu noteh shamayim v’yosed aretz, umoshav y’karo bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo b’govhei
עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים
Al ken n’kaveh l’cha Adonai Eloheinu, lir’ot m’hera b’tif’eret uzecha, l’ha’avir gilulim
יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל כִּי לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל בֶּרֶךְ, תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל
Yakiru v’yed’u kol yosh’vei tevel, ki l’cha tichra kol berech, tishava kol

blocks.he: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם. וַאֲנַחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
blocks.tr: Aleinu l’shabeach la’adon hakol, latet g’dula l’yotzer b’reshit, shelo asanu k’goyei ha’aratzot, v’lo samanu k’mishp’chot ha’adama; shelo sam chelkeinu kahem, v’goraleinu k’chol hamonam. Va’anachnu kor’im umishtachavim umodim, lifnei melech malchei ham’lachim, haKadosh baruch hu.

blocks.he: שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים. הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּנוּ אֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ, כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת, אֵין עוֹד.
blocks.tr: Shehu noteh shamayim v’yosed aretz, umoshav y’karo bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo b’govhei m’romim. Hu Eloheinu ein od, emet malkeinu efes zulato, kakatuv b’torato: v’yadata hayom vahashevota el l’vavecha, ki Adonai hu ha’Elohim bashamayim mima’al v’al ha’aretz mitachat, ein od.

blocks.he: עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן, לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי. וְכָל בְּנֵי בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶךָ, לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶיךָ כָּל רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Al ken n’kaveh l’cha Adonai Eloheinu, lir’ot m’hera b’tif’eret uzecha, l’ha’avir gilulim min ha’aretz, v’ha’elilim karot yikaretun, l’taken olam b’malchut Shaddai. V’chol b’nei vasar yikr’u vishmecha, l’hafnot eilecha kol rish’ei aretz.

blocks.he: יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל כִּי לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל בֶּרֶךְ, תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל לָשׁוֹן. לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפֹּלוּ, וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּנוּ, וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם אֶת עֹל מַלְכוּתֶךָ, וְתִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ: יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Yakiru v’yed’u kol yosh’vei tevel, ki l’cha tichra kol berech, tishava kol lashon. L’fanecha Adonai Eloheinu yichr’u v’yipolu, v’lichvod shimcha y’kar yitenu, vikab’lu chulam et ol malchutecha, v’timloch aleihem m’hera l’olam va’ed. Ki hamalchut shel’cha hi, ul’olmei ad timloch b’chavod, kakatuv b’toratecha: Adonai yimloch l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמַר: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד.
blocks.tr: V’ne’emar: v’haya Adonai l’melech al kol ha’aretz, bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad ushmo echad.

blocks.en: It is upon us to acknowledge the Oneness of Creation, and to celebrate the majesty of it all — we who were not made like the nations of the lands, nor set like the families of the earth; whose portion is not theirs, whose lot is our own. And so we bend, and bow, and give thanks before what is beyond every power, the Holy One of blessing.

The heavens stretched wide, the earth set on its foundations, glory and strength filling the highest heights — this is our God; there is no other, none else at all. As it is written in the Torah: Know this day and take it to heart, that the Eternal is God in the heavens above and on the earth below; there is no other.

And so we hope in You, the Eternal our God: soon to see the splendor of Your strength, when every idol and false god is swept from the earth, and the world is mended whole in the oneness of the Almighty. All who live will call on Your name, and earth’s wrongdoers will turn back to You. Let the world come to know that every knee bends and every tongue swears true before You. Before You, Eternal our God, may all bow low, honor Your name, and take on together the obligation of Oneness, soon and always. All is Yours, and forever You endure in glory, as it is written in Your Torah: The Eternal will reign forever and ever. And it is said: the Eternal shall be sovereign over all the earth; on that day the Eternal shall be One, and the name One.

sources.name: Mourner’s Kaddish
aliases: Mourners rise; the community answers, and no one grieves alone — a prayer for the dead with no word for death.
openingWords: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן
Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon
Mourners rise, in body or in spirit; all who wish may stand
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.
יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא,
Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu,
יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא, וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon uvyomeichon uvchayei d’chol beit Yisra’el, ba’agala uvizman kariv, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: Mourners rise, in body or in spirit; all who wish may stand with them.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא, לְעֵלָּא מִן־כָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’ela min kol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא, וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’lama raba min sh’maya, v’chayim aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh shalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Israel, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the name of the Holy One of blessing — far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

May great peace from heaven, and life, be upon us and upon all Israel — and say: Amen. May the One who makes peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Israel, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Birkat Kohanim
aliases: The oldest blessing we have — Aaron’s words, lifted over the whole room.
openingWords: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה
Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, bar’cheinu bab’racha ham’shuleshet baTorah, hak’tuva al y’dei Moshe
Our God and God of our ancestors — bless us with the
יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ, הָאֲמוּרָה מִפִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו כֹּהֲנִים עַם קְדוֹשֶׁךָ, כָּאָמוּר:
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, bar’cheinu bab’racha ham’shuleshet baTorah, hak’tuva al y’dei Moshe avdecha, ha’amura mipi Aharon uvanav kohanim am k’doshecha, ka’amur:

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors — bless us with the threefold blessing of the Torah, written by the hand of Moses Your servant, spoken by Aaron and his sons, the priests, Your holy people, as it is said:

blocks.he: יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
blocks.tr: Yisa Adonai panav eilecha v’yasem l’cha shalom.

blocks.en: May the Eternal bless you and keep you. May the Eternal’s face shine upon you and be gracious to you. May the Eternal’s face turn toward you and grant you peace.

sources.name: Adon Olam
aliases: The service ends the way it began: in song. Adon Olam is the melody that carries us out.
openingWords: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא. לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל,
Adon olam asher malach, b’terem kol y’tzir nivra. L’et na’asa v’cheftzo kol,

blocks.he: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא. לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא.
blocks.tr: Adon olam asher malach, b’terem kol y’tzir nivra. L’et na’asa v’cheftzo kol, azai melech sh’mo nikra.

blocks.he: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא. וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה.
blocks.tr: V’acharei kichlot hakol, l’vado yimloch nora. V’hu haya v’hu hoveh, v’hu yihyeh b’tif’ara.

blocks.he: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּירָה. בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה.
blocks.tr: V’hu echad v’ein sheni, l’hamshil lo l’hachbira. B’li reshit b’li tachlit, v’lo ha’oz v’hamisra.

blocks.he: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה. וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא.
blocks.tr: V’hu Eli v’chai go’ali, v’tzur chevli b’et tzara. V’hu nisi umanos li, m’nat kosi b’yom ekra.

blocks.he: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִירָה. וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, יְיָ לִי וְלֹא אִירָא.
blocks.tr: B’yado afkid ruchi, b’et ishan v’a’ira. V’im ruchi g’viyati, Adonai li v’lo ira.

blocks.en: Eternal One of all, who was before any form was created; when all was made by Your will, then was Your name made known. And after all has ceased to be, You alone endure, beyond all awe. You were, You are, You will be in glory.

You are One; there is no second to compare or set beside You. Without beginning, without end — Yours is the strength, and Yours all that is. You are my God, my living Redeemer, my Rock in time of trouble; my banner, my refuge, the portion of my cup on the day I call.
Into Your hand I entrust my spirit, when I sleep and when I wake; and with my spirit, my body too — the Eternal is with me, I will not fear.

sources.name: Yigdal
aliases: Maimonides’ thirteen principles, set to song.
openingWords: יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים חַי וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח, נִמְצָא וְאֵין עֵת אֶל מְצִיאוּתוֹ.
Yigdal Elohim chai v’yishtabach, nimtza v’ein et el m’tzi’uto.
אֶחָד וְאֵין יָחִיד כְּיִחוּדוֹ, נֶעְלָם וְגַם אֵין סוֹף לְאַחְדוּתוֹ.
Echad v’ein yachid k’yichudo, ne’elam v’gam ein sof l’achduto.
Great is the living God, and praised: existing, beyond any moment we
אֵין לוֹ דְמוּת הַגּוּף וְאֵינוֹ גוּף, לֹא נַעֲרֹךְ אֵלָיו קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ.
Ein lo d’mut haguf v’eino guf, lo na’aroch elav k’dushato.
קַדְמוֹן לְכָל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִבְרָא, רִאשׁוֹן וְאֵין רֵאשִׁית לְרֵאשִׁיתוֹ.

blocks.he: יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים חַי וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח, נִמְצָא וְאֵין עֵת אֶל מְצִיאוּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Yigdal Elohim chai v’yishtabach, nimtza v’ein et el m’tzi’uto.

blocks.he: אֶחָד וְאֵין יָחִיד כְּיִחוּדוֹ, נֶעְלָם וְגַם אֵין סוֹף לְאַחְדוּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Echad v’ein yachid k’yichudo, ne’elam v’gam ein sof l’achduto.

blocks.en: Great is the living God, and praised: existing, beyond any moment we could bound. One, and there is no oneness like that oneness — hidden, and endless in Your unity.

blocks.he: אֵין לוֹ דְמוּת הַגּוּף וְאֵינוֹ גוּף, לֹא נַעֲרֹךְ אֵלָיו קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Ein lo d’mut haguf v’eino guf, lo na’aroch elav k’dushato.

blocks.he: קַדְמוֹן לְכָל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִבְרָא, רִאשׁוֹן וְאֵין רֵאשִׁית לְרֵאשִׁיתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Kadmon l’chol davar asher nivra, rishon v’ein reishit l’reishito.

blocks.en: You have no bodily form and are not a body; nothing can measure Your holiness. Before all that was created, first — with no beginning to Your beginning.

blocks.he: הִנּוֹ אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם לְכָל נוֹצָר, יוֹרֶה גְדֻלָּתוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Hino adon olam l’chol notzar, yoreh g’dulato umalchuto.

blocks.he: שֶׁפַע נְבוּאָתוֹ נְתָנוֹ, אֶל אַנְשֵׁי סְגֻלָּתוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Shefa n’vu’ato n’tano, el anshei s’gulato v’tif’arto.

blocks.en: Behold, the Eternal of the world, to every creature teaching Your greatness and Your endless reach. You poured out the gift of prophecy upon the people of Your treasure and Your splendor.

blocks.he: לֹא קָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמֹשֶׁה עוֹד, נָבִיא וּמַבִּיט אֶת תְּמוּנָתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Lo kam b’Yisra’el k’Moshe od, navi umabit et t’munato.

blocks.he: תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת נָתַן לְעַמּוֹ אֵל, עַל יַד נְבִיאוֹ נֶאֱמַן בֵּיתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Torat emet natan l’amo El, al yad n’vio ne’eman beito.

blocks.en: None arose in Yisrael like Moses again — a prophet who beheld Your very likeness. A Torah of truth You gave Your people, through Your prophet, the trusted one of Your house.

blocks.he: לֹא יַחֲלִיף הָאֵל וְלֹא יָמִיר דָּתוֹ, לְעוֹלָמִים לְזוּלָתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Lo yachalif ha’El v’lo yamir dato, l’olamim l’zulato.

blocks.he: צוֹפֶה וְיוֹדֵעַ סְתָרֵינוּ, מַבִּיט לְסוֹף דָּבָר בְּקַדְמוּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Tzofeh v’yodea s’tareinu, mabit l’sof davar b’kadmuto.

blocks.en: God will not exchange nor alter that teaching — never, for any other. You watch and know our secrets, seeing the end of a thing in its beginning.

blocks.he: גּוֹמֵל לְאִישׁ חֶסֶד כְּמִפְעָלוֹ, נוֹתֵן לְרָשָׁע רַע כְּרִשְׁעָתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Gomel l’ish chesed k’mif’alo, noten l’rasha ra k’rish’ato.

blocks.en: You reward the good according to their deeds, and repay the wicked their evil according to their wickedness.

blocks.he: יִשְׁלַח לְקֵץ הַיָּמִין מְשִׁיחֵנוּ, לִפְדּוֹת מְחַכֵּי קֵץ יְשׁוּעָתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Yishlach l’ketz hayamin m’shicheinu, lifdot m’chakei ketz y’shu’ato.

blocks.en: At the end of days You will send our messiah, to redeem those who wait for the end of Your deliverance.

blocks.he: מֵתִים יְחַיֶּה אֵל בְּרֹב חַסְדּוֹ, בָּרוּךְ עֲדֵי עַד שֵׁם תְּהִלָּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Meitim y’chayeh El b’rov chasdo, baruch adei ad shem t’hilato.

blocks.en: God will revive the dead, in the fullness of divine love — blessed forever is the Name of that praise.
The Kiddush for Shabbat morning — Kiddusha Rabbah — p. .

Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who calls

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם,. אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ לִקְרֹא אֶת הַהַלֵּל:

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who calls us toward holiness as we sing the Hallel.

blocks.he: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְיָ הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְיָ. יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם. מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹאוֹ מְהֻלָּל שֵׁם יְיָ.
blocks.tr: Hal’lu Yah. Hal’lu avdei Adonai, hal’lu et shem Adonai. Y’hi shem Adonai m’vorach, me’ata v’ad olam. Mimizrach shemesh ad m’vo’o, m’hulal shem Adonai.

blocks.he: רָם עַל־כׇּל־גּוֹיִם יְיָ עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ. מִי כַּיְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַמַּגְבִּיהִי לָשָׁבֶת. הַמַּשְׁפִּילִי לִרְאוֹת בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Ram al kol goyim Adonai, al hashamayim k’vodo. Mi k’Adonai Eloheinu, hamagbihi lashavet. Hamashpili lir’ot bashamayim uva’aretz.

blocks.he: מְקִימִי מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן. לְהוֹשִׁיבִי עִם־נְדִיבִים עִם נְדִיבֵי עַמּוֹ. מוֹשִׁיבִי עֲקֶרֶת הַבַּיִת אֵם־הַבָּנִים שְׂמֵחָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
blocks.tr: M’kimi me’afar dal, me’ashpot yarim evyon. L’hoshivi im n’divim, im n’divei amo. Moshivi akeret habayit, em habanim s’meicha, hal’lu Yah.

blocks.en: Halleluyah! Praise, you servants of the One; praise the Name. Blessed be the Name now and forever — from the rising of the sun to its setting, the Name is praised.
High above all the nations is the One; God's glory rises over the heavens. Who is like the One our God — enthroned on high, yet bending low to look upon the heavens and the earth —

who lifts the poor from the dust and raises the needy from the ash-heap, to seat them among the generous, among the generous of the people; who makes the childless one at home a happy mother of children. Halleluyah!

blocks.he: מִלִּפְנֵי אָדוֹן חוּלִי אָרֶץ מִלִּפְנֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲקֹב. הַהֹפְכִי הַצּוּר אֲגַם־מָיִם חַלָּמִישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ־מָיִם.
blocks.tr: Milifnei Adon chuli aretz, milifnei Eloah Ya’akov. Hahofchi hatzur agam mayim, chalamish l’ma’y’no mayim.

blocks.en: When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech, Judah became God’s holy place, Israel God’s dominion. The sea saw and fled, the Jordan turned back; the mountains danced like rams, the hills like young sheep. What frightened you, sea, that you fled — Jordan, that you turned back? Mountains, that you danced like rams — hills, like young sheep? Tremble, earth, before the One, before the God of Jacob, who turns rock into a pool of water, flint into a flowing spring.

sources.name: Psalm 115
aliases: Not to us — but to the Name. Idols that cannot speak, and a God who remembers.
openingWords: לֹא לָנוּ יְיָ לֹא־לָנוּ כִּי־לְשִׁמְךָ תֵּן כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדְּךָ עַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ. לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם
Lo lanu Adonai, lo lanu, ki l’shimcha ten kavod, al chasd’cha al
עֲצַבֵּיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם. פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא
Atzabeihem kesef v’zahav, ma’aseh y’dei adam. Peh lahem v’lo y’dabeiru, einayim lahem
יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּטַח בַּיְיָ עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא. בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בִּטְחוּ בַיְיָ עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם
Yisra’el b’tach ba’Adonai, ezram umaginam hu. Beit Aharon bitchu va’Adonai, ezram umaginam
יְיָ זְכָרָנוּ יְבָרֵךְ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית אַהֲרֹן. יְבָרֵךְ יִרְאֵי יְיָ
Adonai z’charanu y’vareich, y’vareich et beit Yisra’el, y’vareich et beit Aharon. Y’vareich

blocks.he: לֹא לָנוּ יְיָ לֹא־לָנוּ כִּי־לְשִׁמְךָ תֵּן כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדְּךָ עַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ. לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה־נָא אֱלֹהֵיהֶם. וֵאלֹהֵינוּ בַשָּׁמָיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵץ עָשָׂה.
blocks.tr: Lo lanu Adonai, lo lanu, ki l’shimcha ten kavod, al chasd’cha al amitecha. Lama yom’ru hagoyim, ayeh na Eloheihem. Ve’loheinu vashamayim, kol asher chafetz asa.

blocks.he: עֲצַבֵּיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם. פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ. אׇזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָעוּ אַף לָהֶם וְלֹא יְרִיחוּן. יְדֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְמִישׁוּן רַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְהַלֵּכוּ לֹא־יֶהְגּוּ בִּגְרוֹנָם. כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶם.
blocks.tr: Atzabeihem kesef v’zahav, ma’aseh y’dei adam. Peh lahem v’lo y’dabeiru, einayim lahem v’lo yir’u. Oznayim lahem v’lo yishma’u, af lahem v’lo y’richun. Y’deihem v’lo y’mishun, ragleihem v’lo y’haleichu, lo yehgu bigronam. K’mohem yihyu oseihem, kol asher botei’ach bahem.

blocks.he: יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּטַח בַּיְיָ עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא. בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בִּטְחוּ בַיְיָ עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא. יִרְאֵי יְיָ בִּטְחוּ בַיְיָ עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא.
blocks.tr: Yisra’el b’tach ba’Adonai, ezram umaginam hu. Beit Aharon bitchu va’Adonai, ezram umaginam hu. Yir’ei Adonai bitchu va’Adonai, ezram umaginam hu.

blocks.he: יְיָ זְכָרָנוּ יְבָרֵךְ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית אַהֲרֹן. יְבָרֵךְ יִרְאֵי יְיָ הַקְּטַנִּים עִם־הַגְּדֹלִים. יֹסֵף יְיָ עֲלֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם וְעַל־בְּנֵיכֶם. בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיְיָ עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Adonai z’charanu y’vareich, y’vareich et beit Yisra’el, y’vareich et beit Aharon. Y’vareich yir’ei Adonai, hak’tanim im hag’dolim. Yosef Adonai aleichem, aleichem v’al b’neichem. B’ruchim atem la’Adonai, oseh shamayim va’aretz.

blocks.he: הַשָּׁמַיִם שָׁמַיִם לַיְיָ וְהָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי־אָדָם. לֹא הַמֵּתִים יְהַלְלוּ־יָהּ וְלֹא כׇּל־יֹרְדֵי דוּמָה. וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
blocks.tr: Hashamayim shamayim la’Adonai, v’ha’aretz natan livnei adam. Lo hameitim y’hal’lu Yah, v’lo kol yor’dei duma. Va’anachnu n’vareich Yah, me’ata v’ad olam, hal’lu Yah.

blocks.en: Not to us, O One, not to us, but to Your name give the glory — for Your love, for Your faithfulness. Why should the nations ask, “Where, now, is their God?” — when our God is in the heavens, doing whatever God wills. Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands: mouths that cannot speak, eyes that cannot see, ears that cannot hear, noses that cannot smell; hands that cannot feel, feet that cannot walk, no sound rising in their throats. Those who make them become like them — everyone who trusts in them. Israel, trust in the One — our help and our shield. House of Aaron, trust in the One — our help and our shield. You who revere the One, trust in the One — our help and our shield. The One has remembered us, and will bless: the house of Israel, the house of Aaron, all who revere the One, the small together with the great. May the One increase you — you and your children. Blessed are you by the One, maker of heaven and earth. The heavens are the heavens of the One, but the earth is given to humankind. The dead do not praise Yah, nor any who go down into silence — but we will bless Yah, now and forever. Halleluyah!

sources.name: Psalm 116
aliases: Pulled back from the edge — I will lift the cup of deliverance and call the Name.
openingWords: אָהַבְתִּי כִּי־יִשְׁמַע יְיָ אֶת־קוֹלִי תַּחֲנוּנָי. כִּי־הִטָּה אׇזְנוֹ לִי וּבְיָמַי אֶקְרָא. אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָוֶת
Ahavti ki yishma Adonai et koli tachanunai. Ki hita ozno li, uv’yamai
חַנּוּן יְיָ וְצַדִּיק וֵאלֹהֵינוּ מְרַחֵם. שֹׁמֵר פְּתָאיִם יְיָ דַּלֹּתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִׁיעַ. שׁוּבִי
Chanun Adonai v’tzadik, ve’loheinu m’racheim. Shomer p’ta’im Adonai, daloti v’li y’hoshia. Shuvi
הֶאֱמַנְתִּי כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אֲנִי עָנִיתִי מְאֹד. אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחׇפְזִי כׇּל־הָאָדָם כֹּזֵב.
He’emanti ki adabeir, ani aniti m’od. Ani amarti v’chofzi, kol ha’adam kozev.
מָה־אָשִׁיב לַיְיָ כׇּל־תַּגְמוּלוֹהִי עָלָי. כּוֹס־יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וּבְשֵׁם יְיָ אֶקְרָא. נְדָרַי לַיְיָ אֲשַׁלֵּם
Ma ashiv la’Adonai, kol tagmulohi alai. Kos y’shu’ot esa, uvshem Adonai ekra.

blocks.he: אָהַבְתִּי כִּי־יִשְׁמַע יְיָ אֶת־קוֹלִי תַּחֲנוּנָי. כִּי־הִטָּה אׇזְנוֹ לִי וּבְיָמַי אֶקְרָא. אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָוֶת וּמְצָרֵי שְׁאוֹל מְצָאוּנִי צָרָה וְיָגוֹן אֶמְצָא. וּבְשֵׁם־יְיָ אֶקְרָא אָנָּה יְיָ מַלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי.
blocks.tr: Ahavti ki yishma Adonai et koli tachanunai. Ki hita ozno li, uv’yamai ekra. Afafuni chevlei mavet, um’tzarei sh’ol m’tza’uni, tzara v’yagon emtza. Uvshem Adonai ekra, ana Adonai malta nafshi.

blocks.he: חַנּוּן יְיָ וְצַדִּיק וֵאלֹהֵינוּ מְרַחֵם. שֹׁמֵר פְּתָאיִם יְיָ דַּלֹּתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִׁיעַ. שׁוּבִי נַפְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָיְכִי כִּי־יְיָ גָּמַל עָלָיְכִי. כִּי חִלַּצְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת אֶת־עֵינִי מִן־דִּמְעָה אֶת־רַגְלִי מִדֶּחִי. אֶתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי יְיָ בְּאַרְצוֹת הַחַיִּים.
blocks.tr: Chanun Adonai v’tzadik, ve’loheinu m’racheim. Shomer p’ta’im Adonai, daloti v’li y’hoshia. Shuvi nafshi limnuchay’chi, ki Adonai gamal alay’chi. Ki chilatzta nafshi mimavet, et eini min dim’a, et ragli midechi. Et’haleich lifnei Adonai b’artzot hachayim.

blocks.he: הֶאֱמַנְתִּי כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אֲנִי עָנִיתִי מְאֹד. אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחׇפְזִי כׇּל־הָאָדָם כֹּזֵב.
blocks.tr: He’emanti ki adabeir, ani aniti m’od. Ani amarti v’chofzi, kol ha’adam kozev.

blocks.he: מָה־אָשִׁיב לַיְיָ כׇּל־תַּגְמוּלוֹהִי עָלָי. כּוֹס־יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וּבְשֵׁם יְיָ אֶקְרָא. נְדָרַי לַיְיָ אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכׇל־עַמּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Ma ashiv la’Adonai, kol tagmulohi alai. Kos y’shu’ot esa, uvshem Adonai ekra. N’darai la’Adonai ashaleim, negda na l’chol amo.

blocks.he: יָקָר בְּעֵינֵי יְיָ הַמָּוְתָה לַחֲסִידָיו. אָנָּה יְיָ כִּי־אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ אֲנִי־עַבְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶךָ פִּתַּחְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָי. לְךָ־אֶזְבַּח זֶבַח תּוֹדָה וּבְשֵׁם יְיָ אֶקְרָא. נְדָרַי לַיְיָ אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכׇל־עַמּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Yakar b’einei Adonai hamavta lachasidav. Ana Adonai ki ani avdecha, ani avd’cha ben amatecha, pitachta l’moseirai. L’cha ezbach zevach toda, uvshem Adonai ekra. N’darai la’Adonai ashaleim, negda na l’chol amo.

blocks.he: בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְיָ בְּתוֹכֵכִי יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
blocks.tr: B’chatzrot beit Adonai, b’tocheichi Y’rushalayim, hal’lu Yah.

blocks.en: I love that the One hears my voice, my pleading — that You bent an ear to me, so all my days I will call. The cords of death wound round me, the straits of Sheol found me, and I met only trouble and grief; then I called on the name of the One: “Please — save my life.” Gracious is the One, and just; our God overflows with mercy. The One keeps the simple; I was brought low, and God saved me. Return, my soul, to your rest, for the One has been good to you — You freed my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling. I will walk before the One in the land of the living. I kept faith even when I said, “I am greatly afflicted”; even in my panic, when I said, “No one can be trusted.” How can I repay the One for all the One's goodness to me? I will lift the cup of rescue and call on the name of the One. My vows to the One I will keep, in the sight of all the people. Precious in the eyes of the One is the death of the faithful. O One — I am Your servant, Your servant, the child of Your handmaid; You have loosed my bonds. To You I will bring a thanksgiving-offering and call on the name of the One. My vows to the One I will keep, in the sight of all the people — in the courts of the house of the One, in your midst, Jerusalem. Halleluyah!

sources.name: Psalm 117
aliases: Two verses, and the joy turns outward — praise for every nation and people.
openingWords: הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְיָ כׇּל־גּוֹיִם שַׁבְּחוּהוּ כׇּל־הָאֻמִּים. כִּי־גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְיָ לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
Hal’lu et Adonai kol goyim, shab’chuhu kol ha’umim. Ki gavar aleinu chasdo,
Praise the One, all you nations; sing praise, all you peoples —

blocks.he: הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְיָ כׇּל־גּוֹיִם שַׁבְּחוּהוּ כׇּל־הָאֻמִּים. כִּי־גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְיָ לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
blocks.tr: Hal’lu et Adonai kol goyim, shab’chuhu kol ha’umim. Ki gavar aleinu chasdo, ve’emet Adonai l’olam, hal’lu Yah.

blocks.en: Praise the One, all you nations; sing praise, all you peoples — for great is God’s love toward us, and the faithfulness of the One is forever. Halleluyah!

Yomar na Yisra’el, ki l’olam chasdo. Yom’ru na veit Aharon, ki l’olam
מִן־הַמֵּצַר קָרָאתִי יָּהּ עָנָנִי בַמֶּרְחָב יָהּ. יְיָ לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי
Min hameitzar karati Yah, anani vamerchav Yah. Adonai li lo ira, ma
כׇּל־גּוֹיִם סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְיָ כִּי אֲמִילַם. סַבּוּנִי גַם־סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְיָ כִּי אֲמִילַם.
Kol goyim s’vavuni, b’shem Adonai ki amilam. Sabuni gam s’vavuni, b’shem Adonai

blocks.he: יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. יֹאמְרוּ־נָא בֵית־אַהֲרֹן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. יֹאמְרוּ־נָא יִרְאֵי יְיָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Yomar na Yisra’el, ki l’olam chasdo. Yom’ru na veit Aharon, ki l’olam chasdo. Yom’ru na yir’ei Adonai, ki l’olam chasdo.

blocks.he: מִן־הַמֵּצַר קָרָאתִי יָּהּ עָנָנִי בַמֶּרְחָב יָהּ. יְיָ לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי אָדָם. יְיָ לִי בְּעֹזְרָי וַאֲנִי אֶרְאֶה בְשֹׂנְאָי. טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיְיָ מִבְּטֹחַ בָּאָדָם. טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיְיָ מִבְּטֹחַ בִּנְדִיבִים.
blocks.tr: Min hameitzar karati Yah, anani vamerchav Yah. Adonai li lo ira, ma ya’aseh li adam. Adonai li b’oz’rai, va’ani er’eh v’son’ai. Tov lachasot ba’Adonai mib’toach ba’adam. Tov lachasot ba’Adonai mib’toach bindivim.

blocks.he: כׇּל־גּוֹיִם סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְיָ כִּי אֲמִילַם. סַבּוּנִי גַם־סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְיָ כִּי אֲמִילַם. סַבּוּנִי כִדְבוֹרִים דֹּעֲכוּ כְּאֵשׁ קוֹצִים בְּשֵׁם יְיָ כִּי אֲמִילַם. דַּחֹה דְחִיתַנִי לִנְפֹּל וַיְיָ עֲזָרָנִי.
blocks.tr: Kol goyim s’vavuni, b’shem Adonai ki amilam. Sabuni gam s’vavuni, b’shem Adonai ki amilam. Sabuni chidvorim, do’achu k’esh kotzim, b’shem Adonai ki amilam. Dacho d’chitani linpol, va’Adonai azarani.

blocks.he: עׇזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה. קוֹל רִנָּה וִישׁוּעָה בְּאׇהֳלֵי צַדִּיקִים יְמִין יְיָ עֹשָׂה חָיִל. יְמִין יְיָ רוֹמֵמָה יְמִין יְיָ עֹשָׂה חָיִל. לֹא־אָמוּת כִּי־אֶחְיֶה וַאֲסַפֵּר מַעֲשֵׂי יָהּ. יַסֹּר יִסְּרַנִּי יָּהּ וְלַמָּוֶת לֹא נְתָנָנִי.
blocks.tr: Ozi v’zimrat Yah, vayhi li lishu’a. Kol rina vishu’a b’oholei tzadikim, y’min Adonai osa chayil. Y’min Adonai romeima, y’min Adonai osa chayil. Lo amut ki echyeh, va’asapeir ma’asei Yah. Yasor yis’rani Yah, v’lamavet lo n’tanani.
Pitchu li sha’arei tzedek, avo vam odeh Yah.

blocks.he: זֶה־הַשַּׁעַר לַיְיָ צַדִּיקִים יָבֹאוּ בוֹ. אוֹדְךָ כִּי עֲנִיתָנִי וַתְּהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה. אֶבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּה. מֵאֵת יְיָ הָיְתָה זֹּאת הִיא נִפְלָאת בְּעֵינֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Zeh hasha’ar la’Adonai, tzadikim yavo’u vo. Od’cha ki anitani, vat’hi li lishu’a. Even ma’asu habonim, hay’ta l’rosh pina. Me’et Adonai hay’ta zot, hi niflat b’eineinu.

blocks.he: זֶה־הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְיָ נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ.
blocks.tr: Zeh hayom asa Adonai, nagila v’nism’cha vo.

blocks.he: אָנָּא יְיָ הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא אָנָּא יְיָ הַצְלִיחָה נָּא.
blocks.tr: Ana Adonai hoshia na. Ana Adonai hatzlicha na.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ הַבָּא בְּשֵׁם יְיָ בֵּרַכְנוּכֶם מִבֵּית יְיָ. אֵל יְיָ וַיָּאֶר לָנוּ אִסְרוּ־חַג בַּעֲבֹתִים עַד־קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ. אֵלִי אַתָּה וְאוֹדֶךָּ אֱלֹהַי אֲרוֹמְמֶךָּ.
blocks.tr: Baruch haba b’shem Adonai, beirachnuchem mibeit Adonai. El Adonai vaya’er lanu, isru chag ba’avotim ad karnot hamizbei’ach. Eli ata v’odeka, Elohai aromemeka.

blocks.he: הוֹדוּ לַיְיָ כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Hodu la’Adonai ki tov, ki l’olam chasdo.

blocks.en: Give thanks to the One, who is good — whose love is forever. Let Israel say it; let the house of Aaron say it; let all who revere the One say it: God’s love is forever.

From the narrow place I called to Yah, and Yah answered me with wide-open space. The One is with me — I will not be afraid; what can a mere mortal do to me? The One is with me, among those who help me; I will yet look my enemies in the face. Better to shelter in the One than to trust in mortals; better to shelter in the One than to trust in the powerful. All the nations surrounded me — in the name of the One I cut them down. They swarmed around me, closed in on every side — in the name of the One I cut them down. They swarmed round me like bees, and were snuffed out like a fire of thorns — in the name of the One I cut them down. You shoved me hard, to make me fall — but the One helped me.

Yah is my strength and my song, and has become my rescue. Voices of joy and rescue ring out in the tents of the just: the right hand of the One does mighty things. The right hand of the One is lifted high; the right hand of the One does mighty things. I will not die but live, and tell what Yah has done. Yah disciplined me hard — but did not hand me over to death.

Open for me the gates of justice — I will enter through them and thank Yah. This is the gate of the One; the just enter through it. I thank You, for You answered me and became my rescue. The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; this is the One's doing, a wonder in our eyes.
This is the day the One has made — let us be glad and rejoice in it.

O One, please — save us! O One, please — let us thrive! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the One; from the house of the One we bless you. The One is God, who has given us light; bind the festival offering with cords, up to the horns of the altar. You are my God, and I thank You; my God, I lift You high. Give thanks to the One, who is good — God's love is forever.

sources.name: Blessing after the Hallel
aliases: The Hallel seals itself with a cascade of praise — blessed is the One sung in songs.
openingWords: יְהַלְלֽוּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ כָּל־מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ וַחֲסִידֶֽיךָ צַדִּיקִים עוֹשֵׂי רְצוֹנֶֽךָ וְכָל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל
Y’hal’lucha Adonai Eloheinu kol ma’asecha, vachasidecha tzadikim osei r’tzonecha, v’chol am’cha beit
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מֶֽלֶךְ מְהֻלָּל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת:
Baruch ata Adonai, melech m’hulal batishbachot.
All Your works shall praise You, Eternal our God; and Your faithful
Blessed are You, Eternal One, sung in praises.

blocks.he: יְהַלְלֽוּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ כָּל־מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ וַחֲסִידֶֽיךָ צַדִּיקִים עוֹשֵׂי רְצוֹנֶֽךָ וְכָל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִנָּה יוֹדוּ וִיבָרְכוּ וִישַׁבְּחוּ וִיפָאֲרוּ וִישׁוֹרְרוּ וִירוֹמְמוּ וְיַעֲרִֽיצוּ וְיַקְדִּֽישׁוּ וְיַמְלִֽיכוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תָּמִיד. כִּי לְךָ טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת וּלְשִׁמְךָ נָאֶה לְזַמֵּר. כִּי מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל.
blocks.tr: Y’hal’lucha Adonai Eloheinu kol ma’asecha, vachasidecha tzadikim osei r’tzonecha, v’chol am’cha beit Yisra’el b’rina yodu vivar’chu vishab’chu vifa’aru vishor’ru viromemu v’ya’aritzu v’yakdishu v’yamlichu et shimcha malkeinu tamid. Ki l’cha tov l’hodot ul’shimcha na’eh l’zamer, ki me’olam v’ad olam ata El.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מֶֽלֶךְ מְהֻלָּל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת:
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, melech m’hulal batishbachot.

blocks.en: All Your works shall praise You, Eternal our God; and Your faithful — the just who do Your will — and all Your people, the house of Israel, will joyfully give thanks, bless, praise, glorify, sing, exalt, revere, sanctify, and declare the oneness of Your name, always. For to You it is good to give thanks, and to Your name fitting to sing — for from world to world, You are God.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, sung in praises.

sources.name: Kiddusha Rabbah
aliases: The "great Kiddush" of Shabbat morning — two words of Torah on the seventh day, and the cup.
