blocks.tr: Ha’El hagadol hagibor v’hanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, v’koneh hakol, v’zocher chasdei avot v’imahot, umevi go’el livnei v’neihem l’ma’an sh’mo b’ahava.

blocks.he: זָכְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים, מֶלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים, וְכָתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים, לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים.
blocks.tr: Zochreinu l’chayim, melech chafetz bachayim, v’chotveinu b’sefer hachayim, l’ma’ancha Elohim chayim.

blocks.he: מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם וְעֶזְרַת שָׂרָה.
blocks.tr: Melech ozer umoshi’a umagen. Baruch ata Adonai, magen Avraham v’ezrat Sara.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, God of our ancestors — God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; God of Sarah, God of Rebecca, God of Leah, God of Rachel, God of Bilhah, and God of Zilpah.

Great, mighty, and awesome God, God Most High, who acts with love, who creates all, who remembers the faithfulness of our ancestors, and who lovingly brings redemption to their children’s children for the sake of Your Name.
Remember us for life, You who delight in life, and write us in the Book of Life — for Your own sake, Source of life.
You are our help, our rescue, our shield. Blessed are You, Eternal One, shield of Abraham and help of Sarah.

Who is like You, Source of mercy, who in compassion remembers Your

blocks.he: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ. מוֹרִיד הַטָּל.
blocks.tr: Ata gibor l’olam Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/meitim ata, rav l’hoshi’a. Morid hatal.

blocks.he: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים, סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים, וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת, וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה.
blocks.tr: M’chalkel chayim b’chesed, m’chayeh hakol/meitim b’rachamim rabim, somech nof’lim, v’rofe cholim, umatir asurim, umkayem emunato lishenei afar. Mi chamocha ba’al g’vurot, umi domeh lach, melech memit umchayeh umatzmi’ach y’shu’a.

blocks.en: You are forever mighty; You give life to all / revive the dead, and Your saving power is great. You cause the dew to fall. You sustain the living with love, giving life to all / reviving the dead with great compassion; You hold up the falling, heal the sick, free the captive, and keep faith with those who sleep in the dust.

blocks.he: מִי כָמוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים, זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לְחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים.
blocks.tr: Mi chamocha av harachamim, zocher y’tzurav l’chayim b’rachamim.

blocks.en: Who is like You, Source of mercy, who in compassion remembers Your creatures for life?

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת הַכֹּל/מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/הַמֵּתִים.
blocks.tr: V’ne’eman ata l’hachayot hakol/meitim. Baruch ata Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/hameitim.

blocks.en: Who is like You, Source of all power? Who can compare — You who bring death and life, and make rescue blossom? You are faithful to give life to all / to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who gives life to all / who revives the dead.

sources.name: K’dushat HaShem
aliases: A blessing of the Name, for a world governed by mercy.

blocks.he: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ, וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל יוֹם יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה.
blocks.tr: Ata kadosh v’shimcha kadosh, ukdoshim b’chol yom y’hal’lucha sela.

blocks.en: You are holy, and Your Name is holy, and those who seek holiness praise You every day.

sources.name: Uv’chein
aliases: Awe and hope for a world made whole.

And so: set the awe of You, Eternal our God, over all
וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יְיָ לְעַמֶּךָ, תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶיךָ וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶׁיךָ וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה

And so: give honor, Eternal One, to Your people, praise to those
וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹזוּ, וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִילוּ, וְעוֹלָתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּיהָ,
Uvchein tzadikim yir’u v’yismachu, visharim ya’alozu, vachasidim b’rina yagilu, v’olata tikpotz piha,

blocks.he: וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ. וְיִירָאוּךָ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים, וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם. כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַעְנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁהַשִּׁלְטוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ, עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶךָ, וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ.
blocks.tr: Uvchein ten pachd’cha Adonai Eloheinu al kol ma’asecha, v’eimat’cha al kol ma shebarata. V’yira’ucha kol hama’asim v’yishtachavu l’fanecha kol hab’ru’im, v’ye’asu chulam aguda achat la’asot r’tzon’cha b’levav shalem. K’mo sheyadanu Adonai Eloheinu shehashilton l’fanecha, oz b’yad’cha ugvura biminecha, v’shimcha nora al kol ma shebarata.

blocks.en: And so: set the awe of You, Eternal our God, over all You have made, and the awe of You over all You have created — that every made thing hold You in awe and all creatures bow before You, and that they all become one company, to do Your will with a whole heart. For we know, Eternal our God, that the governing is Yours: strength in Your hand and power in Your right hand, and Your Name is awesome over all You have made.

blocks.he: וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יְיָ לְעַמֶּךָ, תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶיךָ וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶׁיךָ וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה לַמְיַחֲלִים לָךְ. שִׂמְחָה לְאַרְצֶךָ וְשָׂשׂוֹן לְעִירֶךָ, וּצְמִיחַת קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדֶּךָ וַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחֶךָ, בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Uvchein ten kavod Adonai l’amecha, t’hila lire’echa v’tikva tova l’dor’shecha ufitchon peh lamyachalim lach. Simcha l’artzecha v’sason l’irecha, utzmichat keren l’David avdecha va’arichat ner l’ven Yishai m’shichecha, bimheira v’yameinu.

blocks.en: And so: give honor, Eternal One, to Your people, praise to those who hold You in awe and good hope to those who seek You, and an open mouth to those who wait for You — joy to Your land and gladness to Your city, and the flowering of new strength for the line of David Your servant, soon, in our own days.

blocks.he: וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹזוּ, וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִילוּ, וְעוֹלָתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּיהָ, וְכָל הָרִשְׁעָה כֻּלָּהּ כְּעָשָׁן תִּכְלֶה, כִּי תַעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן הָאָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Uvchein tzadikim yir’u v’yismachu, visharim ya’alozu, vachasidim b’rina yagilu, v’olata tikpotz piha, v’chol harish’a kula k’ashan tichleh, ki ta’avir memshelet zadon min ha’aretz.

blocks.he: וְתִמְלוֹךְ אַתָּה יְיָ לְבַדֶּךָ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, בְּהַר צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ, וּבִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ: יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם, אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר, הַלְלוּיָהּ.
blocks.tr: V’timloch ata Adonai l’vadecha al kol ma’asecha, b’har Tziyon mishkan k’vodecha, uvirushalayim ir kodshecha, kakatuv b’divrei kodshecha: yimloch Adonai l’olam, Elohayich Tziyon l’dor vador, hal’luyah.

blocks.en: And so: the just will see and be glad, the upright will rejoice, the faithful will delight in song — and wrongdoing will shut its mouth, and all wickedness will vanish like smoke, when You clear the rule of arrogance from the earth. And You alone, Eternal One, will be the Oneness over all You have made, on Mount Zion, the dwelling of Your glory, and in Yerushalayim, Your holy city — as it is written: The Eternal will reign forever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.

blocks.he: קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֶךָ, וְאֵין אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ. כַּכָּתוּב: וַיִּגְבַּהּ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט, וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדָּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה.
blocks.tr: Kadosh ata v'nora sh'mecha, v'ein eloah mibal'adecha. Kakatuv: vayigbah Adonai tz'va'ot bamishpat, v'ha'El hakadosh nikdash bitzdaka.

blocks.en: You are holy, and Your Name inspires awe, and there is no god but You — as it is written: “the Source of all being is exalted through justice, and the holy God is hallowed through righteousness.” (Isaiah 5:16)
Blessed are You, Eternal One, the holy Sovereign.

sources.name: K’dushat HaYom
aliases: The blessing that names the day: Yom HaZikaron, the Day of Remembrance.
openingWords: אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים. אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ. וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת. וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ

You chose us from among all peoples, and loved us, and wanted

Vatiten lanu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava (et yom haShabbat hazeh v’) et yom
And You gave us, Eternal our God, in love (this Shabbat day
אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא וְיַגִּיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר

blocks.he: אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים. אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ. וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת. וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ. וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ. וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ.
blocks.tr: Ata v’chartanu mikol ha’amim, ahavta otanu v’ratzita banu, v’romamtanu mikol hal’shonot, v’kidashtanu b’mitzvotecha, v’keiravtanu malkeinu la’avodatecha, v’shimcha hagadol v’hakadosh aleinu karata.

blocks.en: You chose us from among all peoples, and loved us, and wanted us; You lifted us up among all tongues and made us holy through Your mitzvot, and drew us near to Your service, and called Your great and holy Name over us.
Motza’ei Shabbat: Vatodi’einu is at the back — p. .

blocks.he: וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה (אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְ) אֶת יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה, יוֹם (זִכְרוֹן) תְּרוּעָה (בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ, זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם.
blocks.tr: Vatiten lanu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava (et yom haShabbat hazeh v’) et yom haZikaron hazeh, yom (zichron) t’ru’a (b’ahava) mikra kodesh, zecher litzi’at Mitzrayim.

blocks.en: And You gave us, Eternal our God, in love (this Shabbat day and) this Day of Remembrance — a day of (the remembrance of) the shofar-blast (in love), a holy calling, a remembrance of the going-out from Egypt.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא וְיַגִּיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר זִכְרוֹנֵנוּ וּפִקְדוֹנֵנוּ, וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ, וְזִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפָנֶיךָ, לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה, לְחֵן וּלְחֶסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים, לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם בְּיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה. זָכְרֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה, וּפָקְדֵנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים. וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים חוּס וְחָנֵּנוּ, וְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ, כִּי אֵלֶיךָ עֵינֵינוּ, כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה.
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, ya’aleh v’yavo v’yagia v’yera’eh v’yeratzeh v’yishama v’yipaked v’yizacher zichroneinu ufikdoneinu, v’zichron avoteinu v’imoteinu, v’zichron mashiach ben David avdecha, v’zichron Yerushalayim ir kodshecha, v’zichron kol am’cha beit Yisra’el l’fanecha, lifleita l’tova, l’chein ulchesed ulrachamim, l’chayim ulshalom b’yom haZikaron hazeh. Zochreinu Adonai Eloheinu bo l’tova, ufokdeinu vo livracha, v’hoshi’einu vo l’chayim. Uvidvar y’shu’a v’rachamim chus v’chaneinu, v’rachem aleinu v’hoshi’einu. Ki eilecha eineinu, ki El melech chanun v’rachum ata.

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors: may there rise and come, reach and be seen, be wanted and heard, counted and remembered — the remembrance of us and of our ancestors, and the remembrance of the anointed one of the house of David Your servant, and the remembrance of Yerushalayim Your holy city, and of all Your people the house of Yisrael — for deliverance and good, for grace and love and mercy, for life and peace, on this Day of Remembrance. Remember us on it for good; take account of us for blessing; save us for life. And with a word of rescue and mercy, spare us and be gracious to us; have compassion on us and save us. For our eyes are turned to You — You are God, gracious and merciful.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, מְלוֹךְ עַל כָּל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בִּכְבוֹדֶךָ, וְהִנָּשֵׂא עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בִּיקָרֶךָ, וְהוֹפַע בַּהֲדַר גְּאוֹן עֻזֶּךָ עַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל אַרְצֶךָ. וְיֵדַע כָּל פָּעוּל כִּי אַתָּה פְעַלְתּוֹ, וְיָבִין כָּל יְצוּר כִּי אַתָּה יְצַרְתּוֹ, וְיֹאמַר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׁמָה בְאַפּוֹ: יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶלֶךְ, וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה.
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, m’loch al kol ha’olam kulo bichvodecha, v’hinasei al kol ha’aretz bikarecha, v’hofa bahadar g’on uzecha al kol yoshvei tevel artzecha. V’yeda kol pa’ul ki ata f’alto, v’yavin kol y’tzur ki ata y’tzarto, v’yomar kol asher n’shama v’apo: Adonai Elohei Yisra’el melech, umalchuto bakol mashala.

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors: let Your glory fill all the world; be lifted up over all the earth in Your splendor; shine out in the majesty of Your strength over all who dwell on the earth You made — and let every made thing know that You made it, and every creature understand that You formed it, and all that breathes say: HaShem, God of Yisrael, is One, and that Oneness holds all things.

blocks.he: (אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ.) קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, (וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְיָנוּחוּ בוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ,) וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת, וּדְבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד.
blocks.tr: (Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu r’tzeh vimnuchateinu.) Kad’sheinu b’mitzvotecha v’ten chelkeinu b’toratecha, sab’einu mituvecha v’samcheinu bishu’atecha, (v’hanchileinu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava uvratzon Shabbat kodshecha, v’yanuchu vo Yisra’el m’kad’shei sh’mecha,) v’taher libeinu l’ovd’cha be’emet, ki ata Elohim emet, ud’varcha emet v’kayam la’ad.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ)יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, melech al kol ha’aretz, m’kadesh (haShabbat v’)Yisra’el v’Yom haZikaron.

blocks.en: (Our God and God of our ancestors, take pleasure in our rest.) Make us holy through Your mitzvot and give us our portion in Your Torah; fill us with Your goodness and gladden us with Your saving help; (in love and favor, grant us Your holy Shabbat as our inheritance, and let Yisrael, who make Your Name holy, rest on it;) and make our hearts pure to serve You in truth — for You are the God of truth, and Your word is truth, enduring forever. Blessed are You, Eternal One over all the earth, who makes holy (Shabbat and) Yisrael and the Day of Remembrance.

וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן.

blocks.tr: R’tzeh Adonai Eloheinu b’am’cha Yisra’el. Utfilatam b’ahava t’kabel b’ratzon, ut’hi l’ratzon tamid avodat Yisra’el amecha. El karov l’chol kor’av, p’neh el avadecha v’chaneinu. Sh’foch ruchacha aleinu,

blocks.he: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן.

blocks.en: Take pleasure, Eternal our God, in Your people Yisrael and in their prayer; in love receive that prayer with favor, and may the service of Your people Yisrael always be, in truth, for the good. God near to all who call, turn to those who serve You, and be gracious to us. Pour out Your spirit upon us.
May our eyes behold Your loving return to Zion. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who returns Your presence to Zion.

sources.name: Modim
aliases: A blessing of gratitude and a plea that we be written for a good life.
openingWords: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
Modim anachnu lach, sha’ata hu Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu l’olam va’ed.
הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ, מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ
Hatov ki lo chalu rachamecha, v’hamrachem ki lo tamu chasadecha, me’olam kivinu
וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים
V’al kulam yitbarach v’yitromam shimcha malkeinu tamid l’olam va’ed. Uch’tov l’chayim tovim
וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶּלָה.
V’chol hachayim yoducha sela, vihal’lu et shimcha be’emet, ha’El y’shu’ateinu v’ezrateinu sela.

blocks.he: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. צוּר חַיֵּינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר. נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם.
blocks.tr: Modim anachnu lach, sha’ata hu Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu l’olam va’ed. Tzur chayeinu, magen yish’einu ata hu l’dor vador. Nodeh l’cha unsaper t’hilatecha, al chayeinu ham’surim b’yadecha, v’al nishmoteinu hap’kudot lach, v’al nisecha sheb’chol yom imanu, v’al nifl’otecha v’tovotecha sheb’chol et, erev vavoker v’tzohorayim.

blocks.he: הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ, מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ.
blocks.tr: Hatov ki lo chalu rachamecha, v’hamrachem ki lo tamu chasadecha, me’olam kivinu lach.

blocks.he: וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: V’al kulam yitbarach v’yitromam shimcha malkeinu tamid l’olam va’ed. Uch’tov l’chayim tovim kol b’nei v’ritecha.

blocks.he: וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶּלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת.
blocks.tr: V’chol hachayim yoducha sela, vihal’lu et shimcha be’emet, ha’El y’shu’ateinu v’ezrateinu sela. Baruch ata Adonai, hatov shimcha ulcha na’eh l’hodot.

blocks.en: We thank You, for You are the One, our God and the God of our ancestors, forever. Rock of our life, shield of our rescue — so You are, in every generation. We give thanks and tell Your praise: for our lives, held in Your hand; for our souls, entrusted to You; for Your miracles that are with us every day; and for Your wonders and Your gifts at every moment — evening, morning, and noon.
You are the Good, whose mercies never end; the Compassionate, whose kindnesses never fail, forever we have placed our hope in You.

For all these things may Your Name be blessed and raised up, always and forever. And write down for a good life all the children of Your covenant. Let all that lives give thanks to You, and praise Your Name in truth, God of our rescue and our help. Blessed are You, Eternal One, whose Name is Goodness, and to whom thanks are due.

blocks.he: שָׁלוֹם רָב עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ תָּשִׂים לְעוֹלָם, כִּי אַתָּה הוּא מֶלֶךְ אָדוֹן לְכָל הַשָּׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל עֵת וּבְכָל שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Shalom rav al Yisra’el am’cha tasim l’olam, ki ata hu melech adon l’chol hashalom. V’tov b’einecha l’varech et am’cha Yisra’el b’chol et uvchol sha’a bishlomecha.

blocks.he: בְּסֵפֶר חַיִּים, בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם, וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה, נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶיךָ, אֲנַחְנוּ וְכָל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם.
blocks.tr: B’sefer chayim, b’racha v’shalom, ufarnasa tova, nizacher v’nikatev l’fanecha, anachnu v’chol am’cha beit Yisra’el, l’chayim tovim ulshalom.

blocks.en: Grant abundant peace to Your people Yisrael forever, for You are the Source of all peace. May it be good in Your eyes to bless Your people Yisrael, in every season and at every hour, with Your peace.
May we all be written in the book of life, for blessing, for peace, and for a good living: us, and all Your people, Yisrael, for a good life and for shalom.
Blessed are You, Adonai, who calls us to create a world of peace.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהַי, נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע, וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה. פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדֹּף נַפְשִׁי.
blocks.tr: Elohai, n’tzor l’shoni mera, usfatai midaber mirma, v’limkal’lai nafshi tidom, v’nafshi ke’afar lakol tihyeh. P’tach libi b’toratecha, uvmitzvotecha tirdof nafshi.

blocks.he: וְכֹל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ, הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי.
blocks.tr: V’chol hachosh’vim alai ra’a, m’hera hafer atzatam v’kalkel machashavtam. Aseh l’ma’an sh’mecha, aseh l’ma’an y’minecha, aseh l’ma’an k’dushatecha, aseh l’ma’an toratecha. L’ma’an yechal’tzun y’didecha, hoshi’a y’min’cha va’aneni.

blocks.he: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי.
blocks.tr: Yihyu l’ratzon imrei fi v’hegyon libi l’fanecha, Adonai tzuri v’go’ali.

blocks.he: עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh hashalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit. To those who curse me, let my soul stay silent; let my soul be humble as the dust before all. Open my heart to Your Torah, that my soul may pursue Your mitzvot.

And all who plan evil against me — quickly undo their designs and unravel their schemes. Act for the sake of Your Name; act for the sake of Your right hand; act for the sake of Your holiness; act for the sake of Your Torah. That those You love may be freed, let Your right hand save — answer me.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Eternal One, my Rock and my Redeemer.
May the One who makes the peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Yisrael, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.
On Shabbat: Vayechulu and Me’ein Sheva are at the back — p. .

sources.name: Kaddish Shalem
aliases: The Full Kaddish — its one added line, titkabel, asks that all we have prayed be received, sealing the Amidah.
openingWords: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן
Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.
יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu,
May the great Name be made great and holy in the world
May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵלָּא וּלְעֵלָּא מִכָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’eila ul’eila mikol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great Name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Yisrael, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the Name of the Holy One of blessing — far, far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

blocks.he: תִּתְקַבֵּל צְלוֹתְהוֹן וּבָעוּתְהוֹן דְּכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁמַיָּא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Titkabel tz’lot’hon uva’ut’hon d’chol beit Yisra’el kodam avuhon di vishmaya, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: Receive the prayers and pleas of all the house of Yisrael before the One in heaven — and say: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא, וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’lama raba min sh’maya, v’chayim aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh hashalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May great peace from heaven, and life, be upon us and upon all Yisrael — and say: Amen. May the One who makes the peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Yisrael, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Aleinu
aliases: Born as a coronation song, a fantasy of power spoken from powerlessness.
openingWords: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת
Aleinu l’shabeach la’adon hakol, latet g’dula l’yotzer b’reshit, shelo asanu k’goyei ha’aratzot,
It is upon us to acknowledge the Oneness of Creation, and to
שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי
Shehu noteh shamayim v’yosed aretz, umoshav y’karo bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo b’govhei
The heavens stretched wide, the earth set on its foundations, glory and
עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים
Al ken n’kaveh l’cha Adonai Eloheinu, lir’ot m’hera b’tif’eret uzecha, l’ha’avir gilulim

blocks.he: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם. וַאֲנַחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
blocks.tr: Aleinu l’shabeach la’adon hakol, latet g’dula l’yotzer b’reshit, shelo asanu k’goyei ha’aratzot, v’lo samanu k’mishp’chot ha’adama; shelo sam chelkeinu kahem, v’goraleinu k’chol hamonam. Va’anachnu °kor’im umishtachavim umodim, lifnei melech malchei ham’lachim, haKadosh baruch hu.

blocks.en: It is upon us to acknowledge the Oneness of Creation, and to celebrate the majesty of it all — we who were not made like the nations of the lands, nor set like the families of the earth; whose portion is not theirs, whose lot is our own. And so we bend, and bow, and give thanks before what is beyond every power, the Holy One of blessing.

blocks.he: שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים. הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּנוּ אֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ, כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת, אֵין עוֹד.
blocks.tr: Shehu noteh shamayim v’yosed aretz, umoshav y’karo bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo b’govhei m’romim. Hu Eloheinu ein od, emet malkeinu efes zulato, kakatuv b’torato: v’yadata hayom vahashevota el l’vavecha, ki Adonai hu ha’Elohim bashamayim mima’al v’al ha’aretz mitachat, ein od.

blocks.en: The heavens stretched wide, the earth set on its foundations, glory and strength filling the highest heights — this is our God; there is no other. As it is written in the Torah: Know this day and take it to heart, that the Eternal is God in the heavens above and on the earth below; there is no other.

blocks.he: עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן, לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי. וְכָל בְּנֵי בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶךָ, לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶיךָ כָּל רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Al ken n’kaveh l’cha Adonai Eloheinu, lir’ot m’hera b’tif’eret uzecha, l’ha’avir gilulim min ha’aretz, v’ha’elilim karot yikaretun, l’taken olam b’malchut Shaddai. V’chol b’nei vasar yikr’u vishmecha, l’hafnot eilecha kol rish’ei aretz.

blocks.he: יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל כִּי לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל בֶּרֶךְ, תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל לָשׁוֹן. לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפֹּלוּ, וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּנוּ, וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם אֶת עֹל מַלְכוּתֶךָ, וְתִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ: יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Yakiru v’yed’u kol yosh’vei tevel, ki l’cha tichra kol berech, tishava kol lashon. L’fanecha Adonai Eloheinu yichr’u v’yipolu, v’lichvod shimcha y’kar yitenu, vikab’lu chulam et ol malchutecha, v’timloch aleihem m’hera l’olam va’ed. Ki hamalchut shel’cha hi, ul’olmei ad timloch b’chavod, kakatuv b’toratecha: Adonai yimloch l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמַר: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד.
blocks.tr: V’ne’emar: v’haya Adonai l’melech al kol ha’aretz, bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad ushmo echad.

blocks.en: And so we hope in You, the Eternal our God: soon to see the splendor of Your strength, when every idol and false god is swept from the earth, and the world is mended whole in the oneness of the Almighty. All who live will call on Your Name, and earth’s wrongdoers will turn back to You. Let the world come to know that every knee bends and every tongue swears true before You. Before You, Eternal our God, may all bow low, honor Your Name, and take on together the obligation of Oneness, soon and always. All is Yours, and forever You endure in glory, as it is written in Your Torah: The Eternal will reign forever and ever. And it is said: the Eternal shall be sovereign over all the earth; on that day the Eternal shall be One, and the Name One.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא, לְעֵלָּא וּלְעֵלָּא מִכָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’eila ul’eila mikol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא, וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’lama raba min sh’maya, v’chayim aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh hashalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great Name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Yisrael, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the Name of the Holy One of blessing — far, far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

May great peace from heaven, and life, be upon us and upon all Yisrael — and say: Amen. May the One who makes the peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Yisrael, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Psalm 27
aliases: L’David — the psalm of the season, said morning and evening from Elul through Sukkot: one thing I ask.
openingWords: לְדָוִד יְיָ אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא, יְיָ מָעוֹז־חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָד. בִּקְרֹב עָלַי
L’David. Adonai ori v’yish’i, mimi ira? Adonai ma’oz chayai, mimi efchad? Bikrov
Of David. The Eternal is my light and my rescue — whom
אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְיָ אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ, שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְיָ כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי, לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְיָ וּלְבַקֵּר
Achat sha’alti me’et Adonai, otah avakesh: shivti b’veit Adonai kol y’mei chayai,
One thing I ask of the Eternal — only this do I
וְעַתָּה יָרוּם רֹאשִׁי עַל אֹיְבַי סְבִיבוֹתַי, וְאֶזְבְּחָה בְאָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵי תְרוּעָה, אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה
V’ata yarum roshi al oy’vai s’vivotai, v’ezb’cha v’oholo zivchei t’ru’a, ashira va’azam’ra

blocks.he: לְדָוִד יְיָ אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא, יְיָ מָעוֹז־חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָד. בִּקְרֹב עָלַי מְרֵעִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי, צָרַי וְאֹיְבַי לִי, הֵמָּה כָשְׁלוּ וְנָפָלוּ. אִם־תַּחֲנֶה עָלַי מַחֲנֶה לֹא־יִירָא לִבִּי, אִם־תָּקוּם עָלַי מִלְחָמָה, בְּזֹאת אֲנִי בוֹטֵחַ.
blocks.tr: L’David. Adonai ori v’yish’i, mimi ira? Adonai ma’oz chayai, mimi efchad? Bikrov alai m’re’im le’echol et b’sari, tzarai v’oy’vai li, hema chashlu v’nafalu. Im tachaneh alai machaneh, lo yira libi; im takum alai milchama, b’zot ani voteach.

blocks.en: Of David. The Eternal is my light and my rescue — whom should I fear? The Eternal is the stronghold of my life — whom should I dread? When evildoers close in on me to devour my flesh — my foes, my enemies — it is they who stumble and fall. Though an army encamp against me, my heart will not fear; though war rise up against me — even then, I trust.

blocks.he: אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְיָ אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ, שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְיָ כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי, לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְיָ וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ. כִּי יִצְפְּנֵנִי בְּסֻכֹּה בְּיוֹם רָעָה, יַסְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵתֶר אָהֳלוֹ, בְּצוּר יְרוֹמְמֵנִי.
blocks.tr: Achat sha’alti me’et Adonai, otah avakesh: shivti b’veit Adonai kol y’mei chayai, lachazot b’no’am Adonai ulvaker b’heichalo. Ki yitzp’neni b’suko b’yom ra’a, yastireni b’seter oholo, b’tzur y’rom’meni.

blocks.en: One thing I ask of the Eternal — only this do I seek: to live in the house of the Eternal all the days of my life, to gaze on the sweetness of the Eternal, and to linger in that sanctuary. For on the day of trouble the Eternal will hide me in a sukkah, conceal me in the shelter of that tent, set me high upon a rock.

blocks.he: וְעַתָּה יָרוּם רֹאשִׁי עַל אֹיְבַי סְבִיבוֹתַי, וְאֶזְבְּחָה בְאָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵי תְרוּעָה, אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה לַיְיָ.
blocks.tr: V’ata yarum roshi al oy’vai s’vivotai, v’ezb’cha v’oholo zivchei t’ru’a, ashira va’azam’ra la’Adonai.

blocks.en: And now my head is lifted high, above the enemies around me. In that tent I will bring offerings with shouts of joy — I will sing, I will make music to the Eternal.

blocks.he: שְׁמַע־יְיָ קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא, וְחָנֵּנִי וַעֲנֵנִי. לְךָ אָמַר לִבִּי בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָי, אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ יְיָ אֲבַקֵּשׁ. אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי, אַל תַּט־בְּאַף עַבְדֶּךָ, עֶזְרָתִי הָיִיתָ, אַל־תִּטְּשֵׁנִי וְאַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי, אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי.
blocks.tr: Sh’ma Adonai koli ekra, v’choneni va’aneni. L’cha amar libi bak’shu fanai, et panecha Adonai avakesh. Al taster panecha mimeni, al tat b’af avdecha; ezrati hayita, al tit’sheni v’al ta’azveni, Elohei yish’i.

blocks.en: Hear my voice, Eternal One, when I call; be gracious to me, and answer me. My heart hears You say: “Seek My face.” Your face, Eternal One, is what I seek. Do not hide Your face from me; do not turn Your servant away in anger. You have been my help — do not cast me off, do not abandon me, God of my rescue.

blocks.he: כִּי־אָבִי וְאִמִּי עֲזָבוּנִי, וַיְיָ יַאַסְפֵנִי. הוֹרֵנִי יְיָ דַּרְכֶּךָ, וּנְחֵנִי בְּאֹרַח מִישׁוֹר, לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי. אַל־תִּתְּנֵנִי בְּנֶפֶשׁ צָרָי, כִּי קָמוּ־בִי עֵדֵי־שֶׁקֶר, וִיפֵחַ חָמָס.
blocks.tr: Ki avi v’imi azavuni, va’Adonai ya’asfeni. Horeni Adonai darkecha, uncheni b’orach mishor, l’ma’an shor’rai. Al tit’neni b’nefesh tzarai, ki kamu vi edei sheker, vifeach chamas.

blocks.en: Though my ancestors abandon me, the Eternal will gather me in. Teach me Your way, Eternal One; lead me on a level path, because of those who lie in wait for me. Do not hand me over to the will of my foes — false witnesses have risen against me, breathing out violence.

blocks.he: לוּלֵא הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּטוּב־יְיָ בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים.
blocks.tr: Lulei he’emanti lir’ot b’tuv Adonai b’eretz chayim.

blocks.en: If I had not trusted that I would see the goodness of the Eternal in the land of the living —

blocks.he: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְיָ, חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ, וְקַוֵּה אֶל־יְיָ.
blocks.tr: Kaveh el Adonai, chazak v’ya’ametz libecha, v’kaveh el Adonai.

blocks.en: Hope in the Eternal. Be strong, and let your heart take courage — and hope in the Eternal.

sources.name: Birkat Kohanim
aliases: Birkat Kohanim, the traditional blessing of the priests.
openingWords: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה
Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, bar’cheinu bab’racha ham’shuleshet baTorah, hak’tuva al y’dei Moshe
Our God and God of our ancestors — bless us with the
יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ, הָאֲמוּרָה מִפִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו כֹּהֲנִים עַם קְדוֹשֶׁךָ, כָּאָמוּר:
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, bar’cheinu bab’racha ham’shuleshet baTorah, hak’tuva al y’dei Moshe avdecha, ha’amura mipi Aharon uvanav kohanim am k’doshecha, ka’amur:

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors — bless us with the threefold blessing of the Torah, written by the hand of Moses Your servant, spoken by Aaron and his sons, the priests, Your holy people, as it is said:

blocks.he: יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
blocks.tr: Yisa Adonai panav eilecha v’yasem l’cha shalom.

blocks.en: May the Eternal bless you and keep you. May the Holy One’s face shine upon you and be gracious to you. May HaShem’s face turn toward you and grant you peace.

sources.name: Adon Olam
aliases: The service ends the way it began: in song, the melody carrying us out, night after night.

Adon olam asher malach, b’terem kol y’tzir nivra. L’et na’asa v’cheftzo kol,

V’acharei kichlot hakol, l’vado yimloch nora. V’hu haya v’hu hoveh, v’hu yihyeh
וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּירָה. בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ
V’hu echad v’ein sheni, l’hamshil lo l’hachbira. B’li reshit b’li tachlit, v’lo
וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה. וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי,
V’hu Eli v’chai go’ali, v’tzur chevli b’et tzara. V’hu nisi umanos li,

blocks.he: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא. לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא.
blocks.tr: Adon olam asher malach, b’terem kol y’tzir nivra. L’et na’asa v’cheftzo kol, azai melech sh’mo nikra.

blocks.he: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא. וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה.
blocks.tr: V’acharei kichlot hakol, l’vado yimloch nora. V’hu haya v’hu hoveh, v’hu yihyeh b’tif’ara.

blocks.he: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּירָה. בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה.
blocks.tr: V’hu echad v’ein sheni, l’hamshil lo l’hachbira. B’li reshit b’li tachlit, v’lo ha’oz v’hamisra.

blocks.he: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה. וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא.
blocks.tr: V’hu Eli v’chai go’ali, v’tzur chevli b’et tzara. V’hu nisi umanos li, m’nat kosi b’yom ekra.

blocks.he: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִירָה. וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, יְיָ לִי וְלֹא אִירָא.
blocks.tr: B’yado afkid ruchi, b’et ishan v’a’ira. V’im ruchi g’viyati, Adonai li v’lo ira.

blocks.en: Eternal One of all, who was before any form was created; when all was made by Your will, then was Your name made known. And after all has ceased to be, You alone endure, beyond all awe. You were, You are, You will be in glory.

You are One; there is no second to compare or set beside You. Without beginning, without end — Yours is the strength, and Yours all that is. You are my God, my living Redeemer, my Rock in time of trouble; my banner, my refuge, the portion of my cup on the day I call.
Into Your hand I entrust my spirit, when I sleep and when I wake; and with my spirit, my body too — the Eternal is with me, I will not fear.

sources.name: Kiddush
aliases: Over a full cup we sanctify the day — Yom HaZikaron — and bless our arrival at a new year.
openingWords: On Shabbat the Kiddush opens with Vayechulu — p. .

Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, Creator of
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר בָּנוּ מִכָּל עָם וְרוֹמְמָנוּ

Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who chose
וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה (אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְ) אֶת יוֹם

blocks.en: On Shabbat the Kiddush opens with Vayechulu — p. .

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הַגָּפֶן.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha’olam, borei p’ri hagafen.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, Creator of the fruit of the vine.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר בָּנוּ מִכָּל עָם וְרוֹמְמָנוּ מִכָּל לָשׁוֹן, וְקִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha’olam, asher bachar banu mikol am v’rom’manu mikol lashon, v’kid’shanu b’mitzvotav.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who chose us from among all peoples, lifted us up among all tongues, and made us holy with Your mitzvot.

blocks.he: וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה (אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְ) אֶת יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה, יוֹם (זִכְרוֹן) תְּרוּעָה (בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ, זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם.
blocks.tr: Vatiten lanu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava (et yom haShabbat hazeh v’) et yom haZikaron hazeh, yom (zichron) t’ru’a (b’ahava) mikra kodesh, zecher litzi’at Mitzrayim.

blocks.en: The lines in parentheses are added when the first night falls on Shabbat.

And You gave us, Eternal our God, in love, (this Shabbat day and) this Day of Remembrance — a day of (the remembrance of) the shofar-blast (in love), a holy calling, a remembrance of the going-out from Egypt.

blocks.he: כִּי בָנוּ בָחַרְתָּ וְאוֹתָנוּ קִדַּשְׁתָּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, וּדְבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ)יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן.
blocks.tr: Ki vanu vacharta v’otanu kidashta mikol ha’amim, ud’varcha emet v’kayam la’ad. Baruch ata Adonai, melech al kol ha’aretz, m’kadesh (haShabbat v’)Yisra’el v’Yom haZikaron.

blocks.en: For You chose us and made us holy from among all peoples, and Your word is truth, enduring forever. Blessed are You, Eternal One over all the earth, who makes holy (Shabbat and) Yisrael and the Day of Remembrance.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁהֶחֱיָנוּ וְקִיְּמָנוּ וְהִגִּיעָנוּ לַזְּמַן הַזֶּה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha’olam, shehecheyanu v’kiy’manu v’higi’anu lazman hazeh.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who has kept us alive, sustained us, and brought us to this moment.
Motza’ei Shabbat: Havdalah, p. .

blocks.he: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ שֶׁתְּחַדֵּשׁ עָלֵינוּ שָׁנָה טוֹבָה וּמְתוּקָה.
blocks.tr: Y’hi ratzon mil’fanecha shet’chadesh aleinu shana tova umtuka.

blocks.en: May it be Your will — renew for us a good and sweet year.

sources.name: Hineni
aliases: Before the day’s first blessing, a traditional moment of humility.

Hineni he’ani mima’as, nir’ash v’nifchad mipachad yoshev t’hilot Yisra’el. Bati la’amod ulhitchanen

כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלַּת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלָּה.
Ki ata shomea t’filat am’cha Yisra’el b’rachamim. Baruch ata shomea t’fila.
For You are the One who hears the prayer of Your people
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ לְהִתְעַטֵּף בַּצִּיצִית.
Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, asher kid’shanu b’mitzvotav v’tzivanu l’hit’atef batzitzit.

blocks.he: הִנְנִי הֶעָנִי מִמַּֽעַשׂ, נִרְעַשׁ וְנִפְחַד מִפַּֽחַד יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל. בָּֽאתִי לַעֲמֹד וּלְהִתְחַנֵּן לְפָנֶֽיךָ עַל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחֽוּנִי, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינִי כְּדַאי וְהָגוּן לְכָךְ.
blocks.tr: Hineni he’ani mima’as, nir’ash v’nifchad mipachad yoshev t’hilot Yisra’el. Bati la’amod ulhitchanen l’fanecha al am’cha Yisra’el asher sh’lachuni, af al pi she’eini k’dai v’hagun l’chach.

blocks.en: Here I am — poor in deeds, shaken and afraid before the One who dwells in the praises of Yisrael. I have come to stand and plead before You, on behalf of Your people Yisrael who have sent me — even though I am not worthy of it, not the right one for this.

blocks.he: כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלַּת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלָּה.
blocks.tr: Ki ata shomea t’filat am’cha Yisra’el b’rachamim. Baruch ata shomea t’fila.

blocks.en: For You are the One who hears the prayer of Your people Yisrael in mercy. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who hears prayer.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ לְהִתְעַטֵּף בַּצִּיצִית.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, asher kid’shanu b’mitzvotav v’tzivanu l’hit’atef batzitzit.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who calls us toward holiness as we wrap ourselves in the fringed tallit.

sources.name: Hareini
aliases: We begin, as we do every morning, with gratitude.
openingWords: הֲרֵינִי מְקַבֵּל / מְקַבֶּלֶת עָלַי מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה שֶׁל וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמֽוֹךָ
Hareini m’kabeil / m’kabelet alai mitzvat aseih shel v’ahavta l’reiacha kamocha.
Before I say a word, I take this on: to love my
לֹא־תִקֹּם וְלֹא־תִטֹּר אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ, אֲנִי יְיָ.
Lo tikom v’lo titor et b’nei amecha, v’ahavta l’re’acha kamocha — ani
Do not take revenge, and do not hold a grudge against the

blocks.he: הֲרֵינִי מְקַבֵּל / מְקַבֶּלֶת עָלַי מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה שֶׁל וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמֽוֹךָ
blocks.tr: Hareini m’kabeil / m’kabelet alai mitzvat aseih shel v’ahavta l’reiacha kamocha.

blocks.en: Before I say a word, I take this on: to love my neighbor as myself. Nothing I am about to pray, I pray alone.

blocks.he: לֹא־תִקֹּם וְלֹא־תִטֹּר אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ, אֲנִי יְיָ.
blocks.tr: Lo tikom v’lo titor et b’nei amecha, v’ahavta l’re’acha kamocha — ani Adonai.

blocks.en: Do not take revenge, and do not hold a grudge against the children of your people — love your fellow as yourself: I am HaShem.

sources.name: Modah Ani
aliases: The first words of the day — gratitude for another chance at life.
openingWords: מוֹדָה / מוֹדֶה / מוֹדֶת אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ, מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם, שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי
Modah / Modeh / Modet ani l’fanecha, melech chai v’kayam, shehechezarta bi
I am grateful before You, who live and endure — You have

blocks.he: מוֹדָה / מוֹדֶה / מוֹדֶת אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ, מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם, שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה, רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Modah / Modeh / Modet ani l’fanecha, melech chai v’kayam, shehechezarta bi nishmati b’chemla — raba emunatecha.

blocks.en: I am grateful before You, who live and endure — You have returned my soul to me in mercy. How great is Your faithfulness.

sources.name: Mah Tovu
aliases: We cross the threshold with Balaam’s blessing — "how good are your tents" — a prayer of arrival.
openingWords: מַה טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב, מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
Mah tovu ohalecha Ya’akov, mishk’notecha Yisra’el.
How good are your tents, Jacob — your dwelling-places, Yisrael!
וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבֹא בֵיתֶךָ, אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶךָ.
Va’ani b’rov chasd’cha avo veitecha, eshtachaveh el heichal kodsh’cha b’yir’atecha.
As for me: in Your abundant love I enter Your house; I
יְיָ, אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶךָ, וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ.
Adonai, ahavti m’on beitecha, umkom mishkan k’vodecha.

blocks.he: מַה טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב, מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: Mah tovu ohalecha Ya’akov, mishk’notecha Yisra’el.

blocks.en: How good are your tents, Jacob — your dwelling-places, Yisrael!

blocks.he: וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבֹא בֵיתֶךָ, אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Va’ani b’rov chasd’cha avo veitecha, eshtachaveh el heichal kodsh’cha b’yir’atecha.

blocks.en: As for me: in Your abundant love I enter Your house; I bow toward Your holy sanctuary, in awe of You.

blocks.he: יְיָ, אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶךָ, וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Adonai, ahavti m’on beitecha, umkom mishkan k’vodecha.

blocks.en: Eternal One, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory rests.

blocks.he: וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְאֶכְרָעָה, אֶבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי יְיָ עֹשִׂי.
blocks.tr: Va’ani eshtachaveh v’echra’a, evr’cha lifnei Adonai osi.

blocks.en: And I — I bow, I bend low, I kneel before the Eternal, my Maker.

blocks.he: וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי לְךָ יְיָ עֵת רָצוֹן, אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב חַסְדֶּךָ, עֲנֵנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Va’ani t’filati l’cha Adonai et ratzon, Elohim b’rov chasdecha, aneni be’emet yish’echa.

blocks.en: As for me — let my prayer come to You, Eternal One, in a time of favor. God, in Your abundant love, answer me with the truth of Your rescue.

sources.name: Asher Yatzar

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר יָצַר אֶת הָאָדָם בְּחָכְמָה, וּבָרָא בוֹ נְקָבִים נְקָבִים, חֲלוּלִים חֲלוּלִים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, asher yatzar et ha’adam b’chochma, uvara vo n’kavim n’kavim, chalulim chalulim.

blocks.he: גָּלוּי וְיָדוּעַ לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ, שֶׁאִם יִפָּתֵחַ אֶחָד מֵהֶם אוֹ יִסָּתֵם אֶחָד מֵהֶם, אִי אֶפְשַׁר לְהִתְקַיֵּם וְלַעֲמוֹד לְפָנֶיךָ אֲפִילוּ שָׁעָה אֶחָת.
blocks.tr: Galuy v’yadua lifnei chise ch’vodecha, she’im yipateach echad mehem o yisatem echad mehem, i efshar l’hitkayem v’la’amod l’fanecha afilu sha’a echat.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, רוֹפֵא כָל בָּשָׂר וּמַפְלִיא לַעֲשׂוֹת.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, rofe chol basar umafli la’asot.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who formed the human being with wisdom and created in the body openings upon openings, hollows upon hollows.
It is revealed and known before the throne of Your glory that if one of them were to open, or one of them to close, it would be impossible to endure and to stand before You even a single hour.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, healer of all flesh, who works wonders.

sources.name: Elohai N’shamah
aliases: Our souls — who we yet could become — are waiting for us.
openingWords: אֱלֹהַי, נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַתָּ בִּי טְהוֹרָה הִיא. אַתָּה בְרָאתָהּ. אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּהּ. אַתָּה נְפַחְתָּהּ

Kol z’man shehan’shama b’kirbi, modah / modeh / modet ani l’fanecha, Adonai
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר נְשָׁמוֹת לִפְגָרִים מֵתִים.

My God, the soul You placed within me is pure. You created

blocks.he: אֱלֹהַי, נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַתָּ בִּי טְהוֹרָה הִיא. אַתָּה בְרָאתָהּ. אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּהּ. אַתָּה נְפַחְתָּהּ בִּי. וְאַתָּה מְשַׁמְּרָהּ בְּקִרְבִּי. וְאַתָּה עָתִיד לִטְּלָהּ מִמֶּנִּי. וּלְהַחֲזִירָהּ בִּי לֶעָתִיד לָבוֹא.
blocks.tr: Elohai, n’shama shenatata bi t’hora hi. Ata v’ratah, ata y’tzartah, ata n’fachtah bi, v’ata m’sham’rah b’kirbi, v’ata atid lit’lah mimeni ulhachazirah bi le’atid lavo.

blocks.he: כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהַנְּשָׁמָה בְּקִרְבִּי, מוֹדָה / מוֹדֶה / מוֹדֶת אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי, רִבּוֹן כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים, אֲדוֹן כָּל הַנְּשָׁמוֹת.
blocks.tr: Kol z’man shehan’shama b’kirbi, modah / modeh / modet ani l’fanecha, Adonai Elohai ve’lohei avotai, ribon kol hama’asim, adon kol han’shamot.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר נְשָׁמוֹת לִפְגָרִים מֵתִים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, hamachazir n’shamot lifgarim meitim.

blocks.en: My God, the soul You placed within me is pure. You created it, You formed it, You breathed it into me; You keep it safe within me, and one day it will surely depart from me.
As long as the soul is within me, I am grateful before You, Eternal my God and God of my ancestors, Source of all works and of all souls.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, who restores souls to lifeless bodies.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who gave the rooster the sense to tell day from night.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁעָשַׂנִי בְּצֶלֶם אֱלֹהִים.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁעָשַׂנִי בֶּן / בַּת / בֶּת חוֹרִין.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, she’asani ben / bat / bet chorin.

blocks.en: …who made me free.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁעָשַׂנִי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, she’asani Yisra’el.

blocks.en: …who made me Yisrael.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, פּוֹקֵחַ עִוְרִים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, pokeach ivrim.

blocks.en: …who opens the eyes of the blind.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, מַלְבִּישׁ עֲרֻמִּים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, malbish arumim.

blocks.en: …who clothes the naked.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, matir asurim.

blocks.en: …who frees the bound.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, זוֹקֵף כְּפוּפִים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, zokef k’fufim.

blocks.en: …who lifts up the bent.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, רוֹקַע הָאָרֶץ עַל הַמָּיִם.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, roka ha’aretz al hamayim.

blocks.en: …who spreads the earth over the waters.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמֵּכִין מִצְעֲדֵי גָבֶר.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, hamechin mitz’adei gaver.

blocks.en: …who steadies a person’s steps.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁעָשָׂה לִּי כָּל צָרְכִּי.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, she’asa li kol tzorki.

blocks.en: …who has provided me all I need.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אוֹזֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּגְבוּרָה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, ozer Yisra’el bigvura.

blocks.en: …who gives strength to Yisrael.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, עוֹטֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִפְאָרָה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, oter Yisra’el b’tif’ara.

blocks.en: …who adorns our world with beauty.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַנּוֹתֵן לַיָּעֵף כֹּחַ.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, hanoten laya’ef koach.

blocks.en: …who gives strength to the weary.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמַּעֲבִיר שֵׁנָה מֵעֵינָי וּתְנוּמָה מֵעַפְעַפָּי.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, hama’avir shena me’einai utnuma me’af’apai.

blocks.en: …who lifts sleep from my eyes and slumber from my eyelids.

blocks.he: וִיהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁתַּרְגִּילֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְדַבְּקֵנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְאַל תְּבִיאֵנוּ לֹא לִידֵי חֵטְא, וְלֹא לִידֵי עֲבֵרָה וְעָוֹן, וְלֹא לִידֵי נִסָּיוֹן, וְלֹא לִידֵי בִזָּיוֹן, וְאַל יִשְׁלֹט בָּנוּ יֵצֶר הָרָע, וְהַרְחִיקֵנוּ מֵאָדָם רָע וּמֵחָבֵר רָע, וְדַבְּקֵנוּ בְּיֵצֶר הַטּוֹב וּבְמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים, וְכוֹף אֶת יִצְרֵנוּ לְהִשְׁתַּעְבֶּד לָךְ, וּתְנֵנוּ הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל יוֹם לְחֵן וּלְחֶסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּבְעֵינֵי כָל רוֹאֵינוּ, וְתִגְמְלֵנוּ חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים.
blocks.tr: Vihi ratzon mil’fanecha Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, shetargileinu b’Toratecha v’dab’keinu b’mitzvotecha, v’al t’vi’einu lo lidei chet, v’lo lidei avera v’avon, v’lo lidei nisayon, v’lo lidei vizayon, v’al yishlot banu yetzer hara, v’harchikeinu me’adam ra umechaver ra, v’dab’keinu b’yetzer hatov uvma’asim tovim, v’chof et yitzreinu l’hishtabed lach, utneinu hayom uvchol yom l’chein ulchesed ulrachamim b’einecha uv’einei chol ro’einu, v’tigm’leinu chasadim tovim.

blocks.en: May it be Your will, Eternal our God and God of our ancestors, to make us at home in Your Torah and to hold us close to Your mitzvot; keep us from wrongdoing, from transgression and guilt, from trial and from disgrace; let no harmful urge rule over us; keep us far from a bad person and a bad companion, and turn us toward the good, toward good deeds. Grant us today and every day grace, kindness, and mercy in Your eyes and in the eyes of all who see us, and deal us kindness upon kindness.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַגּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, hagomel chasadim tovim l’amo Yisra’el.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal One, who deals kindness upon kindness to the people Yisrael.

blocks.he: וְהַעֲרֶב נָא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָתְךָ בְּפִינוּ וּבְפִי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל. וְנִהְיֶה אֲנַחְנוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵינוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלָּנוּ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶךָ וְלוֹמְדֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ [יֵשׁ אוֹמְרִים: תוֹרָתְךָ] לִשְׁמָהּ.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמְלַמֵּד תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, hamlamed Torah l’amo Yisra’el.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר בָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת תּוֹרָתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, asher bachar banu mikol ha’amim v’natan lanu et Torato.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who calls us toward holiness as we immerse ourselves in the words of Torah.

Make the words of Your Torah sweet, Eternal our God, in our mouths and in the mouths of Your people, the house of Yisrael — so that we, and our children, and the children of Your people the house of Yisrael, may all come to know Your Name and to study Your Torah for its own sake. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who teaches Torah to the people Yisrael.
Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who chose us from among all the peoples and gave us the Torah. Blessed are You, Eternal One, giver of the Torah.

aliases: Torah as a process that is lived and nurtured and grown.

blocks.he: אֵלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם שִׁעוּר. הַפֵּאָה, וְהַבִּכּוּרִים, וְהָרֵאָיוֹן, וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים, וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה. אֵלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאָדָם אוֹכֵל פֵּרוֹתֵיהֶן בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְהַקֶּרֶן קַיֶּמֶת לוֹ לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא. כִּבּוּד אָב וָאֵם, וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים, וַהֲבָאַת שָׁלוֹם בֵּין אָדָם לַחֲבֵרוֹ, וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה כְּנֶגֶד כֻּלָּם.
blocks.tr: Eilu d’varim she’ein lahem shi’ur: hapea, v’habikurim, v’hare’ayon, ugmilut chasadim, v’talmud Torah. Eilu d’varim she’adam ochel peiroteihen ba’olam hazeh v’hakeren kayemet lo la’olam haba: kibud av va’em, ugmilut chasadim, vahava’at shalom bein adam lachavero, v’talmud Torah k’neged kulam.

blocks.en: These are the things that have no fixed measure: the corner of the field left for the poor, the first-fruits, the pilgrim’s appearance at the Temple, acts of loving-kindness, and the study of Torah. And these are the things whose fruit a person enjoys in this world while the principal endures for the world to come: honoring our ancestors, acts of loving-kindness, and making peace between one person and another — and the study of Torah, which equals them all.

sources.name: Baruch She’amar
aliases: The mystical power of words: becoming follows speaking.
openingWords: בָּרוּךְ שֶׁאָמַר וְהָיָה הָעוֹלָם. בָּרוּךְ הוּא. בָּרוּךְ עוֹשֶׂה בְרֵאשִׁית. בָּרוּךְ אוֹמֵר וְעוֹשֶׂה.
Baruch she’amar v’haya ha’olam. Baruch hu. Baruch oseh v’reishit. Baruch omer v’oseh.
Blessed is the One who spoke, and the world came to be.
נְהַלֶּלְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בִּשְׁבָחוֹת וּבִזְמִרוֹת. וּנְגַדֶּלְךָ וּנְשַׁבֵּחֲךָ וּנְפָאֶרְךָ, וְנַזְכִּיר שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ.
N’halelcha Adonai Eloheinu bishvachot uvizmirot, ungadelcha unshabechacha unfa’ercha, v’nazkir shimcha malkeinu Eloheinu.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ מְהֻלָּל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת.
Baruch ata Adonai, melech m’hulal batishbachot.
With praises and with songs we praise You, Eternal our God —

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ שֶׁאָמַר וְהָיָה הָעוֹלָם. בָּרוּךְ הוּא. בָּרוּךְ עוֹשֶׂה בְרֵאשִׁית. בָּרוּךְ אוֹמֵר וְעוֹשֶׂה. בָּרוּךְ גּוֹזֵר וּמְקַיֵּם. בָּרוּךְ מְרַחֵם עַל הָאָרֶץ. בָּרוּךְ מְרַחֵם עַל הַבְּרִיּוֹת. בָּרוּךְ מְשַׁלֵּם שָׂכָר טוֹב לִירֵאָיו. בָּרוּךְ חַי לָעַד וְקַיָּם לָנֶצַח. בָּרוּךְ פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל. בָּרוּךְ שְׁמוֹ.
blocks.tr: Baruch she’amar v’haya ha’olam. Baruch hu. Baruch oseh v’reishit. Baruch omer v’oseh. Baruch gozer umkayem. Baruch m’rachem al ha’aretz. Baruch m’rachem al hab’riyot. Baruch m’shalem sachar tov lire’av. Baruch chai la’ad v’kayam lanetzach. Baruch podeh umatzil. Baruch sh’mo.

blocks.en: Blessed is the One who spoke, and the world came to be. Blessed is the One. Blessed is the Maker of beginnings. Blessed is the One who speaks and does. Blessed is the One who decrees and fulfills. Blessed is the One who has mercy on the earth. Blessed is the One who has mercy on all creatures. Blessed is the One who gives good reward to those who stand in awe. Blessed is the One who lives forever and endures for all time. Blessed is the One who redeems and rescues. Blessed is that Name.

blocks.he: נְהַלֶּלְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בִּשְׁבָחוֹת וּבִזְמִרוֹת. וּנְגַדֶּלְךָ וּנְשַׁבֵּחֲךָ וּנְפָאֶרְךָ, וְנַזְכִּיר שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ. יָחִיד חֵי הָעוֹלָמִים. מֶלֶךְ מְשֻׁבָּח וּמְפֹאָר עֲדֵי עַד שְׁמוֹ הַגָּדוֹל.
blocks.tr: N’halelcha Adonai Eloheinu bishvachot uvizmirot, ungadelcha unshabechacha unfa’ercha, v’nazkir shimcha malkeinu Eloheinu. Yachid chei ha’olamim. Melech m’shubach umfo’ar adei ad sh’mo hagadol.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ מְהֻלָּל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, melech m’hulal batishbachot.

blocks.en: With praises and with songs we praise You, Eternal our God — we make You great, we laud You, we glorify You, and we call Your Name to mind, our God: the Only One, life of all the worlds — lauded and glorified, whose great Name endures to the very end of time. Blessed are You, Eternal One, sung in praises.

sources.name: Psalm 121
aliases: An ancient psalm for the dark nights of the soul.
openingWords: שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת, אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים, מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי. עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְיָ, עֹשֵׂה
Shir lama’alot, esa einai el heharim, me’ayin yavo ezri. Ezri me’im Adonai,
A song for the ascents. I lift my eyes to the mountains

blocks.he: שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת, אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים, מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי. עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְיָ, עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ. אַל־יִתֵּן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֶךָ, אַל־יָנוּם שֹׁמְרֶךָ. הִנֵּה לֹא־יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן, שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל. יְיָ שֹׁמְרֶךָ, יְיָ צִלְּךָ עַל־יַד יְמִינֶךָ. יוֹמָם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֹא־יַכֶּכָּה, וְיָרֵחַ בַּלָּיְלָה. יְיָ יִשְׁמׇרְךָ מִכׇּל־רָע, יִשְׁמֹר אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ. יְיָ יִשְׁמׇר־צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ, מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם.
blocks.tr: Shir lama’alot, esa einai el heharim, me’ayin yavo ezri. Ezri me’im Adonai, oseh shamayim va’aretz. Al yiten lamot raglecha, al yanum shom’recha. Hineh lo yanum v’lo yishan, shomer Yisra’el. Adonai shom’recha, Adonai tzil’cha al yad y’minecha. Yomam hashemesh lo yakeka, v’yareach balaila. Adonai yishmorcha mikol ra, yishmor et nafshecha. Adonai yishmor tzeit’cha uvoecha, me’ata v’ad olam.

blocks.en: A song for the ascents. I lift my eyes to the mountains — where will my help come from? My help comes from the Eternal, maker of heaven and earth. HaShem will not let your foot give way; the One who guards you does not slumber. The Guardian of Yisrael neither slumbers nor sleeps. The Eternal is your keeper, the Eternal is your shade at your right hand. By day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon by night. The Eternal will guard you from all harm — will guard your life. The Eternal will guard your going out and your coming in, from now and forever.

sources.name: Psalm 27
aliases: L’David — the psalm of the season, said morning and evening from Elul through Sukkot: one thing I ask.
openingWords: לְדָוִד יְיָ אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא, יְיָ מָעוֹז־חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָד.
L’David. Adonai ori v’yish’i, mimi ira? Adonai ma’oz chayai, mimi efchad?
Of David. The Eternal is my light and my rescue — whom
אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְיָ אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ, שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְיָ כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי, לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְיָ וּלְבַקֵּר
Achat sha’alti me’et Adonai, otah avakesh: shivti b’veit Adonai kol y’mei chayai,
One thing I ask of the Eternal — only this do I

blocks.he: לְדָוִד יְיָ אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא, יְיָ מָעוֹז־חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָד.
blocks.tr: L’David. Adonai ori v’yish’i, mimi ira? Adonai ma’oz chayai, mimi efchad?

blocks.en: Of David. The Eternal is my light and my rescue — whom should I fear? The Eternal is the stronghold of my life — whom should I dread?

blocks.he: אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְיָ אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ, שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְיָ כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי, לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְיָ וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ.
blocks.tr: Achat sha’alti me’et Adonai, otah avakesh: shivti b’veit Adonai kol y’mei chayai, lachazot b’no’am Adonai ulvaker b’heichalo.

blocks.en: One thing I ask of the Eternal — only this do I seek: to live in the house of the Eternal all the days of my life, to gaze on the sweetness of the Eternal, and to linger in that sanctuary.

sources.name: Ashrei
aliases: An acrostic of joy — one of the earliest Jewish liturgies.
openingWords: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ, עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה. אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ, אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם
Ashrei yoshvei veitecha, od y’hal’lucha sela. Ashrei ha’am shekacha lo, ashrei ha’am
Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they never stop praising
תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ, וַאֲבָרְכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. בְּכׇל־יוֹם אֲבָרְכֶךָּ, וַאֲהַלְלָה
T’hila l’David. Aromimcha Elohai hamelech, va’avarcha shimcha l’olam va’ed. B’chol yom avarcheka,
A song of praise, of David. I will lift You high, my
זֵכֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ, וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ. חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ, אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדׇל־חָסֶד. טוֹב־יְיָ
Zecher rav tuvcha yabi’u, v’tzidkatcha y’ranenu. Chanun v’rachum Adonai, erech apayim ugdol-chased.

blocks.he: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ, עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה. אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ, אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיְיָ אֱלֹהָיו.
blocks.tr: Ashrei yoshvei veitecha, od y’hal’lucha sela. Ashrei ha’am shekacha lo, ashrei ha’am she’Adonai Elohav.

blocks.en: Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they never stop praising You. Selah. Happy the people for whom it is so; happy the people whose God is the One.

blocks.he: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ, וַאֲבָרְכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. בְּכׇל־יוֹם אֲבָרְכֶךָּ, וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. גָּדוֹל יְיָ וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד, וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵקֶר. דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ. הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶךָ, וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה. וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְאֹתֶיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ, וּגְדֻלָּתְךָ אֲסַפְּרֶנָּה.
blocks.tr: T’hila l’David. Aromimcha Elohai hamelech, va’avarcha shimcha l’olam va’ed. B’chol yom avarcheka, va’ahalela shimcha l’olam va’ed. Gadol Adonai umhulal m’od, v’ligdulato ein cheker. Dor l’dor y’shabach ma’asecha, ugvurotecha yagidu. Hadar k’vod hodecha, v’divrei niflotecha asicha. Ve’ezuz nor’otecha yomeru, ugdulatcha asaprena.

blocks.en: A song of praise, of David. I will lift You high, my God, my Sovereign, and bless Your Name forever and ever. Every day I will bless You, and praise Your Name forever and ever. Great is the One, and greatly to be praised; that greatness is beyond all searching out. One generation praises Your works to the next, and tells of Your mighty acts. On the glorious splendor of Your majesty, and Your wondrous deeds, I will meditate. They will speak of the might of Your awesome acts, and I will recount Your greatness.

blocks.he: זֵכֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ, וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ. חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ, אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדׇל־חָסֶד. טוֹב־יְיָ לַכֹּל, וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כׇּל־מַעֲשָׂיו. יוֹדוּךָ יְיָ כׇּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְבָרְכוּכָה. כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ יֹאמֵרוּ, וּגְבוּרָתְךָ יְדַבֵּרוּ.
blocks.tr: Zecher rav tuvcha yabi’u, v’tzidkatcha y’ranenu. Chanun v’rachum Adonai, erech apayim ugdol-chased. Tov Adonai lakol, v’rachamav al kol ma’asav. Yoducha Adonai kol ma’asecha, vachasidecha y’varchucha. K’vod malchutcha yomeru, ugvuratcha y’daberu.

blocks.en: They will pour out the memory of Your abundant goodness, and sing of Your justice. Gracious and compassionate is the One, slow to anger and great in love. The One is good to all, and that mercy rests upon all creation. All Your works will thank You, and the faithful will bless You. They will tell the glory of Your reign, and speak of Your power —

blocks.he: לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו, וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ. מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כׇּל־עֹלָמִים, וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכׇל־דּוֹר וָדֹר. סוֹמֵךְ יְיָ לְכׇל־הַנֹּפְלִים, וְזוֹקֵף לְכׇל־הַכְּפוּפִים. עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּ, וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אׇכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ. פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת־יָדֶךָ, וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכׇל־חַי רָצוֹן. צַדִּיק יְיָ בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָיו, וְחָסִיד בְּכׇל־מַעֲשָׂיו.
blocks.tr: L’hodia livnei ha’adam g’vurotav, uchvod hadar malchuto. Malchutcha malchut kol olamim, umemshaltcha b’chol dor vador. Somech Adonai l’chol hanoflim, v’zokef l’chol hak’fufim. Einei chol eilecha y’saberu, v’ata noten lahem et ochlam b’ito. Poteach et yadecha, umasbia l’chol chai ratzon. Tzadik Adonai b’chol d’rachav, v’chasid b’chol ma’asav.

blocks.en: to make known to all people those mighty acts, and the glorious splendor of that reign. Your reign is a reign for all worlds, and Your rule endures through every generation. The One holds up all who fall, and lifts up all who are bowed down. The eyes of all look to You in hope, and You give them their food in its season. You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing. The One is just in all those ways, and faithful in all those deeds.

blocks.he: קָרוֹב יְיָ לְכׇל־קֹרְאָיו, לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת. רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה, וְאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם. שׁוֹמֵר יְיָ אֶת־כׇּל־אֹהֲבָיו, וְאֵת כׇּל־הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד. תְּהִלַּת יְיָ יְדַבֶּר־פִּי, וִיבָרֵךְ כׇּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קׇדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Karov Adonai l’chol kor’av, l’chol asher yikra’uhu ve’emet. R’tzon y’re’av ya’ase, v’et shav’atam yishma v’yoshi’em. Shomer Adonai et kol ohavav, v’et kol har’sha’im yashmid. T’hilat Adonai y’daber pi, vivarech kol basar shem kodsho l’olam va’ed.

blocks.en: The One is near to all who call — to all who call out in truth. The One fulfills the longing of those who are in awe, hears their cry, and saves them. The One watches over all who love, but all the wicked will be destroyed. My mouth will speak the praise of the One; let all flesh bless that holy name, forever and ever.

blocks.he: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם, הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
blocks.tr: Va’anachnu n’varech Yah, me’ata v’ad olam, hal’lu-Yah.

blocks.en: And we will bless Yah, from now and forever. Halleluyah.

sources.name: Psalm 150
aliases: The final psalm. A call to express our joy with every instrument and every voice.
openingWords: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ. הַלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקׇדְשׁוֹ, הַלְלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ. הַלְלוּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָיו, הַלְלוּהוּ כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ.
Hal’lu-Yah. Hal’lu-El b’kodsho, hal’luhu birkia uzo. Hal’luhu vigvurotav, hal’luhu k’rov gudlo.
Halleluyah. Praise God in the holy place; praise the One in the

blocks.he: הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רָם וְנִשָּׂא.
blocks.tr: HaMelech — yoshev al kise ram v’nisa.

blocks.en: The Sovereign sits — on a high and lofty throne.

blocks.he: שׁוֹכֵן עַד מָרוֹם וְקָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹ. וְכָתוּב רַנְּנוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיְיָ, לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה. בְּפִי יְשָׁרִים תִּתְרוֹמָם, וּבְדִבְרֵי צַדִּיקִים תִּתְבָּרַךְ, וּבִלְשׁוֹן חֲסִידִים תִּתְקַדָּשׁ, וּבְקֶרֶב קְדוֹשִׁים תִּתְהַלָּל.
blocks.tr: Shochein ad marom v’kadosh sh’mo. V’chatuv: ran’nu tzadikim ba’Adonai, laysharim nava t’hila. B’fi y’sharim titromam, uvdivrei tzadikim titbarach, uvilshon chasidim titkadash, uvkerev k’doshim tit’halal.

blocks.he: וּבְמַקְהֲלוֹת רִבְבוֹת עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בְּרִנָּה יִתְפָּאַר שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר.
blocks.tr: Uvmakhalot riv’vot am’cha beit Yisra’el, b’rina yitpa’ar shimcha malkeinu b’chol dor vador.

blocks.en: The One dwells forever, exalted and holy is that name. And it is written: sing out, you just ones, to the One — praise is fitting on the lips of the upright. On the mouth of the upright You are lifted up, in the words of the just You are blessed, on the tongue of the faithful You are made holy, and in the midst of the holy You are praised. And in the great gatherings of Your people, the house of Yisrael, in song Your Name is glorified, our Sovereign, in every generation.

blocks.he: יִשְׁתַּבַּח שִׁמְךָ לָעַד מַלְכֵּנוּ, הָאֵל הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. כִּי לְךָ נָאֶה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ:
blocks.tr: Yishtabach shimcha la’ad malkeinu, ha’El hamelech hagadol v’hakadosh bashamayim uva’aretz. Ki l’cha na’e Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu:

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֵל מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת, אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת, אֲדוֹן הַנִּפְלָאוֹת, הַבּוֹחֵר בְּשִׁירֵי זִמְרָה, מֶלֶךְ אֵל חֵי הָעוֹלָמִים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, El melech gadol batishbachot, El hahoda’ot, adon haniflaot, habocher b’shirei zimra, melech El chei ha’olamim.

blocks.en: May Your Name be praised forever — the God, the great and holy One, in heaven and on earth. For to You, our God and God of our ancestors, all this is fitting: song and praise, chant and melody, strength and reach, endurance, greatness and power, glory and splendor, holiness and majesty — blessings and thanksgivings, from now and forever.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, great in praises, God of thanksgiving, Source of wonders, who delights in songs of praise, life of all the worlds.

May the great Name be made great and holy in the world
May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ, וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon uvyomeichon uvchayei d’chol beit Yisra’el, ba’agala uvizman kariv, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא, לְעֵלָּא וּלְעֵלָּא מִכָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’eila ul’eila mikol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great Name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Yisrael, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the Name of the Holy One of blessing — far, far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who forms light and creates dark, who makes peace and creates all things.

blocks.en: Light everlasting, held in the storehouse of life: out of the dark God said “light” — and there was.

blocks.he: הַמֵּאִיר לָאָרֶץ וְלַדָּרִים עָלֶיהָ בְּרַחֲמִים, וּבְטוּבוֹ מְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית. מָה־רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְיָ, כֻּלָּם בְּחׇכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ, מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ.

blocks.en: You light the earth and those who live upon it, in mercy, and in Your goodness renew, each day, always, the work of creation. How many are Your works, Eternal One — all of them made in wisdom; the earth is full of what You have made.

blocks.he: שִׁמְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִתְקַדַּשׁ. וְזִכְרְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ יִתְפָּאַר. תִּתְבָּרַךְ מוֹשִׁיעֶנּוּ עַל שֶׁבַח מַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ. וְעַל מְאוֹרֵי אוֹר שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ יְפָאֲרוּךָ סֶלָה.
blocks.tr: Shimcha Adonai Eloheinu yitkadash, v’zichr’cha malkeinu yitpa’ar. Titbarach moshi’einu al shevach ma’asei yadecha, v’al m’orei or she’asita y’fa’arucha sela.

blocks.en: May Your Name, our God, be hallowed, and the memory of You be glorified. Be blessed, our Deliverer, for the splendor of the work of Your hands; and for the lights of light that You made — let them glorify You, Selah.

blocks.he: אוֹר חָדָשׁ עַל צִיּוֹן תָּאִיר, וְנִזְכֶּה כֻלָּנוּ מְהֵרָה לְאוֹרוֹ.
blocks.tr: Or chadash al Tziyon ta’ir, v’nizkeh chulanu m’hera l’oro.

blocks.en: May You shine a new light upon Zion, and may we all soon be worthy of its light.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, who forms the lights.
