וְהָאֵר עֵינֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְדַבֵּק לִבֵּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְיַחֵד לְבָבֵנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וּלְיִרְאָה אֶת שְׁמֶךָ,
V’ha’er eineinu b’Toratecha, v’dabek libeinu b’mitzvotecha, v’yached l’vaveinu l’ahava ulyir’a et sh’mecha,

blocks.he: אַהֲבָה רַבָּה אֲהַבְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, חֶמְלָה גְּדוֹלָה וִיתֵרָה חָמַלְתָּ עָלֵינוּ. אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, בַּעֲבוּר אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁבָּטְחוּ בְךָ וַתְּלַמְּדֵם חֻקֵּי חַיִּים, כֵּן תְּחָנֵּנוּ וּתְלַמְּדֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Ahava raba ahavtanu Adonai Eloheinu, chemla g’dola vitera chamalta aleinu. Avinu malkeinu, ba’avur avoteinu v’imoteinu shebat’chu v’cha vat’lam’dem chukei chayim, ken t’choneinu utlam’deinu.

blocks.en: With abundant love You have loved us, Eternal our God; with great and overflowing tenderness You have cared for us. Avinu Malkeinu — for the sake of our ancestors who trusted in You, and whom You taught the laws of life, be gracious to us, too, and teach us.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ הָאָב הָרַחֲמָן, הַמְרַחֵם, רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ, וְתֵן בְּלִבֵּנוּ לְהָבִין וּלְהַשְׂכִּיל, לִשְׁמֹעַ, לִלְמֹד וּלְלַמֵּד, לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת וּלְקַיֵּם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי תַלְמוּד תּוֹרָתֶךָ בְּאַהֲבָה.
blocks.tr: Avinu ha’av harachaman, hamrachem, rachem aleinu, v’ten b’libeinu l’havin ulhaskil, lishmo’a, lilmod ullamed, lishmor v’la’asot ulkayem et kol divrei talmud Toratecha b’ahava.

blocks.en: Merciful One, source of mercy, have mercy on us: put into our hearts the will to understand and discern, to listen, to learn and to teach, to keep and to do and to fulfill all the teachings of Your Torah, in love — bound to those who came before us, to those beside us, and most of all to those still to come.

blocks.he: וְהָאֵר עֵינֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְדַבֵּק לִבֵּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְיַחֵד לְבָבֵנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וּלְיִרְאָה אֶת שְׁמֶךָ, וְלֹא נֵבוֹשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשְׁךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא בָּטָחְנוּ, נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: V’ha’er eineinu b’Toratecha, v’dabek libeinu b’mitzvotecha, v’yached l’vaveinu l’ahava ulyir’a et sh’mecha, v’lo nevosh l’olam va’ed. Ki v’shem kodsh’cha hagadol v’hanora batachnu, nagila v’nism’cha bishu’atecha.

blocks.en: Light up our eyes with Your Torah, hold our hearts close to Your mitzvot, and make our whole heart one — to love and to hold in awe Your Name — so we are never ashamed. For in Your great and awesome holy Name we have trusted; let us celebrate and rejoice in Your saving help.

blocks.he: וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ, וְתוֹלִיכֵנוּ קוֹמְמִיּוּת לְאַרְצֵנוּ, כִּי אֵל פּוֹעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת אָתָּה, וּבָנוּ בָחַרְתָּ מִכָּל עַם וְלָשׁוֹן, וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל סֶלָה בֶּאֱמֶת, לְהוֹדוֹת לְךָ וּלְיַחֶדְךָ בְּאַהֲבָה.
blocks.tr: Vahavi’einu l’shalom me’arba kanfot ha’aretz, v’tolicheinu kom’miyut l’artzeinu, ki El po’el y’shu’ot ata, uvanu vacharta mikol am v’lashon, v’kerav’tanu l’shimcha hagadol sela be’emet, l’hodot l’cha ulyachedcha b’ahava.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַבּוֹחֵר בְּעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבָה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, habocher b’amo Yisra’el b’ahava.

blocks.en: Bring us home in peace from the four corners of the earth, and lead us upright to our land — for You are the God who brings rescue, and You chose us from every people and tongue, and You have drawn us near to Your great Name, in truth, to give thanks to You and to make You one, in love. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who chooses the people Yisrael, in love.

sources.name: The Sh’ma
aliases: The central verse of our teaching; the oneness of it all.
openingWords: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְיָ֥ אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְיָ֥ ׀ אֶחָֽד׃
Sh’ma Yisra’el, Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai echad.
Baruch shem k’vod malchuto l’olam va’ed. · Blessed is the Name of

blocks.he: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְיָ֥ אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְיָ֥ ׀ אֶחָֽד׃
blocks.tr: Sh’ma Yisra’el, Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai echad.
blocks.en: Hear, O Israel! The Eternal is our God, the Eternal alone.
Baruch shem k’vod malchuto l’olam va’ed. · Blessed is the Name of God's glorious reign, forever and ever.

sources.name: V’ahavta
aliases: A hope that if we live the best of our values, the world will be different.
openingWords: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְיָ֣ אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכׇל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ׃ וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י
V’ahavta et Adonai Elohecha, b’chol l’vavcha uvchol nafsh’cha uvchol m’odecha. V’hayu had’varim
וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל־יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזֻז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
Uk’shartam l’ot al yadecha, v’hayu l’totafot bein einecha. Uch’tavtam al m’zuzot beitecha
You shall love the Eternal your God with all your heart and
Bind them as a sign on your hand and let them serve
וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְיָ֤ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙
V’haya im shamoa tishm’u el mitzvotai asher anochi m’tzaveh etchem hayom, l’ahava

blocks.he: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְיָ֣ אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכׇל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ׃ וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם עַל־לְבָבֶֽךָ׃ וְשִׁנַּנְתָּ֣ם לְבָנֶ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֖ בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשׇׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃
blocks.tr: V’ahavta et Adonai Elohecha, b’chol l’vavcha uvchol nafsh’cha uvchol m’odecha. V’hayu had’varim ha’eleh asher anochi m’tzav’cha hayom al l’vavecha. V’shinantam l’vanecha v’dibarta bam, b’shivt’cha b’veitecha uvlecht’cha vaderech, uvshochb’cha uvkumecha.

blocks.he: וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל־יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזֻז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
blocks.tr: Uk’shartam l’ot al yadecha, v’hayu l’totafot bein einecha. Uch’tavtam al m’zuzot beitecha uvish’arecha.

blocks.en: You shall love the Eternal your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might. Take to heart these instructions with which I charge you this day. Impress them upon your children. Recite them when you stay at home and when you are away, when you lie down and when you get up.
Bind them as a sign on your hand and let them serve as a symbol on your forehead; inscribe them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.

blocks.he: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְיָ֤ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ וּלְעׇבְד֔וֹ בְּכׇל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃ וְנָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר־אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִירֹֽשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃ וְנָתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃
blocks.tr: V’haya im shamoa tishm’u el mitzvotai asher anochi m’tzaveh etchem hayom, l’ahava et Adonai Eloheichem ul’ovdo b’chol l’vavchem uvchol nafsh’chem. V’natati m’tar artz’chem b’ito, yoreh umalkosh, v’asafta d’ganecha v’tirosh’cha v’yitzharecha. V’natati esev b’sad’cha liv’hemtecha, v’achalta v’sava’ta.

blocks.he: הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃ וְחָרָ֨ה אַף־יְיָ֜ בָּכֶ֗ם וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֑הּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְיָ֖ נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
blocks.tr: Hisham’ru lachem pen yifteh l’vavchem, v’sartem va’avadtem elohim acherim v’hishtachavitem lahem. V’chara af Adonai bachem, v’atzar et hashamayim v’lo yihyeh matar, v’ha’adama lo titen et y’vulah, va’avadtem m’hera me’al ha’aretz hatova asher Adonai noten lachem.

blocks.he: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרַ֣י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַֽל־נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל־יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶֽם׃ וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשׇׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃ לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵיכֶם֙ וִימֵ֣י בְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְיָ֛ לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם כִּימֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
blocks.tr: V’samtem et d’varai eleh al l’vavchem v’al nafsh’chem, uk’shartem otam l’ot al yedchem, v’hayu l’totafot bein eineichem. V’limadtem otam et b’neichem l’daber bam, b’shivt’cha b’veitecha uvlecht’cha vaderech, uvshochb’cha uvkumecha. Uch’tavtam al m’zuzot beitecha uvish’arecha. L’ma’an yirbu y’meichem vimei v’neichem al ha’adama asher nishba Adonai la’avoteichem latet lahem, kimei hashamayim al ha’aretz.

blocks.en: If, then, you obey the commandments that I enjoin upon you this day, loving the Eternal your God and rendering service with all your heart and soul, I will grant the rain for your land in season, the early rain and the late. You shall gather in your new grain and wine and oil— I will also provide grass in the fields for your cattle—and thus you shall eat your fill.

Take care not to be lured away to serve other gods and bow to them. For God’s anger will flare up against you, shutting up the skies so that there will be no rain and the ground will not yield its produce; and you will soon perish from the good land that God is assigning to you. Therefore impress these My words upon your very heart: bind them as a sign on your hand and let them serve as a symbol on your forehead, and teach them to your children—reciting them when you stay at home and when you are away, when you lie down and when you get up; and inscribe them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates— to the end that you and your children may endure, in the land that God swore to your fathers to assign to them, as long as there is a heaven over the earth.

blocks.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְנָ֥תְנ֛וּ עַל־צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
blocks.tr: Daber el b’nei Yisra’el v’amarta alehem, v’asu lahem tzitzit al kanfei vig’deihem l’dorotam, v’natnu al tzitzit hakanaf p’til t’chelet.

blocks.he: וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺ֣ת יְיָ֔ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תָת֜וּרוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
blocks.tr: V’haya lachem l’tzitzit, ur’item oto uz’chartem et kol mitzvot Adonai, va’asitem otam, v’lo taturu acharei l’vavchem v’acharei eineichem asher atem zonim achareihem.

blocks.en: God said to Moses as follows: Speak to the Israelite people and instruct them to make for themselves fringes on the corners of their garments throughout the ages; let them attach a cord of blue to the fringe at each corner. That shall be your fringe; look at it and recall all God’s commandments and observe them, so that you do not follow your heart and eyes in your urge to stray.

blocks.he: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵאלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃ אֲנִ֞י יְיָ֣ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְיָ֥ אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
blocks.tr: L’ma’an tizk’ru va’asitem et kol mitzvotai, vih’yitem k’doshim leloheichem. Ani Adonai Eloheichem, asher hotzeti etchem me’eretz Mitzrayim lihyot lachem lelohim, ani Adonai Eloheichem.

blocks.en: Thus you shall be reminded to observe all My commandments and to be holy to your God. I am the Eternal your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God: I, your Eternal God.

sources.name: Emet v’Yatziv
aliases: The seam between the Sh’ma and our vision of a redeemed world.
openingWords: אֱמֶת — וְיַצִּיב וְנָכוֹן וְקַיָּם וְיָשָׁר וְנֶאֱמָן וְאָהוּב וְחָבִיב וְנֶחְמָד וְנָעִים וְנוֹרָא
Emet — v’yatziv v’nachon v’kayam v’yashar v’ne’eman v’ahuv v’chaviv v’nechmad v’na’im v’nora
True and firm, and settled, and enduring; upright, faithful, beloved and dear,
אֱמֶת, אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם מַלְכֵּנוּ, צוּר יַעֲקֹב מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ. לְדֹר וָדֹר הוּא קַיָּם
Emet, Elohei olam malkeinu, tzur Ya’akov magen yish’einu. L’dor vador hu kayam
True: the God of all time, the rock of Jacob, the shield
וּדְבָרָיו חָיִים וְקַיָּמִים. נֶאֱמָנִים וְנֶחֱמָדִים לָעַד וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עוֹלָמִים.
Ud’varav chayim v’kayamim, ne’emanim v’nechemadim la’ad ul’olmei olamim.

blocks.he: אֱמֶת — וְיַצִּיב וְנָכוֹן וְקַיָּם וְיָשָׁר וְנֶאֱמָן וְאָהוּב וְחָבִיב וְנֶחְמָד וְנָעִים וְנוֹרָא וְאַדִּיר וּמְתֻקָּן וּמְקֻבָּל וְטוֹב וְיָפֶה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָלֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Emet — v’yatziv v’nachon v’kayam v’yashar v’ne’eman v’ahuv v’chaviv v’nechmad v’na’im v’nora v’adir umtukan umkubal v’tov v’yafeh hadavar hazeh aleinu l’olam va’ed.

blocks.en: True and firm, and settled, and enduring; upright, faithful, beloved and dear, delightful and sweet, awesome and mighty, well-ordered and welcome, good and beautiful is this word for us, forever.

blocks.he: אֱמֶת, אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם מַלְכֵּנוּ, צוּר יַעֲקֹב מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ. לְדֹר וָדֹר הוּא קַיָּם וּשְׁמוֹ קַיָּם, וְכִסְאוֹ נָכוֹן, וּמַלְכוּתוֹ וֶאֱמוּנָתוֹ לָעַד קַיָּמֶת.
blocks.tr: Emet, Elohei olam malkeinu, tzur Ya’akov magen yish’einu. L’dor vador hu kayam ushmo kayam, v’chis’o nachon, umalchuto ve’emunato la’ad kayemet.

blocks.en: True: the God of all time, the rock of Jacob, the shield that saves us. From generation to generation the Eternal endures, and that Name endures; unchanging, that oneness and that faithfulness stand fast, forever.

blocks.he: וּדְבָרָיו חָיִים וְקַיָּמִים. נֶאֱמָנִים וְנֶחֱמָדִים לָעַד וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עוֹלָמִים.
blocks.tr: Ud’varav chayim v’kayamim, ne’emanim v’nechemadim la’ad ul’olmei olamim.

blocks.en: And the words of the Eternal are living and enduring, faithful and cherished, forever and to all eternity.

blocks.he: אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ שֶׁיִּשְׁמַע לְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתוֹרָתְךָ וּדְבָרְךָ יָשִׂים עַל לִבּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Ashrei ish sheyishma l’mitzvotecha, v’torat’cha ud’var’cha yasim al libo.

blocks.en: Happy is the one who listens to Your mitzvot, and takes Your Torah and Your word to heart.

blocks.he: אֱמֶת, אַתָּה הוּא אָדוֹן לְעַמֶּךָ וּמֶלֶךְ גִּבּוֹר לָרִיב רִיבָם. אֱמֶת, אַתָּה הוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְאַתָּה הוּא אַחֲרוֹן, וּמִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ גּוֹאֵל וּמוֹשִׁיעַ.
blocks.tr: Emet, ata hu adon l’amecha umelech gibor lariv rivam. Emet, ata hu rishon v’ata hu acharon, umibal’adecha ein lanu melech go’el umoshia.

blocks.en: True: You are the guide of Your people, mighty to take up their cause. True: You are the first and You are the last; besides You we have no one who redeems and saves.

blocks.he: מִמִּצְרַיִם גְּאַלְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וּמִבֵּית עֲבָדִים פְּדִיתָנוּ. וְיַם סוּף בָּקַעְתָּ, וִידִידִים הֶעֱבַרְתָּ.
blocks.tr: Mimitzrayim g’altanu Adonai Eloheinu, umibeit avadim p’ditanu. V’yam suf bakata, vididim he’evarta.

blocks.en: From Egypt You redeemed us, HaShem our God, and from the house of bondage You set us free. You brought us through the Sea of Reeds, carrying the beloved across — and we came out singing.

blocks.he: עַל זֹאת שִׁבְּחוּ אֲהוּבִים וְרוֹמְמוּ אֵל, וְנָתְנוּ יְדִידִים זְמִירוֹת שִׁירוֹת וְתִשְׁבָּחוֹת, בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְמֶלֶךְ אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם. רָם וְנִשָּׂא, גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא, מַשְׁפִּיל גֵּאִים וּמַגְבִּיהַּ שְׁפָלִים, מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים וּפוֹדֶה עֲנָוִים, וְעוֹזֵר דַּלִּים וְעוֹנֶה לְעַמּוֹ בְּעֵת שַׁוְּעָם אֵלָיו.
blocks.tr: Al zot shib’chu ahuvim v’rom’mu El, v’nat’nu y’didim z’mirot shirot v’tishbachot, b’rachot v’hoda’ot l’melech El chai v’kayam. Ram v’nisa, gadol v’nora, mashpil ge’im umagbiah sh’falim, motzi asirim ufodeh anavim, v’ozer dalim v’oneh l’amo b’et shav’am elav.

blocks.en: For this the beloved praised and exalted God, offering songs and praises and thanksgiving to the living and enduring One — high and lifted up, great and awesome, who brings down the proud and lifts up the lowly, frees the captive and redeems the humble, helps the poor and answers the people in the hour of their cry.

blocks.he: תְּהִלּוֹת לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן, בָּרוּךְ הוּא וּמְבֹרָךְ. מֹשֶׁה וּמִרְיָם וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ עָנוּ שִׁירָה בְּשִׂמְחָה רַבָּה, וְאָמְרוּ כֻלָּם:
blocks.tr: T’hilot l’El elyon, baruch hu umvorach. Moshe uMiryam uvnei Yisra’el l’cha anu shira b’simcha raba, v’amru chulam:

blocks.en: Praises to the Most High, blessed and praised. Moses and Miriam and the children of Yisrael sang to You, in great joy, and all of them said:

sources.name: Mi Chamocha
aliases: The song at the shore. The moment a people first sang itself free.
openingWords: מִֽי־כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְיָ֔ מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃
Mi chamocha ba’elim Adonai, mi kamocha nedar bakodesh, nora t’hilot oseh fele.
Who is like You among the mighty, O Source of freedom? Who
שִׁירָה חֲדָשָׁה שִׁבְּחוּ גְאוּלִים לְשִׁמְךָ עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם, יַחַד כֻּלָּם הוֹדוּ וְהִמְלִיכוּ
Shira chadasha shib’chu g’ulim l’shimcha al s’fat hayam, yachad kulam hodu v’himlichu
A new song the redeemed sang to Your Name at the edge

blocks.he: מִֽי־כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְיָ֔ מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃
blocks.tr: Mi chamocha ba’elim Adonai, mi kamocha nedar bakodesh, nora t’hilot oseh fele.

blocks.en: Who is like You among the mighty, O Source of freedom? Who is like You — glorious in holiness, awesome in praises, working wonders!

blocks.he: שִׁירָה חֲדָשָׁה שִׁבְּחוּ גְאוּלִים לְשִׁמְךָ עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם, יַחַד כֻּלָּם הוֹדוּ וְהִמְלִיכוּ וְאָמְרוּ:
blocks.tr: Shira chadasha shib’chu g’ulim l’shimcha al s’fat hayam, yachad kulam hodu v’himlichu v’amru:

blocks.en: A new song the redeemed sang to Your Name at the edge of the sea; together they gave thanks, called You One, and said: The Eternal will reign forever and ever.

blocks.he: צוּר יִשְׂרָאֵל, קוּמָה בְּעֶזְרַת יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּפְדֵה כִנְאֻמֶךָ יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל. גֹּאֲלֵנוּ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ, קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
blocks.tr: Tzur Yisra’el, kuma b’ezrat Yisra’el, ufdeh chin’umecha Y’huda v’Yisra’el. Go’aleinu Adonai tz’va’ot sh’mo, k’dosh Yisra’el.

blocks.en: Rock of Yisrael — rise up to Yisrael’s help; make good on Your promise, and set Judah and Yisrael free. Our redeemer — Source of all being is that name — the Holy One of Yisrael. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who redeemed Yisrael.

sources.name: The Amidah
aliases: Three steps forward, as if entering a small room.
openingWords: אֲדֹנָי, שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
Adonai, s’fatai tiftach, ufi yagid t’hilatecha.
Adonai, open my lips, that my mouth may declare Your praise.

blocks.he: אֲדֹנָי, שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Adonai, s’fatai tiftach, ufi yagid t’hilatecha.

blocks.en: Adonai, open my lips, that my mouth may declare Your praise.

sources.name: Avot v’Imahot
aliases: We stand in a court we inherited — connection to the past becomes the day’s first plea: remember us for life.
openingWords: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ,
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu,
אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב;
Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, ve’lohei Ya’akov;
אֱלֹהֵי שָׂרָה, אֱלֹהֵי רִבְקָה, אֱלֹהֵי לֵאָה, וֵאלֹהֵי רָחֵל, אֱלֹהֵי בִּלְהָה, וֵאלֹהֵי זִלְפָּה.
Elohei Sara, Elohei Rivka, Elohei Le’a, ve’lohei Rachel, Elohei Bilha, ve’lohei Zilpa.
הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל, וְזוֹכֵר
Ha’El hagadol hagibor v’hanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, v’koneh hakol, v’zocher

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ,
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu,

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב;
blocks.tr: Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, ve’lohei Ya’akov;

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵי שָׂרָה, אֱלֹהֵי רִבְקָה, אֱלֹהֵי לֵאָה, וֵאלֹהֵי רָחֵל, אֱלֹהֵי בִּלְהָה, וֵאלֹהֵי זִלְפָּה.
blocks.tr: Elohei Sara, Elohei Rivka, Elohei Le’a, ve’lohei Rachel, Elohei Bilha, ve’lohei Zilpa.

blocks.he: הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל, וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת, וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה.
blocks.tr: Ha’El hagadol hagibor v’hanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, v’koneh hakol, v’zocher chasdei avot v’imahot, umevi go’el livnei v’neihem l’ma’an sh’mo b’ahava.

blocks.he: זָכְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים, מֶלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים, וְכָתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים, לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים.
blocks.tr: Zochreinu l’chayim, melech chafetz bachayim, v’chotveinu b’sefer hachayim, l’ma’ancha Elohim chayim.

blocks.he: מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם וְעֶזְרַת שָׂרָה.
blocks.tr: Melech ozer umoshi’a umagen. Baruch ata Adonai, magen Avraham v’ezrat Sara.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, God of our ancestors — God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; God of Sarah, God of Rebecca, God of Leah, God of Rachel, God of Bilhah, and God of Zilpah.

Great, mighty, and awesome God, God Most High, who acts with love, who creates all, who remembers the faithfulness of our ancestors, and who lovingly brings redemption to their children’s children for the sake of Your Name.
Remember us for life, You who delight in life, and write us in the Book of Life — for Your own sake, Source of life.
You are our help, our rescue, our shield. Blessed are You, Eternal One, shield of Abraham and help of Sarah.

blocks.he: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ. מוֹרִיד הַטָּל.
blocks.tr: Ata gibor l’olam Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/meitim ata, rav l’hoshi’a. Morid hatal.

blocks.he: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים, סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים, וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת, וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה.
blocks.tr: M’chalkel chayim b’chesed, m’chayeh hakol/meitim b’rachamim rabim, somech nof’lim, v’rofe cholim, umatir asurim, umkayem emunato lishenei afar. Mi chamocha ba’al g’vurot, umi domeh lach, melech memit umchayeh umatzmi’ach y’shu’a.

blocks.en: You are forever mighty; You give life to all / revive the dead, and Your saving power is great. You cause the dew to fall. You sustain the living with love, giving life to all / reviving the dead with great compassion; You hold up the falling, heal the sick, free the captive, and keep faith with those who sleep in the dust.

blocks.he: מִי כָמוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים, זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לְחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים.
blocks.tr: Mi chamocha av harachamim, zocher y’tzurav l’chayim b’rachamim.

blocks.en: Who is like You, Source of mercy, who in compassion remembers Your creatures for life?

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת הַכֹּל/מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/הַמֵּתִים.
blocks.tr: V’ne’eman ata l’hachayot hakol/meitim. Baruch ata Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/hameitim.

blocks.en: Who is like You, Source of all power? Who can compare — You who bring death and life, and make rescue blossom? You are faithful to give life to all / to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who gives life to all / who revives the dead.

sources.name: Un’taneh Tokef
aliases: Our reckoning with mortality — there is no looking away on these Days of Awe.
openingWords: וּנְתַנֶּה תֹּקֶף קְדֻשַּׁת הַיּוֹם, כִּי הוּא נוֹרָא וְאָיֹם, וּבוֹ תִּנָּשֵׂא מַלְכוּתֶךָ, וְיִכּוֹן
Un’taneh tokef k’dushat hayom, ki hu nora v’ayom, uvo tinasei malchutecha, v’yikon
Let us proclaim the power of today’s holiness. How full of awe
אֱמֶת כִּי אַתָּה הוּא דַּיָּן וּמוֹכִיחַ וְיוֹדֵעַ וָעֵד, וְכוֹתֵב וְחוֹתֵם וְסוֹפֵר וּמוֹנֶה,
Emet ki ata hu dayan umochiach v’yodea va’ed, v’chotev v’chotem v’sofer umoneh,
It is true that nothing is hidden and nothing is lost: all
וּבְשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל יִתָּקַע, וְקוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה יִשָּׁמַע, וּמַלְאָכִים יֵחָפֵזוּן, וְחִיל וּרְעָדָה יֹאחֵזוּן,
Uvshofar gadol yitaka, v’kol d’mama daka yishama, umal’achim yechafezun, v’chil ur’ada yochezun,

blocks.he: וּנְתַנֶּה תֹּקֶף קְדֻשַּׁת הַיּוֹם, כִּי הוּא נוֹרָא וְאָיֹם, וּבוֹ תִּנָּשֵׂא מַלְכוּתֶךָ, וְיִכּוֹן בְּחֶסֶד כִּסְאֶךָ, וְתֵשֵׁב עָלָיו בֶּאֱמֶת
blocks.tr: Un’taneh tokef k’dushat hayom, ki hu nora v’ayom, uvo tinasei malchutecha, v’yikon b’chesed kisecha, v’teshev alav be’emet.

blocks.en: Let us proclaim the power of today’s holiness. How full of awe and dread it is. On this day what is beyond us comes into view: founded in love, and settled in truth.

blocks.he: אֱמֶת כִּי אַתָּה הוּא דַּיָּן וּמוֹכִיחַ וְיוֹדֵעַ וָעֵד, וְכוֹתֵב וְחוֹתֵם וְסוֹפֵר וּמוֹנֶה, וְתִזְכֹּר כָּל הַנִּשְׁכָּחוֹת, וְתִפְתַּח אֶת סֵפֶר הַזִּכְרוֹנוֹת, וּמֵאֵלָיו יִקָּרֵא, וְחוֹתָם יַד כָּל אָדָם בּוֹ
blocks.tr: Emet ki ata hu dayan umochiach v’yodea va’ed, v’chotev v’chotem v’sofer umoneh, v’tizkor kol hanishkachot, v’tiftach et sefer hazichronot, ume’elav yikarei, v’chotam yad kol adam bo.

blocks.en: It is true that nothing is hidden and nothing is lost: all of it known, all of it witnessed, written and sealed, counted and reckoned; even what we had forgotten is remembered. The book of remembrance opens, and it reads itself, for every human hand has signed it.

blocks.he: וּבְשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל יִתָּקַע, וְקוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה יִשָּׁמַע, וּמַלְאָכִים יֵחָפֵזוּן, וְחִיל וּרְעָדָה יֹאחֵזוּן, וְיֹאמְרוּ הִנֵּה יוֹם הַדִּין, לִפְקֹד עַל צְבָא מָרוֹם בַּדִּין, כִּי לֹא יִזְכּוּ בְעֵינֶיךָ בַּדִּין וְכָל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם יַעַבְרוּן לְפָנֶיךָ כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן כְּבַקָּרַת רוֹעֶה עֶדְרוֹ, מַעֲבִיר צֹאנוֹ תַּחַת שִׁבְטוֹ, כֵּן תַּעֲבִיר וְתִסְפֹּר וְתִמְנֶה, וְתִפְקֹד נֶפֶשׁ כָּל חָי, וְתַחְתֹּךְ קִצְבָה לְכָל בְּרִיָּה, וְתִכְתֹּב אֶת גְּזַר דִּינָם
blocks.tr: Uvshofar gadol yitaka, v’kol d’mama daka yishama, umal’achim yechafezun, v’chil ur’ada yochezun, v’yomru: hineh yom hadin, lifkod al tz’va marom badin, ki lo yizku v’einecha badin. V’chol ba’ei olam ya’avrun l’fanecha kivnei maron. K’vakarat ro’eh edro, ma’avir tzono tachat shivto, ken ta’avir v’tispor v’timneh, v’tifkod nefesh kol chai, v’tachtoch kitzba l’chol b’riya, v’tichtov et g’zar dinam.

blocks.en: A great shofar sounds, and a thin, whispering silence is heard. The angels rush, gripped by trembling and dread, and cry: here it is, the day of reckoning, a day to call the hosts of heaven to account, for even they are not innocent in Your eyes. Every being who enters the world passes before You like a flock, one by one. As a shepherd counts the flock, each one passing under the staff, so we pass before You — and You count, and number, and take account of every living soul, mark out the measure of each life, and write out their decree.

blocks.he: בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה יִכָּתֵבוּן, וּבְיוֹם צוֹם כִּפּוּר יֵחָתֵמוּן.
blocks.tr: B’Rosh Hashanah yikatevun, uvyom tzom Kippur yechatemun.

blocks.he: כַּמָּה יַעַבְרוּן, וְכַמָּה יִבָּרֵאוּן, מִי יִחְיֶה, וּמִי יָמוּת, מִי בְקִצּוֹ, וּמִי לֹא בְקִצּוֹ, מִי בַמַּיִם, וּמִי בָאֵשׁ, מִי בַחֶרֶב, וּמִי בַחַיָּה, מִי בָרָעָב, וּמִי בַצָּמָא, מִי בָרַעַשׁ, וּמִי בַמַּגֵּפָה, מִי בַחֲנִיקָה, וּמִי בַסְּקִילָה, מִי יָנוּחַ, וּמִי יָנוּעַ, מִי יִשָּׁקֵט, וּמִי יִטָּרֵף, מִי יִשָּׁלֵו, וּמִי יִתְיַסָּר, מִי יַעֲנִי, וּמִי יַעֲשִׁיר, מִי יֻשְׁפַּל, וּמִי יָרוּם. וּתְשׁוּבָה וּתְפִלָּה וּצְדָקָה מַעֲבִירִין אֶת רֹעַ הַגְּזֵרָה.
blocks.tr: Kama ya’avrun, v’chama yibare’un. Mi yichyeh, umi yamut. Mi v’kitzo, umi lo b’kitzo. Mi vamayim, umi va’esh, mi vacherev, umi vachaya, mi vara’av, umi vatzama, mi vara’ash, umi vamagefa, mi vachanika, umi vaskila. Mi yanuach, umi yanua, mi yishakeit, umi yitaref, mi yishalev, umi yityasar, mi ya’ani, umi ya’ashir, mi yushpal, umi yarum. Ut’shuva ut’fila utz’daka ma’avirin et ro’a hag’zera.

blocks.he: כִּי כְּשִׁמְךָ כֵּן תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, קָשֶׁה לִכְעוֹס וְנוֹחַ לִרְצוֹת, כִּי לֹא תַחְפֹּץ בְּמוֹת הַמֵּת, כִּי אִם בְּשׁוּבוֹ מִדַּרְכּוֹ וְחָיָה, וְעַד יוֹם מוֹתוֹ תְּחַכֶּה לוֹ, אִם יָשׁוּב מִיַּד תְּקַבְּלוֹ. כִּי אַתָּה הוּא יוֹצְרָם וְיוֹדֵעַ יִצְרָם, כִּי הֵם בָּשָׂר וָדָם.
blocks.tr: Ki k’shimcha ken t’hilatecha, kasheh lich’os v’noach lirtzot, ki lo tachpotz b’mot hameit, ki im b’shuvo midarko v’chaya, v’ad yom moto t’chakeh lo, im yashuv miyad t’kablo. Ki ata hu yotz’ram v’yodea yitzram, ki hem basar vadam.

blocks.en: For as Your Name is, so is Your praise — slow to anger and easily reconciled; for You do not want the death of anyone who dies, but that they turn from their way and live. To the very last day You wait for them; the moment they turn, You welcome them back. For You are the one who formed them, and You know what they are made of — that they are flesh and blood.

blocks.he: אָדָם יְסוֹדוֹ מֵעָפָר וְסוֹפוֹ לֶעָפָר. בְּנַפְשׁוֹ יָבִיא לַחְמוֹ. מָשׁוּל כְּחֶרֶס הַנִּשְׁבָּר, כְּחָצִיר יָבֵשׁ, וּכְצִיץ נוֹבֵל, כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר, וּכְעָנָן כָּלָה, וּכְרוּחַ נוֹשָׁבֶת, וּכְאָבָק פּוֹרֵחַ, וְכַחֲלוֹם יָעוּף. וְאַתָּה הוּא מֶלֶךְ אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם.
blocks.tr: Adam y’sodo me’afar v’sofo le’afar. B’nafsho yavi lachmo. Mashul k’cheres hanishbar, k’chatzir yavesh, uch’tzitz novel, k’tzel over, uch’anan kala, uch’ruach noshavet, uch’avak porei’ach, v’chachalom ya’uf. V’ata hu melech El chai v’kayam.

blocks.en: A human being: dust at the start, dust at the end — spending a life just to bring home bread. Like a broken shard, like withering grass and a fading flower, a passing shadow, a vanishing cloud, a gust of wind, a scatter of dust, a dream that flies off. — And You: the living and enduring God, being that is always becoming.

sources.name: K’dushah
aliases: We rise up on our toes at Kadosh as we strive toward holiness.
openingWords: נְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בָּעוֹלָם כְּשֵׁם שֶׁמַּקְדִּישִׁים אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁמֵי מָרוֹם. כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד
Nekadesh et shimcha ba’olam, k’shem shemakdishim oto bishmei marom, kakatuv al yad
קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ.
Kadosh, kadosh, kadosh Adonai tz’va’ot, m’lo chol ha’aretz k’vodo.
אָז בְּקוֹל רַֽעַשׁ גָּדוֹל אַדִּיר וְחָזָק מַשְׁמִיעִים קוֹל מִתְנַשְּׂאִים לְעֻמַּת שְׂרָפִים. לְעֻמָּתָם
Az b’kol ra’ash gadol adir v’chazak mashmi’im kol, mitnas’im l’umat s’rafim, l’umatam

blocks.he: נְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בָּעוֹלָם כְּשֵׁם שֶׁמַּקְדִּישִׁים אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁמֵי מָרוֹם. כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ. וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל זֶה וְאָמַר:
blocks.tr: Nekadesh et shimcha ba’olam, k’shem shemakdishim oto bishmei marom, kakatuv al yad n’vi’echa: v’kara zeh el zeh v’amar:

blocks.he: קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ.
blocks.tr: Kadosh, kadosh, kadosh Adonai tz’va’ot, m’lo chol ha’aretz k’vodo.

blocks.he: אָז בְּקוֹל רַֽעַשׁ גָּדוֹל אַדִּיר וְחָזָק מַשְׁמִיעִים קוֹל מִתְנַשְּׂאִים לְעֻמַּת שְׂרָפִים. לְעֻמָּתָם בָּרוּךְ יֹאמֵֽרוּ:
blocks.tr: Az b’kol ra’ash gadol adir v’chazak mashmi’im kol, mitnas’im l’umat s’rafim, l’umatam baruch yomeru:

blocks.he: מִמְּקוֹמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תוֹפִֽיעַ וְתִמְלוֹךְ עָלֵֽינוּ כִּי מְחַכִּים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ מָתַי תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּצִיּוֹן בְּקָרוֹב בְּיָמֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד תִּשְׁכּוֹן. תִּתְגַּדַּל וְתִתְקַדַּשׁ בְּתוֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִירְךָ לְדוֹר וָדוֹר וּלְנֵֽצַח נְצָחִים. וְעֵינֵֽינוּ תִרְאֶֽינָה מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ כַּדָּבָר הָאָמוּר בְּשִׁירֵי עֻזֶּֽךָ עַל יְדֵי דָוִד מְשִֽׁיחַ צִדְקֶֽךָ:
blocks.tr: Mim’komcha malkeinu tofi’a v’timloch aleinu, ki m’chakim anachnu lach. Matai timloch b’Tziyon? B’karov b’yameinu, l’olam va’ed tishkon. Titgadal v’titkadash b’toch Yerushalayim ircha l’dor vador ulnetzach n’tzachim. V’eineinu tir’ena malchutecha, kadavar ha’amur b’shirei uzecha al y’dei David m’shiach tzidkecha:

blocks.he: יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ.
blocks.tr: Yimloch Adonai l’olam, Elohayich Tziyon l’dor vador, hal’luyah.

blocks.he: לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נַגִּיד גָּדְלֶֽךָ וּלְנֵֽצַח נְצָחִים קְדֻשָּׁתְךָ נַקְדִּישׁ וְשִׁבְחֲךָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מִפִּֽינוּ לֹא יָמוּשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ אָֽתָּה.
blocks.tr: L’dor vador nagid godlecha, ulnetzach n’tzachim k’dushatcha nakdish, v’shivchacha Eloheinu mipinu lo yamush l’olam va’ed, ki El melech gadol v’kadosh ata.

blocks.en: We make Your Name holy in the world as they make it holy in the heights of heaven, as Your prophet wrote: and they called out, one to another, and said:
Holy, holy, holy is the Source of all being; the fullness of the whole earth is that glory.
Then, with the sound of a great roar, mighty and strong, they raise their voices, lifting toward the seraphim, and facing them say: Blessed —
Blessed is the glory of the Eternal, from its place.

From Your place, appear to us — for we are waiting for You. When will that day come to Zion? Soon, in our own days — dwell there forever. Be magnified and made holy within Yerushalayim Your city, from generation to generation, for all time. May our own eyes see the world made whole, as the word is sung in the songs of Your strength, by the hand of David, Your anointed of justice:
The Eternal will reign forever — your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.
From generation to generation we will tell Your greatness, and for all time make holy Your holiness; Your praise, our God, will never leave our mouths, for You are a great and holy God.

sources.name: Uv’chein
aliases: Awe and hope for a world made whole.
openingWords: וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל מַה
Uvchein ten pachd’cha Adonai Eloheinu al kol ma’asecha, v’eimat’cha al kol ma
And so: set the awe of You, Eternal our God, over all
וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יְיָ לְעַמֶּךָ, תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶיךָ וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶׁיךָ וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה
Uvchein ten kavod Adonai l’amecha, t’hila lire’echa v’tikva tova l’dor’shecha ufitchon peh
And so: give honor, Eternal One, to Your people, praise to those
וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹזוּ, וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִילוּ, וְעוֹלָתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּיהָ,
Uvchein tzadikim yir’u v’yismachu, visharim ya’alozu, vachasidim b’rina yagilu, v’olata tikpotz piha,

blocks.he: וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ. וְיִירָאוּךָ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים, וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם. כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַעְנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁהַשִּׁלְטוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ, עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶךָ, וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ.
blocks.tr: Uvchein ten pachd’cha Adonai Eloheinu al kol ma’asecha, v’eimat’cha al kol ma shebarata. V’yira’ucha kol hama’asim v’yishtachavu l’fanecha kol hab’ru’im, v’ye’asu chulam aguda achat la’asot r’tzon’cha b’levav shalem. K’mo sheyadanu Adonai Eloheinu shehashilton l’fanecha, oz b’yad’cha ugvura biminecha, v’shimcha nora al kol ma shebarata.

blocks.en: And so: set the awe of You, Eternal our God, over all You have made, and the awe of You over all You have created — that every made thing hold You in awe and all creatures bow before You, and that they all become one company, to do Your will with a whole heart. For we know, Eternal our God, that the governing is Yours — strength in Your hand and power in Your right hand — and Your Name is awesome over all You have made.

blocks.he: וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יְיָ לְעַמֶּךָ, תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶיךָ וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶׁיךָ וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה לַמְיַחֲלִים לָךְ. שִׂמְחָה לְאַרְצֶךָ וְשָׂשׂוֹן לְעִירֶךָ, וּצְמִיחַת קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדֶּךָ וַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחֶךָ, בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Uvchein ten kavod Adonai l’amecha, t’hila lire’echa v’tikva tova l’dor’shecha ufitchon peh lamyachalim lach. Simcha l’artzecha v’sason l’irecha, utzmichat keren l’David avdecha va’arichat ner l’ven Yishai m’shichecha, bimheira v’yameinu.

blocks.en: And so: give honor, Eternal One, to Your people, praise to those who hold You in awe and good hope to those who seek You, and an open mouth to those who wait for You — joy to Your land and gladness to Your city, and the flowering of new strength for the line of David Your servant, soon, in our own days.

blocks.he: וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹזוּ, וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִילוּ, וְעוֹלָתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּיהָ, וְכָל הָרִשְׁעָה כֻּלָּהּ כְּעָשָׁן תִּכְלֶה, כִּי תַעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן הָאָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Uvchein tzadikim yir’u v’yismachu, visharim ya’alozu, vachasidim b’rina yagilu, v’olata tikpotz piha, v’chol harish’a kula k’ashan tichleh, ki ta’avir memshelet zadon min ha’aretz.

blocks.he: וְתִמְלוֹךְ אַתָּה יְיָ לְבַדֶּךָ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, בְּהַר צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ, וּבִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ: יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם, אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר, הַלְלוּיָהּ.
blocks.tr: V’timloch ata Adonai l’vadecha al kol ma’asecha, b’har Tziyon mishkan k’vodecha, uvirushalayim ir kodshecha, kakatuv b’divrei kodshecha: yimloch Adonai l’olam, Elohayich Tziyon l’dor vador, hal’luyah.

blocks.en: And so: the just will see and be glad, the upright will rejoice, the faithful will delight in song — and wrongdoing will shut its mouth, and all wickedness will vanish like smoke, when You clear the rule of arrogance from the earth. And You alone, Eternal One, will be the Oneness over all You have made, on Mount Zion, the dwelling of Your glory, and in Yerushalayim, Your holy city — as it is written: The Eternal will reign forever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.

blocks.he: קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֶךָ, וְאֵין אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ. כַּכָּתוּב: וַיִּגְבַּהּ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט, וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדָּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה.
blocks.tr: Kadosh ata v'nora sh'mecha, v'ein eloah mibal'adecha. Kakatuv: vayigbah Adonai tz'va'ot bamishpat, v'ha'El hakadosh nikdash bitzdaka.

blocks.en: You are holy, and Your Name inspires awe, and there is no god but You — as it is written: “the Source of all being is exalted through justice, and the holy God is hallowed through righteousness.” (Isaiah 5:16)
Blessed are You, Eternal One, the holy Sovereign.

sources.name: K’dushat HaYom
aliases: The blessing that names the day: Yom HaZikaron, the Day of Remembrance.
openingWords: אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ, וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת, וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ
Ata v’chartanu mikol ha’amim, ahavta otanu v’ratzita banu, v’romamtanu mikol hal’shonot, v’kidashtanu
You chose us from among all peoples, and loved us, and wanted
וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה (אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְ) אֶת יוֹם
Vatiten lanu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava (et yom haShabbat hazeh v’) et yom
And You gave us, Eternal our God, in love (this Shabbat day
אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא וְיַגִּיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר
Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, ya’aleh v’yavo v’yagia v’yera’eh v’yeratzeh v’yishama v’yipaked v’yizacher

blocks.he: אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ, וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת, וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ, וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ.
blocks.tr: Ata v’chartanu mikol ha’amim, ahavta otanu v’ratzita banu, v’romamtanu mikol hal’shonot, v’kidashtanu b’mitzvotecha, v’keiravtanu malkeinu la’avodatecha, v’shimcha hagadol v’hakadosh aleinu karata.

blocks.en: You chose us from among all peoples, and loved us, and wanted us; You lifted us up among all tongues and made us holy through Your mitzvot, and drew us near to Your service, and called Your great and holy Name over us.

blocks.he: וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה (אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְ) אֶת יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה, יוֹם (זִכְרוֹן) תְּרוּעָה (בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ, זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם.
blocks.tr: Vatiten lanu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava (et yom haShabbat hazeh v’) et yom haZikaron hazeh, yom (zichron) t’ru’a (b’ahava) mikra kodesh, zecher litzi’at Mitzrayim.

blocks.en: And You gave us, Eternal our God, in love (this Shabbat day and) this Day of Remembrance — a day of (the remembrance of) the shofar-blast (in love), a holy calling, a remembrance of the going-out from Egypt.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא וְיַגִּיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר זִכְרוֹנֵנוּ וּפִקְדוֹנֵנוּ, וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ, וְזִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפָנֶיךָ, לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה, לְחֵן וּלְחֶסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים, לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם בְּיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה.
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, ya’aleh v’yavo v’yagia v’yera’eh v’yeratzeh v’yishama v’yipaked v’yizacher zichroneinu ufikdoneinu, v’zichron avoteinu v’imoteinu, v’zichron mashiach ben David avdecha, v’zichron Yerushalayim ir kodshecha, v’zichron kol am’cha beit Yisra’el l’fanecha, lifleita l’tova, l’chein ulchesed ulrachamim, l’chayim ulshalom b’yom haZikaron hazeh.

blocks.he: זָכְרֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה, וּפָקְדֵנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים. וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים חוּס וְחָנֵּנוּ, וְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ, כִּי אֵלֶיךָ עֵינֵינוּ, כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה.
blocks.tr: Zochreinu Adonai Eloheinu bo l’tova, ufokdeinu vo livracha, v’hoshi’einu vo l’chayim. Uvidvar y’shu’a v’rachamim chus v’chaneinu, v’rachem aleinu v’hoshi’einu. Ki eilecha eineinu, ki El melech chanun v’rachum ata.

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors: may there rise and come, reach and be seen, be wanted and heard, counted and remembered — the remembrance of us and of our ancestors, and the remembrance of the anointed one of the house of David Your servant, and the remembrance of Yerushalayim Your holy city, and of all Your people the house of Yisrael — for deliverance and good, for grace and love and mercy, for life and peace, on this Day of Remembrance.

Remember us on it for good; take account of us for blessing; save us for life. And with a word of rescue and mercy, spare us and be gracious to us; have compassion on us and save us. For our eyes are turned to You — You are God, gracious and merciful.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, מְלוֹךְ עַל כָּל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בִּכְבוֹדֶךָ, וְהִנָּשֵׂא עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בִּיקָרֶךָ, וְהוֹפַע בַּהֲדַר גְּאוֹן עֻזֶּךָ עַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל אַרְצֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, m’loch al kol ha’olam kulo bichvodecha, v’hinasei al kol ha’aretz bikarecha, v’hofa bahadar g’on uzecha al kol yoshvei tevel artzecha.

blocks.he: וְיֵדַע כָּל פָּעוּל כִּי אַתָּה פְעַלְתּוֹ, וְיָבִין כָּל יְצוּר כִּי אַתָּה יְצַרְתּוֹ, וְיֹאמַר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׁמָה בְאַפּוֹ: יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶלֶךְ, וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה.
blocks.tr: V’yeda kol pa’ul ki ata f’alto, v’yavin kol y’tzur ki ata y’tzarto, v’yomar kol asher n’shama v’apo: Adonai Elohei Yisra’el melech, umalchuto bakol mashala.

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors: let Your glory fill all the world; be lifted up over all the earth in Your splendor; shine out in the majesty of Your strength over all who dwell on the earth You made —
and let every made thing know that You made it, and every creature understand that You formed it, and all that breathes say: HaShem, God of Yisrael, is One, and that Oneness holds all things.

blocks.he: (אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ.) קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, (וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְיָנוּחוּ בוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ,) וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת, וּדְבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד.
blocks.tr: (Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu r’tzeh vimnuchateinu.) Kad’sheinu b’mitzvotecha v’ten chelkeinu b’toratecha, sab’einu mituvecha v’samcheinu bishu’atecha, (v’hanchileinu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava uvratzon Shabbat kodshecha, v’yanuchu vo Yisra’el m’kad’shei sh’mecha,) v’taher libeinu l’ovd’cha be’emet, ki ata Elohim emet, ud’varcha emet v’kayam la’ad.

blocks.en: The lines in parentheses are added when Rosh Hashanah falls on Shabbat.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ)יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, melech al kol ha’aretz, m’kadesh (haShabbat v’)Yisra’el v’Yom haZikaron.

blocks.en: (Our God and God of our ancestors, take pleasure in our rest.) Make us holy through Your mitzvot and give us our portion in Your Torah; fill us with Your goodness and gladden us with Your saving help; (in love and favor, grant us Your holy Shabbat as our inheritance, and let Yisrael, who make Your Name holy, rest on it;) and make our hearts pure to serve You in truth — for You are the God of truth, and Your word is truth, enduring forever. Blessed are You, Eternal One over all the earth, who makes holy (Shabbat and) Yisrael and the Day of Remembrance.

sources.name: Avodah
aliases: Our prayer that our impact matches our intentions.

blocks.en: Take pleasure, Eternal our God, in Your people Yisrael and in their prayer; in love receive that prayer with favor, and may the service of Your people Yisrael always be, in truth, for the good. God near to all who call, turn to those who serve You, and be gracious to us. Pour out Your spirit upon us.
May our eyes behold Your loving return to Zion. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who returns Your presence to Zion.

blocks.he: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. צוּר חַיֵּינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר. נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם.
blocks.tr: Modim anachnu lach, sha’ata hu Adonai Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu l’olam va’ed. Tzur chayeinu, magen yish’einu ata hu l’dor vador. Nodeh l’cha unsaper t’hilatecha, al chayeinu ham’surim b’yadecha, v’al nishmoteinu hap’kudot lach, v’al nisecha sheb’chol yom imanu, v’al nifl’otecha v’tovotecha sheb’chol et, erev vavoker v’tzohorayim.

blocks.he: הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ, מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ.
blocks.tr: Hatov ki lo chalu rachamecha, v’hamrachem ki lo tamu chasadecha, me’olam kivinu lach.

blocks.he: וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ. וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶּלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת.
blocks.tr: V’al kulam yitbarach v’yitromam shimcha malkeinu tamid l’olam va’ed. Uch’tov l’chayim tovim kol b’nei v’ritecha. V’chol hachayim yoducha sela, vihal’lu et shimcha be’emet, ha’El y’shu’ateinu v’ezrateinu sela. Baruch ata Adonai, hatov shimcha ulcha na’eh l’hodot.

blocks.en: We thank You, for You are the One, our God and the God of our ancestors, forever. Rock of our life, shield of our rescue — so You are, in every generation. We give thanks and tell Your praise: for our lives, held in Your hand; for our souls, entrusted to You; for Your miracles that are with us every day; and for Your wonders and Your gifts at every moment — evening, morning, and noon.
You are the Good, whose mercies never end; the Compassionate, whose kindnesses never fail, forever we have placed our hope in You.

For all these things may Your Name be blessed and raised up, always and forever. And write down for a good life all the children of Your covenant. Let all that lives give thanks to You, and praise Your Name in truth, God of our rescue and our help. Blessed are You, Eternal One, whose Name is Goodness, and to whom thanks are due.

sources.name: Sim Shalom
aliases: For peace, and to be written into the Book of Life — the day’s plea for wholeness.
openingWords: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ.
Sim shalom tova uvracha, chein vachesed v’rachamim, aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el amecha.
בְּסֵפֶר חַיִּים, בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם, וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה, נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶיךָ, אֲנַחְנוּ וְכָל עַמְּךָ
B’sefer chayim, b’racha v’shalom, ufarnasa tova, nizacher v’nikatev l’fanecha, anachnu v’chol am’cha
Grant peace, goodness and blessing, grace and love and mercy, upon us
May we all be written in the book of life, for blessing,

blocks.he: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ, כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד, וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל עֵת וּבְכָל שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Sim shalom tova uvracha, chein vachesed v’rachamim, aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el amecha. Barcheinu avinu kulanu k’echad b’or panecha, ki v’or panecha natata lanu Adonai Eloheinu torat chayim v’ahavat chesed, utz’daka uvracha v’rachamim v’chayim v’shalom. V’tov b’einecha l’varech et am’cha Yisra’el b’chol et uvchol sha’a bishlomecha.

blocks.he: בְּסֵפֶר חַיִּים, בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם, וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה, נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶיךָ, אֲנַחְנוּ וְכָל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם.
blocks.tr: B’sefer chayim, b’racha v’shalom, ufarnasa tova, nizacher v’nikatev l’fanecha, anachnu v’chol am’cha beit Yisra’el, l’chayim tovim ulshalom.

blocks.en: Grant peace, goodness and blessing, grace and love and mercy, upon us and upon all Yisrael Your people. Bless us, our Source, all of us as one, in the light of Your face — for by the light of Your face You gave us, Eternal our God, a Torah of life and the love of kindness, tzedakah and blessing and mercy and life and peace. And may it be good in Your eyes to bless Your people Yisrael, in every season and at every hour, with Your peace.
May we all be written in the book of life, for blessing, for peace, and for a good living: us, and all Your people, Yisrael, for a good life and for shalom.
Blessed are You, Adonai, who calls us to create a world of peace.

sources.name: Elohai N’tzor
aliases: Space for the words of our heart.
openingWords: אֱלֹהַי, נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע, וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר
Elohai, n’tzor l’shoni mera, usfatai midaber mirma, v’limkal’lai nafshi tidom, v’nafshi ke’afar
וְכֹל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ,
V’chol hachosh’vim alai ra’a, m’hera hafer atzatam v’kalkel machashavtam. Aseh l’ma’an sh’mecha,
יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי.
Yihyu l’ratzon imrei fi v’hegyon libi l’fanecha, Adonai tzuri v’go’ali.
עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל
Oseh hashalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol

blocks.he: אֱלֹהַי, נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע, וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה. פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדֹּף נַפְשִׁי.
blocks.tr: Elohai, n’tzor l’shoni mera, usfatai midaber mirma, v’limkal’lai nafshi tidom, v’nafshi ke’afar lakol tihyeh. P’tach libi b’toratecha, uvmitzvotecha tirdof nafshi.

blocks.he: וְכֹל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ, הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי.
blocks.tr: V’chol hachosh’vim alai ra’a, m’hera hafer atzatam v’kalkel machashavtam. Aseh l’ma’an sh’mecha, aseh l’ma’an y’minecha, aseh l’ma’an k’dushatecha, aseh l’ma’an toratecha. L’ma’an yechal’tzun y’didecha, hoshi’a y’min’cha va’aneni.

blocks.he: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי.
blocks.tr: Yihyu l’ratzon imrei fi v’hegyon libi l’fanecha, Adonai tzuri v’go’ali.

blocks.he: עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh hashalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit. To those who curse me, let my soul stay silent; let my soul be humble as the dust before all. Open my heart to Your Torah, that my soul may pursue Your mitzvot.

And all who plan evil against me — quickly undo their designs and unravel their schemes. Act for the sake of Your Name; act for the sake of Your right hand; act for the sake of Your holiness; act for the sake of Your Torah. That those You love may be freed, let Your right hand save — answer me.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Eternal One, my Rock and my Redeemer.
May the One who makes the peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Yisrael, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Avinu Malkeinu
aliases: Avinu Malkeinu, our traditional plea with the universe to be different than it is.
openingWords: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ.
Avinu Malkeinu, sh’ma koleinu, chus v’rachem aleinu.
…hear our voice; spare us, have mercy on us.
אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָתָּה.
Avinu Malkeinu, ein lanu melech ela ata.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, sh’ma koleinu, chus v’rachem aleinu.

blocks.en: …hear our voice; spare us, have mercy on us.
…we have sinned before You.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָתָּה.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, ein lanu melech ela ata.

blocks.en: …we have no sovereign but You.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ סְלַח וּמְחַל לְכָל עֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, s’lach umchal l’chol avonoteinu.

blocks.en: …forgive and pardon all our wrongs.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן הֲרוּגִים עַל שֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, aseh l’ma’an harugim al shem kodshecha.

blocks.en: …act for the sake of those killed for the holiness of Your Name.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חֲמוֹל עָלֵינוּ וְעַל עוֹלָלֵינוּ וְטַפֵּנוּ.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, chamol aleinu v’al olaleinu v’tapeinu.

blocks.en: …have mercy on us, and on our infants, and on our children.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כַּלֵּה דֶּבֶר וְחֶרֶב וְרָעָב מֵעָלֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, kaleh dever v’cherev v’ra’av me’aleinu.

blocks.en: …end plague and sword and hunger among us;

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כַּלֵּה כָּל צַר וּמַשְׂטִין מֵעָלֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, kaleh kol tzar umastin me’aleinu.

blocks.en: …end every foe and adversary.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כָּתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר חַיִּים טוֹבִים.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, kotveinu b’sefer chayim tovim.

blocks.en: …write us in the book of a good life;

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חַדֵּשׁ עָלֵינוּ שָׁנָה טוֹבָה.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, chadesh aleinu shana tova.

blocks.en: …renew for us a good year;

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ הָרֵם קֶרֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, harem keren Yisra’el amecha.

blocks.en: …raise up the strength of Your people Yisrael.

blocks.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶסֶד וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Avinu Malkeinu, chaneinu va’aneinu ki ein banu ma’asim, aseh imanu tzedaka vachesed v’hoshi’einu.

blocks.en: Avinu Malkeinu, be gracious and answer us, for we have little merit. Treat us with tzedakah and love. Save us.

sources.name: Kaddish Shalem
aliases: The Full Kaddish — its one added line, titkabel, asks that all we have prayed be received, sealing the Amidah.
openingWords: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן
Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.
יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu,
May the great Name be made great and holy in the world
May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon uvyomeichon uvchayei d’chol beit Yisra’el, ba’agala uvizman kariv, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵלָּא וּלְעֵלָּא מִכָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’eila ul’eila mikol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great Name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Yisrael, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the Name of the Holy One of blessing — far, far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

blocks.he: תִּתְקַבֵּל צְלוֹתְהוֹן וּבָעוּתְהוֹן דְּכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁמַיָּא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Titkabel tz’lot’hon uva’ut’hon d’chol beit Yisra’el kodam avuhon di vishmaya, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: Receive the prayers and pleas of all the house of Yisrael before the One in heaven — and say: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא, וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’lama raba min sh’maya, v’chayim aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh hashalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May great peace from heaven, and life, be upon us and upon all Yisrael — and say: Amen. May the One who makes the peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Yisrael, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Ein Kamocha
aliases: We celebrate the pageantry and majesty of text.

Ein kamocha va’elohim Adonai, v’ein k’ma’asecha. Malchut’cha malchut kol olamim, umemshalt’cha b’chol
אַב הָרַחֲמִים, הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת צִיּוֹן, תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלָיִם. כִּי בְךָ לְבַד
Av harachamim, heitiva virtzon’cha et Tziyon, tivneh chomot Y’rushalayim. Ki v’cha l’vad
There is none like You among all powers, Eternal One — nothing
Source of compassion — in Your goodwill, be good to Zion; rebuild

blocks.he: אֵין כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי, וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ. מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל עוֹלָמִים, וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ, יְיָ מָלָךְ, יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. יְיָ עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן, יְיָ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם.
blocks.tr: Ein kamocha va’elohim Adonai, v’ein k’ma’asecha. Malchut’cha malchut kol olamim, umemshalt’cha b’chol dor vador. Adonai melech, Adonai malach, Adonai yimloch l’olam va’ed. Adonai oz l’amo yiten, Adonai y’varech et amo vashalom.

blocks.he: אַב הָרַחֲמִים, הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת צִיּוֹן, תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלָיִם. כִּי בְךָ לְבַד בָּטָחְנוּ, מֶלֶךְ אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא אֲדוֹן עוֹלָמִים.
blocks.tr: Av harachamim, heitiva virtzon’cha et Tziyon, tivneh chomot Y’rushalayim. Ki v’cha l’vad batachnu, melech El ram v’nisa adon olamim.

blocks.en: There is none like You among all powers, Eternal One — nothing like the things You make. Your reign is a reign over all worlds; Your rule holds through every generation. The Eternal rules; the Eternal has ruled; the Eternal will rule forever and ever. May the Holy One give strength to this people; may the Holy One bless this people with peace.
Source of compassion — in Your goodwill, be good to Zion; rebuild the walls of Yerushalayim. For in You alone we have trusted, exalted, uplifted, God everlasting.

sources.name: Vay’hi Binso’a
aliases: The ark opens; we carry the Torah out, as Moses moved it through the wilderness.
openingWords: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָאָרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה: קוּמָה יְיָ וְיָפֻצוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ, וְיָנֻסוּ מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ.
Vay’hi binso’a ha’aron vayomer Moshe: Kuma Adonai v’yafutzu oyvecha, v’yanusu m’san’echa mipanecha.
כִּי מִצִּיּוֹן תֵּצֵא תוֹרָה, וּדְבַר יְיָ מִירוּשָׁלָיִם.
Ki miTziyon tetze Tora, udvar Adonai miY’rushalayim.
בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ.
Baruch shenatan Tora l’amo Yisra’el bikdushato.
When the ark would set out, Moses would say: Rise up, Eternal
For Torah goes forth from Zion, and the word of the Eternal

blocks.he: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָאָרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה: קוּמָה יְיָ וְיָפֻצוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ, וְיָנֻסוּ מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ.
blocks.tr: Vay’hi binso’a ha’aron vayomer Moshe: Kuma Adonai v’yafutzu oyvecha, v’yanusu m’san’echa mipanecha.

blocks.he: כִּי מִצִּיּוֹן תֵּצֵא תוֹרָה, וּדְבַר יְיָ מִירוּשָׁלָיִם.
blocks.tr: Ki miTziyon tetze Tora, udvar Adonai miY’rushalayim.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Baruch shenatan Tora l’amo Yisra’el bikdushato.

blocks.en: When the ark would set out, Moses would say: Rise up, Eternal One — let Your enemies scatter, let those who hate You flee before You.
For Torah goes forth from Zion, and the word of the Eternal from Yerushalayim.
Blessed is the One who gave Torah to the people Yisrael, in holiness.

sources.name: The Thirteen Attributes
aliases: At the open ark we name the ways of mercy, three times.
openingWords: יְיָ, יְיָ, אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן, אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת, נֹצֵר חֶסֶד
Adonai, Adonai, El rachum v’chanun, erech apayim v’rav chesed ve’emet, notzer chesed
HaShem, HaShem, the Eternal, compassionate and gracious, patient, abounding in love and

blocks.en: Three times.

blocks.he: יְיָ, יְיָ, אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן, אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת, נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים, נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה, וְנַקֵּה.
blocks.tr: Adonai, Adonai, El rachum v’chanun, erech apayim v’rav chesed ve’emet, notzer chesed la’alafim, nosei avon vafesha v’chata’a, v’nakeh.

blocks.en: HaShem, HaShem, the Eternal, compassionate and gracious, patient, abounding in love and truth, keeping love to the thousandth generation, bearing wrongdoing and rebellion and failure, and granting pardon.

sources.name: Sh’ma
aliases: The Sh’ma to a raised scroll — call and response — as we repeat these ancient words.
openingWords: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, יְיָ אֶחָד. אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ, גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵינוּ, קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא

blocks.he: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, יְיָ אֶחָד. אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ, גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵינוּ, קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא שְׁמוֹ.

blocks.he: גַּדְּלוּ לַיְיָ אִתִּי, וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו.
blocks.tr: Gad’lu la’Adonai iti, unrom’ma sh’mo yachdav.

blocks.en: Listen, Yisrael: the Eternal is our God, the Eternal is One.
One is our God; great beyond measure; holy and awesome is that Name.
Magnify the Eternal with me — let us lift up that Name together.

blocks.en: Yours, Eternal One, is the greatness, the power, the beauty, the endurance, the majesty — yes, all that is in the heavens and on the earth. Yours, Eternal One, is the sovereignty, lifted up as head over all.
Lift up the Eternal our God, and bow down toward that footstool — the Holy One.
Lift up the Eternal our God, and bow toward that holy mountain — for the Eternal our God is holy.

blocks.en: 6 Sarah said, “God has brought me laughter; everyone who hears will laugh with me.” 7 And she added, “Who would have said to Abraham That Sarah would suckle children! Yet I have borne a son in his old age.”

8 The child grew up and was weaned, and Abraham held a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned. 9 Sarah saw the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham playing. 10 She said to Abraham, “Cast out that slave-woman and her son, for the son of that slave shall not share in the inheritance with my son Isaac.” 11 The matter distressed Abraham greatly, for it concerned a son of his.

12 But God said to Abraham, “Do not be distressed over the boy or your slave; whatever Sarah tells you, do as she says, for it is through Isaac that offspring shall be continued for you. 13 As for the son of the slave-woman, I will make a nation of him, too, for he is your seed.”

14 Early next morning Abraham took some bread and a skin of water, and gave them to Hagar. He placed them over her shoulder, together with the child, and sent her away. And she wandered about in the wilderness of Beer-sheba. 15 When the water was gone from the skin, she left the child under one of the bushes, 16 and went and sat down at a distance, a bowshot away; for she thought, “Let me not look on as the child dies.” And sitting thus afar, she burst into tears.

17 God heard the cry of the boy, and an angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Fear not, for God has heeded the cry of the boy where he is. 18 Come, lift up the boy and hold him by the hand, for I will make a great nation of him.” 19 Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. She went and filled the skin with water, and let the boy drink.
20 God was with the boy and he grew up; he dwelt in the wilderness and became skilled with a bow. 21 He lived in the wilderness of Paran; and his mother got a wife for him from the land of Egypt.

22 At that time Abimelech and Phicol, chief of his troops, said to Abraham, “God is with you in everything that you do. 23 Therefore swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me or with my kith and kin, but will deal with me and with the land in which you have sojourned as loyally as I have dealt with you.” 24 And Abraham said, “I swear it.”

25 Then Abraham reproached Abimelech for the well of water that the servants of Abimelech had seized. 26 But Abimelech said, “I do not know who did this; you did not tell me, nor have I heard of it until today.” 27 Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two of them made a pact.

28 Abraham then set seven ewes of the flock by themselves, 29 and Abimelech said to Abraham, “What mean these seven ewes that you have set apart?” 30 He replied, “You are to accept these seven ewes from me as proof that I dug this well.” 31 Hence that place was called Beer-sheba, for there the two of them swore an oath.

blocks.en: 1 Some time afterward, God put Abraham to the test—saying to him, “Abraham.” He answered, “Here I am.” 2 “Take your son, your favored one, Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the heights that I will point out to you.” 3 So early next morning, Abraham saddled his donkey and took with him two of his servants and his son Isaac. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and he set out for the place of which God had told him.

4 On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place from afar. 5 Then Abraham said to his servants, “You stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go up there; we will worship and we will return to you.” 6 Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and put it on his son Isaac. He himself took the firestone and the knife; and the two walked off together. 7 Then Isaac said to his father Abraham, “Father!” And he answered, “Yes, my son.” And he said, “Here are the firestone and the wood; but where is the sheep for the burnt offering?” 8 And Abraham said, “It is God who will see to the sheep for this burnt offering, my son.” And the two of them walked on together.

9 They arrived at the place of which God had told him. Abraham built an altar there; he laid out the wood; he bound his son Isaac; he laid him on the altar, on top of the wood. 10 And Abraham picked up the knife to slay his son.

20 Some time later, Abraham was told, “Milcah too has borne sons to your brother Nahor: 21 Uz the first-born, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram; 22 and Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel”—

23 Bethuel being the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother. 24 And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore [sons]—Tebah, Gaham, and Tahash—and [a daughter,] Maacah.

blocks.tr: HaKadosh Baruch Hu yimalei rachamim aleihem, l’hachalimam ul’rap’otam ul’hachazikam, v’yishlach lahem m’heira r’fuah sh’leima, r’fuat hanefesh ur’fuat haguf, hashta ba’agala uvizman kariv. V’nomar: Amen.

blocks.en: May the One who blessed our fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and our mothers Sarah, Rebecca, Rachel, Leah, Bilhah, and Zilpah, bless and heal those who are ill […]. May the Holy One of blessing be filled with compassion for them — to restore them, to heal them, to strengthen them — and send them, swiftly, a complete healing, healing of the spirit and healing of the body, now, speedily, and soon. And let us say: Amen.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, צוּר כָּל הָעוֹלָמִים, צַדִּיק בְּכָל הַדּוֹרוֹת, הָאֵל הַנֶּאֱמָן הָאוֹמֵר וְעוֹשֶׂה, הַמְדַבֵּר וּמְקַיֵּם, שֶׁכָּל דְּבָרָיו אֱמֶת וָצֶדֶק.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha’olam, tzur kol ha’olamim, tzadik b’chol hadorot, ha’El hane’eman ha’omer v’oseh, hamdaber umkayem, shekol d’varav emet vatzedek.

blocks.he: נֶאֱמָן אַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְנֶאֱמָנִים דְּבָרֶיךָ, וְדָבָר אֶחָד מִדְּבָרֶיךָ אָחוֹר לֹא יָשׁוּב רֵיקָם, כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ נֶאֱמָן וְרַחֲמָן אָתָּה.
blocks.tr: Ne’eman ata hu Adonai Eloheinu v’ne’emanim d’varecha, v’davar echad mid’varecha achor lo yashuv reikam, ki El melech ne’eman v’rachaman ata.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הָאֵל הַנֶּאֱמָן בְּכָל דְּבָרָיו.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, ha’El hane’eman b’chol d’varav.

blocks.he: רַחֵם עַל צִיּוֹן כִּי הִיא בֵּית חַיֵּינוּ, וְלַעֲלוּבַת נֶפֶשׁ תּוֹשִׁיעַ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Rachem al Tziyon ki hi beit chayeinu, v’la’aluvat nefesh toshia bimheira v’yameinu.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְשַׂמֵּחַ צִיּוֹן בְּבָנֶיהָ.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, m’sameach Tziyon b’vaneha.

blocks.he: שַׂמְּחֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא עַבְדֶּךָ, וּבְמַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד מְשִׁיחֶךָ, בִּמְהֵרָה יָבוֹא וְיָגֵל לִבֵּנוּ. עַל כִּסְאוֹ לֹא יֵשֵׁב זָר, וְלֹא יִנְחֲלוּ עוֹד אֲחֵרִים אֶת כְּבוֹדוֹ, כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשְׁךָ נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לּוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יִכְבֶּה נֵרוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Sam’cheinu Adonai Eloheinu b’Eliyahu hanavi avdecha, uvmalchut beit David m’shichecha, bimheira yavo v’yagel libeinu. Al kis’o lo yeishev zar, v’lo yinchalu od acherim et k’vodo, ki v’shem kodsh’cha nishbata lo shelo yichbeh nero l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: עַל הַתּוֹרָה וְעַל הָעֲבוֹדָה וְעַל הַנְּבִיאִים (וְעַל יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה) וְעַל יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה, שֶׁנָּתַתָּ לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ (לִקְדֻשָּׁה וְלִמְנוּחָה) לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָרֶת. עַל הַכֹּל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ וּמְבָרְכִים אוֹתָךְ, יִתְבָּרַךְ שִׁמְךָ בְּפִי כָּל חַי תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, וּדְבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד.
blocks.tr: Al haTora v’al ha’avoda v’al han’vi’im (v’al yom haShabbat hazeh) v’al yom haZikaron hazeh, shenatata lanu Adonai Eloheinu (likdusha v’limnucha) l’chavod ultif’aret. Al hakol Adonai Eloheinu anachnu modim lach umvar’chim otach, yitbarach shimcha b’fi kol chai tamid l’olam va’ed, ud’varcha emet v’kayam la’ad.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ)יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, melech al kol ha’aretz, m’kadesh (haShabbat v’)Yisra’el v’Yom haZikaron.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe — Rock of all worlds, just in every generation, the faithful God who says and does, who speaks and fulfills, whose every word is truth and justice.

You are faithful, Eternal our God, and Your words are faithful; not one of Your words comes back empty — for You are God, faithful and merciful. Blessed are You, Eternal One, the God faithful in every word.
Have compassion on Zion, for it is the home of our life; rescue the crushed spirit, soon, in our own days. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who gladdens Zion in her children.

Gladden us, Eternal our God, with Elijah the prophet, Your servant, and with the reign of the house of David, Your anointed; may it come soon and bring joy to our hearts. Let no stranger sit upon his throne, let no others inherit his glory — for by Your holy Name You swore his lamp would never go dark. Blessed are You, Eternal One, shield of David.

For the Torah, and the offering, and the prophets, (and for this day of Shabbat,) and for this Day of Remembrance that You gave us, Eternal our God, (for holiness and for rest,) for honor and for beauty — for all of it, HaShem our God, we thank You and bless You. May Your Name be blessed in the mouth of all that lives, always, forever; and Your word is truth, enduring forever. Blessed are You, Eternal One over all the earth, who makes holy (Shabbat and) Yisrael and the Day of Remembrance.

sources.name: Y’halelu
aliases: The Torah lifted to go home — one last call and answer.
openingWords: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְיָ, כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ.
Y’hal’lu et shem Adonai, ki nisgav sh’mo l’vado.
הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם, וַיָּרֶם קֶרֶן לְעַמּוֹ, תְּהִלָּה לְכׇל־חֲסִידָיו, לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם קְרֹבוֹ,
Hodo al eretz v’shamayim, vayarem keren l’amo, t’hila l’chol chasidav, livnei Yisra’el
Let them praise the name of the Eternal — for that name
Its splendor is over earth and sky. God raised up a horn

blocks.he: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְיָ, כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Y’hal’lu et shem Adonai, ki nisgav sh’mo l’vado.

blocks.he: הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם, וַיָּרֶם קֶרֶן לְעַמּוֹ, תְּהִלָּה לְכׇל־חֲסִידָיו, לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם קְרֹבוֹ, הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
blocks.tr: Hodo al eretz v’shamayim, vayarem keren l’amo, t’hila l’chol chasidav, livnei Yisra’el am k’rovo, hal’luyah.

blocks.en: Let them praise the name of the Eternal — for that name alone is exalted.
Its splendor is over earth and sky. God raised up a horn for this people — a song of praise for all the faithful, for the children of Yisrael, the people close to God. Halleluyah.

sources.name: Uv’nucho Yomar
aliases: The pageantry of the Torah’s reluctant return to the ark
openingWords: וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר: שׁוּבָה יְיָ רִבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל. קוּמָה יְיָ לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ, אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן
Uvnucho yomar: Shuva Adonai riv’vot alfei Yisra’el. Kuma Adonai limnuchatecha, ata va’aron
As it came to rest, Moses would say: Return, Eternal One, to

blocks.he: וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר: שׁוּבָה יְיָ רִבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל. קוּמָה יְיָ לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ, אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּךָ. כֹּהֲנֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ צֶדֶק, וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ. בַּעֲבוּר דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ אַל תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Uvnucho yomar: Shuva Adonai riv’vot alfei Yisra’el. Kuma Adonai limnuchatecha, ata va’aron uzecha. Kohanecha yilb’shu tzedek, vachasidecha y’raneinu. Ba’avur David avdecha al tashev p’nei m’shichecha.

blocks.en: As it came to rest, Moses would say: Return, Eternal One, to the countless thousands of Yisrael. Rise, Eternal One, to Your resting place — You and the ark of Your strength. Let Your priests be clothed in righteousness, and Your faithful sing for joy. For the sake of David Your servant, do not turn away the face of Your anointed.

Ki lekach tov natati lachem, Torati al ta’azovu.
