For I have given you a good teaching — do not abandon
It is a tree of life to those who hold fast to

blocks.he: כִּי לֶקַח טוֹב נָתַתִּי לָכֶם, תּוֹרָתִי אַל תַּעֲזֹבוּ.
blocks.tr: Ki lekach tov natati lachem, Torati al ta’azovu.

blocks.he: עֵץ־חַיִּים הִיא לַמַּחֲזִיקִים בָּהּ, וְתֹמְכֶיהָ מְאֻשָּׁר. דְּרָכֶיהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹעַם, וְכׇל־נְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ שָׁלוֹם.
blocks.tr: Etz chayim hi lamachazikim bah, v’tom’cheha m’ushar. D’racheha darchei noam, v’chol n’tivoteha shalom.

blocks.he: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה, חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם.
blocks.tr: Hashiveinu Adonai eilecha v’nashuva, chadesh yameinu k’kedem.

blocks.en: For I have given you a good teaching — do not abandon My Torah.
It is a tree of life to those who hold fast to it, and all who uphold it are happy. Its ways are ways of pleasantness, and all its paths are peace.
Turn us back to You, Eternal One, and we will return — make our days new, as of old.

sources.name: Psalm 47
aliases: A traditional psalm before the shofar.
openingWords: This psalm is sung before the shofar is sounded.
לַמְנַצֵּחַ ׀ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃ כׇּל־הָעַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָף הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים בְּקוֹל רִנָּה׃ כִּי־יְיָ עֶלְיוֹן
Lamnatzeach livnei Korach mizmor. Kol ha’amim tik’u chaf, hari’u leiElohim b’kol rina.
יַדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּינוּ וּלְאֻמִּים תַּחַת רַגְלֵינוּ׃ יִבְחַר־לָנוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֶת־גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר־אָהֵב סֶלָה׃
Yadber amim tachteinu, ul’umim tachat ragleinu. Yivchar lanu et nachalateinu, et g’on
עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְיָ בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃ זַמְּרוּ אֱלֹהִים זַמֵּרוּ זַמְּרוּ לְמַלְכֵּנוּ זַמֵּרוּ׃
Ala Elohim bitru’a, Adonai b’kol shofar. Zamru Elohim zameiru, zamru l’malkeinu zameiru.
כִּי מֶלֶךְ כׇּל־הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּיל׃ מָלַךְ אֱלֹהִים עַל־גּוֹיִם אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁב ׀

blocks.en: This psalm is sung before the shofar is sounded.

blocks.he: לַמְנַצֵּחַ ׀ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃ כׇּל־הָעַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָף הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים בְּקוֹל רִנָּה׃ כִּי־יְיָ עֶלְיוֹן נוֹרָא מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כׇּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
blocks.tr: Lamnatzeach livnei Korach mizmor. Kol ha’amim tik’u chaf, hari’u leiElohim b’kol rina. Ki Adonai elyon nora, melech gadol al kol ha’aretz.

blocks.he: יַדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּינוּ וּלְאֻמִּים תַּחַת רַגְלֵינוּ׃ יִבְחַר־לָנוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֶת־גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר־אָהֵב סֶלָה׃
blocks.tr: Yadber amim tachteinu, ul’umim tachat ragleinu. Yivchar lanu et nachalateinu, et g’on Ya’akov asher ahev sela.

blocks.he: עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְיָ בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃ זַמְּרוּ אֱלֹהִים זַמֵּרוּ זַמְּרוּ לְמַלְכֵּנוּ זַמֵּרוּ׃
blocks.tr: Ala Elohim bitru’a, Adonai b’kol shofar. Zamru Elohim zameiru, zamru l’malkeinu zameiru.

blocks.he: כִּי מֶלֶךְ כׇּל־הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּיל׃ מָלַךְ אֱלֹהִים עַל־גּוֹיִם אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁב ׀ עַל־כִּסֵּא קׇדְשׁוֹ׃
blocks.tr: Ki melech kol ha’aretz Elohim, zamru maskil. Malach Elohim al goyim, Elohim yashav al kisei kodsho.

blocks.he: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים ׀ נֶאֱסָפוּ עַם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם כִּי לֵאלֹהִים מָגִנֵּי־אֶרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלָה׃
blocks.tr: N’divei amim ne’esafu am Elohei Avraham, ki leiElohim maginei eretz, m’od na’ala.

blocks.en: For the leader — a psalm of the Korahites. All you peoples, clap your hands; raise a shout to God with a voice of song. For the Eternal Most High is awesome, great Sovereign over all the earth — who subdues peoples beneath us, nations beneath our feet; who chose our portion for us, the pride of Jacob, beloved. Selah. God has risen amid the blast; the Eternal, at the sound of the shofar. Sing to God, sing; sing to our Sovereign, sing. For God is Sovereign of all the earth — sing a song of insight. God reigns over the nations; God is seated on a holy throne. The generous of the peoples are gathered, the people of the God of Abraham — for the shields of the earth belong to God, who is very highly exalted.

blocks.he: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם. וַאֲנַחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
blocks.tr: Aleinu l’shabeach la’adon hakol, latet g’dula l’yotzer b’reshit, shelo asanu k’goyei ha’aratzot, v’lo samanu k’mishp’chot ha’adama; shelo sam chelkeinu kahem, v’goraleinu k’chol hamonam. Va’anachnu kor’im umishtachavim umodim, lifnei melech malchei ham’lachim, haKadosh baruch hu.

blocks.he: שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים. הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּנוּ אֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ, כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת, אֵין עוֹד.
blocks.tr: Shehu noteh shamayim v’yosed aretz, umoshav y’karo bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo b’govhei m’romim. Hu Eloheinu ein od, emet malkeinu efes zulato, kakatuv b’torato: v’yadata hayom vahashevota el l’vavecha, ki Adonai hu ha’Elohim bashamayim mima’al v’al ha’aretz mitachat, ein od.

blocks.en: It is upon us to acknowledge the Oneness of Creation, and to celebrate the majesty of it all — we who were not made like the nations of the lands, nor set like the families of the earth; whose portion is not theirs, whose lot is our own. And so we bend, and bow, and give thanks before what is beyond every power, the Holy One of blessing.

The heavens stretched wide, the earth set on its foundations, glory and strength filling the highest heights — this is our God; there is no other. As it is written in the Torah: Know this day and take it to heart, that the Eternal is God in the heavens above and on the earth below; there is no other.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ)יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, melech al kol ha’aretz, m’kadesh (haShabbat v’)Yisra’el v’Yom haZikaron.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal One, greater than all the earth, who makes holy (Shabbat and) Yisrael and the Day of Remembrance.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ קוֹל שׁוֹפָר.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai Eloheinu melech ha’olam, asher kid’shanu b’mitzvotav v’tzivanu lishmo’a kol shofar.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who calls us toward holiness as we hear the voice of the shofar.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁהֶחֱיָנוּ וְקִיְּמָנוּ וְהִגִּיעָנוּ לַזְּמַן הַזֶּה.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha’olam, shehecheyanu v’kiy’manu v’higi’anu lazman hazeh.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who has kept us alive, sustained us, and brought us to this moment.

blocks.he: אַתָּה זוֹכֵר מַעֲשֵׂה עוֹלָם וּפוֹקֵד כָּל־יְצֽוּרֵי קֶֽדֶם. לְפָנֶֽיךָ נִגְלוּ כָּל־תַּעֲלוּמוֹת וַהֲמוֹן נִסְתָּרוֹת שֶׁמִּבְּרֵאשִׁית. כִּי אֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ. וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ: אַתָּה זוֹכֵר אֶת כָּל הַמִּפְעָל. וְגַם כָּל־הַיְצוּר לֹא נִכְחַד מִמֶּֽךָּ. הַכֹּל גָּלוּי וְיָדֽוּעַ לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ. צוֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט עַד סוֹף כָּל הַדּוֹרוֹת. כִּי תָבִיא חֹק זִכָּרוֹן לְהִפָּקֵד כָּל רֽוּחַ וָנָֽפֶשׁ. לְהִזָּכֵר מַעֲשִׂים רַבִּים וַהֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת לְאֵין תַּכְלִית. מֵרֵאשִׁית כָּזֹאת הוֹדָֽעְתָּ. וּמִלְּפָנִים אוֹתָהּ גִּלִּֽיתָ.
blocks.tr: Ata zocher ma’aseh olam, ufoked kol y’tzurei kedem. L’fanecha niglu kol ta’alumot vahamon nistarot shemibb’reshit. Ki ein shich’cha lifnei chise ch’vodecha, v’ein nistar mineged einecha. Ata zocher et kol hamif’al, v’gam kol hay’tzur lo nichchad mimeka. Hakol galui v’yadua l’fanecha, Adonai Eloheinu, tzofeh umabit ad sof kol hadorot. Ki tavi chok zikaron l’hipaked kol ruach vanafesh, l’hizacher ma’asim rabim vahamon b’riyot l’ein tachlit. Mereshit kazot hoda’ta, umil’fanim otah gilita.

blocks.en: You remember the making of the world and call to account all that was formed of old. Before You every hidden thing is revealed, the multitude of secrets since the beginning — for there is no forgetting before Your throne of glory, and nothing is hidden from Your sight. You remember every deed, and no creature is concealed from You; all is revealed and known before You, Eternal our God, who watches and beholds to the very end of all generations. For You set a statute of remembrance, when every spirit and soul is called to account, when countless deeds and creatures beyond number are recalled. From the beginning You made this known, and long ago You revealed it.

blocks.he: זֶה הַיּוֹם תְּחִלַּת מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ זִכָּרוֹן לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן. כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב: וְעַל הַמְּדִינוֹת בּוֹ יֵאָמֵר אֵי זוֹ לַחֶֽרֶב. וְאֵי זוֹ לַשָּׁלוֹם. אֵי זוֹ לָרָעָב. וְאֵי זוֹ לַשּׂוֹבַע. וּבְרִיּוֹת בּוֹ יִפָּקֵֽדוּ. לְהַזְכִּירָם לַחַיִּים וְלַמָּֽוֶת: מִי לֹא נִפְקָד כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה. כִּי זֵֽכֶר כָּל הַיְּצוּר לְפָנֶֽיךָ בָּא. מַעֲשֵׂה אִישׁ וּפְקֻדָּתוֹ. וַעֲלִילוֹת מִצְעֲדֵי גָֽבֶר. מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם וְתַחְבּוּלוֹתָיו וְיִצְרֵי מַעַלְלֵי אִישׁ: אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁכָּחֶֽךָּ. וּבֶן אָדָם יִתְאַמֶּץ בָּךְ. כִּי דוֹרְשֶֽׁיךָ לְעוֹלָם לֹא יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ. וְלֹא יִכָּלְמוּ לָנֶֽצַח כָּל הַחוֹסִים בָּךְ: כִּי זֵֽכֶר כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים לְפָנֶֽיךָ בָּא וְאַתָּה דוֹרֵשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה כֻלָּם:
blocks.tr: Zeh hayom t’chilat ma’asecha, zikaron l’yom rishon, ki chok l’Yisra’el hu, mishpat lelohei Ya’akov. V’al ham’dinot bo ye’amer: ei zo lacherev v’ei zo lashalom, ei zo lara’av v’ei zo lasova. Uvriyot bo yipakedu l’hazkiram lachayim v’lamavet. Mi lo nifkad k’hayom hazeh, ki zecher kol hay’tzur l’fanecha ba: ma’aseh ish ufkudato, va’alilot mitz’adei gaver, machsh’vot adam v’tachbulotav v’yitzrei ma’al’lei ish. Ashrei ish shelo yishkachecha, uven adam yit’ametz bach, ki dor’shecha l’olam lo yikashelu, v’lo yikal’mu lanetzach kol hachosim bach. Ki zecher kol hama’asim l’fanecha ba, v’ata doresh ma’aseh chulam.

blocks.en: This is the day that begins Your work, a remembrance of the first day — a statute for Yisrael, a judgment of the God of Jacob. Concerning the nations, on this day it is told which is destined for the sword and which for peace, which for famine and which for plenty; and creatures are called to account upon it, remembered for life or for death. Who is not called to account as on this day? — for the memory of all that is formed comes before You: each person's deed and destiny, the acts and footsteps of every mortal, the thoughts of a human being, all their schemes, and the impulses behind their deeds. Happy the one who does not forget You, the child of earth who takes strength in You; for those who seek You will never stumble, and those who take refuge in You will never be shamed. For the memory of every deed comes before You, and You inquire into the doing of them all.
Blessed are You, Eternal One, who remembers the covenant.

blocks.he: אַתָּה נִגְלֵֽיתָ בַּעֲנַן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ עַל עַם קָדְשֶׁךָ לְדַבֵּר עִמָּם. מִן הַשָּׁמַֽיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּם קוֹלֶֽךָ וְנִגְלֵֽיתָ עֲלֵיהֶם בְּעַרְפְלֵי טֹֽהַר. גַּם (כָּל) הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ חָל מִפָּנֶֽיךָ וּבְרִיּוֹת בְּרֵאשִׁית חָרְדוּ מִמֶּֽךָּ בְּהִגָּלוֹתְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עַל־הַר סִינַי לְלַמֵּד לְעַמְּךָ תּוֹרָה וּמִצְווֹת. וַתַּשְׁמִיעֵם אֶת הוֹד קוֹלֶֽךָ וְדִבְּרוֹת קָדְשְׁךָ מִלַּהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ. בְּקוֹלוֹת וּבְרָקִים עֲלֵיהֶם נִגְלֵֽיתָ וּבְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר עֲלֵיהֶם הוֹפָֽעְתָּ: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ, וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיֹת הַבֹּֽקֶר וַיְהִי קֹלֹת וּבְרָקִים וְעָנָן כָּבֵד עַל הָהָר וְקֹל שֹׁפָר חָזָק מְאֹד וַיֶּחֱרַד כָּל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה:
blocks.tr: Ata nigleita ba’anan k’vodecha al am kodsh’cha l’daber imam. Min hashamayim hishmatam kolecha, v’nigleita aleihem b’arflei tohar. Gam (kol) ha’olam kulo chal mipanecha, uvriyot b’reshit char’du mimeka b’higalot’cha malkeinu al har Sinai l’lamed l’am’cha Torah umitzvot. Vatashmi’em et hod kolecha v’dibrot kodsh’cha milahavot esh. B’kolot uvrakim aleihem nigleita, uvkol shofar aleihem hofa’ta. Kakatuv b’toratecha: Vay’hi vayom hash’lishi bihyot haboker, vay’hi kolot uvrakim v’anan kaved al hahar, v’kol shofar chazak m’od, vayecherad kol ha’am asher bamachaneh.

blocks.en: You revealed Yourself in the cloud of Your glory to Your holy people, to speak with them. From the heavens You made them hear Your voice, and revealed Yourself to them in clouds of purity. The whole world, too, trembled before You, and the creatures of the beginning shook in awe of You, when You were revealed to us on Mount Sinai — to teach Your people Torah and mitzvot. You made them hear the majesty of Your voice, Your holy words out of flames of fire. In thunder and lightning You were revealed to them, and in the sound of the shofar You shone forth upon them. As it is written in Your Torah: 'And on the third day, as morning broke, there was thunder and lightning and a heavy cloud on the mountain, and a very strong shofar-sound, and all the people in the camp trembled.'

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמַר וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאֹד מֹשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר וְהָאֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶֽנּוּ בְקוֹל:
blocks.tr: V’ne’emar: Vay’hi kol hashofar holech v’chazek m’od, Moshe y’daber v’ha’Elohim ya’anenu v’kol.

blocks.en: And it is said: 'And the sound of the shofar grew steadily stronger; Moses spoke, and God answered him in a voice.'

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמַר וְכָל הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת הַקּוֹלֹת וְאֶת הַלַּפִּידִם וְאֵת קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וְאֶת הָהָר עָשֵׁן וַיַּרְא הָעָם וַיָּנֻֽעוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מֵרָחֹק:
blocks.tr: V’ne’emar: V’chol ha’am ro’im et hakolot v’et halapidim v’et kol hashofar v’et hahar ashen, vayar ha’am vayanu’u vaya’amdu merachok.

blocks.en: And it is said: 'And all the people saw the thunder and the flames and the sound of the shofar and the mountain smoking; the people saw, and they trembled and stood at a distance.'

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵֽעַ קוֹל תְּרוּעַת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרַחֲמִים.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, shomea kol teruat amo Yisra’el b’rachamim.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal One, who hears the sound of the shofar-cry of Your people Yisrael, in mercy.

sources.name: Hayom Harat Olam · Shofarot
aliases: After each blast: today the world is born, and we stand before it.

אֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתֵינוּ יֶעֱרַב לְפָנֶיךָ, אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא, מֵבִין וּמַאֲזִין, מַבִּיט וּמַקְשִׁיב לְקוֹל

blocks.he: הַיּוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם, הַיּוֹם יַעֲמִיד בַּמִּשְׁפָּט כָּל יְצוּרֵי עוֹלָמִים. אִם כְּבָנִים, אִם כַּעֲבָדִים. אִם כְּבָנִים רַחֲמֵנוּ כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים. וְאִם כַּעֲבָדִים עֵינֵינוּ לְךָ תְלוּיוֹת, עַד שֶׁתְּחָנֵּנוּ וְתוֹצִיא כָאוֹר מִשְׁפָּטֵנוּ, אָיוֹם קָדוֹשׁ.
blocks.tr: Hayom harat olam, hayom ya’amid bamishpat kol y’tzurei olamim. Im k’vanim, im ka’avadim. Im k’vanim, rachameinu k’rachem av al banim. V’im ka’avadim, eineinu l’cha t’luyot, ad shet’chaneinu v’totzi cha’or mishpateinu, ayom kadosh.

blocks.en: Today, the world is born. Today, all its creatures stand in judgment. If as children: have mercy on us, as a parent has mercy on their children. If as servants: our eyes are turned to You, waiting — until You are gracious, and bring our judgment forth, clear as light — awesome and holy One.

blocks.he: אֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתֵינוּ יֶעֱרַב לְפָנֶיךָ, אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא, מֵבִין וּמַאֲזִין, מַבִּיט וּמַקְשִׁיב לְקוֹל תְּקִיעָתֵנוּ, וּתְקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן סֵדֶר שׁוֹפְרוֹתֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Areshet s’fateinu ye’erav l’fanecha, El ram v’nisa, mevin uma’azin, mabit umakshiv l’kol t’ki’ateinu, ut’kabel b’rachamim uvratzon seder shofroteinu.

blocks.en: Let the word of our lips be sweet before You — high and lifted-up God, who understands and listens, watches and hears the sound of our shofar — and receive, in mercy and favor, our order of shofar-verses.

sources.name: Hayom T’am’tzeinu
aliases: Eight short askings, each answered Amen — the morning narrows, at the last, to one word: today.

blocks.en: Today, make us strong.
Today, bless us.
Today, help us grow.
Today, seek us out for good.
Today, renew for us a good year.
Today, hear our cry.

blocks.he: הַיּוֹם תְּקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Hayom t’kabel b’rachamim uvratzon et t’filateinu.

blocks.en: Today, receive our prayer with compassion and with favor.
Today, hold us up with Your right hand of justice.
Amen.

אַתָּה הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ. אַתָּה הוּא אֲדוֹנֵינוּ. אַתָּה הוּא מַלְכֵּנוּ. אַתָּה הוּא מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
Ata hu Eloheinu, ata hu Adoneinu, ata hu Malkeinu, ata hu Moshi’einu.

blocks.he: אֵין כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ. אֵין כַּאדוֹנֵינוּ. אֵין כְּמַלְכֵּנוּ. אֵין כְּמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. מִי כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ. מִי כַאדוֹנֵינוּ. מִי כְמַלְכֵּנוּ. מִי כְמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Ein keloheinu, ein kadoneinu, ein k’malkeinu, ein k’moshi’einu. Mi cheloheinu, mi chadoneinu, mi ch’malkeinu, mi ch’moshi’einu.

blocks.en: There is none like our God, none like our Source, none like our Shelter, none like the One who saves us. Who is like our God, like our Source, like our Shelter, like the One who saves us?

blocks.he: נוֹדֶה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ. נוֹדֶה לַאדוֹנֵינוּ. נוֹדֶה לְמַלְכֵּנוּ. נוֹדֶה לְמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ אֲדוֹנֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ מַלְכֵּנוּ. בָּרוּךְ מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Nodeh leloheinu, nodeh ladoneinu, nodeh l’malkeinu, nodeh l’moshi’einu. Baruch Eloheinu, baruch Adoneinu, baruch Malkeinu, baruch Moshi’einu.

blocks.en: We give thanks to our God, to our Source, to our Shelter, to the One who saves us. Blessed is our God, our Source, our Shelter, the One who saves us.

blocks.he: אַתָּה הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ. אַתָּה הוּא אֲדוֹנֵינוּ. אַתָּה הוּא מַלְכֵּנוּ. אַתָּה הוּא מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ.
blocks.tr: Ata hu Eloheinu, ata hu Adoneinu, ata hu Malkeinu, ata hu Moshi’einu.

blocks.en: You are our God, our Source, our Shelter, the One who saves us.

blocks.he: אַתָּה הוּא שֶׁהִקְטִירוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים.
blocks.tr: Ata hu shehiktiru avoteinu l’fanecha et k’toret hasamim.

blocks.en: You are the One before whom our ancestors burned the incense of spices.

sources.name: Aleinu
aliases: Born as a coronation song, a fantasy of power spoken from powerlessness.
openingWords: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת
Aleinu l’shabeach la’adon hakol, latet g’dula l’yotzer b’reshit, shelo asanu k’goyei ha’aratzot,
It is upon us to acknowledge the Oneness of Creation, and to
שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי
Shehu noteh shamayim v’yosed aretz, umoshav y’karo bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo b’govhei
The heavens stretched wide, the earth set on its foundations, glory and
עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים
Al ken n’kaveh l’cha Adonai Eloheinu, lir’ot m’hera b’tif’eret uzecha, l’ha’avir gilulim

blocks.he: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם. וַאֲנַחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
blocks.tr: Aleinu l’shabeach la’adon hakol, latet g’dula l’yotzer b’reshit, shelo asanu k’goyei ha’aratzot, v’lo samanu k’mishp’chot ha’adama; shelo sam chelkeinu kahem, v’goraleinu k’chol hamonam. Va’anachnu °kor’im umishtachavim umodim, lifnei melech malchei ham’lachim, haKadosh baruch hu.

blocks.en: It is upon us to acknowledge the Oneness of Creation, and to celebrate the majesty of it all — we who were not made like the nations of the lands, nor set like the families of the earth; whose portion is not theirs, whose lot is our own. And so we bend, and bow, and give thanks before what is beyond every power, the Holy One of blessing.

blocks.he: שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים. הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּנוּ אֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ, כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת, אֵין עוֹד.
blocks.tr: Shehu noteh shamayim v’yosed aretz, umoshav y’karo bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo b’govhei m’romim. Hu Eloheinu ein od, emet malkeinu efes zulato, kakatuv b’torato: v’yadata hayom vahashevota el l’vavecha, ki Adonai hu ha’Elohim bashamayim mima’al v’al ha’aretz mitachat, ein od.

blocks.en: The heavens stretched wide, the earth set on its foundations, glory and strength filling the highest heights — this is our God; there is no other. As it is written in the Torah: Know this day and take it to heart, that the Eternal is God in the heavens above and on the earth below; there is no other.

blocks.he: עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן, לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי. וְכָל בְּנֵי בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶךָ, לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶיךָ כָּל רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Al ken n’kaveh l’cha Adonai Eloheinu, lir’ot m’hera b’tif’eret uzecha, l’ha’avir gilulim min ha’aretz, v’ha’elilim karot yikaretun, l’taken olam b’malchut Shaddai. V’chol b’nei vasar yikr’u vishmecha, l’hafnot eilecha kol rish’ei aretz.

blocks.he: יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל כִּי לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל בֶּרֶךְ, תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל לָשׁוֹן. לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפֹּלוּ, וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּנוּ, וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם אֶת עֹל מַלְכוּתֶךָ, וְתִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ: יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Yakiru v’yed’u kol yosh’vei tevel, ki l’cha tichra kol berech, tishava kol lashon. L’fanecha Adonai Eloheinu yichr’u v’yipolu, v’lichvod shimcha y’kar yitenu, vikab’lu chulam et ol malchutecha, v’timloch aleihem m’hera l’olam va’ed. Ki hamalchut shel’cha hi, ul’olmei ad timloch b’chavod, kakatuv b’toratecha: Adonai yimloch l’olam va’ed.

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמַר: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד.
blocks.tr: V’ne’emar: v’haya Adonai l’melech al kol ha’aretz, bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad ushmo echad.

blocks.en: And so we hope in You, the Eternal our God: soon to see the splendor of Your strength, when every idol and false god is swept from the earth, and the world is mended whole in the oneness of the Almighty. All who live will call on Your Name, and earth’s wrongdoers will turn back to You. Let the world come to know that every knee bends and every tongue swears true before You. Before You, Eternal our God, may all bow low, honor Your Name, and take on together the obligation of Oneness, soon and always. All is Yours, and forever You endure in glory, as it is written in Your Torah: The Eternal will reign forever and ever. And it is said: the Eternal shall be sovereign over all the earth; on that day the Eternal shall be One, and the Name One.

sources.name: Mourner’s Kaddish
aliases: Mourners rise; the community answers, and no one grieves alone.
openingWords: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ, וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן
Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon
May the great Name be made great and holy in the world
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.
May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity.
יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא,
Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu,

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ, וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon uvyomeichon uvchayei d’chol beit Yisra’el, ba’agala uvizman kariv, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great Name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Yisrael, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.en: May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא, לְעֵלָּא וּלְעֵלָּא מִכָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’eila ul’eila mikol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the Name of the Holy One of blessing — far, far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא, וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’lama raba min sh’maya, v’chayim aleinu v’al kol Yisra’el, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May great peace from heaven, and life, be upon us and upon all Yisrael — and say: Amen.

blocks.he: עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו, הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ, וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Oseh hashalom bimromav, hu ya’aseh shalom aleinu, v’al kol Yisra’el, v’al kol yosh’vei tevel, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the One who makes the peace in the high places make peace for us, for all Yisrael, and for all who dwell on earth — and say: Amen.

sources.name: Shehecheyanu
aliases: Day two: a fruit not yet tasted, and a blessing for arriving at a beginning.

Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha’olam, borei p’ri ha’etz.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁהֶחֱיָנוּ וְקִיְּמָנוּ וְהִגִּיעָנוּ לַזְּמַן הַזֶּה.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, Creator of the fruit of the tree.
Blessed are You, Eternal our God, Source of the universe, who has kept us alive, sustained us, and brought us to this moment.

sources.name: Birkat Kohanim
aliases: Birkat Kohanim, the traditional blessing of the priests.
openingWords: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה
Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, bar’cheinu bab’racha ham’shuleshet baTorah, hak’tuva al y’dei Moshe
Our God and God of our ancestors — bless us with the
יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ, הָאֲמוּרָה מִפִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו כֹּהֲנִים עַם קְדוֹשֶׁךָ, כָּאָמוּר:
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, bar’cheinu bab’racha ham’shuleshet baTorah, hak’tuva al y’dei Moshe avdecha, ha’amura mipi Aharon uvanav kohanim am k’doshecha, ka’amur:

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors — bless us with the threefold blessing of the Torah, written by the hand of Moses Your servant, spoken by Aaron and his sons, the priests, Your holy people, as it is said:

blocks.he: יִשָּׂ֨א יְיָ֤ ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
blocks.tr: Yisa Adonai panav eilecha v’yasem l’cha shalom.

blocks.en: May the Eternal bless you and keep you. May the Holy One’s face shine upon you and be gracious to you. May HaShem’s face turn toward you and grant you peace.

aliases: The service ends the way it began: in song, the melody carrying us out, night after night.

V’hu echad v’ein sheni, l’hamshil lo l’hachbira. B’li reshit b’li tachlit, v’lo
וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה. וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי,

blocks.en: Psalm 27 is said here — p. .

blocks.he: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא. לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא.
blocks.tr: Adon olam asher malach, b’terem kol y’tzir nivra. L’et na’asa v’cheftzo kol, azai melech sh’mo nikra.

blocks.he: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא. וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה.
blocks.tr: V’acharei kichlot hakol, l’vado yimloch nora. V’hu haya v’hu hoveh, v’hu yihyeh b’tif’ara.

blocks.he: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּירָה. בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה.
blocks.tr: V’hu echad v’ein sheni, l’hamshil lo l’hachbira. B’li reshit b’li tachlit, v’lo ha’oz v’hamisra.

blocks.he: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה. וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא.
blocks.tr: V’hu Eli v’chai go’ali, v’tzur chevli b’et tzara. V’hu nisi umanos li, m’nat kosi b’yom ekra.

blocks.he: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִירָה. וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, יְיָ לִי וְלֹא אִירָא.
blocks.tr: B’yado afkid ruchi, b’et ishan v’a’ira. V’im ruchi g’viyati, Adonai li v’lo ira.

blocks.en: Eternal One of all, who was before any form was created; when all was made by Your will, then was Your name made known.
And after all has ceased to be, You alone endure, beyond all awe. You were, You are, You will be in glory.
You are One; there is no second to compare or set beside You. Without beginning, without end — Yours is the strength, and Yours all that is.
You are my God, my living Redeemer, my Rock in time of trouble; my banner, my refuge, the portion of my cup on the day I call.
Into Your hand I entrust my spirit, when I sleep and when I wake; and with my spirit, my body too — the Eternal is with me, I will not fear.

sources.name: Yigdal
aliases: Maimonides’ thirteen principles, set to song.
openingWords: יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים חַי וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח, נִמְצָא וְאֵין עֵת אֶל מְצִיאוּתוֹ.
Yigdal Elohim chai v’yishtabach, nimtza v’ein et el m’tzi’uto.
אֶחָד וְאֵין יָחִיד כְּיִחוּדוֹ, נֶעְלָם וְגַם אֵין סוֹף לְאַחְדוּתוֹ.
Echad v’ein yachid k’yichudo, ne’elam v’gam ein sof l’achduto.
Great is the living God, and praised: existing, beyond any moment we
אֵין לוֹ דְמוּת הַגּוּף וְאֵינוֹ גוּף, לֹא נַעֲרֹךְ אֵלָיו קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ.
Ein lo d’mut haguf v’eino guf, lo na’aroch elav k’dushato.
קַדְמוֹן לְכָל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִבְרָא, רִאשׁוֹן וְאֵין רֵאשִׁית לְרֵאשִׁיתוֹ.

blocks.he: יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים חַי וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח, נִמְצָא וְאֵין עֵת אֶל מְצִיאוּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Yigdal Elohim chai v’yishtabach, nimtza v’ein et el m’tzi’uto.

blocks.he: אֶחָד וְאֵין יָחִיד כְּיִחוּדוֹ, נֶעְלָם וְגַם אֵין סוֹף לְאַחְדוּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Echad v’ein yachid k’yichudo, ne’elam v’gam ein sof l’achduto.

blocks.en: Great is the living God, and praised: existing, beyond any moment we could bound. One, and there is no oneness like that oneness — hidden, and endless in Your unity.

blocks.he: אֵין לוֹ דְמוּת הַגּוּף וְאֵינוֹ גוּף, לֹא נַעֲרֹךְ אֵלָיו קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Ein lo d’mut haguf v’eino guf, lo na’aroch elav k’dushato.

blocks.he: קַדְמוֹן לְכָל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִבְרָא, רִאשׁוֹן וְאֵין רֵאשִׁית לְרֵאשִׁיתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Kadmon l’chol davar asher nivra, rishon v’ein reishit l’reishito.

blocks.en: You have no bodily form and are not a body; nothing can measure Your holiness. Before all that was created, first — with no beginning to Your beginning.

blocks.he: הִנּוֹ אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם לְכָל נוֹצָר, יוֹרֶה גְדֻלָּתוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Hino adon olam l’chol notzar, yoreh g’dulato umalchuto.

blocks.he: שֶׁפַע נְבוּאָתוֹ נְתָנוֹ, אֶל אַנְשֵׁי סְגֻלָּתוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ.
blocks.tr: Shefa n’vu’ato n’tano, el anshei s’gulato v’tif’arto.

blocks.en: Behold, the Eternal of the world, to every creature teaching Your greatness and Your endless reach. You poured out the gift of prophecy upon the people of Your treasure and Your splendor.

blocks.he: לֹא קָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמֹשֶׁה עוֹד, נָבִיא וּמַבִּיט אֶת תְּמוּנָתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Lo kam b’Yisra’el k’Moshe od, navi umabit et t’munato.

blocks.he: תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת נָתַן לְעַמּוֹ אֵל, עַל יַד נְבִיאוֹ נֶאֱמַן בֵּיתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Torat emet natan l’amo El, al yad n’vio ne’eman beito.

blocks.en: None arose in Yisrael like Moses again — a prophet who beheld Your very likeness. A Torah of truth You gave Your people, through Your prophet, the trusted one of Your house.

blocks.he: לֹא יַחֲלִיף הָאֵל וְלֹא יָמִיר דָּתוֹ, לְעוֹלָמִים לְזוּלָתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Lo yachalif ha’El v’lo yamir dato, l’olamim l’zulato.

blocks.he: צוֹפֶה וְיוֹדֵעַ סְתָרֵינוּ, מַבִּיט לְסוֹף דָּבָר בְּקַדְמוּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Tzofeh v’yodea s’tareinu, mabit l’sof davar b’kadmuto.

blocks.en: God will not exchange nor alter that teaching — never, for any other. You watch and know our secrets, seeing the end of a thing in its beginning.

blocks.he: גּוֹמֵל לְאִישׁ חֶסֶד כְּמִפְעָלוֹ, נוֹתֵן לְרָשָׁע רַע כְּרִשְׁעָתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Gomel l’ish chesed k’mif’alo, noten l’rasha ra k’rish’ato.

blocks.en: You reward the good according to their deeds, and repay the wicked their evil according to their wickedness.

blocks.he: יִשְׁלַח לְקֵץ הַיָּמִין מְשִׁיחֵנוּ, לִפְדּוֹת מְחַכֵּי קֵץ יְשׁוּעָתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Yishlach l’ketz hayamin m’shicheinu, lifdot m’chakei ketz y’shu’ato.

blocks.en: At the end of days You will send our messiah, to redeem those who wait for the end of Your deliverance.

blocks.he: מֵתִים יְחַיֶּה אֵל בְּרֹב חַסְדּוֹ, בָּרוּךְ עֲדֵי עַד שֵׁם תְּהִלָּתוֹ.
blocks.tr: Meitim y’chayeh El b’rov chasdo, baruch adei ad shem t’hilato.

blocks.en: God will revive the dead, in the fullness of divine love — blessed forever is the Name of that praise.

sources.name: Ashrei
aliases: An acrostic of joy — one of the earliest Jewish liturgies.
openingWords: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ, עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה. אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ, אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם
Ashrei yoshvei veitecha, od y’hal’lucha sela. Ashrei ha’am shekacha lo, ashrei ha’am
Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they never stop praising
תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ, וַאֲבָרְכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. בְּכׇל־יוֹם אֲבָרְכֶךָּ, וַאֲהַלְלָה
T’hila l’David. Aromimcha Elohai hamelech, va’avarcha shimcha l’olam va’ed. B’chol yom avarcheka,
A song of praise, of David. I will lift You high, my
זֵכֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ, וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ. חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ, אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדׇל־חָסֶד. טוֹב־יְיָ
Zecher rav tuvcha yabi’u, v’tzidkatcha y’ranenu. Chanun v’rachum Adonai, erech apayim ugdol-chased.

blocks.he: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ, עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה. אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ, אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיְיָ אֱלֹהָיו.
blocks.tr: Ashrei yoshvei veitecha, od y’hal’lucha sela. Ashrei ha’am shekacha lo, ashrei ha’am she’Adonai Elohav.

blocks.en: Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they never stop praising You. Selah. Happy the people for whom it is so; happy the people whose God is the One.

blocks.he: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ, וַאֲבָרְכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. בְּכׇל־יוֹם אֲבָרְכֶךָּ, וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. גָּדוֹל יְיָ וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד, וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵקֶר. דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ. הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶךָ, וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה. וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְאֹתֶיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ, וּגְדֻלָּתְךָ אֲסַפְּרֶנָּה.
blocks.tr: T’hila l’David. Aromimcha Elohai hamelech, va’avarcha shimcha l’olam va’ed. B’chol yom avarcheka, va’ahalela shimcha l’olam va’ed. Gadol Adonai umhulal m’od, v’ligdulato ein cheker. Dor l’dor y’shabach ma’asecha, ugvurotecha yagidu. Hadar k’vod hodecha, v’divrei niflotecha asicha. Ve’ezuz nor’otecha yomeru, ugdulatcha asaprena.

blocks.en: A song of praise, of David. I will lift You high, my God, my Sovereign, and bless Your Name forever and ever. Every day I will bless You, and praise Your Name forever and ever. Great is the One, and greatly to be praised; that greatness is beyond all searching out. One generation praises Your works to the next, and tells of Your mighty acts. On the glorious splendor of Your majesty, and Your wondrous deeds, I will meditate. They will speak of the might of Your awesome acts, and I will recount Your greatness.

blocks.he: זֵכֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ, וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ. חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ, אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדׇל־חָסֶד. טוֹב־יְיָ לַכֹּל, וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כׇּל־מַעֲשָׂיו. יוֹדוּךָ יְיָ כׇּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְבָרְכוּכָה. כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ יֹאמֵרוּ, וּגְבוּרָתְךָ יְדַבֵּרוּ.
blocks.tr: Zecher rav tuvcha yabi’u, v’tzidkatcha y’ranenu. Chanun v’rachum Adonai, erech apayim ugdol-chased. Tov Adonai lakol, v’rachamav al kol ma’asav. Yoducha Adonai kol ma’asecha, vachasidecha y’varchucha. K’vod malchutcha yomeru, ugvuratcha y’daberu.

blocks.en: They will pour out the memory of Your abundant goodness, and sing of Your justice. Gracious and compassionate is the One, slow to anger and great in love. The One is good to all, and that mercy rests upon all creation. All Your works will thank You, and the faithful will bless You. They will tell the glory of Your reign, and speak of Your power —

blocks.he: לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו, וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ. מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כׇּל־עֹלָמִים, וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכׇל־דּוֹר וָדֹר. סוֹמֵךְ יְיָ לְכׇל־הַנֹּפְלִים, וְזוֹקֵף לְכׇל־הַכְּפוּפִים. עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּ, וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אׇכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ. פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת־יָדֶךָ, וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכׇל־חַי רָצוֹן. צַדִּיק יְיָ בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָיו, וְחָסִיד בְּכׇל־מַעֲשָׂיו.
blocks.tr: L’hodia livnei ha’adam g’vurotav, uchvod hadar malchuto. Malchutcha malchut kol olamim, umemshaltcha b’chol dor vador. Somech Adonai l’chol hanoflim, v’zokef l’chol hak’fufim. Einei chol eilecha y’saberu, v’ata noten lahem et ochlam b’ito. Poteach et yadecha, umasbia l’chol chai ratzon. Tzadik Adonai b’chol d’rachav, v’chasid b’chol ma’asav.

blocks.en: to make known to all people those mighty acts, and the glorious splendor of that reign. Your reign is a reign for all worlds, and Your rule endures through every generation. The One holds up all who fall, and lifts up all who are bowed down. The eyes of all look to You in hope, and You give them their food in its season. You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing. The One is just in all those ways, and faithful in all those deeds.

blocks.he: קָרוֹב יְיָ לְכׇל־קֹרְאָיו, לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת. רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה, וְאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם. שׁוֹמֵר יְיָ אֶת־כׇּל־אֹהֲבָיו, וְאֵת כׇּל־הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד. תְּהִלַּת יְיָ יְדַבֶּר־פִּי, וִיבָרֵךְ כׇּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קׇדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
blocks.tr: Karov Adonai l’chol kor’av, l’chol asher yikra’uhu ve’emet. R’tzon y’re’av ya’ase, v’et shav’atam yishma v’yoshi’em. Shomer Adonai et kol ohavav, v’et kol har’sha’im yashmid. T’hilat Adonai y’daber pi, vivarech kol basar shem kodsho l’olam va’ed.

blocks.en: The One is near to all who call — to all who call out in truth. The One fulfills the longing of those who are in awe, hears their cry, and saves them. The One watches over all who love, but all the wicked will be destroyed. My mouth will speak the praise of the One; let all flesh bless that holy name, forever and ever.

blocks.he: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם, הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
blocks.tr: Va’anachnu n’varech Yah, me’ata v’ad olam, hal’lu-Yah.

blocks.en: And we will bless Yah, from now and forever. Halleluyah.
On Shabbat: the week’s portion is read before the Amidah, in three aliyot.
The blessings are on p. and p. .

sources.name: Chatzi Kaddish
aliases: A seam in the service. One movement closes, and the next begins.
openingWords: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן
Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.
יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu,
May the great Name be made great and holy in the world
May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed

blocks.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא. (אָמֵן.) בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitgadal v’yitkadash sh’meh raba. (Amen.) B’alma di v’ra chir’uteh, v’yamlich malchuteh b’chayeichon uvyomeichon uvchayei d’chol beit Yisra’el, ba’agala uvizman kariv, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.
blocks.tr: Y’he sh’meh raba m’varach l’alam ulalmei almaya.

blocks.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵלָּא וּלְעֵלָּא מִכָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחָמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
blocks.tr: Yitbarach v’yishtabach v’yitpa’ar v’yitromam v’yitnase v’yit’hadar v’yit’aleh v’yit’halal sh’meh d’kudsha b’rich hu, l’eila ul’eila mikol birchata v’shirata, tushb’chata v’nechamata da’amiran b’alma, v’imru: Amen.

blocks.en: May the great Name be made great and holy in the world that was created by divine will. May a world made whole take hold in your lifetime and in your days and in the life of all the house of Yisrael, swiftly and soon — and say: Amen.

May the great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted, raised and honored, uplifted and celebrated be the Name of the Holy One of blessing — far, far beyond any blessing or song, any praise or consolation that can be spoken in the world — and say: Amen.

sources.name: The Amidah
aliases: Three steps forward, as if entering a small room.
openingWords: אֲדֹנָי, שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
Adonai, s’fatai tiftach, ufi yagid t’hilatecha.
Adonai, open my lips, that my mouth may declare Your praise.

blocks.he: אֲדֹנָי, שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Adonai, s’fatai tiftach, ufi yagid t’hilatecha.

blocks.en: Adonai, open my lips, that my mouth may declare Your praise.

sources.name: Avot v’Imahot
aliases: We stand in a court we inherited — connection to the past becomes the day’s first plea: remember us for life.

Ha’El hagadol hagibor v’hanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, v’koneh hakol, v’zocher

blocks.he: זָכְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים, מֶלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים, וְכָתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים, לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים.
blocks.tr: Zochreinu l’chayim, melech chafetz bachayim, v’chotveinu b’sefer hachayim, l’ma’ancha Elohim chayim.

blocks.he: מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם וְעֶזְרַת שָׂרָה.
blocks.tr: Melech ozer umoshi’a umagen. Baruch ata Adonai, magen Avraham v’ezrat Sara.

blocks.en: Blessed are You, Eternal our God, God of our ancestors — God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; God of Sarah, God of Rebecca, God of Leah, God of Rachel, God of Bilhah, and God of Zilpah.

Great, mighty, and awesome God, God Most High, who acts with love, who creates all, who remembers the faithfulness of our ancestors, and who lovingly brings redemption to their children’s children for the sake of Your Name.
Remember us for life, You who delight in life, and write us in the Book of Life — for Your own sake, Source of life.
You are our help, our rescue, our shield. Blessed are You, Eternal One, shield of Abraham and help of Sarah.

Who is like You, Source of mercy, who in compassion remembers Your

blocks.he: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ. מוֹרִיד הַטָּל.
blocks.tr: Ata gibor l’olam Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/meitim ata, rav l’hoshi’a. Morid hatal.

blocks.he: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים, סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים, וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת, וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה.
blocks.tr: M’chalkel chayim b’chesed, m’chayeh hakol/meitim b’rachamim rabim, somech nof’lim, v’rofe cholim, umatir asurim, umkayem emunato lishenei afar. Mi chamocha ba’al g’vurot, umi domeh lach, melech memit umchayeh umatzmi’ach y’shu’a.

blocks.en: You are forever mighty; You give life to all / revive the dead, and Your saving power is great. You cause the dew to fall. You sustain the living with love, giving life to all / reviving the dead with great compassion; You hold up the falling, heal the sick, free the captive, and keep faith with those who sleep in the dust.

blocks.he: מִי כָמוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים, זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לְחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים.
blocks.tr: Mi chamocha av harachamim, zocher y’tzurav l’chayim b’rachamim.

blocks.en: Who is like You, Source of mercy, who in compassion remembers Your creatures for life?

blocks.he: וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת הַכֹּל/מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל/הַמֵּתִים.
blocks.tr: V’ne’eman ata l’hachayot hakol/meitim. Baruch ata Adonai, m’chayeh hakol/hameitim.

blocks.en: Who is like You, Source of all power? Who can compare — You who bring death and life, and make rescue blossom? You are faithful to give life to all / to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who gives life to all / who revives the dead.

blocks.he: נְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בָּעוֹלָם כְּשֵׁם שֶׁמַּקְדִּישִׁים אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁמֵי מָרוֹם. כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ. וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל זֶה וְאָמַר:
blocks.tr: Nekadesh et shimcha ba’olam, k’shem shemakdishim oto bishmei marom, kakatuv al yad n’vi’echa: v’kara zeh el zeh v’amar:

blocks.he: קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ.
blocks.tr: Kadosh, kadosh, kadosh Adonai tz’va’ot, m’lo chol ha’aretz k’vodo.

blocks.he: אָז בְּקוֹל רַֽעַשׁ גָּדוֹל אַדִּיר וְחָזָק מַשְׁמִיעִים קוֹל מִתְנַשְּׂאִים לְעֻמַּת שְׂרָפִים. לְעֻמָּתָם בָּרוּךְ יֹאמֵֽרוּ:
blocks.tr: Az b’kol ra’ash gadol adir v’chazak mashmi’im kol, mitnas’im l’umat s’rafim, l’umatam baruch yomeru:

blocks.he: מִמְּקוֹמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תוֹפִֽיעַ וְתִמְלוֹךְ עָלֵֽינוּ כִּי מְחַכִּים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ מָתַי תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּצִיּוֹן בְּקָרוֹב בְּיָמֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד תִּשְׁכּוֹן. תִּתְגַּדַּל וְתִתְקַדַּשׁ בְּתוֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִירְךָ לְדוֹר וָדוֹר וּלְנֵֽצַח נְצָחִים. וְעֵינֵֽינוּ תִרְאֶֽינָה מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ כַּדָּבָר הָאָמוּר בְּשִׁירֵי עֻזֶּֽךָ עַל יְדֵי דָוִד מְשִֽׁיחַ צִדְקֶֽךָ:
blocks.tr: Mim’komcha malkeinu tofi’a v’timloch aleinu, ki m’chakim anachnu lach. Matai timloch b’Tziyon? B’karov b’yameinu, l’olam va’ed tishkon. Titgadal v’titkadash b’toch Yerushalayim ircha l’dor vador ulnetzach n’tzachim. V’eineinu tir’ena malchutecha, kadavar ha’amur b’shirei uzecha al y’dei David m’shiach tzidkecha:

blocks.he: יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ.
blocks.tr: Yimloch Adonai l’olam, Elohayich Tziyon l’dor vador, hal’luyah.

blocks.he: לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נַגִּיד גָּדְלֶֽךָ וּלְנֵֽצַח נְצָחִים קְדֻשָּׁתְךָ נַקְדִּישׁ וְשִׁבְחֲךָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מִפִּֽינוּ לֹא יָמוּשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ אָֽתָּה.
blocks.tr: L’dor vador nagid godlecha, ulnetzach n’tzachim k’dushatcha nakdish, v’shivchacha Eloheinu mipinu lo yamush l’olam va’ed, ki El melech gadol v’kadosh ata.

blocks.en: We make Your Name holy in the world as they make it holy in the heights of heaven, as Your prophet wrote: and they called out, one to another, and said:
Holy, holy, holy is the Source of all being; the fullness of the whole earth is that glory.
Then, with the sound of a great roar, mighty and strong, they raise their voices, lifting toward the seraphim, and facing them say: Blessed —
Blessed is the glory of the Eternal, from its place.

From Your place, appear to us — for we are waiting for You. When will that day come to Zion? Soon, in our own days — dwell there forever. Be magnified and made holy within Yerushalayim Your city, from generation to generation, for all time. May our own eyes see the world made whole, as the word is sung in the songs of Your strength, by the hand of David, Your anointed of justice:
The Eternal will reign forever — your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.
From generation to generation we will tell Your greatness, and for all time make holy Your holiness; Your praise, our God, will never leave our mouths, for You are a great and holy God.

sources.name: Uv’chein
aliases: Awe and hope for a world made whole.
openingWords: וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל מַה

And so: set the awe of You, Eternal our God, over all
וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יְיָ לְעַמֶּךָ, תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶיךָ וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶׁיךָ וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה
Uvchein ten kavod Adonai l’amecha, t’hila lire’echa v’tikva tova l’dor’shecha ufitchon peh
And so: give honor, Eternal One, to Your people, praise to those
וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹזוּ, וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִילוּ, וְעוֹלָתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּיהָ,
Uvchein tzadikim yir’u v’yismachu, visharim ya’alozu, vachasidim b’rina yagilu, v’olata tikpotz piha,

blocks.he: וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ. וְיִירָאוּךָ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים, וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם. כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַעְנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁהַשִּׁלְטוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ, עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶךָ, וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ.
blocks.tr: Uvchein ten pachd’cha Adonai Eloheinu al kol ma’asecha, v’eimat’cha al kol ma shebarata. V’yira’ucha kol hama’asim v’yishtachavu l’fanecha kol hab’ru’im, v’ye’asu chulam aguda achat la’asot r’tzon’cha b’levav shalem. K’mo sheyadanu Adonai Eloheinu shehashilton l’fanecha, oz b’yad’cha ugvura biminecha, v’shimcha nora al kol ma shebarata.

blocks.en: And so: set the awe of You, Eternal our God, over all You have made, and the awe of You over all You have created — that every made thing hold You in awe and all creatures bow before You, and that they all become one company, to do Your will with a whole heart. For we know, Eternal our God, that the governing is Yours — strength in Your hand and power in Your right hand — and Your Name is awesome over all You have made.

blocks.he: וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יְיָ לְעַמֶּךָ, תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶיךָ וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶׁיךָ וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה לַמְיַחֲלִים לָךְ. שִׂמְחָה לְאַרְצֶךָ וְשָׂשׂוֹן לְעִירֶךָ, וּצְמִיחַת קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדֶּךָ וַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחֶךָ, בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ.
blocks.tr: Uvchein ten kavod Adonai l’amecha, t’hila lire’echa v’tikva tova l’dor’shecha ufitchon peh lamyachalim lach. Simcha l’artzecha v’sason l’irecha, utzmichat keren l’David avdecha va’arichat ner l’ven Yishai m’shichecha, bimheira v’yameinu.

blocks.en: And so: give honor, Eternal One, to Your people, praise to those who hold You in awe and good hope to those who seek You, and an open mouth to those who wait for You — joy to Your land and gladness to Your city, and the flowering of new strength for the line of David Your servant, soon, in our own days.

blocks.he: וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹזוּ, וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִילוּ, וְעוֹלָתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּיהָ, וְכָל הָרִשְׁעָה כֻּלָּהּ כְּעָשָׁן תִּכְלֶה, כִּי תַעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן הָאָרֶץ.
blocks.tr: Uvchein tzadikim yir’u v’yismachu, visharim ya’alozu, vachasidim b’rina yagilu, v’olata tikpotz piha, v’chol harish’a kula k’ashan tichleh, ki ta’avir memshelet zadon min ha’aretz.

blocks.he: וְתִמְלוֹךְ אַתָּה יְיָ לְבַדֶּךָ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ, בְּהַר צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ, וּבִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ: יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם, אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר, הַלְלוּיָהּ.
blocks.tr: V’timloch ata Adonai l’vadecha al kol ma’asecha, b’har Tziyon mishkan k’vodecha, uvirushalayim ir kodshecha, kakatuv b’divrei kodshecha: yimloch Adonai l’olam, Elohayich Tziyon l’dor vador, hal’luyah.

blocks.en: And so: the just will see and be glad, the upright will rejoice, the faithful will delight in song — and wrongdoing will shut its mouth, and all wickedness will vanish like smoke, when You clear the rule of arrogance from the earth. And You alone, Eternal One, will be the Oneness over all You have made, on Mount Zion, the dwelling of Your glory, and in Yerushalayim, Your holy city — as it is written: The Eternal will reign forever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.

blocks.he: קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֶךָ, וְאֵין אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ. כַּכָּתוּב: וַיִּגְבַּהּ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט, וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדָּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה.
blocks.tr: Kadosh ata v'nora sh'mecha, v'ein eloah mibal'adecha. Kakatuv: vayigbah Adonai tz'va'ot bamishpat, v'ha'El hakadosh nikdash bitzdaka.

blocks.en: You are holy, and Your Name inspires awe, and there is no god but You — as it is written: “the Source of all being is exalted through justice, and the holy God is hallowed through righteousness.” (Isaiah 5:16)
Blessed are You, Eternal One, the holy Sovereign.

sources.name: K’dushat HaYom
aliases: The blessing that names the day: Yom HaZikaron, the Day of Remembrance.
openingWords: אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ, וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת, וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ
Ata v’chartanu mikol ha’amim, ahavta otanu v’ratzita banu, v’romamtanu mikol hal’shonot, v’kidashtanu

Vatiten lanu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava (et yom haShabbat hazeh v’) et yom
And You gave us, Eternal our God, in love (this Shabbat day

Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, ya’aleh v’yavo v’yagia v’yera’eh v’yeratzeh v’yishama v’yipaked v’yizacher

blocks.he: אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ, וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת, וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ, וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ.
blocks.tr: Ata v’chartanu mikol ha’amim, ahavta otanu v’ratzita banu, v’romamtanu mikol hal’shonot, v’kidashtanu b’mitzvotecha, v’keiravtanu malkeinu la’avodatecha, v’shimcha hagadol v’hakadosh aleinu karata.

blocks.en: You chose us from among all peoples, and loved us, and wanted us; You lifted us up among all tongues and made us holy through Your mitzvot, and drew us near to Your service, and called Your great and holy Name over us.

blocks.he: וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה (אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְ) אֶת יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה, יוֹם (זִכְרוֹן) תְּרוּעָה (בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ, זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם.
blocks.tr: Vatiten lanu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava (et yom haShabbat hazeh v’) et yom haZikaron hazeh, yom (zichron) t’ru’a (b’ahava) mikra kodesh, zecher litzi’at Mitzrayim.

blocks.en: And You gave us, Eternal our God, in love (this Shabbat day and) this Day of Remembrance — a day of (the remembrance of) the shofar-blast (in love), a holy calling, a remembrance of the going-out from Egypt.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא וְיַגִּיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר זִכְרוֹנֵנוּ וּפִקְדוֹנֵנוּ, וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ, וְזִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפָנֶיךָ, לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה, לְחֵן וּלְחֶסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים, לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם בְּיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה.
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, ya’aleh v’yavo v’yagia v’yera’eh v’yeratzeh v’yishama v’yipaked v’yizacher zichroneinu ufikdoneinu, v’zichron avoteinu v’imoteinu, v’zichron mashiach ben David avdecha, v’zichron Yerushalayim ir kodshecha, v’zichron kol am’cha beit Yisra’el l’fanecha, lifleita l’tova, l’chein ulchesed ulrachamim, l’chayim ulshalom b’yom haZikaron hazeh.

blocks.he: זָכְרֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה, וּפָקְדֵנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים. וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים חוּס וְחָנֵּנוּ, וְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ, כִּי אֵלֶיךָ עֵינֵינוּ, כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה.
blocks.tr: Zochreinu Adonai Eloheinu bo l’tova, ufokdeinu vo livracha, v’hoshi’einu vo l’chayim. Uvidvar y’shu’a v’rachamim chus v’chaneinu, v’rachem aleinu v’hoshi’einu. Ki eilecha eineinu, ki El melech chanun v’rachum ata.

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors: may there rise and come, reach and be seen, be wanted and heard, counted and remembered — the remembrance of us and of our ancestors, and the remembrance of the anointed one of the house of David Your servant, and the remembrance of Yerushalayim Your holy city, and of all Your people the house of Yisrael — for deliverance and good, for grace and love and mercy, for life and peace, on this Day of Remembrance.

Remember us on it for good; take account of us for blessing; save us for life. And with a word of rescue and mercy, spare us and be gracious to us; have compassion on us and save us. For our eyes are turned to You — You are God, gracious and merciful.

blocks.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ, מְלוֹךְ עַל כָּל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בִּכְבוֹדֶךָ, וְהִנָּשֵׂא עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בִּיקָרֶךָ, וְהוֹפַע בַּהֲדַר גְּאוֹן עֻזֶּךָ עַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל אַרְצֶךָ.
blocks.tr: Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu, m’loch al kol ha’olam kulo bichvodecha, v’hinasei al kol ha’aretz bikarecha, v’hofa bahadar g’on uzecha al kol yoshvei tevel artzecha.

blocks.he: וְיֵדַע כָּל פָּעוּל כִּי אַתָּה פְעַלְתּוֹ, וְיָבִין כָּל יְצוּר כִּי אַתָּה יְצַרְתּוֹ, וְיֹאמַר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׁמָה בְאַפּוֹ: יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶלֶךְ, וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה.
blocks.tr: V’yeda kol pa’ul ki ata f’alto, v’yavin kol y’tzur ki ata y’tzarto, v’yomar kol asher n’shama v’apo: Adonai Elohei Yisra’el melech, umalchuto bakol mashala.

blocks.en: Our God and God of our ancestors: let Your glory fill all the world; be lifted up over all the earth in Your splendor; shine out in the majesty of Your strength over all who dwell on the earth You made —
and let every made thing know that You made it, and every creature understand that You formed it, and all that breathes say: HaShem, God of Yisrael, is One, and that Oneness holds all things.

blocks.he: (אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ.) קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, (וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְיָנוּחוּ בוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ,) וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת, וּדְבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד.
blocks.tr: (Eloheinu ve’lohei avoteinu v’imoteinu r’tzeh vimnuchateinu.) Kad’sheinu b’mitzvotecha v’ten chelkeinu b’toratecha, sab’einu mituvecha v’samcheinu bishu’atecha, (v’hanchileinu Adonai Eloheinu b’ahava uvratzon Shabbat kodshecha, v’yanuchu vo Yisra’el m’kad’shei sh’mecha,) v’taher libeinu l’ovd’cha be’emet, ki ata Elohim emet, ud’varcha emet v’kayam la’ad.

blocks.en: The lines in parentheses are added when Rosh Hashanah falls on Shabbat.

blocks.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ)יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן.
blocks.tr: Baruch ata Adonai, melech al kol ha’aretz, m’kadesh (haShabbat v’)Yisra’el v’Yom haZikaron.

blocks.en: (Our God and God of our ancestors, take pleasure in our rest.) Make us holy through Your mitzvot and give us our portion in Your Torah; fill us with Your goodness and gladden us with Your saving help; (in love and favor, grant us Your holy Shabbat as our inheritance, and let Yisrael, who make Your Name holy, rest on it;) and make our hearts pure to serve You in truth — for You are the God of truth, and Your word is truth, enduring forever. Blessed are You, Eternal One over all the earth, who makes holy (Shabbat and) Yisrael and the Day of Remembrance.

blocks.tr: R’tzeh Adonai Eloheinu b’am’cha Yisra’el. Utfilatam b’ahava t’kabel b’ratzon, ut’hi l’ratzon tamid avodat Yisra’el amecha. El karov l’chol kor’av, p’neh el avadecha v’chaneinu. Sh’foch ruchacha aleinu,

blocks.he: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן.
blocks.tr: V’techezena eineinu b’shuvcha l’Tziyon b’rachamim. Baruch ata Adonai, hamachazir sh’chinato l’Tziyon.

blocks.en: Take pleasure, Eternal our God, in Your people Yisrael and in their prayer; in love receive that prayer with favor, and may the service of Your people Yisrael always be, in truth, for the good. God near to all who call, turn to those who serve You, and be gracious to us. Pour out Your spirit upon us.
May our eyes behold Your loving return to Zion. Blessed are You, Eternal One, who returns Your presence to Zion.

sources.name: Modim
aliases: A blessing of gratitude and a plea that we be written for a good life.
openingWords: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
